jobs.title: Product Associate
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
Join J.P. Morgan's Corporate & Investment Bank Client 360 team to transform how organizational data is managed, governed, and leveraged. Drive innovative, AI-enabled data solutions that enhance accuracy, operational efficiency, and business decision-making.
  
  
As a Product Associate within the Corporate & Investment Bank Client 360 (C360) team, you will be responsible for driving product strategy and execution across entity resolution, organizational profiles, and third-party data integration. You will develop scalable, governed data solutions that improve accuracy, transparency, and operational efficiency. Partnering with cross-functional teams, you will leverage advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI-enabled capabilities to enhance data quality and usability. You will also drive product innovation, stakeholder alignment, and measurable business outcomes across interconnected platforms.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Own product strategy, roadmap, and execution for entity resolution, organizational profiles, and third-party data integration.
* Develop scalable entity resolution capabilities integrating internal and external data sources into a unified, governed organizational dataset.
* Drive AI- and machine learning-enabled solutions to improve matching accuracy, processing efficiency, and operational scalability.
* Design governed challenge-and-override workflows to support data accuracy, feedback management, and consistent decision-making across systems.
* Build diagnostic and explainability capabilities to enhance transparency, identify data quality issues, and support operational decisions.
* Lead organizational profile arbitration, ensuring accurate attribute selection, data lineage, auditability, and governance.
* Drive vendor data integration and data model evolution while maintaining architectural standards and operational controls.
* Establish data quality frameworks, documentation standards, and performance metrics to improve data reliability and usability.
* Evaluate third-party data capabilities and prioritize integrations based on business value, feasibility, and operational readiness.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Data Science, Architecture, Data Governance, and business stakeholders to deliver integrated product solutions.
* Define success metrics, manage dependencies, and communicate product priorities, delivery progress, and risks to senior stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications, Skills And Capabilities**

* Demonstrated product management experience delivering complex, scalable data products or platforms.
* Proven ability to translate business requirements into product strategies, roadmaps, and actionable delivery plans.
* Hands-on experience with entity resolution, identity matching, data mastering, or organizational data management.
* Strong understanding of deterministic matching, machine learning-assisted classification, and high-volume data processing.
* Knowledge of data quality management, entity modeling, metadata, data lineage, and attribute arbitration.
* Ability to evaluate algorithmic performance using precision, recall, processing efficiency, and explainability metrics.
* Experience designing governed data workflows, feedback mechanisms, and operational controls.
* Understanding of data architecture principles, schema management, and third-party data integration.
* Experience collaborating with Engineering, Data Science, and AI/ML teams on data-driven product solutions.
* Strong product execution capabilities, including roadmap prioritization, backlog management, and dependency resolution.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, analytical, and cross-functional leadership skills.

**Preferred Qualifications, Skills And Capabilities**

* Experience delivering data products within financial services, particularly Corporate & Investment Banking.
* Exposure to enterprise-wide data platforms supporting multiple business lines and interconnected systems.
* Experience implementing AI-enabled or agent-based capabilities within production data environments.
* Familiarity with human-in-the-loop AI workflows, model evaluation, and AI governance frameworks.
* Knowledge of third-party data vendor evaluation, selection, and commercial engagement processes.
* Experience with vendor data normalization, automated onboarding, and scalable integration frameworks.
* Familiarity with organizational reference data and its applications in client onboarding, risk management, and analytics.

**About Us**
JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
  
  
**About The Team**
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Consumer Growth
jobs.description:
**About Rupeek**

Founded in 2015 and headquartered in Bangalore, Rupeek is an asset-backed digital lending fintech making credit more accessible by helping Indians unlock the value of their gold. We combine technology, customer-focused design, and on-ground execution to make borrowing simpler and more convenient.

Rupeek is backed by leading investors including
**Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & Southeast Asia), Accel, Bertelsmann India Investments, and Elevation Capital**
.

Join us to solve meaningful challenges at the intersection of consumer experience, technology, and financial services—with ownership to shape products and see their impact on customers and the business.

**Work directly with leadership:**
Collaborate with
**Sumit Maniyar
, Founder & CEO**
,
**Setu Poddar
, CTO**
, and Rupeek’s business and operations leaders. Gain firsthand exposure to company strategy, contribute to important product decisions, and build products alongside the people shaping Rupeek’s next phase of growth.

**Location:**
Bangalore

**Experience:**
3–5 years in product management

**The opportunity**

**Help more customers discover Rupeek, take their first loan, and choose us again.**

As Product Manager for Consumer Growth, you’ll own growth opportunities across our app and web journeys—from initial discovery and onboarding to conversion, repeat borrowing, and referrals.

You’ll combine customer research, product analytics, and experimentation to make borrowing simpler and more intuitive. Your mandate is to deliver measurable, sustainable growth while building customer confidence at every step.

**What you’ll own**

* **Activation and conversion:**
  Identify where customers hesitate or drop off, and improve the journey from first visit to a successfully disbursed loan.
* **Customer understanding:**
  Use interviews, feedback, funnel analysis, and cohort insights to uncover customer needs and barriers.
* **Growth experimentation:**
  Develop hypotheses, prioritize opportunities, and run A/B tests or pilots with clear success criteria.
* **Retention and repeat usage:**
  Build relevant journeys that bring customers back when they need credit and encourage referrals.
* **Personalized experiences:**
  Partner with business and marketing teams on messaging, offers, and lifecycle engagement that reflect customer needs.
* **End-to-end execution:**
  Work with design, engineering, analytics, and operations to launch improvements, measure results, and scale what works.

**What success looks like**

Better onboarding completion, higher conversion to disbursal, stronger repeat usage and referrals, and improved funnel efficiency—with customer trust, satisfaction, and business economics as guardrails.

**What you’ll bring**

* 3–5 years of product management experience, preferably in consumer technology, fintech, or digital platforms.
* Evidence of improving a customer or business metric through product changes—and a clear explanation of what you learned.
* Strong understanding of funnels, cohorts, retention, and experimentation.
* Hands-on experience with analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, or Google Analytics. SQL proficiency is a plus.
* Strong product judgment: the ability to connect customer needs, user experience, and commercial outcomes.
* Clear communication and the ability to turn ambiguous problems into focused, testable opportunities.
* Experience in onboarding, conversion, lifecycle engagement, or referral products is valuable.

**Why this role**

* **Own measurable growth:**
  Connect your product decisions directly to customer and business outcomes.
* **Solve a meaningful consumer challenge:**
  Make a trust-sensitive financial journey easier to understand and complete.
* **Shape the full customer lifecycle:**
  Work across first-time adoption, engagement, repeat usage, and advocacy.
* **Build and learn:**
  Take ideas from customer insight to experiment to scale product improvement.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
PhonePe is on a mission to change the landscape of digital payments and financial services in India. On this mission, we are committed to hiring the best while creating an environment of equal opportunity and empowerment. As a Senior Product Manager at PhonePe, you will own and drive the roadmap for our platform and user centric products. You will work with other pod members and a diverse set of stakeholders towards a collective set of objectives. We work on complex technology, scale while iterating quickly and have a bias for impact in everything we do.
  
  
**Job Description**

* Identify large problem statements, break them down, and build consumer experiences and platforms to solve them
* Scope and phase product building meaningfully over and above standard use cases.
* Translate pod and product strategy into a crisp, annual roadmap and define measurable

objectives of a suite of products
  
  

* Be the subject matter expert in driving business decisions and fully understand the cost and revenue implications of your product suite.
* Drive annual and quarterly planning and execution cadences across pods.
* Be the thought leader for the product suite and evangelize goals and objectives. Drive alignment

across stakeholders by effectively engaging them with data.
  
  

* Participate in interviews for PM, APM roles and provide inputs for resource planning across

functions.

* Excellent communication skills.
* At least 6+ years of experience in Product / Platform building and development.

data sets.
  
  

* Good with scalable data modeling and abstractions on platform design. Can think over and above traditional use cases.
* Come with a strong point of view on all aspects of the business and balance between a data-backed view and ambiguity.
* Can own output metrics and impact while balancing priorities across pods.

jobs.title: Product Owner - Digital Channels
jobs.description:
**Organization Unit Purpose**

* TBS provides an integrated single window approach for all transactional requirements of its corporate clientele across various segments and sectors such as commercial, government and financial institutions. It aims at assisting them with innovative financing and payment solutions as well as offers the convenience of interacting with the bank, away from traditional means.
* The Transaction Banking team continuously interacts with CFO’s and Treasury Teams of its corporate clients and is committed to build strong relationships by meeting their underlying organizational objectives.

**Position Description:**

Product Owner (PO) is accountable for maximizing the value of the product resulting from the work of the Scrum Team by taking complete ownership of the Product and its delivery across ENBD UAE, Islamic and other international entities as per the product scope owned by the squad PO is a virtual leader of the squad and is product’s representative outside the squad for all functional, technical, operational as well as financial matters

  **web, mobile, Host to Host and API Banking**
  )

jobs.title: Manager-Digital Product Management
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
Global Merchant & Network Services brings together American Express' merchant and network-related businesses, including relationships with merchants, issuers, acquirers, processors, and strategic partners globally.
  
  
The Network Product team develops and delivers secure, resilient, and scalable payment network capabilities. This includes Authorization, Tokenization, Authentication, Digital Wallets, Local Network solutions, and Network-to-Network integrations that support market expansion, regulatory requirements, and global interoperability.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Network Product professional to drive the development and delivery of strategic payment network capabilities. The role requires strong knowledge of payment networks, issuing, acquiring, transaction processing, and digital payments, along with the ability to translate business and partner needs into clear product requirements and executable delivery plans.
  
  
Strong project management, communication, and stakeholder management skills are critical. The individual will coordinate cross-functional workstreams, manage risks and dependencies, drive governance, and communicate progress and decisions effectively to senior leaders, internal teams, and external partners.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute product roadmaps for payment network capabilities aligned with enterprise priorities, market needs, and regulatory requirements.
* Lead end-to-end delivery of capabilities across Authorization, Tokenization, Authentication, Digital Wallets, Local Network solutions, and Network-to-Network integrations.
* Translate business, customer, partner, and regulatory needs into features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and delivery milestones.
* Apply strong understanding of payment networks, issuing, acquiring, processing, transaction flows, and network specifications to guide product decisions.
* Ensure solutions meet intended business outcomes and consider scalability, security, resilience, operational readiness, and interoperability.
* Partner with Engineering and Quality Assurance teams across solution design, development, testing, implementation, and post-launch readiness.
* Maintain integrated delivery plans covering scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, and decisions.
* Coordinate execution across Product, Technology, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and external partner teams.
* Proactively identify delivery risks and blockers, drive mitigation, and escalate matters requiring leadership attention.
* Prepare concise executive updates, dashboards, roadmaps, and governance materials, translating complex topics for technical and non-technical audiences.
* Build trusted relationships and influence decisions across global, cross-functional, and highly matrixed teams.

**Qualifications**
**Minimum Qualification**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business Management, or related field.
* Relevant experience in payment network products, digital payments, product management, network delivery, or payment technology.
* Strong understanding of the payment's ecosystem, including networks, issuers, acquirers, processors, and digital payment providers.
* Knowledge of payment transaction flows and capabilities such as authorization, authentication, tokenization, clearing, and settlement.
* Experience delivering products or capabilities through requirements, development, testing, implementation, and operational readiness.
* Demonstrated project or program management experience across multiple teams, workstreams, risks, and dependencies.
* Ability to translate business requirements into clear product and technical deliverables.
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, executive communication, stakeholder management, influencing, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and highly matrixed environment.

**Preferred Qualification**

* Demonstrated experience working with payment networks, issuers, acquirers, processors, digital wallet providers, or network capability modernization programs is strongly preferred.
* Experience with Authorization, Tokenization, Authentication, SafeKey, Digital Wallets, Local Network solutions, or Network-to-Network integrations.
* Knowledge of card processing, payment message flows, network specifications, and payment operations.
* Experience delivering complex modernization, migration, regulatory, or market-enablement initiatives.
* Experience managing product roadmaps, backlogs, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Experience with Agile or SAFe delivery methodologies and knowledge of Rally, JIRA, Confluence, or similar tools.
* Experience engaging with external network partners, processors, vendors, or payment ecosystem participants.

**About Us**
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
  
  
As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

jobs.title: Product Owner – Card Fraud, Payments & Authentication
jobs.description:
****Job Summary****
Synechron is seeking an experienced
**Product Designer**
to join its Card Fraud squad and shape capabilities that protect customers from card fraud while supporting secure and seamless payment experiences.
  
  
The role will focus on owning the product roadmap and priorities for Card Fraud capabilities, understanding the end-to-end card payment lifecycle, and translating customer, fraud, regulatory, and technology requirements into clear product outcomes.
  
  
The successful candidate will work across Fraud, Cards, Engineering, Operations, Architecture, and external scheme or vendor teams to identify opportunities for fraud detection and prevention across authentication, authorisation, and clearing flows.
  
  
The role will contribute to business objectives by improving fraud prevention, supporting secure payment experiences, reducing customer and business risk, enabling regulatory and scheme readiness, and delivering measurable improvements across card-payment capabilities.
  
  
****Software Requirements****
**Required Software Skills**

* Product management and ownership tools: Experience using tools and practices to manage roadmaps, priorities, backlogs, requirements, acceptance criteria, dependencies, risks, and delivery outcomes.
* Payment and fraud platforms: Understanding of systems supporting card payments, fraud detection, fraud decisioning, transaction monitoring, authentication controls, and fraud prevention.
* Card payment lifecycle: Strong knowledge of authentication, authorisation, and clearing processes.
* Card scheme processes: Strong knowledge of Mastercard and Visa card-scheme payment flows and operating requirements.
* Requirements management: Ability to document product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, process flows, and success measures.
* Roadmap and backlog management: Ability to define, prioritize, maintain, and communicate product roadmaps and delivery priorities.
* Data and reporting: Ability to use product, payment, fraud, operational, and performance information to support prioritization and decision-making.
* Stakeholder collaboration: Experience working with business, technology, operations, architecture, fraud, cards, scheme, and vendor stakeholders.

****Preferred Software Skills****

* Experience with Discover/Diners Club card-scheme payment flows.
* Exposure to real-time transaction monitoring, fraud rules, fraud strategies, authentication controls, or fraud platforms.
* Familiarity with Agile product-management and delivery tools.
* Experience with analytics, dashboards, product-performance reporting, and fraud-related metrics.
* Exposure to regulatory, scheme, and payment-transformation delivery tools and processes.

****Version And Experience Guidance****

* Specific software versions are not mandated in the requirements.
* Candidates should have experience with current product-management, payment, fraud, reporting, and collaboration tools.
* Candidates should be able to assess changes across card-payment systems, scheme requirements, fraud controls, operational processes, and technology dependencies.
* Experience should include practical ownership of product outcomes, roadmap priorities, requirements, delivery decisions, and production optimization.

****Overall Responsibilities****

* Own and drive the product roadmap and priorities for Card Fraud capabilities.
* Translate customer, fraud, regulatory, scheme, operational, and technology requirements into clear product outcomes.
* Define product goals, outcomes, priorities, delivery milestones, acceptance criteria, and success measures.
* Partner closely with Fraud, Cards, Engineering, Operations, Architecture, and external scheme or vendor teams.
* Understand end-to-end card transaction flows and identify where fraud detection and prevention controls can be effectively applied.
* Lead discovery and requirements definition for new fraud capabilities, scheme changes, and card-payment initiatives.
* Define product requirements, user stories, business rules, acceptance criteria, and delivery priorities.
* Manage dependencies, risks, assumptions, constraints, and trade-offs across multiple initiatives and stakeholder groups.
* Assess the impact of authentication, authorisation, and clearing changes on card fraud controls and customer payment experiences.
* Support the design and delivery of fraud detection, fraud decisioning, transaction monitoring, authentication, and prevention capabilities.
* Support production readiness, implementation, rollout, incident response, and ongoing optimization of fraud capabilities.
* Monitor product performance and use evidence to recommend improvements to fraud controls, payment journeys, operational processes, and customer outcomes.
* Coordinate scheme, regulatory, and payment-transformation initiatives where applicable.
* Ensure product decisions consider security, privacy, customer experience, operational feasibility, sustainability, and business value.
* Contribute to measurable outcomes, including improved fraud detection, reduced fraud losses, reduced false positives, improved payment approval rates, improved customer experience, and timely delivery of scheme or regulatory changes.

****Technical Skills (By Category)****
**Programming Languages**
****Essential****

* Ability to understand technical concepts, system behavior, APIs, data flows, integrations, and application dependencies.
* Ability to review technical requirements, solution options, acceptance criteria, and implementation impacts.
* Ability to communicate effectively with engineers, architects, analysts, fraud specialists, and technology teams.
* Ability to interpret payment, fraud, operational, and product data to support decisions.

****Preferred****

* Exposure to SQL, data analysis, or reporting tools.
* Familiarity with scripting or automation used in product analysis, reporting, or validation.
* Understanding of technical concepts related to real-time transaction processing and fraud decisioning.

**Databases/Data Management**
****Essential****

* Understanding of card-transaction, customer, payment, fraud, authentication, authorisation, clearing, and settlement data.
* Ability to assess data requirements for fraud controls, decisioning, transaction monitoring, reporting, and product measurement.
* Understanding of data quality, lineage, access control, protection, retention, and governance.
* Ability to use data and performance measures to assess product outcomes and prioritize improvements.
* Understanding of the impact of data availability, latency, accuracy, and completeness on fraud decisions and payment processing.

****Preferred****

* Exposure to real-time transaction monitoring data and fraud analytics.
* Familiarity with fraud rules, strategies, decision attributes, customer profiles, transaction patterns, and risk indicators.
* Experience with dashboards, data models, reporting tools, and analytical platforms.
* Knowledge of data requirements for card schemes, regulatory reporting, and payment transformation.

**Cloud Technologies**
****Essential****

* Understanding of technology environments that support card payments, fraud platforms, transaction processing, and customer-facing services.
* Ability to consider scalability, availability, security, latency, resilience, monitoring, and operational support in product decisions.
* Understanding of system dependencies across payment, fraud, authentication, authorisation, clearing, and operational platforms.

****Preferred****

* Exposure to cloud-based payment, fraud, analytics, or transaction-monitoring platforms.
* Familiarity with cloud-native services, APIs, real-time processing, event-driven architecture, and distributed systems.
* Understanding of cloud cost management, resource efficiency, and sustainable technology operations.

**Frameworks and Libraries**
****Essential****

* Product management and product ownership frameworks.
* Agil

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
We are looking for an ambitious, systems-thinking, and highly analytical Product Manager to take ownership of our foundational cash management, treasury, and settlement ecosystem. As our transaction volume scales, the complexity of moving money efficiently, securely, and reliably becomes paramount.
  
  
In this role, you will be the driving force behind the core systems that govern optimal liquidity, power seamless financial operations, and establish direct integrations with central payment networks. You will navigate complex regulatory and technical landscapes, starting with optimizing our daily liquidity and settlement operations. Over time, you will spearhead the evolution of this function from an operational backbone into a highly strategic, value-generating engine that optimizes our working capital and financial intelligence.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Drive Core Treasury Platforms: Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for our treasury and liquidity management platforms, translating complex financial workflows into scalable, automated product architectures.
* Optimize Money Movement: Design and launch scalable products that automate fund flows, optimize merchant payouts, and ensure seamless money movement across our internal and external ecosystems.
* Build for System Resilience: Develop highly fault-tolerant platform capabilities that guarantee business continuity, intelligent transaction routing, and systemic resilience against external network or banking outages.
* Enable Financial Intelligence: Create product features and tools that empower our finance and treasury teams with advanced cash flow forecasting, real-time visibility, and strategic capital optimization.
* Manage Complex Integrations: Lead the product strategy for secure and robust API integrations with key financial networks and banking partners to expand our foundational operational capabilities.
* Embed Compliance & Controls: Ensure all treasury products are built with a compliance-first mindset, incorporating automated reconciliation, rigorous financial controls, and seamless auditability.

**Qualifications**

* Experience: 2 to 4 years of proven experience in Product Management, successfully taking complex, backend-heavy products from conception to launch.
* Domain Preference: Prior experience in Fintech, Banking, Payments, or building highly scalable backend platform products is highly preferred (though not a strict requirement for a fast learner with strong fundamentals).
* Technical Acumen: Ability to deeply understand and orchestrate complex transaction flows, messaging architectures, and secure API integrations between internal ledgers and external financial institutions.
* Analytical Rigor: Exceptional data-driven problem-solving skills. You should be comfortable navigating complex financial workflows, large-scale reconciliations, and designing solutions for intricate edge cases.
* Strategic Execution: A strong bias for action with the ability to balance immediate operational requirements with long-term, highly scalable platform architecture.
* Cross-Functional Leadership: Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. You will need to collaborate seamlessly with and influence engineering, finance, treasury operations, and legal/compliance teams.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About mPokket**

Founded in 2016 by Gaurav Jalan, mPokket was born from a simple yet powerful realisation - while global youth enjoyed financial freedom, young Indians faced barriers. We set out to bridge the gap between aspirations and affordability by empowering the youth of Bharat.

At mPokket, we exist to remove the financial friction that stalls potential. We are on a mission to empower Young India, the Aspirants, and the Self-Starters to achieve their dreams with true financial independence.

Today, we bridge that gap by offering quick, dignified, and accessible instant loans up to Rs. 2,00,000. We are proud to be a trusted partner for over 65 million customers, maintaining a 4.6/5 rating on the Google Play Store.

The same belief shapes our commitment to communities, colleagues, and customers. We are a Great Place To Work Certified organisation, committed to high-performing teams, ownership and meaningful impact.

**Job Summary**

**Senior Product Manager**

Own the collections product for mPokket’s lending business. Improve recovery and reduce roll rates and collection costs while making agents more productive and treating borrowers in financial distress with dignity.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Recovery & Roll-Rate Strategy**

Own recovery and roll rates across days-past-due (DPD) buckets, from DPD7 through DPD180+, with a focus on early delinquency.

Use cohort data, borrower interviews and agent observations to identify recovery opportunities. Test early-bucket reminders and improve settlement logic to protect margins.

**2. Cost to Collect & Agent Productivity**

Reduce the cost per rupee recovered by balancing automation, agent capacity and channel mix. Test voice-bot strategies against recovery and cost metrics.

Shadow collections agents and improve workflows, tooling and the way agents record call outcomes.

**3. Borrower Experience & Cross-functional Delivery**

Design collections and repayment journeys that help borrowers in financial distress resolve outstanding balances with dignity.

Work with Risk, Data Science, Collections Operations, Engineering, Compliance and Customer Support to run experiments and deliver product improvements.

**Success in the First Six Months**

Use your own analysis to identify and explain the biggest opportunities to improve recovery.

Run at least one live experiment that meaningfully improves recovery or roll rate.

Shadow agents and fix at least one recurring issue in their workflow.

Build trust with Risk and Collections Operations. Exercise independent judgment and demonstrate the outcome of a decision your manager initially questioned.

**What We’re Looking For**

Take ownership of ambiguous problems. Use data, borrower conversations and agent observations to diagnose the issue and write your own brief.

Build a plan when the next step is unclear. Aim to ship an initial version in two weeks and use the results to decide what to do next.

Interpret cohort data, spot anomalies and ask analysts precise follow-up questions. SQL is optional.

Show empathy for borrowers in financial distress and communicate your product reasoning clearly in writing.

Prior lending or fintech experience is welcome. We provide training in credit, DPD, regulation and collections strategy. An MBA and top-tier consulting experience are optional.

**Selection Process**

Roadmap exercise. Prepare a brief within 48 hours outlining your problem framing, the data you need, your top three ideas and what you would ship in the first two weeks.

Working session. Discuss the brief and explain how you would revise it as new information emerges.

Product discussion. Walk through one product decision that worked and one that did not.

Reference checks. We select references, including a peer, to discuss your ownership and judgment.

**How to Apply**

A 200–400 word note about an ambiguous problem you owned end to end. Explain the problem, your actions, the outcome and what you would do differently.

One writing sample, such as a product requirements document, strategy memo or post-mortem, that shows your reasoning.

Your résumé.

**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced Senior Product Owner to lead the transformation of ideas into seamless, intuitive product experiences. This role requires a strong client focus and business acumen to effectively prioritize and deliver on competing demands. You will inspire and influence cross-functional teams to achieve positive outcomes with executional excellence. If you are a creative problem solver who thrives on tackling complex challenges and building products from inception to scale, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
Key responsibilities include product management, governance, and commercialization activities to support client channel onboarding and the development of scalable digital solutions. Additionally, you will serve as a key point of contact for education, thought leadership, and product expertise related to client channel onboarding.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**

**Processes**

jobs.description:
**About Bright Money**

Bright Money is a Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers. It brings together SaaS products to help consumers build credit, manage their debt, and get access to suitable loans and credit cards. These are the major financial needs of middle-income consumers living paycheck-to-paycheck.

Bright is a profitable, India-built, U.S.-market Consumer FinTech, with revenue trajectory to $100M in the coming 6 months. The business model combines subscription revenue with a financial service marketplace revenues, for loans, credit cards, and credit building tools.

Bright has launched an AI money assistant and AI agentic UX flows for access to credit. It will be the first AI-driven Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers.

The Bright product suite has potential for global markets beyond the US. The market size is 100M global middle-income consumers, with a revenue pool opportunity of $15B.

Bright is backed by 3 top global venture capital firms, and leading tech angel investors in the USA, Europe, and Asia.

Bright was founded in 2019 by a founding team from McKinsey’s Banking Practice (Petko Plachkov and Avi Patchava) and InMobi Data Scientists (Varun Modi and Avi Patchava). The core team is ex-InMobi Engineering and Data Sciences, recently joined by senior leaders from McKinsey. Bright is a data-driven, fast-paced execution culture that will build a Global Consumer FinTech, all functions operating from India.'

**What is the team & role about?**

We are hiring a Platform Product Manager - Banking Platform to own and scale core banking and money-movement platform capabilities that power multiple financial products. This role focuses on bank account lifecycles, payment rails, partner integrations, and regulatory-ready infrastructure, enabling product teams to build reliably and at scale.

This is a senior product leadership role combining deep platform ownership, people management, executive-level communication, and structured problem-solving. You will operate as a trusted partner to Engineering leadership and CXOs, translating complex technical and regulatory challenges into clear decisions and execution plans.

**What will you do?**

**Banking Infrastructure & Money Movement**

* Drive platform capabilities supporting bank account lifecycles and money movement (e.g., ACH equivalents, local bank transfers, instant payments, reconciliation workflows).
* Lead integrations with banking partners, payment processors, and financial infrastructure providers.
* Ensure strong handling of edge cases such as failures, retries, reversals, exceptions, and settlements.

**Compliance, Risk & Resilience**

* Translate regulatory, scheme, and partner constraints into clear platform requirements (e.g., auditability, controls, data retention, reporting).
* Partner with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Operations to ensure controls are embedded into platform design.

**Execution & Delivery**

* Write high-quality PRDs and platform requirements that engineers can execute against with clarity.
* Prioritize across run-the-business work, platform improvements, and new enablement initiatives.
* Lead cross-functional execution across multiple engineering teams.

**Stakeholder & Internal Customer Experience**

* Act as the product owner for internal consumers of the platform (Product, Engineering, Ops).
* Improve developer and internal product team experience through clear APIs, documentation, and self-serve capabilities.
* Communicate progress, risks, and decisions clearly to senior leadership.

**Ideal candidate profile looks like?**

**Experience & Background:**

* 5 - 12 years of Product Management experience, with strong exposure to backend, platform, or infrastructure products.
* Prior people management experience, including mentoring or managing Product Managers
* Exposure to high-scale, high-availability systems with strict SLAs.
* Strong understanding of APIs, distributed systems, data platforms, and cloud architectures.
* Strong systems thinking and technical fluency, comfortable working deeply with engineers on architecture and trade-offs.

**Mindset & Operating DNA:**

* Experience defining and using KPIs/OKRs to drive prioritization and outcomes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proven ability to manage complex dependencies and cross-functional stakeholders.

**Non-Fit Profiles:**

* Domain experts without Platform Ownership experience.
* PMs from Low-Scale or Low-Reliability Environments.
* Product Managers without deep technical depth.
* Pure UI/ UX-First Product Managers.
* Program Manager or Project Managers.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience building internal platforms or developer-facing products.
* Exposure to global-scale, high-availability systems.
* Experience in fintech, banking, payments, or other regulated systems.

**What Bright Offers?**

* A profitable sub-unicorn with U.S. market scale – liquidity potential at $1–3B valuations.

* Wealth creation: Equity at an inflection stage of scale.

**The opportunity**

At Hitachi Energy, we are driving the digital transformation of our global business landscape through robust and scalable ERP solutions. As an ERP Enterprise Architect, you will play a pivotal role in defining and governing the ERP architecture strategy, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture principles and business objectives. You will collaborate with cross-functional architecture teams, delivery organizations, and strategic partners to shape the future ERP landscape, support S/4HANA transformation initiatives, and drive technology standardization across the organization.

This is an exciting opportunity to influence strategic technology decisions, establish architecture best practices, and lead the evolution of a modern, secure, and sustainable ERP ecosystem.

**How you'll make an impact**

* Define, maintain, and continuously evolve ERP architecture principles, standards, reference architectures, and technology roadmaps.
* Ensure ERP architecture alignment with broader enterprise architecture frameworks by collaborating with Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Data, Integration, and Archetype Architecture teams.

* Provide strategic ERP architecture direction and guidance across IT delivery teams and external implementation partners.

* Validate adherence to technology standards, approved platforms, security requirements, and lifecycle management principles.

* Partner with ERP leadership to define ERP roadmaps, release planning, upgrade strategies, and key technology decisions.
* Represent the ERP architecture function in governance boards, steering committees, and strategic decision-making forums.
* Drive ERP technology rationalization, simplification, modernization, and retirement of obsolete technologies.
* Support resolution of complex architectural challenges across internal teams, vendors, and implementation partners.
* Foster architecture governance practices that encourage consistency, scalability, maintainability, and business value realization.
* Lead and mentor senior technical experts while promoting architectural excellence and knowledge sharing across the organization.

**Your background**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 10 years of progressive experience across IT functions within large, geographically distributed global organizations.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in a senior SAP Architecture or SAP Enterprise Architecture leadership role.
* Extensive expertise in SAP Enterprise Architecture across complex, multinational SAP environments.
* Strong experience leading S/4HANA transformation programs and implementing Clean Core architecture principles.
* Deep understanding of SAP technologies including S/4HANA, SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), Integration Suite, and data management solutions.

* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and technology functions.
* Experience managing relationships with SAP, system integrators, and strategic technology partners.
* Excellent communication, influencing, and decision-making skills in complex global environments.
* TOGAF Certification and/or SAP Enterprise Architecture Certification is preferred.
* Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

jobs.title: Hardware Design Engineer
jobs.description:
**Role & responsibilities**

1. Join RENSAR hardware team utilizing your board level design skills to develop digital and analog circuits.

2. Be involved in all phases of board level hardware development in small self-motivated teams.

3. Perform design documentation, component selection, schematic edits, DFMEA, DFM, DFT etc. to ensure that your design is meeting the requirements, is competitive, production friendly and highly reliable.

4. Work with the board layout designers and support the layout by providing design constraints, rules, guidelines and reviews.

5. Validate your design using simulation tools and perform functional quality analysis of your design.

6. Make technical presentations on the details of your design and project status.

7. Interface with customers and field engineers on an as needed basis, helping to resolve field problems while learning more about applications and user habits.

  
  

**Preferred candidate profile**

1. ME / M. tech., BE / B Tech. Electronics & Communication Engineering or equivalent.

2. 3-6 years of thorough hands-on experience of designing boards using 8 / 32-bit boards using MCUs like MSP 430, TMS320, STM32 etc. and analog mixed signal circuits.

3. Strong component engineering knowledge and exposure to semiconductor markets.

4. Strong knowledge of communication protocols like SPI, I2C, Ethernet, RS-232, RS-485 etc.

5. Must have worked with PWB designers to review the board designs for signal integrity, EMI/EMC compliance etc. Should be well versed with DFM / DFT using Cadence development tools.

6. Thorough knowledge of EMC standards like IEC6100, IEC 61526, CISPR 11 etc. and their practical application through out the design life cycle.

7. Hardcore board bring-up & debugging experience using instruments like Logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and in-circuit emulators.

8. Ability to interact and work with external test & certification labs to validate the product compliance.

9. Excellent verbal & written communication in Hindi & English.

10. Ready to travel across the country for gaining field and application knowledge as well as trouble shooting.

11. Should have hands on experience of board Box-up using enclosures made of polymer, sheet metal and castings, enclosures.

12. Strong linguistic skill for documentation of the development efforts.

  

**Desired**

  

1. DSP based design experience.

2. Proven track record with both Analog and high-speed digital designs.

3. Experience with low level analog signal design techniques.

4. Experience designing with programmable logic devices.

5. Software experience to generate diagnostic code (C, C++, and/or assembly language).

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
You are accountable within a project to drive the specifications to conclusions. You are accountable for getting a sign off on the Business Specification Document (BSD). With your input the Engineering manager will start delivering a working system for the customer. You closely work together with the Engineering Manager.
  
  
You lead complex engagements. You are the customer's trusted advisor in creating clarity on the full requirements set for the program. This also is towards the backbase team. You act as an experienced Backbase consultant to clients.
  
  
Based on the defined strategy from the bank and the goal of the program, your job is to proactively support the customer on creating and implementing their omni-channel digital banking transformation vision and strategy.
  
  
You clearly communicate progress, risks, blockers, and dependencies with the core team. You are an experienced consultant who analyzes, captures, and prioritizes customer requirements, identifies product improvements, and defines best practices.
  
  
As a person you are organised, have oversight, know how to finish a job without loose ends and are used to working in a fixed date environment.
  
  
You manage the process of feature requests and maints with PnP.
  
  
**Result Driven**

* Leads the business requirements gathering and completing the specs. He/she owns this full for the project.
* Accountability for the end-to-end quality of functional and technical specifications, including the alignment of UX and Solution Architecture within the signed-off BSD.
* Accountable for thorough and accurate project backlog management in Jira, including scope definition and backlog quality.
* Accountable for creating and signing off on BSD plus managing the CR process that comes out of this. Accountable for writing and organizing user stories and epics, feature requests, and MAINTS (product bug reports).
* Coaching / instructing formatting to others, and ensuring a signed-off Business Specification Document (BSD)/Project Config Sheet.
* Uses AI in a meaningful way to speed up the process. Knows for example how to translate AI generated notes and recordings into specs.
* Capable of giving a Demo on the Backbase Product.

**Communication Skills**

* Manages customer expectations, works closely with customers, and leads engaging workshops.

**Product Knowledge**

* Provides guidance to clients on the best usage of the product as well as customization. Works with Backbase R&D colleagues where customization is necessary to explore out-of-the-box options or recommend enhancements.

**Problem-solving & Analytical Skills**

* Is able to create BSD’s independently.
* Industry knowledge & Business Value:
* Defines essential requirements for customers to achieve their objectives and realize their customer experience vision within the financial industry context.
* Quantifies the value for the customer between solving something in adopt vs build. And takes into account items that may speed up requirements gathering and or development.

**Adaptability**

* Translates customer vision into a sound project backlog and explores out-of-the-box options versus recommended enhancements.
* Strategically applies AI tools across complex business analysis initiatives in order to improve documentation and solution quality, while continuously adapting approaches in a dynamic and fast-changing environment.
* Understanding the Agentic SDLC and how the flows improve month after month.

Creativity
  
  

* Identifies product improvements and defines best practices.

**Leadership Skills**

* Guides the team, acts as the customer’s proxy product owner, and provides some amount of mentoring to Junior Business Analysts.
* Experience: 3-7 years in a similar role.
* Backbase/Banking Experience: 1+ year in Backbase; 3-4 years in Banking or Financial services.
* Domain Knowledge: Seen by their peers as an expert with deep knowledge and understanding of at least one Backbase Line of Business (LOB)
* Methodology: Expert in creating Business Specification Documents (BSD), Epics, User stories and BE tasks. Knowledge of Backbase way of working (delivery hub) and fluent working with our Agentic SDLC.
* Tooling: Expert in Jira, Gemini (or similar LLM), Google sheets / slides and workshopping tools like Miro. Has AI as a default way of working.
* Education: Bachelor’s Degree or higher; IIBA CCB certification.
* Language: Professional working proficiency in English and local language.
* Travel: Willingness to travel according to project need and demand.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Specialist (WT- Contact Center (Ops))
jobs.description:
Leads the strategic vision and roadmap for a digital product or products within a specific business area, demonstrating a deep understanding of the digital product(s). Digital products may have enterprise-wide implications.
  
  
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Product Manager, Specialist role is responsible for leading digital product management initiatives, overseeing the development, implementation, and optimization of strategic products. This role requires close collaboration with cross-functional teams to enhance customer experience, define product roadmaps, and drive business growth. The specialist ensures smooth product execution, manages escalations, and employs data-driven insights to refine product strategies. Additionally, they work with stakeholders to align product goals with business objectives and market needs.
  
  
This Product Manager will lead enhancements to the customer service and contact center tools used by our crew to serve clients, including the integration of AI capabilities
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead digital product management efforts for multiple digital products or one strategic product, ensuring alignment with business goals.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement best practices that enhance the customer experience and drive impactful changes.
* Coach digital product teams on best practices, learnings, and product development methodologies to maximize efficiency.
* Partner with stakeholders to resolve production and implementation issues promptly, supporting escalations when needed to enable rapid delivery.
* Oversee the planning, development, and execution of new digital products, including market analysis, feature definition, and implementation planning.
* Develop pricing and positioning strategies, ensuring products are competitive and aligned with market demand.
* Utilize qualitative and quantitative analysis techniques to continually improve the user experience and optimize product performance.
* Translate product strategy into detailed requirements and prototypes, collaborating with engineering teams to ensure timely and resource-efficient delivery.
* Lead product launches by working closely with marketing teams, executives, and other product management stakeholders to drive successful go-to-market strategies.
* Evaluate promotional plans to ensure consistency with product line strategies and effective messaging across customer segments.
* Participate in ongoing business planning, departmental prioritization activities, and special projects as required.
* Lead the modernization of contact-center desktop capabilities and supporting tools to improve the experience of contact-center staff and participants while enabling stronger customer relationships.
* Coordinate dependencies across multiple applications and product teams by understanding interconnected roadmaps, managing delivery trade-offs, and balancing technical constraints with speed to market.

**Qualifications And Skills**

* Minimum 8 years of related work experience, with at least two years of experience leading large cross-functional teams on major organizational projects.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science or IT, or Bachelor’s in Computer Applications (BCA), or Master’s in Computer Applications (MCA).
* Strong expertise in digital product management, market analysis, and user experience optimization.
* Proven ability to translate customer insights into product improvements and new features.
* Experience working with engineering teams to drive product development from concept to launch.
* Excellent strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities to align product strategy with business goals.
* Experience in a contact-center or service environment, including familiarity with contact-center operations, desktop platforms, and the tools that support customer-service teams.
* Demonstrated ability to manage cross-product dependencies and collaborate with multiple product managers; financial-services experience is preferred but not mandatory, and relevant banking or healthcare customer-service systems experience may be considered.

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
  
  
**Our mission**
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
  
  
**Our commitment to you**
Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
  
  
**Financial wellness**
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
  
  
**Physical wellness**
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
  
  
**Personal wellness**
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
  
  
**How We Work**
Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

jobs.company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
jobs.description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $115 billion in investment capital as of September 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are seeking an enthusiastic, analytical, and resourceful product manager to join our Investment Services Technology team, partnering closely with the Compliance team, based in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram. This position offers the opportunity for broad exposure to the firm’s trading, operations, and software development groups, as well as the chance to manage real-time issues related to the firm’s expanding suite of global investment products in a dynamic, constantly evolving regulatory environment. The role offers an inclusive and dynamic environment, with a focus on improving technology for efficiency, control, and scalability. The ideal candidate will bring exceptional product management fundamentals, experience in process optimization and workflow automation, and the judgment to operate effectively in a highly regulated and confidential environment with diverse stakeholders.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
You will drive technological solutions that support critical compliance functions across the firm, collaborating with cross-functional teams — engineering, design, business, and other front- and back-office partners — to develop and launch new products and features. You will develop and maintain a strategic product roadmap that aligns with the firm's overall goals and evolves continuously based on user feedback, prioritization, and other factors while working with senior leadership in Compliance. **Summary**
**Position Summary**
Senior Delivery Product Owner - Hyderabad
  
  
If you are energized by solving complex business problems through technology and want to help shape the future of global tax delivery, consider joining the US Tax Transformation technology team. This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in Deloitte’s digital transformation by helping bring innovative products, capabilities, and experiences to life for our tax professionals and stakeholders around the world. You will work at the intersection of business, technology, and execution—partnering across teams to support high-impact initiatives that improve how we operate, serve clients, and create value at scale.
  
  
**Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited**
commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all of the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service lines have obtained support through Deloitte Tax in India. Deloitte Tax in India offers you opportunities to learn U.S. taxation, a much sought-after career option.
  
  
we are leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace. We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services and
**add greater impact to clients**
by
**combining technology and tax technical**
resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
As a Delivery Product Owner Lead, you will play an important role in advancing product priorities across Deloitte Tax & Legal’s technology transformation portfolio. You will collaborate closely with Delivery Product Owners, product leadership, business stakeholders, and technology teams to help translate business needs into delivery-ready features, validate quality through detailed review and testing, and support the successful rollout of product capabilities. This role offers the opportunity to contribute across the full product lifecycle—from requirements refinement and acceptance criteria review to prioritization support, deployment readiness, process documentation, and end-user enablement. The required candidate is highly detail-oriented, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and energized by working across teams and domains in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
Additional responsibilities include:
  
  

* Collaborate with Delivery Product Owners and development teams to help refine feature priorities, requirements, acceptance criteria, and expected business outcomes.
* Support prioritization discussions by organizing inputs, surfacing dependencies, and helping evaluate business value, risk, and readiness.
* Collaborate with the Technical Product Owners and broader team on scope, sequencing, sprint planning, feature readiness, deployment preparation, and progress tracking.
* Help build and apply cross-domain knowledge to work effectively across functional areas, connect related impacts and dependencies, and help sustain continuity as priorities evolve.

* Support in executing regular sprint testing, Program Increment testing, and hands-on feature validation to help ensure functionality aligns with product specifications and user needs.

**The Team**
Deloitte Tax LLP's Tax Transformation Office (TTO) is responsible to provide support for the design, development, and deployment of innovative, enterprise technology, tools, and standard processes to support the delivery of tax services. The TTO team focuses on enhancing Deloitte Tax LLP’s ability to provide comprehensive, value-added, and efficient tax services to our clients. It is a dynamic team with professionals of varying backgrounds from tax technical, technology development, change management, Six Sigma, and project management. The team consults and executes on a wide range of initiatives involving process and tool development and implementation including training development, engagement management, tool design, and implementation.
  
  
**Location –**
Hyderabad & Gurugram
  
  
**Shift Time –**
11 am to 8 pm or 2 pm to11 pm IST
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Required 6+ years experience
* 3+ years of experience supporting product delivery, business analysis, project coordination, or technology implementation teams.
* 3+ years supporting large-scale, full-lifecycle system implementation or modernization projects involving complex technical integrations, APIs, and middleware.
* Strong attention to detail, with the ability to review functional requirements, acceptance criteria, and defects thoroughly and identify business impacts, gaps, risks, and dependencies.
* Experience supporting testing activities, validating feature readiness, and contributing to process documentation, learning materials, or end-user enablement resources.
* Ability to synthesize information across stakeholders, modules, and workstreams to support well-informed product and support decisions.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and follow through on execution details.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment, manage ambiguity, and adapt quickly to changing priorities.
* Curiosity, sound judgment, and a proactive mindset for working across teams, identifying issues early, and helping move priorities forward.
* Experience using development, design, and IT service management tools (e.g., Azure DevOps (AzDo), JIRA, ServiceNow, Sketch, Abstract, Figma) for ticketing, feature management, and tracking work across the delivery lifecycle.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams to apply Artificial Intelligence solutions to solve business problems.
* Understanding of LLMs, RAGs, Optical Character Recognition, and how these can be leveraged to solve business problems.

* Agile and project management certifications preferred (e.g., SAFe Agilist, Certified Scrum Master (CSM), PMP, Lean Six Sigma)
* Ability to perform job responsibilities within a hybrid work model that may requires professionals to co-locate in person 2–3 days per week.

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Techdome**
Techdome is a product engineering company that builds AI that works in the real world, not just in demos. Our teams of engineers, designers, and AI specialists deliver LLM applications, RAG systems, AI agents, conversational assistants, and workflow automation for enterprises in FinTech, Healthcare, E-commerce, EdTech, Logistics, and SaaS. Every product we ship is built to pass security reviews, integrate with existing systems, and meet compliance requirements from day one.
  
  
**The Role**
Anyone can get a GenAI prototype working in a week. Getting it to survive a security audit, hold its accuracy under real traffic, and stay profitable at scale is the hard part, and that is the part you will own.
  
  
As a Technical Product Manager at Techdome, you will guide AI products from the first client conversation to launch and beyond. You are the person who spots the vague requirement, the missed handoff, or the lurking risk while fixing it is still cheap.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**
**Shaping the product**

* Turn a client’s rough idea into a clear product definition with scope, milestones, timelines, and budget.
* Understand each client’s industry, regulations, and compliance obligations, and convert them into requirements engineers can build from without guesswork.

**Taking GenAI to production**

* Partner with ML engineers to harden LLM, RAG, agent, and automation prototypes into reliable, scalable, safe systems.
* Define and track the metrics that decide success in production: accuracy, latency, evaluation scores, and cost per query.
* Make sure each AI feature connects to client systems through APIs and meets enterprise standards for security, privacy, and uptime.

**Keeping everyone aligned**

* Coordinate UI/UX, frontend, backend, mobile, QA, DevOps, and business analysts so every handoff is explicit and nothing falls through.
* Plan team capacity and keep every party accountable to their commitments.
* Manage relationships with partners such as LLM and cloud providers.

**Managing risk and communication**

* Run formal change control whenever scope, timeline, or budget shifts.
* Surface delivery, technical, and AI-specific risks early: hallucinations, prompt injection, data leakage, bias, and runaway costs.
* Track progress in JIRA or Azure DevOps and keep clients and leadership informed, with no surprises.
* Use AI tools yourself to speed up documentation, planning, tracking, and reporting.

**What You Bring**
**Must have**

* 2+ years as a Product Manager delivering complex enterprise software on time and on budget.
* Hands-on GenAI experience, ideally shipping an LLM, RAG, or agent-based product, with a practical grasp of the AI lifecycle and its risks.
* A record of leading cross-functional teams across design, engineering, QA, and DevOps.
* Working knowledge of Agile (Scrum/Kanban) and Waterfall, and tools like JIRA, Azure DevOps, Trello, or Asana.
* Enough technical depth in the SDLC, APIs, microservices, databases, cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), and CI/CD to challenge estimates and earn engineers’ respect.
* Sound judgment on risk, change, vendors, and stakeholders.
* Clear written and spoken communication, including with senior client executives.

**Nice to have**

* Familiarity with LLM evaluation, guardrails, and cost optimization.
* PMP, PRINCE2, CSM, CSPO, or an AI/cloud certification.
* Domain experience in FinTech or Healthcare.
* Cross-industry exposure and the curiosity to pick up a new domain fast.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Clients trust you. They get honest updates, early warnings, and no surprises.
* Engineers trust you. Your requirements are clear, your estimates are fair, and handoffs don’t leave them guessing.
* Risks surface early. Hallucination, data leakage, and cost issues are caught before launch, not after.
* Products reach production. AI features go live within budget, with accuracy, latency, and cost per query tracked and holding steady.
* The way we work improves. You leave behind at least one process, template, or habit that makes the next project easier.

jobs.title: Digital Solution Designer
jobs.description:
**Location:**
Hyderabad

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About Divami**

Divami is a design partner to product companies working on hard, high-stakes problems in AI-first platforms, enterprise SaaS, financial products, and category-defining tools. Our clients do not come to us because their designs need polish. They come to us because their product needs to become a decision engine rather than a well-styled interface, and we turn strategy into shipped work with the frameworks to make it repeatable.

**The role**

You would own the design solution across a client engagement end-to-end. That work starts before the brief, in the effort of framing what the actual problem is. It runs through information architecture, key decision moments, edge cases, and the invisible logic tying them together. And it continues past the handover into the health of the client relationship itself. You would be the person clients trust to sharpen their thinking rather than just deliver against it, and you would produce frameworks other people at Divami reuse without rework.

**What you’ll own**

* **Client success, not just deliverables.**
  You measure your work by renewal, expansion, and satisfaction rather than by whether the file was handed off on time. Accounts grow because of your ownership.
* **The problem before the solution.**
  You proactively close gaps in user or business understanding before anyone flags them. If something is fuzzy, you name it and go after it, rather than waiting for the brief to catch up.
* **The whole solution, not just the screens.**
  Information architecture, key decision moments, edge cases, empty states, and the invisible logic tying them together.
* **Direction, not just execution.**
  You shape client or product direction through design thinking and innovation judgment. When the situation calls for it, you push for disruptive or category-defining solutions rather than defending against safe defaults.
* **Design rationale others can rely on.**
  You document trade-offs, decisions, and the reasoning behind them so the next person on the account is not starting from zero.
* **Reusable IP.**
  You produce frameworks, patterns, and playbooks that other designers at Divami pick up and use as they are. Your work compounds beyond your own engagements.
* **The room.**
  You handle direct client pushback with reasoning rather than defensiveness. You walk into leadership presentations without a safety net and walk out with alignment.
* **The bench.**
  You coach other designers in business-first thinking, disruptive versus incremental framing, and client handling. Designers around you level up because you are on the account.

**How you’ll think**

* **Problems get sharpened before they get solved.**
  You find the 20 percent that drives 80 percent of the value, and you name it clearly enough that everyone on the account can see the same problem.
* **Outcomes are visible at the moment of decision.**
  Every screen should tell the user and the business what happens next, and why. If the outcome is invisible, the design is not done.
* **Reasoning is portable.**
  Trade-offs get documented, decisions get explained, and the thinking behind a call is captured so the next person picks up where you left off.
* **Disruptive or incremental is a choice, not a default.**
  You know when to push for the category-defining answer and when the safe one is genuinely the right call. You can defend both.
* **Client success is a design metric.**
  Renewal, expansion, and satisfaction sit inside how you measure your own work, not outside it.
* **Multiplication over addition.**
  Your best work compounds through the frameworks others use, not through the individual files you personally shipped.

**The craft**

* **UX and product design mastery.**
  Information architecture, interaction patterns, decision flows, edge cases, and design systems. Craft you can defend on principle rather than just on intuition.
* **Business fluency.**
  Reading the shape of a business, sizing an opportunity, and sizing the risk of a design choice. You can talk to a CXO in their language, not just yours.
* **Facilitation.**
  Workshops, alignment sessions, and co-creation with clients. You can hold a room when the room disagrees.
* **Executive presence.**
  Walking a leadership team through a hard call without breaking rapport, and reframing the conversation when the reasoning holds up.
* **Framework thinking.**
  Turning specific learnings from one engagement into reusable IP that helps the whole practice get better.
* **Written and visual communication that lands.**
  Strategy docs, decision memos, walkthroughs, and slides that carry an argument on their own.

**Signals we look for**

These are patterns we watch for in how you talk about past work rather than items to tick off a checklist.

* **You describe a project by its client outcome.**
  The deliverable list is the least interesting part of the story you tell.
* **You can point to a moment you disagreed with a client.**
  You held the line with reasoning, and it changed the direction of the work.
* **You have produced something others still use.**
  A framework, a playbook, a decision pattern, or a system that other designers pick up without rework.
* **When you describe ambiguity, you describe how you closed it,**
  not how you flagged it.
* **You have a view on when to build the incremental thing**
  and when to push for the disruptive one. You can defend both calls.
* **You measure your work by what happened after it shipped,**
  not by how it looked at handoff.

**Qualifications**

* **4 to 8 years**
  designing digital products across SaaS, enterprise, fintech, or platforms with real complexity. Meaningful time in senior IC or lead roles.
* **A portfolio of decisions, not just artifacts.**
  Case studies that show how you moved from an ambiguous problem to a shipped solution, and where you traded off.
* **Evidence of account ownership.**
  Concrete examples of relationships you grew, renewed, or expanded because of how you showed up, not just because of what you shipped.
* **Executive-room confidence.**
  You can present to a CXO, hear a hard pushback, and respond with reasoning that reframes the conversation without getting defensive.

**Why this role**

* **Ownership that is real.**
  You own the account, the outcome, and the direction, not just a Figma file.
* **A new domain every quarter.**
  AI-first platforms, enterprise tools, financial products, and industry-defining software. Range that compresses years of learning.
* **Frameworks that are actually used.**
  Divami’s methodology (VEDA), empathy-led frameworks, and outcome-driven approaches we have validated across real client work.
* **Room to shape how we work,**
  not just what we ship. If you have opinions about how design should be practiced, we want them on the table.
* **A bench of people**
  who take craft and business seriously in equal measure.
