jobs.title: Support Lead
jobs.description:
**About Vymo:**

  

Vymo is transforming how financial institutions manage their distribution networks and collections operations. Our AI-powered Distribution Management System (DMS) and Collection Management System (CMS) platform is trusted by 350,000+ users across 70+ global financial enterprises. We enable banks and insurers to optimize performance across their distribution channels and drive operational excellence in collections.

  
  

**Why Global Leaders Choose Vymo:**

  

Vymo partners with financial institutions through a comprehensive solution that combines deep domain expertise with cutting-edge technology. Our platform's human-centric design, coupled with enterprise-grade scalability and AI-powered intelligence, delivers measurable business outcomes while ensuring high user adoption and engagement.

  
  

**Recognition & Trust :**

  

* **Funding:** Backed by $45M+ from leading investors, including Peak XV partners (formerly Sequoia), Emergence Capital, and Bertelsmann Investments.

  

* **Clients:** Trusted by global financial leaders such as Berkshire Hathaway, AIA, AXA, SBI Life, HDFC Bank, Aditya Birla Capital, Tata AIA, and ABSLI.

  

* **Industry Recognition:** Recognized by Celent in their 2024 Distribution Management Solutions report (Advanced Functionality ranking).

  

Recognized by Celent in their 2024 Distribution Management Solutions report (Advanced Functionality ranking).

  

Featured in Gartner's Market Guide for Sales Engagement Applications.

  

Recognized as a "Strong Performer" in Forrester's Sales Engagement Wave Report. Recipient of the Microsoft 'AI for All' award for innovation in artificial intelligence.

  

Explore Vymo at vymo.com

  

**Product Evolution:**

  

The evolution of Vymo's product can be divided into three strategic phases:

  

**1. Lead and Activity Management:** Providing a mobile-first tool for large enterprises with distributed field sales teams to digitize processes and gain real-time visibility into team productivity.

  

**2. Sales Engagement Platform:** Building advanced capabilities (nudges, goals, playbooks, performance dashboards) to improve business outcomes for financial institutions.

  

**3. Distribution Management Platform (Current Phase):** Consolidating the tech stack for financial institutions. Our long-term vision is to become an insurance "core system" by owning the end-to-end advisor life cycle, encompassing recruitment, onboarding, training, selling, engagement, and performance management.

  

**The Role:**

  

The Lead, Engineering Support drives the day-to-day execution of the operating model that lets Support and Engineering function as one team. This role owns the hands-on lifecycle of production issues triage, investigation, root cause analysis, resolution and is the person others look to when an incident gets genuinely hard.

  

Success here is about executing and reinforcing repeatable systems, not just resolving individual incidents. You'll work within the runbooks, escalation paths, SLAs, and RCA practices the team has established and be a driving voice in sharpening them so issues get resolved consistently, without depending on any one person's memory.

  

You'll combine technical depth with clear customer communication, working closely with Engineering while building confidence with enterprise customers directly. As Vymo expands its AI-native platform, Support will increasingly lean on intelligent agents to triage issues, correlate signals, and recommend root causes. This role is expected to work inside that operating model structuring your own RCAs and runbooks so they're clean and repeatable enough to eventually support that shift.

  
  

**What You Will Do**

  

**1. Production Operations**

  

* **Drive Production Triage and Resolution:** Own the lifecycle of complex production issues spanning the support-engineering boundary, from initial triage through final resolution.

  

* **Contribute to Root Cause Frameworks:** Lead blameless root cause analyses on the incidents you own, and contribute improvements to the team's severity and triage frameworks.

  

* **Apply SLAs and Watch for Patterns:** Work within defined SLAs, and flag recurring failure patterns in issue telemetry before they escalate further.

  
  

**2. Reinforce Operational Excellence Process, Runbooks, and Metrics**

  

* **Maintain and Sharpen Runbooks:** Keep runbooks and escalation paths current based on what you learn in the field, so resolution doesn't depend on any one person including you.

  

* **Run Blameless RCAs:** Ensure every major incident you handle gets a clear, tracked root cause fix.

  

* **Track and Surface Metrics:** Monitor MTTR, ticket volume, and recurrence rate on your issues, and surface patterns worth a process fix.

  
  

**3. Mentor and Set the Technical Bar**

  

* **Mentor Hybrid Technical Talent:** Support and coach teammates who combine architectural depth with client-facing communication, modeling what strong triage looks like.

  

* **Hold the Technical Bar:** Demonstrate and reinforce the excellence benchmark for production triage the team is expected to hit.

  

* **Reframe Escalations as Insights:** Treat escalated issues as learning data for Engineering, and help build that habit in others.

  
  

**4. Work Inside an AI-Native Support Future**

  

* **Build AI-Ready Artifacts:** Write runbooks, triage logic, and RCA templates as explicit, structured workflows that an agentic system could eventually parse and execute.

  

* **Flag Human-vs-Automation Boundaries:** Notice where a task is manual only due to missing tooling versus where it genuinely needs human judgment, and say so.

  

* **Stay Current on AI Tooling:** Track emerging AI-native support capabilities and bring informed opinions on where they'd help your area of ownership

  
  

**What You Will Bring Experience and Fluency**

  

* **Hands-on Engineering Foundation:** 6-8 years of total experience, including direct production code delivery, meaningful exposure to the engineering/support interface, and comfort reading codebases, diagnostic logs, and architecture diagrams to independently drive technical RCAs.

  

* **Operational Process Fluency:** Experience working within and improving runbooks, SLA metrics, and on-call escalation frameworks in a B2B Enterprise SaaS environment, where downtime carries real commercial stakes for clients.

  
  

* **Informal Leadership:** Experience mentoring or informally guiding junior engineers, even without formal people-management responsibility.

  
  

**Mindset & Core Traits**

  

**High-Agency Problem Ownership:** Claims ownership of ambiguous production incidents without waiting to be assigned; builds repeatable workflows rather than leaning on ad hoc fixes.

  

**Calm Under Production Pressure:** A steadying presence during live, high-priority incidents, communicating clearly across technical and client-facing boundaries.

  

**Systemic Thinker:** Looks to close single points of failure rather than becoming one even when being the go-to person would be easier in the short term.

  

**Forward-Looking AI Orientation:** Genuinely curious about AI-native workflows, and structures your own work so it's ready for that shift.

  

**Continuous Improvement Mindset:** Treats every escalation as a chance to improve the system, not just close the ticket.

jobs.title: Head of Finance & Accounts
jobs.description:
**Job Description: Head of Finance & Accounts**

**Company:** Hatti Food & Beverages Pvt. Ltd. (Hatti Kaapi)  
**Designation:** Head, Finance & Accounts  
**Department:** Finance & Accounts  
**Job Location:** Bengaluru  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Reporting To:** Managing Director / CEO

  

**Job Summary**

Hatti Food & Beverages Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a highly qualified, experienced, and strategic Finance Head to lead the company's Finance & Accounts function.

  

The ideal candidate should have substantial experience in the FMCG, Food & Beverage, Retail, or Manufacturing industry, with a strong understanding of financial management, business planning, accounting, taxation, statutory compliance, and commercial operations.

  

The candidate will be responsible for developing financial strategies, driving profitability, strengthening financial controls, managing working capital, ensuring regulatory compliance, and providing strategic financial insights to support business growth.

  

The role requires a hands-on finance leader with the ability to manage multi-location operations, improve financial processes, and work closely with senior management on business decisions.

  

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

  

**1. Financial Planning & Strategic Management**

* Develop and implement financial strategies aligned with the company's business objectives and growth plans.
* Lead annual budgeting, financial forecasting, and long-term financial planning.
* Monitor financial performance and provide periodic reports and recommendations to Management.
* Analyse revenue, expenditure, profitability and business performance across outlets and business units.
* Provide financial insights and recommendations to support strategic business decisions.
* Evaluate new business opportunities, expansion plans, capital investments and financial feasibility.

  

**2. Financial Reporting & MIS**

* Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and management reports.
* Ensure timely preparation and presentation of Profit & Loss statements, Balance Sheets and Cash Flow statements.
* Develop and implement financial MIS, dashboards and performance tracking systems.
* Monitor outlet-wise, region-wise and business-unit-wise financial performance.
* Analyse budget versus actual performance and highlight deviations with corrective action plans.
* Ensure accuracy, transparency and timely closure of financial records.

  

**3. FMCG / Food & Beverage Commercial Finance**

* Manage financial operations in a multi-location retail, FMCG and food service environment.
* Monitor product costing, food costs, gross margins, contribution margins and operating expenses.
* Implement effective inventory valuation and stock reconciliation processes.
* Monitor raw material procurement costs, wastage, stock movement and inventory holding.
* Work closely with Procurement, Operations and Supply Chain teams to improve cost efficiency.
* Establish effective controls over outlet-level cash collections, expenses, billing and settlements.
* Monitor outlet profitability and identify opportunities for margin improvement.

  

**4. Working Capital & Treasury Management**

* Manage cash flow, fund allocation, liquidity and working capital requirements.
* Monitor accounts receivable, accounts payable, and outstanding balances.
* Ensure timely vendor payments and effective credit management.
* Develop cash flow forecasts and optimise the utilisation of financial resources.
* Maintain banking relationships and coordinate with financial institutions for funding requirements.
* Monitor fund utilisation and ensure adequate liquidity for business operations.

  

**5. Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable GST, Income Tax, TDS, TCS, and other statutory requirements.
* Oversee timely filing of statutory returns, payments and reconciliations.
* Coordinate with external auditors, tax consultants, and statutory authorities.
* Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and regulatory requirements.
* Establish strong internal financial controls and ensure proper documentation.
* Monitor changes in taxation laws and regulatory requirements affecting the business.

  

**6. Internal Controls & Risk Management**

* Establish and strengthen internal financial control systems and accounting procedures.
* Develop financial policies, approval matrices, and expense control mechanisms.
* Monitor financial risks, operational leakages and potential irregularities.
* Conduct periodic financial reviews and internal audits across outlets and departments.
* Ensure proper reconciliation of bank accounts, vendor accounts, customer accounts, and inventory.
* Implement corrective measures to minimise financial losses and improve operational efficiency.

  

**7. Accounts & Finance Team Leadership**

* Lead, guide and develop the Finance & Accounts team.
* Define responsibilities, establish performance expectations and monitor team deliverables.
* Ensure timely processing of vendor payments, employee reimbursements, payroll accounting, and financial transactions.
* Build efficient accounting processes and improve departmental productivity.
* Coordinate with HR, Operations, Procurement, Sales and other departments for financial requirements.

  

**8. Audit & Business Coordination**

* Manage statutory, internal, and tax audits.
* Coordinate with auditors, consultants, bankers and other external stakeholders.
* Ensure audit schedules, supporting documents and reconciliations are completed on time.
* Present financial performance, business risks and recommendations to senior management.
* Support management in business expansion, investment evaluation and financial decision-making.

  

**Educational Qualifications**

* Chartered Accountant / CMA / MBA in Finance from a reputed institution with strong relevant experience.
* Strong knowledge of accounting standards, taxation, and financial management.

  

**Experience Requirements**

* 5 - 10 years of overall experience in Finance & Accounts.
* At least 3 years in a senior finance leadership or managerial position.
* Strong and preferably mandatory experience in FMCG, Food & Beverage, Retail, Manufacturing, or a multi-location business.
* Experience in managing large-scale financial operations, budgeting, costing, taxation, audits, and financial reporting.
* Experience in ERP implementation, accounting automation, and process improvement will be an added advantage.

  

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strategic financial planning and business partnering.
* Advanced financial analysis and interpretation.
* Strong knowledge of GST, Income Tax, TDS, and statutory compliance.
* Budgeting, forecasting and financial modelling.
* Working capital and cash flow management.
* Inventory valuation, product costing and margin analysis.
* Internal financial controls and risk management.
* ERP / Accounting software knowledge.
* Advanced MS Excel and financial MIS reporting.
* Strong leadership, negotiation, and decision-making skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.

  

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Improvement in overall business profitability and operating margins.
* Accuracy and timely closure of monthly financial statements.
* Effective working capital and cash flow management.
* Timely statutory compliance and audit completion.
* Reduction in operational costs and financial leakages.
* Improvement in inventory control and reconciliation.
* Timely and accurate financial MIS and management reporting.
* Strengthening of internal financial controls and processes.

  

**Interested candidates with strong FMCG / Food & Beverage finance experience and a proven track record in leading finance functions are encouraged to apply.**

jobs.description:
The role demands a technically exceptional advisor who is equally adept at managing complex, multi-workstream deal mandates and at building trusted, long-term relationships with PE sponsors, strategic acquirers, founders, and investment banks. The successful candidate will lead tax due diligence, deal structuring, SPA advisory, and post-deal integration engagements while also playing a material role in business development, practice growth, and team leadership.

**ROLE DETAILS**

**Detailed Job Description**

**Project & Engagement Management**

* Scope and structure engagements rigorously from the outset defining the mandate, work plan, team composition, deliverable schedule, and fee structure; ensure alignment with client expectations and firm economics before engagement commencement
* Manage concurrent deal mandates often across multiple live transactions simultaneously with disciplined prioritisation, clear delegation, and proactive risk management to ensure no engagement is compromised
* Drive deal timelines actively maintaining pressure on internal teams and external advisors to meet deal milestones, flagging delays early, and re-planning where required to protect deal outcomes
* Enforce quality control and risk management protocols across all deliverables conducting technical reviews, stress-testing advice positions, and escalating novel or high-risk issues to firm leadership appropriately
* Manage engagement economics proactively including fee discussions, scope creep management, WIP tracking, billing, and client-level profitability ensuring the practice remains commercially healthy
* Maintain deal documentation discipline ensuring matter files, advice trails, conflict checks, and engagement letters are current and in line with firm risk management protocols
* Coordinate cross-functional deal teams acting as the orchestrating senior advisor across internal practice groups (TP, Indirect Tax, Regulatory, Employment Tax) and external advisors on integrated deal mandates

**Technical Advisory & Transaction Execution**

* Lead buy-side and sell-side tax due diligence across domestic and cross-border transactions identifying, quantifying, and clearly communicating tax exposures, contingent liabilities, and structural risks to deal teams and investment committees
* Design and advise on optimal deal structures share vs. asset acquisitions, slump sales, itemised transfers, demergers, NCLT merger schemes, and business transfers with a sharp focus on tax efficiency, regulatory compliance, and commercial workability
* Advise on purchase price mechanics and SPA provisions including tax representations and warranties, indemnities, tax covenants, earn-out tax treatment, warranty and indemnity (W&I) insurance, and locked-box vs. completion accounts mechanisms
* Provide comprehensive cross-border M&A advisory structuring inbound acquisitions, outbound investments, offshore holding structures, repatriation strategies, and exit tax planning across relevant treaty and FEMA / FDI frameworks
* Advise PE sponsors and portfolio companies on exit structuring IPO readiness from a tax perspective, secondary PE sales, drag-along and tag-along mechanics, management buyouts, and rollover structures
* Advise on indirect tax (GST / Stamp Duty) implications of deal structures, in coordination with the Indirect Tax practice; flag deal-critical indirect tax exposures in due diligence
* Support clients on NCLT-driven restructurings mergers, demergers, amalgamations, and capital reductions including scheme drafting support, tax opinions, and regulatory filings strategy
* Advise on Section 79 (change in shareholding), GAAR, Sections 50C, 56(2)(x) and other anti-avoidance provisions relevant to M&A transactions; provide practical, risk-calibrated positions
* Provide technical opinions and memos on novel or complex M&A tax issues; oversee quality control across all deal deliverables to ensure Tier 1 standards of accuracy, clarity, and commercial utility

**Client Management**

* Serve as the lead relationship partner for a portfolio of PE sponsors, strategic acquirers, and founder-led businesses owning client satisfaction, retention, and relationship expansion
* Maintain high-frequency, proactive client engagement providing regulatory updates, market intelligence, and advisory touchpoints beyond active deal mandates to cement the firm as a trusted advisor
* Anticipate client needs through a deep understanding of their portfolio, deal pipeline, and strategic priorities positioning the firm's advisory capabilities ahead of deal events
* Manage complex, multi-party client situations including situations with conflicting stakeholder interests, tight deal timelines, or significant tax exposure with composure, sound judgment, and a solutions orientation
* Coordinate effectively across deal advisors working alongside M&A legal counsel, investment banks, auditors, and regulatory advisors to ensure the firm's tax advice is integrated, actionable, and deal-enabling
* Handle senior escalations and sensitive advisory issues with maturity including managing tax risk communications to investment committees, boards, and LP advisory committees

**Business Development & Client Origination**

* Proactively identify and pursue BD opportunities including converting referrals from PE deal teams, investment banks, legal counsel, and management consultants into active mandates; expanding scope with existing deal clients into retainer or post-deal advisory
* Build and maintain a personal network of deal origination relationships with PE fund deal teams, corp dev teams at strategic acquirers, CFOs, founders, M&A legal counsel (domestic and international), investment bankers, and boutique advisors
* Lead pitches and RFP responses for M&A tax mandates including preparing pitch books, capability statements, deal credentials, and fee proposals that are commercially compelling and technically differentiated
* Establish and grow the firm's brand in the Bengaluru M&A ecosystem through presence at PE/VC forums, M&A roundtables, sector-specific events, and university/campus engagements
* Track M&A market activity (announced deals, sector trends, regulatory changes) and proactively communicate relevant insights to existing and prospective clients using market intelligence as a lever for client conversations and mandate origination
* Collaborate with Partners across corporate tax, funds, indirect tax, and regulatory practices to originate and deliver integrated, cross-practice mandates on complex transactions
* Contribute to firm-wide thought leadership authoring client alerts, deal commentary, sector-specific M&A tax guides, and speaking at industry forums to enhance the firm's deal advisory brand

**Post-Deal & Restructuring Advisory**

* Advise on post-acquisition tax integration harmonisation of group tax positions, entity rationalisation, simplification of holding structures, and integration of acquired tax functions

jobs.description:

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

**Role Overview**
We are seeking a seasoned technology leader to serve as Senior Manager, Software Engineering. This role is accountable for end-to-end delivery across Azure Cloud, modern web applications, Salesforce, and payment platforms. The successful candidate will combine strong technical expertise with disciplined execution, build high-performing engineering teams, and coordinate complex initiatives across multiple functions and geographies. This leader will translate business priorities into scalable technology outcomes while strengthening engineering practices, operational resilience, security, and accountability.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Build high-performing teams: Recruit, develop, coach, and retain engineers; establish clear expectations, empower decision-making, and create succession and capability-development plans.
* Coordinate globally: Align teams, vendors, dependencies, and stakeholders across multiple geographies and time zones, ensuring clear ownership, effective handoffs, and timely escalation of risks and decisions.
* Manage delivery health: Establish transparent governance for scope, schedule, quality, budget, capacity, dependencies, risks, and technical debt; use metrics to guide decisions and continuous improvement.
* Own operational outcomes: Ensure platforms meet availability, resilience, security, compliance, recovery, and support expectations; lead effective incident response and root-cause remediation.
* Influence technology direction: Evaluate emerging technologies, guide build-versus-buy decisions, and shape modernization plans that balance innovation, maintainability, cost, and risk.
* Communicate with impact: Provide concise, data-driven updates to senior leaders and stakeholders, surfacing trade-offs and enabling timely decisions.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Proven technology delivery experience, including significant experience leading engineering teams across multiple projects/initiatives in parallel.

* Strong working knowledge of Azure Cloud architecture and services, cloud-native design, integration patterns, APIs, and DevSecOps practices.
* Experience overseeing modern web application delivery, including front-end, back-end, security, performance, accessibility, and production support considerations.
* Experience with Salesforce platforms, custom development, integrations, release management, and governance.
* Experience with payment ecosystems, including transaction flows, integrations, reconciliation, resiliency, security, and regulatory or control requirements.
* Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams, resolve cross-team dependencies, and lead distributed teams across geographies.
* Strong financial, vendor, resource, risk, and change-management capabilities.
* Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and decision-making skills.

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

We are looking for a technology generalist with deep engineering expertise who is comfortable working across different programming languages, frameworks, architectures and business domains.

* Define development standards, code review processes and technical documentation requirements.
* Conduct technical interviews and assess candidate capabilities across different technology stacks.
* Mentor engineering leads and develop future technology leaders.
* Manage internal development teams, freelancers, technology vendors and outsourced partners.

**6. DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure & Cybersecurity**

* Establish robust CI/CD, release management and automated testing processes.
* Implement cybersecurity controls, vulnerability management, access controls and secure development practices.

* Strong hands-on software engineering background with experience designing and scaling production app

jobs.title: Manager, Product Managment
jobs.description:
**About ModMed**

At ModMed®, we are transforming healthcare through technology. Our mission is to empower healthcare providers with innovative, specialty-specific software solutions that simplify clinical and administrative workflows, improve operational efficiency, and enable better patient care.

Our solutions combine deep healthcare expertise with modern technology to address the complex challenges faced by medical practices. We are a global team of innovators, engineers, product leaders, and healthcare professionals passionate about making a meaningful difference in healthcare.

Join us and help shape the future of healthcare technology!

**About Our Practice Management Product**

ModMed's Practice Management solutions help healthcare practices streamline their administrative, operational, and financial workflows. From scheduling and patient registration to billing, claims management, and revenue cycle operations, our technology helps practices operate more efficiently and manage the business of healthcare.

We continuously evolve our products by leveraging modern technologies, intelligent automation, and AI-driven capabilities to simplify complex workflows, reduce manual effort, and improve financial and operational outcomes for healthcare providers.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a hands-on, people-first
**Manager – Product Management**
to lead and develop a team of Product Owners responsible for our Practice Management product portfolio.

This role combines people leadership, product execution, customer engagement, and AI-driven product innovation. You will be responsible for building a high-performing Product Owner team, establishing strong product discovery and requirements practices, and ensuring initiatives deliver measurable value to customers and the business.

A key focus will be defining and validating requirements for AI-powered features and intelligent automation, translating complex healthcare and financial workflows into clear product specifications, and partnering closely with Engineering, Product, and business stakeholders to bring these capabilities to market.

You will own outcomes across the product lifecycle, from problem discovery and prioritisation through development, customer validation, release, and adoption.

**What You'll Do**

**Product & People Leadership**

* Build, lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Product Owners.
* Establish clear ownership, accountability, performance expectations, and development plans across the team.
* Coach Product Owners on product discovery, requirements definition, prioritisation, stakeholder management, and execution.
* Allocate initiatives based on business priorities, team capacity, and individual strengths.
* Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, customer focus, and continuous improvement.

**Product Strategy & Initiative Ownership**

* Drive execution of the Practice Management product roadmap in alignment with business objectives and customer needs.
* Ensure every initiative has a clearly defined problem statement, expected business outcome, scope, success criteria, and ownership.
* Balance competing priorities and make informed decisions on resource allocation and initiative sequencing.
* Maintain visibility into product progress, dependencies, risks, and outcomes.
* Ensure initiatives move efficiently from discovery through development, release, and customer adoption.

**AI-Driven Product Requirements & Automation**

* Establish standards for defining, analysing, documenting, and validating requirements for AI-driven features and intelligent automation.
* Translate complex business logic, operational workflows, and automation triggers into clear functional specifications.
* Ensure requirements include detailed workflows, business rules, edge cases, acceptance criteria, and expected system behaviour.
* Partner with Engineering and AI teams to validate technical feasibility, model accuracy, scalability, and reliability.
* Drive appropriate validation of AI-generated outputs, including accuracy, consistency, and compliance considerations.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI and automation to simplify workflows, reduce manual intervention, and improve operational efficiency.

**Data-Driven Decision Making & Product Prioritisation**

* Leverage product analytics, operational data, and customer insights to identify workflow inefficiencies and improvement opportunities.
* Use data to prioritise automation initiatives that reduce manual effort, improve productivity, and deliver measurable financial outcomes for customers.
* Define and track product success metrics, including feature adoption, workflow efficiency, time saved, automation rates, and financial impact.
* Use SQL for data validation, root-cause analysis, and investigation of product and operational issues.
* Establish a metrics-driven approach to product prioritisation and continuous improvement.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with Engineering, Product Management, Architecture, AI, and business stakeholders to drive successful product outcomes.
* Work with technical teams to address complex workflows, business rules, edge cases, scalability, and system dependencies.
* Ensure alignment between product requirements, technical implementation, and intended business outcomes.
* Communicate product decisions, priorities, and trade-offs effectively to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Bring together cross-functional teams to resolve challenges and maintain momentum across initiatives.

**Customer Engagement & Release Management**

* Lead customer discovery sessions, product demonstrations, and feedback discussions to understand real-world challenges.
* Oversee alpha and beta programs to validate new capabilities and incorporate customer feedback into product decisions.
* Ensure product functionality meets customer expectations and delivers the intended operational and financial value.
* Drive release readiness, ensuring product documentation, training materials, and communication plans are in place before general availability.
* Monitor feature adoption and customer feedback post-release to identify opportunities for further improvement.

**What You'll Bring**

**Experience & Domain Expertise**

* 8+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, or related product leadership roles.
* At least 2 years of experience leading and developing Product Owners or Product Managers.
* Strong experience working in SaaS or cloud-based product environments.
* Deep understanding of healthcare technology, Practice Management, medical billing, and revenue cycle management workflows.
* Proven experience owning product initiatives from discovery and requirements definition through development, release, and adoption.
* Demonstrated ability to build and develop product talent while managing multiple initiatives.

**Product & AI Capabilities**

* Strong ability to identify the problem worth solving, define the desired outcomes, and translate business needs into actionable product requirements.
* Expertise in developing high-quality functional specifications, workflow diagrams, business rules, and acceptance criteria.
* Practical understanding of AI-driven products, intelligent automation, and AI-assisted workflows.
* Ability to evaluate AI capabilities and limitations and establish appropriate validation approaches for accuracy, reliability, and compliance.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools to improve product discovery, requirements gathering, analysis, and documentation.
* Strong analytical capabilities with proficiency in SQL for data validation and problem investigation.
* Experience defining product KPIs and measuring adoption, operational efficiency, and business impact.

**Leadership & Stakeholder Management**

* Proven ability to lead, mentor, and empower Product Owners to take ownership of product outcomes.
* Strong prioritisation and decision-making skill

This is not only a delivery leadership role. You are expected to continuously improve how engineering operates by introducing modern engineering practices, scaling engineering excellence across teams and driving AI-assisted software development.
  
  
You will lead Engineering Managers and Technical Leaders across multiple customer engagements, engineering quality and organizational growth.
  
  

* Lead and grow an engineering organization of 100+ engineers across multiple customer programs.
* Coach, develop and raise the bar for Engineering Managers through regular mentoring, feedback and performance management.
* Drive engineering excellence by improving delivery predictability, quality, developer experience, operational readiness and engineering metrics.
* Establish consistent engineering governance, release readiness, architecture and quality practices across multiple teams.
* Partner with customers, Delivery Managers, Technical Leaders, Architects and Product leadership to build trusted engineering relationships and resolve complex delivery challenges.
* Build a culture of ownership, accountability, continuous improvement and technical excellence.
* Lead engineering transformation through adoption of AI-native development practices, Agentic SDLC, automation and modern platform capabilities.
* Develop engineering capability for the region through hiring, succession planning, technical communities and career development.

What success looks like
  
  

* You build an organization where:
* Engineering Managers grow into exceptional leaders.
* Teams deliver predictably with a balance of quality.
* Engineering decisions are driven by data.
* Customers trust engineering commitments.
* AI measurably improves engineering productivity and quality.
* Engineering standards scale consistently across projects and teams.
* Difficult organizational changes are implemented when required to improve long-term outcomes.
* Proven experience leading multiple engineering teams (50+ engineers) through Engineering Managers.
* Experience operating large-scale software delivery organizations across multiple concurrent projects.
* Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices including architecture governance, CI/CD, testing strategies, observability, operational excellence and engineering metrics.
* Demonstrated success building and coaching engineering leaders

Experience leading organizational transformation and driving measurable engineering improvements.
  
  

* Strong customer-facing leadership with the ability to build trust while navigating difficult delivery situations.
* Hands-on understanding of AI-assisted software engineering, developer tooling and Agentic SDLC with the ability to pragmatically introduce these practices across engineering organizations.
* Excellent communication skills with both executive stakeholders and engineering teams.
* Bias for ownership, continuous improvement and data-driven decision making.

Leadership principles
  
  

* Engineering Directors at Backbase:
* Build leaders.
* Measure outcomes, not activity.
* Solve systemic problems rather than local optimizations.
* Raise engineering quality without slowing delivery.
* Challenge the status quo and continuously improve how engineering works.
* Embrace AI as an engineering multiplier while maintaining strong engineering fundamentals.

jobs.title: Manager, IT Delivery
jobs.description:
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Manager, IT Delivery is responsible for leading high-performing data and technology teams and delivering strategic data initiatives that generate measurable business value.
  
  
This role combines people leadership, product delivery, stakeholder management, and operational oversight. The manager will lead teams operating across data engineering, data platforms, data warehousing, data lakes, data governance, data quality, and analytics.
  
  
The manager will have end-to-end accountability for the development, delivery, maintenance, production support, reliability, and continuous improvement of data products. The successful candidate will bring strong leadership and communication capabilities, experience managing product-oriented teams, and a sound understanding of modern data ecosystems. The role requires the ability to translate business priorities into executable delivery plans, develop engineering talent, manage delivery commitments, and ensure the scalability, quality, security, and reliability of data solutions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead, coach, and develop high-performing data and technology teams, including hiring, performance management, workforce planning, and talent development.
* Drive delivery of strategic initiatives across data engineering, data warehousing, data lakes / lakehouses, data integration, data governance, data quality, analytics, and business intelligence.
* Partner with business, product, architecture, and engineering stakeholders to translate priorities into product roadmaps, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes.
* Lead product-oriented teams with end-to-end accountability for the development, delivery, maintenance, production support, reliability, and continuous improvement of data products.
* Drive Agile practices, including intake management, backlog prioritization, estimation, sprint and release planning, and delivery governance.
* Manage capacity planning, resource forecasting, delivery commitments, risks, issues, and cross-team dependencies to enable predictable execution.
* Ensure data solutions are scalable, secure, reliable, reusable, and compliant with applicable technology, risk, privacy, and information security standards.
* Promote effective data governance, data quality, metadata management, lineage, ownership, and stewardship practices.
* Monitor delivery, quality, and operational health through relevant metrics, and provide clear, concise updates to stakeholders and leadership.
* Foster strong stakeholder relationships and communicate complex data and technology topics effectively to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Promote automation, standardization, engineering excellence, cost optimization, and modern data practices, including cloud and AI-enabled capabilities.
* Drive a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, continuous learning, and business-outcome ownership.
* Provide leadership during major incidents and critical production events, partnering with support and engineering teams to drive timely resolution, stakeholder communication, and service recovery while ensuring operational continuity.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 10+ years of experience in technology delivery, software engineering, data platforms, or IT services, including people leadership experience.
* Proven experience leading teams in a product-based environment with responsibility for delivery execution and stakeholder management.
* Strong understanding of Agile delivery practices, backlog management, sprint planning, and Jira.
* Experience leading data-focused technology initiatives, including data engineering, analytics, data quality, governance, or modern data platforms.
* Strong people leadership, coaching, and talent development skills.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing abilities.
* Demonstrated ability to drive execution, manage ambiguity, solve complex problems, and lead organisational change.
* Ability to understand technical concepts and effectively partner with engineering teams to deliver business outcomes.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in financial services or other highly regulated industries.
* Exposure to cloud-based data platforms and AI-enabled technology initiatives.
* Agile, Scrum, PMP, SAFe, or related certifications preferred.
* Experience leading cloud data platform, data modernization, or platform transformation initiatives.
* Experience managing geographically distributed or cross-functional teams.
* Familiarity with industry-standard cloud, data engineering, analytics, governance, and data quality technologies.

**Key Success Factors**

* Experience in data-centric technology environments.
* Ability to build, scale, and lead high-performing teams.
* Sound understanding of data engineering, data platforms, governance, quality, and analytics.
* Strong product and Agile delivery leadership.
* Effective capacity planning, forecasting, and execution management.
* Ownership and accountability for delivery and operational outcomes.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication.
* Ability to connect data and technology investments to business outcomes.
* Ability to operate effectively in a complex, cross-functional environment.
* Commitment to engineering quality, operational excellence, risk management, and continuous improvement.

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
  
  
**Our mission**
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
  
  
**Our commitment to you**
**Benefits**
Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
  
  
**Financial wellness**
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
  
  
**Physical wellness**
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
  
  
**Personal wellness**
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
  
  
**How We Work**
Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

**Description**
Amazon built world-class finance and accounting machinery to run its own business at scale. Finance as a Service (FaaS) is turning that machinery into a product: end-to-end back-office finance and accounting, delivered to sellers and partners as a service. Customers get Amazon-grade accuracy, controllership, and compliance without building it themselves. We run accounts payable, accounts receivable, record-to-report, and tax operations for a growing roster customers today.
  
  
The systems that power FaaS today are highly specialized, built to run Amazon's own books and in many ways add odds what other businesses really want and need. FaaS as a product will benefit from an operations stack built with multi-tenancy, data isolation, multi-auditor control support built into its foundation from the start. FaaS must scale from large multinationals down to small local business, and its technology must be similarly geared. Scaling FaaS into a durable business requires a deliberate long-term strategy, and this includes the technology that powers it.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management, Context Engine
jobs.description:
**Our Company:**
At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
As Director of Product Management, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for the capabilities that let Teradata's Enterprise Context Engine understand customer data on its own: schema and ontology discovery, natural language processing, and AI driven workflow and policy extraction. The Context Engine extracts, curates, and continuously improves metadata and business context, grounded in Teradata's industry knowledge models, so that human analysts move faster and AI agents are grounded in trusted enterprise meaning.
  
  
You will serve as the Context Engine's senior product leader in the region and partner closely with local engineering, data science, and architecture teams along with product and engineering leaders across the US. You will set direction, make prioritization decisions, and hold your team accountable for customer outcomes, from discovery and design through launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Strategy, Roadmap & Outcomes**

* Own the roadmap knowledge graph completion / Ontology Learning, Reflexion-based memory extraction, and reinforcement learning-focused feature sets within the Context Engine portfolio. Translate customer needs and business priorities into clear requirements, prioritization decisions, and success criteria.
* Act as the primary touchpoint and evangelist for Context Engine to customers, executives, and field teams in the APJ region.
* Define how these capabilities are reusable by and drive value across Teradata products, personas, and business domains, and across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
* Shape the competitive position and differentiation of the Context Engine against competitors such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft, Google, and emerging AI data platform and semantic layer vendors.

**Automated Workflow Assembly**

* Define the product vision for automatically assembling workflows from discovered schemas and semantics, including data preparation, mapping, validation, enrichment, and publication of context, without hand-built pipelines for each customer.
* Specify how agents plan, compose, and execute these workflows, including reusable workflow templates, orchestration, approval checkpoints, and rollback.
* Set requirements for observability, explainability, and auditability so that customers can see why a workflow was assembled the way it was and trust what it produced.
* Define how workflows and discovered context are exposed to external agents and frameworks through Model Context Protocol (MCP) and other open agent interfaces.

**How Success Is Measured**

* Customer adoption and production deployments of semantic extraction and automated workflow capabilities, including successful agent and application consumption of the context they produce.
* Discovery and mapping quality: accuracy, coverage, and confidence calibration of discovered schemas, relationships, and semantic mappings, and the share accepted by stewards without correction.
* Automation outcomes: reduction in time and manual effort to onboard a new customer data estate and reach usable context, and the share of workflows assembled and run without hand-built pipelines.
* Platform usability as measured by targeted KPIs and customer sentiment.
* Pipeline influence, win-rate contribution, and analyst and customer perception of Teradata's context and trusted-AI position.

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* Bachelor's degree and 12+ years of experience, including 6+ years in product management or equivalent technical product leadership, with 4+ years on enterprise NLP, search, or metadata and data discovery platforms.
* Hands-on experience with NLP and LLM-based applications such as entity and concept extraction, semantic matching, embeddings, and natural language grounding to structured data, including how to evaluate them.
* Experience with BPMN 2. 0 structured workflows, and a demonstrable record of bringing agentic AI solutions from concept to production.
* Working familiarity with ontology and knowledge graph concepts, and with how graph-based context is consumed by retrieval and agent systems.
* Experience with utilizing agent self-learning approaches such as Reflexion, Reflective learning (ERL), or similar approaches to verbal reinforcement learning to improve agents in response to events and encounters in production systems.

**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.
  
  
Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

Anaqua is looking for a dynamic Engineering Team Manager to lead our Platform & Microservices team spanning development, QA automation, and DevOps. This is a hands-on leadership role — you write code, review architecture, and make technical decisions while managing people and delivery.
  
  
You will play a dual role: Product Owner for the platform services (owning the backlog, priorities, and roadmap) and technical team lead who drives Agile execution, engineering excellence, and team growth. You lead by example — your team sees you in the code, in the design discussions, and at the whiteboard.
  
  
**You'll Love This Job If You Like To**

* Team Management — lead a cross-functional Agile team of developers, QA automation engineers, and DevOps engineers.
* Agile Execution — drive sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, retrospectives, and release coordination.
* Delivery Ownership — own delivery commitments — sprint goals, release timelines, and production readiness.
* People Development — build a high-performing team through hiring, onboarding, mentoring, performance reviews, and career development.
* Stakeholder Management — remove blockers, manage dependencies across teams, and escalate risks proactively.

**Hands-On Technical Leadership**

* Lead by Example — actively participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and design decisions.

* DevOps Fluency — strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and infrastructure automation.
* QA Understanding — familiarity with test automation strategy — E2E (Playwright), API testing, contract testing, and quality gates in pipelines.
* Technical Decision-Making — ability to evaluate technical trade-offs, guide technology choices, and drive architectural standards.
* Production Ownership — experience with observability, production debugging, incident management, and post-mortem processes.

**Engineering Practices**

* Establish and enforce coding standards, review processes, and engineering guidelines across development, QA, and DevOps.
* Champion shift-left quality — automated testing, static analysis, security scanning integrated into the development workflow.
* Drive adoption of AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to improve team productivity.
* define and track engineering metrics — deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, MTTR.
* Ensure secure coding practices and compliance with organizational security policies.

* strong command of the Agile work item hierarchy — Epics, Features, User Stories, Tasks, Bugs.
* Jira mastery — board configuration, sprint metrics, velocity tracking, release planning, and reporting.
* full SDLC ownership — from requirements through development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance.
* clear understanding of environments and promotion workflows — Dev, QA, Staging, Pre-Production, Production.

**Professional Skills & Mindset**

* Proven track record of delivering complex technical projects on time and at quality.
* Dynamic and adaptable — comfortable switching between strategic planning and hands-on problem solving.
* Excellent communicator — translates business needs to technical teams and technical complexity to business stakeholders.
* Customer-centric — every decision is evaluated through the lens of end-user impact.
* Proactive and innovative — brings ideas to improve product, process, tools, and team capabilities.
* Resilient under pressure — maintains clarity and calm during production incidents and tight deadlines.

**What You'll Need To Be Successful**

* 10+ years of relevant industry experience required.
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or Certified Product Owner (CSPO).
* Experience managing distributed or remote teams.
* ReactJS frontend knowledge for full-stack architectural context.
* Python for scripting and automation.
* Cloud cost optimization and FinOps awareness.
* Background in brand protection, IP enforcement, or digital investigation domains.
* Experience in enterprise SaaS domains.

Anaqua, Inc. is a premium provider of integrated intellectual property (IP) management technology solutions and services. Anaqua’s AQX platform combines best practice workflows with big data analytics and tech-enabled services to create an intelligent environment designed to inform IP strategy, enable IP decision-making, and streamline IP operations. Today, nearly half of the top 100 U.S. patent filers and global brands, as well as a growing number of law firms worldwide use Anaqua’s solutions. Over one million IP executives, attorneys, paralegals, administrators, and innovators in large and medium-sized companies use the platform for their IP management needs. The company’s global operations are headquartered in Boston, with offices across the U.S., Europe, Asia, and Australia. For additional information, please visit anaqua.com, or on LinkedIn.

jobs.description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.
  
  
**Essential Skills**

* 12+ years of proven track record in securities post-trade processing as a lead business/product lead associated with business and/or IT change programmes
* 10+ years’ of experience gained within a client environment - directly working for Investment Bank/Broker Dealer or in a vendor relationship
* Experience creating target operating models and persuading/influencing Operations to adhere to them
* Excellent Capital Markets knowledge – across Fixed Income or Equities.
* Strong mentoring skills are essential. Should be open to lead a virtual functional team and own the deliverables.
* Excellent written communication skills. Writes clearly and concisely, able to structure and present concepts well, can deliver written work that requires only cursory review/sign off.

**Advantageous**

* Have an existing network of client relationships in order to understand current and future needs.
* Experience presenting at vendor user groups, industry conferences, expos and events.
* Experience training offshore resources and providing product governance by reviewing requirements and solutions to ensure adherence to agreed functional and technical approaches
* Ability to take disparate data and define a problem statement – can deal with ambiguity in a situation and move it to clarity and definition
* Experience in requirements/pre-sales engagement/workshops
* Excellent presentation skills. Able to communicate to a non-specialist audience/business specialist audience linking concepts across boundaries and articulating high level examples across varying domains
* Experience in techno-functional role will be added advantage.
* Experience in Broadridge products like impact, BPS, Gloss will be advantageous.

We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective.
  
  
**Use of AI in Hiring**
As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration.

jobs.title: Walk-in || School Accountant
jobs.description:
**1. Job Summary**

  

We are looking for a qualified, detail-oriented and responsible \*Accountant\* to manage the day-to-day accounting and financial operations of the school.

  

The candidate will be responsible for student fee accounting, vendor payments, bank reconciliation, statutory compliance, payroll coordination, financial reporting and maintaining accurate financial records.

  

**2. Key Roles and Responsibilities**

  

**Student Fee Management**

- Maintain student-wise fee records, including tuition fees, admission fees, transport fees and other applicable charges.

- Record daily fee collections through cash, UPI, bank transfers, cheques and online payment gateways.

- Generate fee receipts and maintain accurate collection records.

- Monitor outstanding fees and prepare student-wise fee due reports.

- Coordinate with the admissions and administration teams for fee reconciliation.

- Prepare daily, weekly and monthly fee collection reports.

- Reconcile fee collection software with accounting records and bank statements.

- Maintain records of fee concessions, scholarships, refunds and adjustments.

  

**Daily Accounting and Bookkeeping**

- Record all financial transactions in Tally Prime or other accounting software.

- Maintain cash books, bank books, ledgers and journal vouchers.

- Verify bills, invoices, receipts and supporting documents.

- Maintain proper accounting records for income and expenditure.

- Perform monthly bank reconciliations.

- Monitor petty cash and day-to-day school expenses.

- Ensure correct classification of expenses and accounting entries.

  

**Vendor and Payment Management**

- Verify vendor invoices against purchase orders and delivery records.

- Maintain vendor-wise outstanding statements.

- Process payments after obtaining necessary approvals.

- Reconcile vendor accounts periodically.

- Maintain records of advances paid to suppliers and contractors.

- Track payments relating to infrastructure, maintenance, books, stationery and other school purchases.

  

**GST, TDS and Statutory Compliance**

- Assist in GST compliance, including applicable GST returns and reconciliations.

- Calculate and deduct TDS on applicable payments.

- Prepare data for quarterly TDS returns.

- Assist with Professional Tax, PF and ESI compliance, wherever applicable.

- Maintain statutory challans, returns and supporting records.

- Coordinate with Chartered Accountants and statutory consultants.

- Ensure timely submission of compliance-related information.

  

**Payroll and Employee Accounts**

- Assist in monthly salary processing.

- Maintain employee salary, advance and deduction records.

- Coordinate attendance and leave data with the HR department.

- Prepare payroll statements and salary payment reports.

- Maintain employee reimbursement and expense claim records.

- Assist with PF, ESI, Professional Tax and TDS calculations.

  

**Financial Reporting and MIS**

- Prepare daily cash and bank position reports.

- Prepare monthly income and expenditure statements.

- Prepare monthly budget-versus-actual expense reports.

- Maintain student fee outstanding reports.

- Prepare vendor payable and advance statements.

- Assist in preparing annual financial statements.

- Provide financial information and MIS reports to school management.

**Audit and Documentation**

- Maintain properly organized accounting vouchers and supporting documents.

- Assist with internal, statutory and tax audits, as applicable.

- Prepare schedules and reconciliations required by auditors.

- Maintain fixed asset registers and depreciation records.

- Ensure confidentiality and accuracy of financial information.

  

The ideal candidate should have experience managing accounting operations independently, preferably in a school environment. The candidate must be capable of handling student fee collections, vendor payments, payroll coordination, statutory compliance and management reporting with minimum supervision.

  
  
  

**Required Skills**

  

- Strong accounting and bookkeeping knowledge.

- Proficiency in Tally Prime and MS Excel.

- Experience in bank reconciliation and financial reporting.

- Knowledge of school fee management systems.

- Good communication and coordination skills.

- Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and meet deadlines.

- Strong attention to detail, accuracy and confidentiality.

  

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

  

| Performance Area | Expected Standard |

|---|---|

| Daily Accounting | Transactions updated daily |

| Fee Reconciliation | Daily reconciliation |

| Bank Reconciliation | Completed monthly |

| Vendor Payments | Processed within approved timelines |

| Statutory Compliance | No avoidable delays |

| Monthly MIS | Submitted by the 5th working day |

| Fee Outstanding Reports | Updated weekly |

| Audit Documentation | Complete and accurate records |

jobs.title: Accounts Executive
jobs.description:
**Company:** CustomFurnish  
**Location:** Hyderabad  
**Experience:** 35 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced **Accounts Executive** to independently manage the day-to-day accounting, payments, taxation and statutory compliance activities of our company.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience managing the complete accounts function of a small or medium-sized business and should be able to work independently with minimal supervision.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Day-to-Day Accounting**

* Maintain books of accounts, including journal entries, ledgers, expenses and financial transactions.
* Handle accounts receivable and accounts payable.
* Maintain customer and vendor accounts, reconcile balances and follow up on outstanding payments.
* Perform bank reconciliations and monitor daily bank transactions.
* Manage petty cash and employee expense reimbursements.

**2. Payments & Banking**

* Process vendor payments, employee reimbursements and other company expenses.
* Prepare payment schedules and ensure timely payments.
* Track customer collections and outstanding receivables.
* Maintain proper documentation and approvals for all payments.

**3. Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Prepare and file GST returns, including GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B, and reconcile GST input tax credit.
* Calculate, deduct, deposit and file TDS returns.
* Manage Provident Fund (PF), ESI (where applicable), Professional Tax and other statutory payments and filings.
* Maintain records relating to gratuity and other employee statutory benefits.
* Ensure timely payment of applicable taxes and statutory dues.

**4. Payroll & Employee-Related Accounting**

* Process monthly payroll, including salary calculations, deductions and reimbursements.
* Maintain employee salary and statutory deduction records.
* Handle full-and-final settlements and leave encashment calculations.
* Coordinate statutory contributions and employee-related payments.

**5. Financial Reporting & Audit**

* Prepare monthly profit and loss statements, expense reports and basic MIS reports.
* Monitor cash flow, outstanding receivables and upcoming payment obligations.
* Assist with monthly and annual closing of accounts.
* Coordinate with the company's Chartered Accountant for audits, income tax filings and annual financial statements.
* Maintain accurate accounting records and supporting documentation.

**6. Inventory & Purchase Accounting**

* Record purchase invoices, supplier payments and purchase returns.
* Reconcile supplier statements and outstanding balances.
* Coordinate with procurement and production teams for invoice verification.
* Assist in tracking inventory purchases, material costs and stock reconciliation.

Qualifications & Skills

* B.Com / M.Com or equivalent qualification in Accounting or Finance.
* **3–5 years of hands-on accounting experience**, preferably in a small or medium-sized company.
* Proficiency in **Tally Prime** and Microsoft Excel.
* Good working knowledge of GST, TDS, PF, ESI and other applicable Indian statutory compliances.
* Experience independently handling accounts payable, receivable, payroll and bank reconciliations.
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage deadlines and work independently.

Preferred Candidate

We are looking for a **hands-on accounts professional, not just a data-entry operator**, who can take ownership of the company's routine accounting operations, ensure timely statutory compliance and provide accurate financial information to management.

Install configure administer and maintain Apache Kafka clusters across development UAT and production environments

Consumer lag

  

Under replicated partitions

  

Broker failures

  

Producer consumer connectivity

  

Partition imbalance

  

Disk and memory utilization

  

Network latency and throughput

If your primary power comes from steering AI coding interfaces like Claude Code and Codex CLI to build, ship, and scale applications at breakneck speeds, this role is designed for you.

AI/ML & GenAI Native: Practical experience building with LLMs, Generative AI APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic), vector databases, and modern machine learning workflows.

jobs.title: Market Research Lead
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

NxtWave is at the forefront of the 21st-century employment landscape, empowering young individuals to become proficient tech professionals regardless of their academic history through our CCBP 4.0 initiatives.

We provide content in local languages and interactive learning experiences, making tech education accessible to everyone. Learning in one's native language enhances understanding, focus, memory, and overall success.

Founded by Rahul Attuluri (Former Amazon, IIIT Hyderabad), Sashank Reddy (IIT Bombay), and Anupam Pedarla (IIT Kharagpur), NxtWave is dedicated to assisting Indian undergraduates in securing lucrative tech positions. With rapid growth, NxtWave has built a community of over 200,000 students from more than 3,000 colleges across India. In the past year, graduates of the CCBP 4.0 program have been recruited by over 1,500 companies, including giants like Amazon, Accenture, IBM, Bank of America, TCS, Deloitte, and others.

Discover more about NxtWave - https://www.ccbp.in

**Position Summary**

Market Intelligence Lead at NxtWave is a pivotal role responsible for keeping a pulse of the market by staying in touch with customer feedback, analyzing competitor products, identifying new market opportunities etc. This role will ensure that we stay ahead of the curve by continuously monitoring the pulse of the market and our products reception. You will play a key role in shaping our product strategy by delivering actionable insights that drive growth and innovation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Customer Sentiment Analysis:** Lead the collection and analysis of customer sentiment on our platform, identifying strengths, pain points, and opportunities for improvement.
* **Effectiveness and consistency in conducting primary research through telephonic conversations and stakeholder outreach to generate actionable insights**
* Handle team coordination, performance tracking, and support for achieving targets.
* **Competitor Analysis:** Conduct thorough research on competitor products, understanding their strengths, weaknesses, and market positioning.
* **Market Research:** Identify emerging market trends and new product opportunities by analyzing industry reports, customer feedback, and competitor actions.
* **Team Leadership:** Manage and mentor a team of research associates who engage with customers and prospects to gather detailed feedback about our product and competitor offerings.
* **Data-Driven Insights:** Develop and present actionable insights to product, marketing, and leadership teams, helping to shape product development, feature prioritization, and go-to-market strategies.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Collaborate closely with product, marketing, sales, and customer success teams to align research efforts with broader company goals.
* **Reporting:** Deliver regular reports and dashboards summarizing key insights and recommendations, ensuring senior management is well-informed of market trends and product sentiment.
* **Process Optimization:** Continuously refine research methodologies to improve efficiency and the accuracy of insights.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.
* 3+ years of experience in customer insights, market research, or competitive intelligence, preferably within tech or edtech industries.
* Leadership: Proven track record of managing a team and delivering on strategic goals.
* Analytical Skills: Strong ability to translate raw data into actionable insights. Experience working with data analytics tools and platforms is a plus.
* Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex findings in a clear and concise manner to stakeholders at all levels.
* Collaboration: Experience working cross-functionally with product, marketing, and customer success teams.
* A strategic thinker with meticulous attention to detail and a robust problem-solving acumen.
* Nice to have: Hands-on experience with customer survey platforms and data analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Tableau, Power BI); Experience with CRM and feedback management systems.
* Comfortable conducting primary research telephonic conversations, to gather insights from end users, stakeholders and cross-functional teams as needed.

**Location: Hyderabad**   
**Working Days: 6 (Sunday Off)**   
**Work Mode: Work-from-Office**  
**Compensation: As per Market Standards**

jobs.description:
Role Overview

The consultant will own the end-to-end TRM solution: from requirements and configuration through testing, automation, Fiori enablement and handover to the treasury team. The goal is to move treasury operations from manual, SAP GUI and spreadsheet-driven work to a controlled, automated and well-reported platform that is less dependent on a few subject matter experts.

Key Responsibilities

* Configure Commodity Option/ Forwards/Swaps including offsetting transactions and realized gain/loss with Hedge Accounting and Integration to 3rd Party TMS such as FXALL/360T.
* Design business partner and contract controls: segregation of duties, dual review of bank detail changes, maker-checker approvals, approval authorization matrix, role-based access and change logging.
* Deliver role-based Fiori apps, web approvals and a treasury operational workbench that replace SAP GUI steps.
* Build embedded analytics and dashboards: mark-to-market, hedge coverage, exposure, liquidity, debt maturity, interest and principal forecasts, counterparty exposure and cash flow forecasts.
* Lead unit, integration and user acceptance testing, cutover support, documentation, training and backup-resource onboarding to reduce dependency on treasury SMEs.
* Work on any custom enhancement needed for any TRM Product Types FX Commodities

Required Experience

* Deep configuration knowledge of Transaction Manager:
* Hands-on experience with financial transaction lifecycle: deal capture, settlement, valuation, accruals, accounting and payment run.
* Strong knowledge of Business Partner configuration, bank detail controls, workflow, maker-checker and role-based authorization design.
* Experience creating or enabling SAP Fiori apps and S/4HANA embedded analytics for treasury users.
* Proven ability in requirement gathering and converting them into functional specifications, run SIT and UAT, support cutover, Go-live & Hypercare phases and produce user documentation and training.

Preferred Qualifications

* SAP Treasury certification (TRM) or S/4HANA Finance certification.
* Preference to CA/CMA/CS or Bachelor’s/master’s degree.
* Qualification on Finance Domain where there was Financial Market subject in curriculum.

Expected Deliverables

* Approved functional and technical specifications for each scope area.
* Configured and tested TRM solution in development, quality and production.
* Automated interfaces and rate-maintenance jobs, with monitoring and error handling.
* Fiori apps, treasury operational workbench and reporting dashboards.
* Test plans and results, authorization matrix, user guides and training sessions.

* Supervise and verify daily accounting entries in Tally Prime / ERPincluding sales, purchases, cash/bank vouchers, journal entries, expense bookings, and inter-branch transfers.
* Ensure timely bank reconciliations, petty cash audits, and ledger scrutiny across HQ, and factories across all the branches.

**2. Statutory Compliance & Taxation**

* Manage timely calculation, filing, and reconciliation of GST returns (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-2B reconciliation, and Annual Returns) and e-way bill compliance.
