jobs.title: Product Manager, Input Zone
jobs.description:
**Product Manager, Input Zone**

  

**About our Team:-**

DSM Product is the product management team within Data Source Management (DSM, led by Adrian Scotney), part of Data Operations (led by Kanwar Singh). It is led by the Head of Product Management and owns product management for how publisher content enters the Input Zone, Elsevier’s governed gateway for academic publisher content. This includes technical onboarding, ingestion development, publisher rights data (Salesforce) and the Platform Intelligence reporting that supports content providers.

The team is organised around three areas: Platform Intelligence (PLINT), Salesforce/SCM, and the Content Acquisition Liaisons functions that cover ingestion development and technical onboarding.

  

**About the Role:-**

The Product Manager, Input Zone will own the technical onboarding and ingestion-development activities for the Content Acquisition Liaisons group and lead execution of related workstreams. They will own the development plan for the ingestion pipeline and technical onboarding workflow, represent this area within the PM team, and have a solid understanding of content providers and publishers. They will represent their technical needs to the delivery team, prioritise and communicate production issues affecting ingestion or onboarding, and support and participate in demos to key stakeholders at programme milestones.

  

**Responsibilities:-**

  

**Customer Focus**

* Interacts with content providers, publishers, and internal engineering teams during technical onboarding and represents their requirements.

* Anticipates onboarding and ingestion needs (for example, journal processing moving to the DPOP-601 workflow and the Scopus transition off the legacy OpsBank workflow) and prioritises them for the group.

* Acts as a named Onboarding Technical Liaison, fielding technical questions from content providers and publishers during negotiation so engineering capacity stays focused on implementation.

* Focuses on meeting onboarding timelines without compromising the completeness or quality of ingested content.

**Data-Driven Decision-Making & Analysis**

* Autonomously analyses onboarding, delivery, and completeness-checking data from multiple sources (content providers, engineering, Governance reporting).

* Compares and evaluates ingestion and onboarding options, and makes recommendations that consider business implications.

* Uses AI tools responsibly to accelerate analysis, and validates the results before acting on them.

**Onboarding & Content Acquisition Lifecycle**

* Communicates technical requirements and timelines clearly to negotiation and engineering stakeholders.

* Coordinates with the LeapSpace negotiation team, system test team, and OpsBank test team on technical onboarding execution once a negotiation concludes.

* Answers internal and provider-facing questions on ingestion capability, manifest handling, and onboarding scope.

* Prioritises and communicates production issues and defects affecting ingestion or onboarding, based on relevant data.

**Product Delivery & Development Lifecycle**

* Leads execution of the development plan for the ingestion pipeline and technical onboarding workflow.

* Defines and prioritises requirement changes for engineering and performs analysis to meet acceptance criteria.

* Authors clear, testable specifications (requirements, acceptance criteria, manifest and validation rules) as the shared source of truth for engineering and AI-assisted development, in line with spec-driven development (SDD).

* Reviews AI-assisted outputs (generated specs, test cases, prototypes) against requirements and is accountable for their quality before they reach engineering.

Designation: Chief Manager

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Title**
=============

**Zonal Sales Manager (South) - IndusInd Bank Affluent & NRI Channel**

**Location**
------------

South India (Chennai) handles all four states of South.

**Reporting To**
----------------

National Sales Head - IndusInd Bank Relationship

**Role Purpose**
================

Lead the South India region for ABSLI's strategic partnership with IndusInd Bank's Affluent, HNI, and NRI Banking segments. The incumbent will be responsible for driving life insurance penetration across the bank's affluent customer base by building strong engagement with banking leadership, enhancing frontline capability, driving sales productivity, and ensuring sustainable business growth.

The role requires deep expertise in bancassurance, wealth management, relationship selling, and team leadership to establish ABSLI as the preferred insurance partner within IndusInd's affluent banking ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

### **Business Development & Revenue Growth**

* Drive insurance sales across Affluent, Imperia, HNI, and NRI customer segments.
* Deliver annualized premium targets (APE/FYP) for South India.
* Increase wallet share within the affluent customer base.
* Build a robust opportunity pipeline from wealth, investment, and protection-led discussions.
* Drive high-ticket and protection-focused product penetration.

### **Relationship Management**

* Manage relationships with Zonal Heads, Regional Heads, Cluster Heads, and Wealth Leaders of IndusInd Bank.
* Position ABSLI as a strategic partner within the bank's affluent business model.
* Conduct regular business reviews with banking stakeholders.
* Ensure alignment of branch priorities with insurance business objectives.

### **Team Leadership**

* Lead a team of Regional Managers and Relationship Managers across South India.
* Drive productivity and capability building.
* Coach teams on HNI sales conversations and financial planning discussions.
* Build a high-performance sales culture.

### **Capability Development**

* Upskill bank relationship managers on:
  + Financial protection planning
  + Estate planning solutions
  + Retirement planning
  + Wealth transfer concepts
  + NRI insurance solutions
  Tax-efficient insurance products

### **Sales Governance**

* Ensure compliance with IRDAI regulations.
* Monitor suitability and quality parameters.
* Drive persistency and customer retention.
* Maintain healthy business mix and reduce concentration risks.

### **Customer Engagement**

* Conduct HNI customer meets, wealth seminars, and investment forums.
* Participate in client acquisition and portfolio review events.
* Engage with key customers for large-ticket closures.

**Key Result Areas (KRAs)**
===========================

**KRA**

  
  

New Business Premium (APE/FYP) Achievement

  
  

Affluent & HNI Customer Acquisition

  
  

Product Mix & Protection Penetration

  
  

Active Branch Productivity

  
  

Banker Activation & Engagement

  
  

Team Productivity & Retention

  
  

Persistency & Quality Metrics

  
  

Stakeholder Relationship

  
  

**Critical Challenges of the Role**
===================================

### **1. New Partnership Establishment**

* Building mindshare and trust for ABSLI within an existing banking ecosystem.
Competing with legacy bancassurance relationships and established insurers.  

### **2. Affluent Customer Expectations**

* HNI and NRI customers demand advisory-led conversations rather than transactional selling.
Higher scrutiny on product suitability and value proposition.  

### **3. Banker Engagement**

* Securing mindshare from affluent bankers already focused on liabilities, investments, and AUM acquisition.
Maintaining insurance visibility amidst competing priorities.  

### **4. Geographic Complexity**

* Managing multiple states, languages, and diverse customer demographics across South India.

### **5. High Ticket Closure Cycles**

Longer sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, family members, and financial advisors.  



### **6. Wealth vs Protection Balance**

* Driving sustainable protection business while meeting premium targets.
Avoiding overdependence on single-premium or investment-oriented sales.  

### **7. NRI Business Development**

Navigating regulatory processes, documentation requirements, and customer accessibility challenges.  



### **8. Talent & Capability Building**

* Developing teams capable of engaging affluent customers on sophisticated financial planning topics.

**Desired Candidate Profile**
=============================

### **Experience**

* 10-15+ years in Wealth Bancassurance.
* Minimum 5 years in a leadership role.
* Strong experience with HNI, Emerging Affluent, Wealth, or NRI segments.
Proven track record of managing large geographies and partnerships.  

### **Preferred Background**

* Bancassurance leadership.
* Insurance distribution leadership.

### **Key Skills**

* Strategic Sales Leadership
* Wealth & Protection Planning
* Stakeholder Management
* Relationship Management
* Team Development
* Negotiation & Influence
* Business Planning
* Data-Driven Sales Management

**Success Profile (First 12 Months)**
=====================================

The ZSM should be able to:

* Establish ABSLI as a preferred insurance partner within IndusInd's Affluent Banking ecosystem.
* Activate 80-90% of targeted affluent banking locations in South India.
* Build a strong pipeline of HNI/NRI business.

* Develop a high-performing regional sales team.

jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Our Business Management team acts as a trusted advisor to senior leaders and optimizes business performance by helping to drive key initiatives. We act as a counterweight to business and group heads and are responsible for identifying, escalating, and mitigating business risks. The role is dynamic and can vary from business to business, in line with the priorities of different lines of business. This is a time-pressured and high-profile position, instrumental in assisting and advising senior management. You will help coordinate the deployment of corporate resources to address strategic and tactical objectives.

Job summary

As a **Business Management** professional within the **Business Management team**, you will help drive strategic and tactical objectives by coordinating corporate resources and advising senior management. You will implement new business strategy, strategic initiatives, or platforms by aligning partners across Finance, Technology, Operations, Legal, and Compliance. You will optimize bottom-line performance by driving key initiatives related to fees, cost base, risk-weighted assets, and capital utilization. You will identify, escalate, and mitigate business risks that could impair the ability to do business, including legal, tax, regulatory, capacity issues, and extraordinary transaction costs. You will partner across functions to define future workflows and implement related technology and infrastructure projects to support an evolving market structure.

Job responsibilities

* **Implement** new business strategy, strategic initiatives, or platforms, including aligning department and support groups (Finance, Technology, Operations, Legal, Compliance)

* **Analyze** financial performance, including expenses; **identify** productivity initiatives and **drive** implementation
* **Partner** with the business, Operations, and Technology to define future workflows and **implement** related technology and infrastructure projects to prepare for evolving market structure requirements
* **Partner** with relevant external service and infrastructure providers
* **Represent** the business in internal and external working groups

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or other related area
* Previous product knowledge and/or prior Business Management or Chief Operating Officer experience
* Energetic and dynamic style
* Highly motivated self-starter with excellent time management and prioritization skills
* Ability to present well to senior and global business heads
* Ability to forge strong internal relationships across a broad range of functions
* Self-motivated, tenacious, and able to work with a high degree of independence
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Ability to define and deliver a strategic agenda across multiple groups
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including ability to analyze large data sets and present conclusions concisely
* Excellent project management and organizational skills, with strong attention to detail and a logical thought process

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**  
  
  

Our Consumer & Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.

  

Global Finance & Business Management works to strategically manage capital, drive growth and efficiencies, maintain financial reporting and proactively manage risk. By providing information, analysis and recommendations to improve results and drive decisions, teams ensure the company can navigate all types of market conditions while protecting our fortress balance sheet.

jobs.description:
**Company** | Hybon Technologies Private Limited  
**Location** | The Executive Centre, 7th Floor, Worldmark 4, Aerocity, New Delhi  
**Employment Type** | Full-time  
**Reporting To** | Chief Financial Officer

Role Overview

Hybon Technologies is looking for a **Head of Accounts** to lead the accounting function for its domestic trading and export business in mobile phones, electronics and IT products. The role owns the books of accounts, financial close, statutory compliance, audit coordination and internal controls. The successful candidate will lead the accounts team and work closely with sales, procurement, logistics and banking teams to keep financial records accurate and resolve discrepancies promptly.

Key Responsibilities

* **Accounting and financial close** — Oversee the general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, bank reconciliations, fixed assets and intercompany balances. Lead monthly and year-end closing and prepare financial statements and supporting schedules.
* **GST and tax compliance** — Oversee GST returns, GSTR-2B reconciliations, input tax credit, e-invoicing and e-way bills. Manage TDS deductions, deposits and returns, and coordinate with tax advisors on statutory filings and notices.
* **Import and export accounting** — Review invoices, bills of entry, shipping bills, customs duties, freight and landed costs. Monitor foreign currency receivables and payables, exchange differences and export realisations. Coordinate with banks and internal teams on remittance documentation and support GST refund claims where applicable.
* **Inventory and cost controls** — Reconcile inventory records with the books and physical stock counts. Investigate stock discrepancies, review valuation and landed costs, and oversee IMEI or serial-number reconciliation where applicable.
* **Receivables, payables and cash flow** — Monitor customer and vendor ageing, advances and credit balances. Drive account confirmations and dispute resolution, review payment schedules and prepare cash flow forecasts for management.
* **Management reporting** — Prepare monthly reports on profitability, gross margins, inventory, overdue receivables and working capital. Explain material variances and flag issues that require management action.
* **Audits and internal controls** — Coordinate statutory, tax and internal audits. Maintain supporting documentation, close audit observations and strengthen review controls for invoicing, payments, credit notes and journal entries.
* **Team leadership** — Supervise and develop the accounts team, set clear responsibilities and review deadlines, and improve accounting processes and ERP workflows.

Qualifications and Experience

* CA preferred. CMA, M.Com or B.Com candidates with relevant senior accounting experience may also be considered.
* 8–12 years of accounting experience, including at least 3 years leading an accounts team.
* Experience in trading, distribution or import/export is preferred. Exposure to mobile phones, electronics or IT hardware is an advantage.
* Hands-on experience in financial closing, GST, TDS, inventory accounting, reconciliations and audit coordination.
* Proficiency in Tally Prime or a comparable ERP, along with strong Excel skills for reconciliations and management reporting.
* Ability to lead a team, meet statutory and reporting deadlines, and communicate clearly with management, auditors, banks and business teams.

Pay: ₹60,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
WE'RE HIRING! | Banking Alliances & Partnerships Manager.

We are hiring a banking professional who can open, run and protect To The Moon Technologies Pvt Ltd's banking relationships: INR pay-in, payout, virtual accounts, CMS and API banking for a crypto trading platform.

* **Department:** Strategic Partnerships (Banking & Payments)
* **Reports To:** Founder & CEO
* **Location:** Lucknow
* **Travel:** Regular travel to Mumbai, Delhi NCR & Bengaluru for bank meetings
* **Experience:** 5+ years in Banking or Fintech
* **Required Expertise:** Digital Banking, API Banking, CMS & Virtual Accounts
* **Employment Type:** Full-time
* **Seniority:** Senior Executive to Manager, based on experience

**About ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd**

ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd is an FIU-IND registered Indian cryptocurrency exchange, headquartered in Jaipur and operating since 2021. We run spot and futures trading plus OTC on-ramp and off-ramp services for Indian users. INR flows, deposits, withdrawals and settlements, sit at the center of our business, and they depend on strong, compliant banking partners.

**Role purpose**

You will own ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd's banking ecosystem end to end. That means finding and onboarding banks, getting API banking, virtual accounts and CMS live, and keeping every relationship healthy. You will also build backup banking so no single bank or payment rail can stop INR deposits or withdrawals.

**Key responsibilities**

1.Bank partnerships and onboarding

a. Find, pitch and onboard private, small finance, cooperative and new-age banks for current accounts, escrow/nodal accounts, pay-in and payout.

b. Present ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd's business model, FIU-IND registration, AML/KYC framework and risk controls to bank product, risk and compliance teams.

c. Lead the bank's due diligence: documents, questionnaires, site visits and onboarding

paperwork.

2. API banking, virtual accounts and CMS

a. Set up and expand virtual account (VAN) structures for user-wise INR deposit collection

and auto-reconciliation.

b. Get API banking live for IMPS, NEFT, RTGS and UPI payouts, plus balance, statement and

status APIs.

c. Set up CMS for collections and bulk payouts, and drive integration with our tech team

through UAT and go-live.

d. Work with UPI collect, payment aggregator and PSP partners as extra deposit rails.

3. Relationship management

a. Act as the single point of contact for every banking partner, from relationship managers

up to senior leadership.

b. Handle account freezes, lien marks, LEA and cyber-cell requests, chargebacks and

transaction holds with the bank and our compliance team.

c. Run regular reviews of volumes, TAT, success rates and issues with each bank.

4. Negotiation and commercials

a. Negotiate pricing, transaction limits, float terms, MDR, payout charges and SLAs.

b. Review and close banking agreements, API terms and SLAs with our legal team.

5. Business continuity

a. Always keep at least two live banking partners for pay-in and payout, with tested

failover.

b. Spot risk early, regulatory changes, a bank's appetite for VDA business and line up

alternatives before they are needed.

6. Compliance and internal coordination

a. Work with compliance, finance, operations and tech so bank requirements under PMLA,

FIU-IND and RBI guidelines are met.

b. Keep partner dashboards, MIS and documentation current for management.

**Must-have requirements**

* 5+ years in banking or fintech, with hands-on work in digital banking, API banking, CMS and

virtual accounts.

* Has managed these products for a corporate client, a fintech platform, a stockbroker, a payment

aggregator or a crypto exchange from the bank side or the client side.

* Has taken at least 2–3 bank integrations (VAN, payout API or CMS) from first meeting to go-live.

* An active network of decision-makers in transaction banking, CMS, digital/API banking and

fintech partnership teams at Indian banks.

* Clear understanding of INR payment rails: IMPS, NEFT, RTGS, UPI, NACH, and escrow/nodal

account structures.

* Working knowledge of KYC/AML, PMLA, FIU-IND and RBI rules relevant to banks serving fintechs

and VDA businesses.

* Strong negotiation, presentation and written communication skills in English and Hindi.

* Graduate in any field; MBA in Finance, Banking or Business preferred.

**Skills and Competencies**

* **Banking Products:** Knowledge of current, escrow and nodal accounts; virtual accounts; CMS collections and payouts; API banking; UPI collect and payout.
* **Technical Fluency:** Ability to read API documentation and understand webhooks, callbacks, reconciliation files and UAT; comfortable coordinating with developers and bank technology teams.
* **Negotiation:** Ability to negotiate pricing, transaction limits, SLAs and agreements while maintaining strong banking relationships.
* **Communication:** Strong presentation and email-writing skills; confident in meetings with bank CXOs, risk and compliance heads.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Ability to align compliance, finance, technology and operations teams around bank integration timelines.
* **Problem Solving:** Ability to resolve account freezes, failed payouts, settlement delays and reconciliation gaps quickly.
* **Ownership:** Self-driven, works independently and takes complete responsibility for follow-through until go-live.
* **Integrity:** Handles confidential banking and customer data with utmost discretion.

**Good to have**

•Earlier work in a bank's transaction banking, CMS, digital banking or fintech alliances team.

•Experience at an Indian crypto exchange, stockbroker, payment gateway, PSP or NBFC.

•Has onboarded a VDA or high-risk business with a bank and understands the bank's concerns.

•Exposure to payment aggregator rules, cross-border payments or stablecoin on/off-ramp flows.

•Familiarity with reconciliation tools, MIS reporting and Excel-based analysis.

Pay: ₹444,000.00 - ₹700,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

Yubi is the place to unleash potential. Freedom, not fear. Avenues, not roadblocks. Opportunity, not obstacles.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Senior Associate - Product Solutions (Credit & Compliance)**

**Location:** Dubai

**About the Role**

We are looking for a strong Product Specialist to join our Product team at YubiMENA. The ideal candidate understands banking credit, risk, and compliance, and knows how products are designed around them. This person sits between clients, sales, and product engineering. They translate each bank's or lender's regulatory, credit, and risk requirements, along with its existing systems, into a configured solution that can be scoped, priced, and delivered.

They will be the main technical and regulatory voice for clients during pre-sales and implementation, and will turn complex requirements into solutions that product and delivery teams can build.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Client discovery and requirements**

  

* Lead discovery workshops with credit, risk, compliance, and technology stakeholders to understand regulatory obligations, risk appetite, and current controls.
* Map regulatory and compliance requirements to product capabilities, covering understanding the obligations, translating them into functional requirements, and tracing each one to the product feature that satisfies it.
* Identify gaps between client needs and the current product, and document them clearly for the product roadmap.

**Solution design**

  

* Design end-to-end solution architectures covering credit origination, underwriting and decisioning, risk monitoring, AML/CFT screening, KYC onboarding, and regulatory reporting, including integration with core banking, onboarding, and payments systems.
* Define configuration approaches for risk-based rules, scoring models, thresholds, and workflows, and explain the trade-offs between them.
* Produce solution documentation: design documents, data flow diagrams, integration specifications, and configuration guides.

**Pre-sales and proposals**

  

* Support sales with technical deep-dives, demos, and proof-of-concept scoping.
* Lead the technical sections of RFPs, RFIs, and security or regulatory questionnaires.
* Estimate implementation effort, timelines, and resource needs, and flag risks early.

**Implementation handover**

  

* Hand off solution designs to delivery and engineering with clear acceptance criteria.
* Support UAT planning and resolve design questions that come up during implementation.
* Contribute reusable patterns and accelerators back to the product team.

**Product input**

  

* Work with Product Management to prioritize features based on client demand, credit policy needs, and regulatory change.
* Track regulatory and credit policy updates and advise on their product impact, including new reporting templates, thresholds, and typology changes.

**Must-Have Qualifications**

  

* 6 to 10 years of experience in banking, with a focus on credit, risk or compliance, including at least 3 years in a solution, pre-sales, implementation, or product-facing role.
* Hands-on experience in credit and compliance processes (underwriting, credit assessment, credit risk, or credit monitoring) and/or financial crime compliance (AML/CFT, sanctions, KYC/CDD) within banks.
* Working knowledge of UAE and GCC regulatory frameworks, including CBUAE requirements.
* Experience designing, configuring, or implementing banking systems such as credit decisioning, risk scoring, transaction monitoring, screening, or case management platforms.
* Ability to write clear solution documents and explain technical concepts to both business stakeholders and engineers.
* Experience running workshops and presenting to senior stakeholders, including CCOs, CROs, and credit heads.
* Strong analytical skills, with comfort working with transaction or portfolio data and tuning metrics such as approval rates, default rates, and false positive rates.

**Preferred Background**

  

* 10 years of banking experience in Dubai or the UAE, in credit, risk or compliance roles.
* Experience in a product department at a bank, or in product design, product management, or solutioning.
* Current or recent experience at an AI-first, tech-forward fintech or financial institution in Dubai, with a prior background in traditional banking.

jobs.title: Manager, Payments & Treasury
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**  
NEXT Ventures is where ambition takes shape and momentum becomes movement. As a global platform, revolutionising access to performance-based capital, we empower the world’s most driven individuals to rise. Through our flagship brand, FundedNext, we empower dreamers to become doers and potential to turn into performance. FNmarkets is our international brokerage arm, serving clients across global markets*.*

With 500+ driven minds across five countries, we power a global rhythm—220,000+ daily users, from 170+ nations, each chasing greatness in their own way.

**Your Role in Our Mission**  
As a Manager, Payments & Treasury (FNmarkets Brokerage), you own the end-to-end movement, safeguarding, and optimization of client and corporate funds across FNmarkets’ international brokerage operations. You will run the PSP and banking portfolio that powers client deposits and withdrawals, manage multi-currency liquidity and FX exposure, and keep settlement, reconciliation, and treasury controls tight as the brokerage scales across markets. Sitting at the intersection of payment operations, treasury, and bank/PSP relationship management, you partner closely with Compliance, Finance, Risk, and trading-platform teams to keep funds flowing reliably, cost-efficiently, and within regulatory requirements.

This role reports to the group Head of Payments & Treasury.

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

* **Payment Operations & PSP Portfolio:**

* **Portfolio Ownership:** Own the PSP and payment-method portfolio (cards, local bank rails, e-wallets, crypto) across the brokerage’s active markets, from onboarding and integration through performance monitoring and offboarding.
* **Payment Routing Optimization:** Optimize payment routing in the orchestrator to lift approval rates, reduce decline and failure rates, and lower blended cost per transaction.
* **SLA & Performance Tracking:** Track and improve deposit/withdrawal success rates, processing times, and chargeback/dispute ratios against agreed SLAs.

**2. Client Funds & Payout Operations:**

* **End-to-End Flow Oversight:** Oversee client deposit and withdrawal flows end to end, ensuring funds are processed accurately, on time, and in line with client-money safeguarding rules.
* **Payout Management:** Manage brokerage client withdrawals and wallet transfers, including volume forecasting, queue management, and exception handling.
* **Fund Segregation & Reporting:** Maintain segregation of client funds from corporate funds and support audit and regulatory reporting on balances.

**3. Treasury, FX & Cash Management:**

* **Multi-Currency Liquidity:** Manage multi-currency liquidity across entities and accounts, ensuring sufficient funding for client withdrawals, settlements, and operating needs.
* **FX & Hedging Execution:** Run FX operations and conversions, monitor currency exposure, and execute hedging or rebalancing as directed by policy.
* **Cash Forecasting & Yield:** Forecast cash positions, optimize working capital, and manage the placement of eligible corporate cash within approved investment and counterparty limits—with client funds held separately and safeguarded at all times.

**4. Banking & Relationship Management:**

* **Partner Management:** Own relationships with banks, PSPs, and acquiring partners—covering commercials, fee and settlement-term negotiation, issue escalation, and periodic performance reviews.
* **Cost Reduction:** Drive down processing, settlement, and FX costs through negotiation and transfer-pricing/routing optimization.
* **Infrastructure Redundancy:** Build banking and PSP redundancy to protect the continuity of client deposits and withdrawals.

**5. Reconciliation, Compliance & Risk:**

* **Multi-Ledger Reconciliation:** Own daily and periodic reconciliation across PSPs, banks, crypto wallets, and the ledger, resolving breaks and ensuring settlement accuracy.
* **Regulatory & Compliance Alignment:** Partner with Compliance on KYC/AML, licensing, and regulatory requirements affecting payment flows and client funds.
* **Risk Mitigation:** Identify and mitigate operational, settlement, counterparty, and fraud risk across the payment and treasury stack.

**6. Projects & Optimization:**

* **Expansion & Automation Initiatives:** Lead payments and treasury projects, including new-market and new-method launches, orchestrator and system integrations, and process automation.
* **Executive Reporting:** Build reporting and dashboards on approval rates, cost, settlement cycles, liquidity, and payout performance for leadership.
* **Cross-Functional Scaling:** Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Finance, and Risk to scale payment and treasury capability as the brokerage grows.

**7. Build & Scale, Team Leadership & Innovation:**

* **Build & Scale:** Define and build out the FNmarkets payments and treasury operating model - people, processes, and systems - to support the brokerage’s growth across new markets and product lines.
* **Team Leadership:** Lead, develop, and grow a high-performing payments & treasury wing for FNmarkets business line, setting clear priorities, fostering accountability, and building capability at every level.
* **Innovation & Knowledge Sharing:** Champion continuous improvement by staying current on industry developments, introducing best practices, and ensuring knowledge flows across the team and key stakeholders.

**What You Bring**

* **Industry Experience:** Minimum 5 years in payments, funds management, and treasury functions at an international brokerage (CFD/FX/securities); strong candidates from payments firms serving brokerage clients also considered.
* **High-Volume Payment Operations:** Hands-on experience managing client deposit and withdrawal flows, PSP relationships, and payment routing in a high-volume, multi-currency environment.
* **Treasury & FX Mastery:** Treasury experience across multi-currency liquidity and cash management, FX operations, and working-capital or settlement optimization.
* **Payment Ecosystem Knowledge:** Strong grasp of digital payment methods and ecosystems—card networks, local/alternative payment rails, e-wallets, and crypto/stablecoin settlement.
* **Commercial Negotiation:** Demonstrated bank and PSP negotiation experience, with a track record of reducing fees and improving settlement terms and approval performance.
* **Reconciliation & Breaks Resolution:** Solid command of reconciliation and settlement across multiple payment partners and ledgers, including breaks investigation.
* **Compliance & Safeguarding:** Working knowledge of KYC/AML, client-money safeguarding, and the compliance/licensing considerations affecting cross-border payment flows.
* **Data & Analytics:** Strong analytical skills; comfortable working with transaction data, dashboards, and spreadsheets to drive decisions.
* **Education & Communication:** A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field; paired with fluent written and spoken English for coordinating across international partners and internal stakeholders.

**Preferred (Nice-to-Haves)**

* **Payment Orchestration:** Experience with payment orchestration platforms and routing logic (e.g., cascading, smart routing, retry optimization).
* **Multi-Jurisdiction Setup:** Familiarity with regulated-entity treasury across multiple jurisdictions, including banking setups and licensing considerations.
* **Market Launches:** Prior experience launching payment methods or banking relationships in new markets.
* **Certifications & SQL:** Relevant certifications (e.g., CTP, payments or treasury qualifications) and SQL or data-analysis skills for working with transaction-level data are good to have.
* **Crypto Settlement:** Exposure to crypto settlement and reconciliation (USDT, TRC-20/ERC-20) and crypto–fiat on/off-ramp flows.

**About SC Ventures**

**SC Ventures is Standard Chartered ’s innovation, fintech investment and ventures arm. We were established to reinvent banking, as the significant technological disruptions to the industry was impacting its ability to serve clients and customers, in the ways they needed to be served. We are a unique ecosystem of innovators, banking experts, business builders and partners who are focused on rewiring the DNA in banking and bringing breakthrough ideas to scale, together. We are building ecosystems around four high conviction themes: Online Economy & Lifestyle, SMEs & World Trade, Digital Assets, and Sustainability & Inclusion. We are a global team of "Members" (excluding individual ventures), including dedicated colleagues from the Group's support functions, based in Singapore, Hong Kong, London, and the United Arab Emirates**

**About HAL**

**HAL is a B2B domestic and cross border marketplace being built for SMEs in the UAE. Incubated by SC Ventures, the ventures arm of Standard Chartered Bank, the platform will enable digital commerce and access to financial & value-added services. HAL’s vision is to act as a super glue connecting multiple partners & ecosystems by bringing together buyers, sellers, financial institutions, logistics partners under one roof. We are building this as an agentic AI native stack along with several strategic partners in the UAE who bring different capabilities into the platform.**

**SMEs are the backbone of the UAE economy and vital for economic growth and diversification. We want to help SMEs grow profitably, safely and with ease. Hal is being built for scale with the latest technologies and with a vision to truly become the one stop shop for SMEs. We are looking to launch later in the year.**

**The Senior Marketing Manager will lead HAL's marketing function, working closely with the CEO and the commercial, product and partnerships teams. This is a commercially driven role: success is measured by the qualified B2B leads you generate (sellers, buyers and SMEs looking for finance), the revenue they bring in, and HAL's growing share of the UAE SME market. You will be hands-on and highly experimental, testing new channels and ideas quickly, doubling down on what works, and doing whatever it takes to help HAL win in the market.**

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager 3
jobs.description:
#### **About Behavox**

Behavox is shaping the future for how businesses harness their most important raw material - data. Our mission is bold: Organize enterprise data into actionable information that protects and promotes the business growth of multinational companies around the world.

From managing enterprise risk and compliance to maximizing revenue and value, our data operating platform presents a widespread opportunity to build multilingual, AI/ML-based solutions that activate data for every function within a global enterprise.

Our approach is unique, and it's validated by our customers who tell us to keep forging ahead because no one else is aggregating, analyzing, and acting on data to uncover opportunities or solve problems quite the way we are.

We are looking for fearless innovators who have an insatiable appetite for building what no one has built before.

**About the Role**

Behavox's Strategic Account Managers own the full commercial relationship with some of the world's most complex and highly regulated financial institutions. This includes delivery outcomes, commercial performance, executive relationships, and long-term strategic growth across a portfolio of global banks, hedge funds, asset managers, and energy firms operating under the world's most demanding regulatory frameworks.

Clients in this portfolio are building or strengthening unified controls frameworks that bring together communications surveillance, trade surveillance, compliant archiving, and policy management into a single, defensible control system. The Strategic Account Manager's role is to understand where each client sits on that journey, ensure Behavox is delivering against their current needs, and position the platform to serve the full scope of their controls framework over time. This requires full end-to-end ownership of the relationship, delivery, health, satisfaction, retention, and growth for every account in the portfolio, operating with a high degree of autonomy on account strategy, renewals, escalations, and executive relationships.

The role requires the ability to think strategically and execute operationally, often in the same day. The Strategic Account Manager will own all renewals across the portfolio, build retention strategy, lead negotiations, and close; accurately forecast ARR churn risk and develop mitigation plans; drive inbound expansion deals independently in collaboration with Account Executives; and lead executive business reviews that are genuinely strategic: conversations about compliance posture, regulatory risk, control maturity, and platform value.

This is a hybrid position based out of our London office.

**What You'll Bring**

* **Enterprise compliance technology and unified controls frameworks.** Deep working knowledge of how communications surveillance, trade surveillance, compliant archiving, and policy management converge into a single control system at regulated financial institutions; understands how clients evaluate and mature their compliance posture over time.
* **Financial services regulatory environment.** Understands the regulatory obligations driving client demand, from communications monitoring requirements to trade reconstruction and archiving mandates, across global banking, hedge fund, asset management, and energy sectors.
* **Multi-stakeholder account management across regulated financial institutions.** Navigates complex organizational structures involving Heads of Surveillance, compliance analysts, technology teams, and operations teams; manages both executive-level strategic relationships and working-level practitioner relationships simultaneously.
* **Commercial lifecycle management for enterprise SaaS.** Owns the full renewal and expansion cycle: retention strategy, churn forecasting, negotiation, close, and pipeline development in partnership with Account Executives; understands how delivery health directly impacts commercial outcomes.
* **Escalation management and operational accountability**. Owns ticket triage, escalation, and resolution end to end for the full portfolio; manages complex, multi-workstream escalations with minimal manager involvement; builds relationships with Product, Engineering, and Support counterparts to accelerate resolution.

**What You'll Do**

* **Account health monitoring and risk identification.** Independently assesses account health and risk across commercial, operational, and relationship dimensions; surfaces risk early by reading ticket patterns, stakeholder signals, and adoption data as intelligence; builds intervention plans without manager direction.
* **Executive business review design and delivery.** Designs and executes QBRs and EBRs for all accounts including executive-level engagement; leads conversations about compliance posture, regulatory risk, control maturity, and platform value rather than product update calls.
* **Renewal ownership and churn forecasting.** Owns all renewals across the portfolio: builds retention strategy, leads negotiations, closes; accurately forecasts ARR churn risk and develops mitigation plans using account health data, stakeholder intelligence, and delivery performance indicators.
* **Expansion identification and commercial execution.** Drives inbound expansion deals independently; collaborates with Account Executives per Unit of One model for strategic accounts; leads with value, not discount-first positioning; builds commercial plays grounded in customer intelligence.
* **Delivery follow-through and client communication ownership.** Owns the client-facing narrative when delivery issues arise, ensuring commitments made to the client are tracked and fulfilled; translates technical or operational updates into language the client can act on; holds internal teams accountable through to confirmed resolution so the client has everything they need without chasing.

**What We Offer**

* A truly global mission with a passionate community in locations all over the world
* Huge impact and learning potential as our aspirations require bold innovation
* Highly competitive compensation
* Benefits include fully covered health coverage for employee and family
* Generous time-off policy and flexible work schedule

**About Our Process**

  

We take Talent very seriously and we are building a community of extraordinary individuals working together in very high performing teams. We also know that the best Talent always has options so we believe that the process has to be a two way assessment - the company AND the candidate assessing the business needs alignment, the career next step alignment, and the cultural alignment.  
  
During the process we will begin by exploring the core factors regarding salary and location along with core experience and skills and values alignment. We will then deep dive explore the critical technical competencies we have identified for the role, and then we will deep dive in behavioral competencies.  
  
The most aligned candidate will then be asked to do a practical work task simulation activity so we can make sure that you will enjoy the kind of work the role requires, and this task will typically be presented and discussed with a group of colleagues and managers. Finally we will ask you to meet with a number of our senior leaders to make sure that you are making the most informed call possible.

**Please note that:**

* We want to get to know you and have a genuine conversation, so the use of AI tools or assistance during live interviews is strictly prohibited and will result in immediate disqualification from the process
* Interviews may be recorded for internal review purposes to ensure fairness and enable collaborative hiring discussions within the team.

**Key** **Account Manager** – **Payments**

OxyX | SME Growth · Accounting Practice Partnerships · Payments & Business Technology  
Position: Key Account Manager – Payments

**Business: OxyX - Kanzpay**  
***www.KanzPay.com***  
***www.OxyTech.ae***

Reports to: Sales / Business Head  
Location: UAE – field and office-based

***Role purpose***

The Key Account Manager – Payments will drive the adoption and growth of OxyX among UAE small and medium-sized businesses (SMEs). The role combines two complementary routes to market: building productive referral relationships with accounting firms and acquiring, onboarding and managing SMEs directly.

The successful candidate will help business owners understand how OxyX can improve collections, payment journeys, customer engagement and day-to-day business decisions. The role is focused on consultative selling, trusted relationships, activation and sustained usage—not simply signing up accounts.

***Key responsibilities***

*1. Accounting firm partnership development*

* Identify, map and approach accounting, bookkeeping and tax advisory practices serving UAE SMEs. **Build relationships with practice owners, partners, directors and client-facing teams; explain the OxyX partner proposition clearly.** Position accounting firms as trusted referral partners who can introduce OxyX to suitable SME clients while retaining their own client relationships. **Arrange partner meetings, briefings, demonstrations and follow-ups; maintain a structured pipeline of prospective and active firms.** Equip partners with approved presentations, product information, referral processes and client onboarding support. **Identify client needs with partner firms and coordinate introductions with the SME's consent.** Maintain partner engagement, track referred opportunities and support partner activation and retention.

*2. Direct SME acquisition and sales*

* Identify and approach SMEs across relevant sectors, including retail, trading, professional services, hospitality and other suitable business categories. **Understand each prospect's business model, current ERP/accounting setup, payment and collection processes, operational pain points and growth priorities.** Conduct needs-based discussions and demonstrate relevant OxyX capabilities rather than delivering generic product presentations. **Explain how OxyX works as an intelligence and action layer alongside the SME's existing systems, subject to connector availability, permissions and supported data.** Develop proposals, manage objections, follow up opportunities and progress prospects through evaluation, decision and onboarding. **Build relationships with business owners, finance managers, operations managers and other decision-makers.**

*3. SME onboarding, activation and account management*

* Coordinate onboarding with the SME, accounting firm and internal implementation/support teams. **Ensure the SME understands agreed use cases, onboarding requirements, connector prerequisites and each party's responsibilities.** Support initial setup, user orientation and first-use milestones; escalate technical or integration issues promptly. **Monitor engagement, identify underused capabilities and recommend relevant steps to improve adoption and business value.** Maintain regular account reviews, resolve relationship issues and identify opportunities for expansion, renewal and referral. **Capture customer feedback and share product, integration and service improvement suggestions internally.**

*4. Product and market understanding*

* Develop working knowledge of OxyX's SME cockpit, business controls, AI-assisted insights, collections and payment-related workflows, rewards, expense-related capabilities and e-invoicing integrations where available. **Understand the distinction between OxyX technology/workflows and services delivered by banks, payment service providers, acquirers and accredited e-invoicing service providers.** Keep up to date with SME operating challenges, accounting practice needs, market developments and competitor propositions. **Translate customer feedback and market observations into clear inputs for product, marketing, operations and management.**

*Performance expectations*

Performance will be assessed on the quality and consistency of partner development, SME acquisition, successful onboarding, active usage, customer retention and value created for SMEs and accounting partners.

Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Lead Digital Product Manager to lead the strategy, vision, and execution of enterprise-scale platform experiences, with a focus on Identity & Access Management (IAM), authorization, and digital platform modernization. You will influence enterprise-wide product strategy, solve complex business and technical challenges, and deliver innovative solutions that improve customer experiences, strengthen platform capabilities, and create measurable business value. The ideal candidate combines strong product leadership, technical depth, and the ability to influence outcomes across a highly matrixed organization.

jobs.title: Director of Product, Global Tax Platform
jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
  
  
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
  
  
Based in San Francisco, Rippling has raised $1.85B+ from investors including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, Bedrock, GIC, Elad Gil, and Goldman Sachs, and was named one of America’s best startup employers by Forbes.
  
  
We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
  
  
**About The Role**
Tax is where trust is won or lost. Every calculation, filing, and payment is a promise to our customers and to the agencies they answer to. As Rippling scales into the enterprise and expands globally, the Tax Platform is mission-critical infrastructure: it must be accurate, explainable, and reliable at a level most payroll systems were never designed for.
  
  
We’re looking for a Director of Product, based in Bangalore, to lead Rippling’s Global Tax Platform team. You’ll own the end-to-end system that calculates, files, and pays taxes globally — across employees and contractors, across every country we operate in, and across federal, state, and local jurisdictions.
  
  
The scope covers:
  
  

* Calculation engine, including the multi-year effort to build Tax Foundry — an AI-enabled tax calculation and policy engine that replaces our third-party dependency.
* Filings and agency communications across all jurisdictions globally.
* Tax payments and reconciliation — accurate, on-time, and fully traceable.
* Upstream data audits and self-serve resolution so issues are caught before they block filings.
* In-product explainability so every tax value can be traced to its source inputs and rules.
* Enterprise readiness — multi-entity, multi-country, equity comp, and complex tax structures at scale.

The goal is simple: no surprises. Customers should never be caught off guard by their tax data, and the team should never be pulled into reactive firefights during filing season.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Own the vision and execution for the Tax Platform across calculation, filing, payments, and reconciliation globally.
* Lead a team of Senior Product Leads across calculation, filings, payments, data quality, and enterprise tax.
* Drive measurable improvements in filing accuracy, on-time payment rates, weekly data accuracy, customer self-serve, and enterprise escalations.
* Make the call on Tax Foundry while maintaining a credible third-party backup plan.
* Build opinionated, configurable workflows that reduce reliance on Tax Ops and CX.
* Partner with Engineering, Tax Ops, CX, Payroll, Compliance, Legal, and GTM to align expansion with platform architecture.
* Serve as a Senior Product Leader in Bangalore, operating tightly with leadership in San Francisco.

**What You Will Need**

* Serve as a senior product leader in Bangalore, operating tightly with leadership in San Francisco.
* 12+ years of Product Management experience.
* Proven experience leading senior IC PMs across multiple teams.
* Experience owning complex, multi-surface platforms with regulatory, tax, or financial complexity.
* Strong systems thinker — you see primitives, not just features.
* Track record of shipping both 0-to-1 launches and scaled products used by large customer bases.
* Comfortable operating at multiple altitudes: strategy, architecture, UX, and execution rigor.
* Strong cross-functional leadership across engineering, tax/compliance, operations, and GTM.
* High ownership mindset — accountable for outcomes, not output.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication in a highly cross-functional, globally distributed role.
* Payroll, tax, accounting, or fintech experience is a strong plus.
* Strong alignment with our leadership principles: in particular, Go and See, and Are Right, a Lot.

If you don’t necessarily meet all of the requirements listed here, we still encourage you to apply because skills can be used in lots of different ways, your life experience is equally important sometimes.
  
  
**The final compensation offered to a successful candidate will depend on several factors, including but not limited to, location, experience, education, training, and business need. This position may also be eligible for bonuses, commissions, and/or equity, subject to applicable plan documents and company policy. Successful candidates hired for this role may also be eligible to participate in the company's benefits programs, which may include, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, retirement benefits, and/or paid time off, as determined by company policy.**

We pioneered Pay in 3 through UPI and are also home to India’s leading 0% EMI e commerce app — giving millions of Indians the freedom to shop now and pay in monthly instalments, with no extra cost and no credit card required.

Headquartered in Mumbai, with offices across major metros including Bengaluru, Gurugram, Delhi and Jaipur, we’re building at the intersection of commerce, credit, technology and culture. Come build Snapmint and help us change how India pays.

As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

**Role Overview**

As Director of Product, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Skan's process intelligence platform. This is the platform that helps the world's largest enterprises see how work actually happens inside their organizations, and act on that understanding. It is technically complex, data-intensive, and genuinely impactful at scale.

We are looking for someone who has spent meaningful time in process mining, process intelligence, or intelligent automation. Not just an awareness of the space, but real product experience in it. You know the gap between a compelling demo and something that actually works in a large enterprise environment. You have shipped products in this domain and have the scars to show for it.

With 12 to 15 years of product experience, including time at AI-native startups, you are comfortable making product calls with incomplete information, working without a lot of support structure around you, and keeping a team focused when everything feels urgent. You are also someone who uses AI tools every day in how you work, not just in what you build. That matters to us.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Vision and Strategy**

* Own the product roadmap for the process intelligence platform, from how we capture and model operational data through to the analytics and prescriptive insights we surface to customers.
* Make clear, defensible decisions on what we build next. You will get input from customers, from sales, from data, and from the competitive landscape. Your job is to synthesize all of that and land on a prioritized point of view.
* Keep the company aligned on product direction. That means being a consistent voice in leadership discussions, not just a person who maintains a roadmap document.
* Know the competitive landscape well. Understand what Celonis, SAP Signavio, UiPath, and the broader BPM and automation ecosystem are doing. Use that knowledge to sharpen Skan's positioning and find the white space.

**Product Execution and Delivery**

* Work closely with engineering, design, and data science to turn complex customer problems into product requirements teams can actually build from. Good PRDs, clear acceptance criteria, and regular communication matter here.
* Manage delivery across several workstreams at once, covering process discovery, analytics, conformance, and integrations. Help teams make smart trade-off decisions when timelines get tight.
* Stay engaged with architecture and data model decisions that affect the product. You do not need to write the code, but you need to understand what is being built and why certain technical choices matter at enterprise scale.
* Hold a high bar for user experience. Process intelligence data is inherently complex. Making it feel accessible and actionable to both business users and technical users is one of the harder product challenges in this space.

**Using AI in How You Work**

We are an AI company. We expect product leaders to work with AI tools every day, not just build products that use them. This is what that looks like in practice.

* Use LLMs and AI research tools to move faster in discovery. Summarize customer interviews, identify patterns across large volumes of feedback, and sharpen your hypotheses without spending days manually reviewing notes.
* Use generative AI to write better first drafts of PRDs and specifications. Spend your energy making judgment calls and refining thinking, not starting from a blank page every single time.
* Set up workflows to track what is happening in the market. Use AI tools to monitor competitor releases, analyst commentary, and community signals across the process mining and automation space so you are never behind.
* Bring your team along. Help your product managers develop real fluency with these tools, including knowing when to trust AI output and when to push back on it.
* Stay grounded in what AI can and cannot do reliably inside enterprise products. That practitioner perspective will directly shape how we build and talk about AI features in the platform.
* Share what you learn. Recommend tools, document what works, and help build an internal culture of AI-augmented work across the product organization.

**Team Leadership**

* Build and grow the product management team. That means hiring thoughtfully, giving people real ownership of meaningful problems, and being the kind of manager whose reports get better over time.
* Set up the operating model. Good product teams do not run themselves. Help establish the rituals, frameworks, and ways of working that let people move fast without losing sight of what matters.
* Create an environment where people are honest about trade-offs, comfortable sitting with uncertainty, and focused on outcomes over activity.

**Customer and Commercial Engagement**

* Spend real time with customers. Get into the detail of how they use the product, where it falls short, and what they actually need. Use those conversations to challenge your assumptions, not just confirm them.
* Show up in executive-level customer conversations and sales cycles as a credible product voice. You should be able to walk a customer through where the product is heading and why it matters to their specific business.
* Work with Customer Success to track how customers are getting value from the platform and use those signals to sharpen what we build next.

**Cross-Functional Alignment**

* Help Sales and Marketing tell a sharper product story. That means going beyond feature lists and helping them articulate what actually makes Skan different in a crowded market.
* Collaborate with Finance and leadership when business cases need product input, whether that involves pricing, packaging, or expansion opportunities.
* Stay close to what Professional Services and Customer Success teams see on the ground. Some of the most useful product insights come from the people who spend the most time with customers post-sale.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* 12 to 15 years of professional experience, with at least 8 years in product management in enterprise software or SaaS.
* You have worked at an AI-native startup. You know what it is like to build under pressure, make product calls without full information, and keep moving without a lot of infrastructure around you.
* Background in process mining, process intelligence, BPM, task mining, or RPA is strongly preferred. Candidates with this domain experience will stand out. If you have worked at companies like Celonis, UiPath, SAP Signavio, ABBYY, Minit, or similar, we want to hear from you.
* Real familiarity with process mining concepts: how event logs work, what conformance checking involves, how process discovery surfaces insigh

jobs.title: Vice President, Finance Data Product Management – P&L
jobs.description:
The VP, Finance Data Product Owner – P&L Data (India) is the execution lead for the P&L data product agenda on
**One Data Foundation**
, supporting the VP, Global Data Product Owner – P&L. The role starts with
**Revenue and Expense Accrual**
data and sits where Finance, Accounting and Technology meet. It works day to day with data producers, consumers and P&L process owners’ teams, and turns the Global Product Owner’s priorities into certified, reusable data products.
  
  
The leader works with process owners to understand how the data is used and what outcome it supports and documents the manual processes and adjustments on both the production and consumption sides. The goal is to raise productivity and efficiency and keep the data products golden by reducing manual manipulation and point-to-point sourcing. The role builds
**governance by design**
(CDEs, definitions, ownership, lineage, DQ rules and controls) into each product and uses AI and automation to modernize a largely waterfall and manual delivery lifecycle.
  
  
*The Global Data Product Owner sets product strategy, priorities, the portfolio roadmap and senior stakeholder agreements. This role executes, recommends and escalates. Controllers, Global Accounting and FP&A own the process and the reported numbers, and Technology owns engineering and production operations.*
**Key Accountabilities**

* Bridge Producers and Consumers
* Be the working-level link between upstream accrual data producers and downstream consumers, so issues are raised once, routed to the right producer and tracked to closure.
* Partner with P&L process owners’ teams (Controllers, Global Accounting, FP&A and other consumers) to understand how they use the data and the outcome they need. Surface pain points and new needs early to the Global Product Owner.
* Draft and maintain producer–consumer terms: definitions, scope, frequency, granularity, quality thresholds, ownership and issue handling, for approval by the Global Product Owner.
* Support the consumer forum by preparing the agenda and facts, and make differences in how consumers interpret or override the same data visible.
* Understand and Reduce Manual Work
* Document the manual processes, adjustments and overrides on the production and consumption sides of each in-scope P&L process. Quantify the effort and find the root causes.
* Recommend and drive fixes: move adjustments upstream or into the product so they are made once and governed, remove spreadsheet dependencies, and stop point-to-point sourcing. Priorities are agreed with the Global Product Owner.
* Use AI and automation to speed requirements, metadata, CDE identification, lineage, DQ rules, documentation and testing, within agreed controls.
* Execute the P&L Data Products
* Run day-to-day delivery of the accrual data products. Maintain the backlog, define requirements, and work with architecture and engineering on sources, transformations, business rules and lineage.
* Prepare each product for certification: definitions, CDEs, lineage, DQ rules and controls complete, reconciled to the authoritative source, and confirmed to meet accounting requirements.
* Fix issues at the source with producers, strengthen reconciliation, and maintain a shared business glossary.
* Publish and reuse on One Data Foundation, enhancing existing products before creating new ones, and support retiring legacy sources and BI reports in favor of certified data.
* Report, Escalate and Lead
* Give the Global Product Owner clear, regular updates on progress, risks and decisions needed. Escalate early and prepare materials for senior stakeholder discussions.
* Work across time zones with agreed overlap hours, documented handoffs and clear written follow-up.
* Guide and develop team members in India as the work grows.

**Required Qualifications**

* Significant banking or financial services experience in Finance, Accounting or P&L functions.
* Strong working knowledge of revenue and/or expense accruals, accounting concepts, controls and reconciliations.
* Solid grasp of data lineage, quality and governance principles, with the ability to analyze and validate data independently (for example, SQL) and reconcile it to source.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to analyze manual processes and adjustments to find root causes and efficiency opportunities.
* Experience working between business and technology teams, with the ability to influence without direct authority and work effectively with global stakeholders across time zones.
* Clear written and verbal communication that explains data issues in terms of business impact.
* Demonstrated curiosity and a record of improving ways of working through automation or AI.

**Preferred**

* Hands-on experience with Databricks, Power BI or similar platforms; working knowledge of SQL and data modeling.
* Exposure to billing, revenue or general ledger systems and how they integrate with reporting platforms.
* Experience with platform migration or re-engineering programs, and with leading complex, multi-team work.
* Familiarity with GenAI or machine learning use cases in Finance, and agile or product ownership experience.
* Background in regulated or audit-sensitive environments, including regulatory and external reporting.
* Professional qualification (CA, CPA, CFA) or a degree in Finance, Accounting, Data or a related field.

MEASURES OF SUCCESS
  
  

* Delivery: accrual data products prepared and certified against the agreed plan, with documented producer–consumer terms.
* Manual work: manual processes and adjustments documented for each in-scope P&L process, with a measurable reduction in manual manipulation, spreadsheet dependencies and point-to-point feeds.
* Consistency and reuse: one agreed definition per P&L measure, more consumers on the certified products, and fewer report-level overrides.
* Issue efficiency: fewer duplicate issues sent to producers and faster resolution.
* Reliability: timely updates, early escalation and clean handoffs, as rated by the Global Product Owner.
* Partnership: process owners and producers report the role is fair, responsive and effective.

LEADERSHIP PROFILE AND CANDIDATE CALIBRATION
  
  

* Bridge-builder mindset (most important)

****What Good Looks Like****
Sits between producers and consumers by choice. Explains each side’s constraints to the other, gets both to commit to a shared agreement, and follows up until it holds.
  
  
**Watch-outs in candidates**
Acts as a requirements taker or a ticket router. Describes the role as “gathering requirements” or “sending tickets.”
  
  

* Curious about the manual work

****What Good Looks Like****
Wants to see how consumers really use the data and finds the adjustments and spreadsheets behind it. Asks why until the root cause is clear.
  
  
**Watch-outs in candidates**
Accepts manual adjustments as normal. Reports what people do without asking why.
  
  

* Ownership of execution

****What Good Looks Like****
Acts as an owner, not an order-taker. Follows through, flags problems early and keeps the Global Product Owner informed without being asked.
  
  
**Watch-outs in candidates**
Waits for detailed direction or makes portfolio-level commitments without agreement from the Global Product Owner.
  
  

* Reuse-first and governance by design

****What Good Looks Like****
Defaults to one certified source and one definition. Builds CDEs, lineage, DQ rules and controls in as the product is built. Challenges point-to-point feeds and local copies.
  
  
**Watch-outs in candidates**
Builds a new dataset for each request. Treats governance as a separate sign-off step.
  
  

* Curious and AI-forward

****What Good Looks Like****
Questions waterfall and manual ways of working. Experiments with AI and automation and keeps controls intact.
  
  
**Watch-outs in candidates**
Defends the current process. Views AI as hype or as a replacement for judgment.
  
  

* Works well across time zone

jobs.title: Associate - Legal Counsel - Cross Border - Asset & Wealth Management
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

JPMorgan Chase & Co. is a leading global financial services firm with assets of $2.6 trillion and operations worldwide, and its Legal Department provides specialized legal support aligned to the firm's lines of business and corporate staff areas. Asset & Wealth Management is one of the largest asset and wealth managers in the world, serving institutional and retail clients through Asset Management and high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients through the Private Bank. The business offers global investment management across equities, fixed income, real estate, hedge funds, private equity, and liquidity, and provides trust and estate, banking, brokerage, and retirement services. The Legal Department is seeking an experienced lawyer to support cross-border efforts, focusing on reviewing and analyzing legal opinions related to the cross-border provision of asset and wealth management products and services, and helping document and communicate related legal and regulatory requirements.

This role is based in Mumbai, India, at the J.P. Morgan Mumbai Corporate Centre, and functionally reports to:

* A Managing Director and Associate General Counsel for Asset & Wealth Management in the United States
* An Executive Director and Assistant General Counsel for Asset & Wealth Management in the United Kingdom
* A local Asset & Wealth Management Legal supervisor in Mumbai

Job summary:

As an Associate Legal Counsel within Asset & Wealth Management Legal, you will support cross-border efforts with a primary focus on reviewing and analyzing legal opinions related to the cross-border provision of products and services. You will help drive documentation of cross-border laws and regulations and communicate related requirements to business stakeholders. You will partner with lawyers, compliance partners, business stakeholders, and external counsel to maintain clear, current, and usable guidance for the business.

Job responsibilities:

* Conduct the first review of new or updated legal opinions from external counsel and new or revised draft rules for the business to provide products and services on a cross-border basis, and facilitate periodic and ad hoc updates of existing materials based on legal or regulatory changes or business developments
* Draft summaries of updates to facilitate the review-and-approval process via an internal workflow tool
* Engage with external counsel, Asset & Wealth Management lawyers, Compliance, and business stakeholders to obtain and resolve feedback on updates
* Field stakeholders' basic queries concerning the materials and fact-specific queries
* Advise as the Legal Department's first point of contact on potential issues relating to cross-border materials
* Provide regular feedback to business stakeholders and cross-border forums on pending reviews
* Conduct additional research and assist on special projects as needed
* Create and enhance audit-ready processes in a highly regulated environment, including through the use of technology

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

* Demonstrate excellent English writing and communication skills
* Hold a law degree
* Be in compliance, prior to commencement of employment, with all relevant licensing requirements, including the requirements of the jurisdiction where the role will be located
* Be sufficiently well qualified to interpret and summarize external legal advice and articulate clear “rules of the road” for the business
* Operate as a self-starter who works collaboratively in a high-performing team, takes ownership of responsibilities and projects, and is results-oriented and flexible
* Manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, complex business environment and maintain communication with attorneys regarding project status and estimated completion timelines
* Demonstrate competence with Microsoft Office products, including Microsoft Excel, and the use of large language models and artificial intelligence
* Successfully complete a conflicts of interest clearance review prior to commencement of employment (applicable to all Legal Department roles)

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

* Master of Laws (LLM) preferred
* 2–4 years of experience in financial services law
* Experience instructing and interacting with external counsel directly
* Experience working across jurisdictions and time zones

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**  
  
  

Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

  

With large, global operations, the Legal team tackles complex issues and helps shape the regulations that affect the businesses.
