11/30/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTC

**Description**

At the **International Finance Corporation (IFC)**, a member of the **World Bank Group (WBG)**, you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. In fiscal year 2026, IFC committed a record $105.6 billion to private companies and financial institutions in developing countries. For more information, visit www.ifc.org.

The CFO and Capital Mobilization Vice Presidency, led by IFC’s Vice President and CFO, mobilizes private capital at scale to support clients that create jobs and drive growth in emerging markets. It brings together debt and equity mobilization, investor engagement, blended finance, and partnerships functions to expand the pool of capital available for development, while also overseeing the Corporation’s financial strategy and reporting, balance sheet management, and treasury functions. This prudent financial stewardship safeguards IFC’s AAA credit rating and ensures discipline, transparency, and alignment with institutional priorities.

Looking ahead, the VPU’s vision is to channel private capital into the sectors with the greatest potential to create jobs by embedding Originate-to-Distribute (OtD) approaches into IFC’s operating model, deepening and diversifying engagement with investors, donors, and development partners, and delivering innovative financial solutions that attract institutional capital to emerging markets. It will leverage data, technology, and market expertise to scale impact and improve efficiency.

As IFC continues to scale its impact and mobilize private capital at scale, in support of the WBG goal of creating jobs that lift people out of poverty, its ability to attract long term institutional investors to invest in IFC-originated emerging market assets has become increasingly central to its operating and financial model. In the context of heightened global uncertainty, constrained public resources, and rising development needs, effective engagement with institutional investors is critical to creating jobs, and sustaining and expanding development impact across emerging markets.

IFC’s originate-to-distribute and capital mobilization initiatives—including securitization, the Managed Co Lending Portfolio Program (MCPP), B Loan syndications, parallel loans, private equity funds and anchor bond investing, thematic bond issuances, blended finance facilities, and other structured mobilization vehicles—have expanded substantially in recent years, reflecting IFC’s strong focus on originating assets that both meet World Bank Group’s development mandate and are consistent with the investment preferences of institutional investors.

To support this strategically critical agenda, IFC is seeking Principal Investor Relations Officers in IFC’s Global Investor Relations function to work in collaboration with IFC’s originate-to-distribute (OtD) initiative and to help embed OtD into the operating model of IFC, by leading and strengthening IFC’s global investor engagement approach. The role will be to lead IFC’s critical institutional investor relationships, positioning IFC as a partner of choice for institutional investors while embedding scalable, best-in-class investor relationship management practices across the organization.

The Principal Investor Relations Officer will be responsible for deepening long-term investor relationships, expanding and diversifying IFC’s investor base, aligning investor mandates with IFC’s mobilization priorities, strengthening IFC’s visibility and credibility in global capital markets, integrating investor intelligence into institutional decision-making, and institutionalizing robust systems, governance, and standards for investor relationship management.

This vacancy announcement is for nine (9) positions posted across multiple duty stations. The selected candidates’ duty stations will be determined based on organizational requirements and business needs.

**Duties and Accountabilities:**

The selected candidate is responsible for performing activities in the following areas:

Own day-to-day IFC relationships with assigned Tier 1 and Tier 2 investors, under the Director’s executive sponsorship for the most significant relationships and expand participation in IFC-originated assets by connecting investor demand with IFC opportunities and the Originate-to-Distribute agenda.

**Relationship ownership & growth responsibilities:**

* Serve as accountable owner and primary point of contact for assigned investors. Where designated as geography Team Lead, lead and coordinate the other officers in the regional hub.
* Map investor interests and identify opportunities across IFC products, platforms and programs.
* Build trusted senior relationships and coordinate integrated engagement with product, regional, industry, transaction and country teams.
* Sponsor priority platforms, roadshows, investor education and external engagements for assigned relationships

**Planning, reviews & execution responsibilities:**

* Develop customized engagement plans, including strategic dialogues, co-investment discussions, site visits, reporting, events and investor education.
* Lead MOUs, frameworks, and commercial terms, subject to Legal clearance and authorized approval/signature.
* Lead onboarding and coordinate KYC and due diligence logistics.
* Conduct quarterly business and annual strategic reviews and maintain accurate Salesforce records and relationship updates.
* Support syndication and structuring teams while engaging with investors.

**Demand, risk & coordination responsibilities:**

* Capture risk appetite, pricing, tenor, sector interests and other actionable demand signals.
* Consolidate and propose relationship risk limits for funds, subsidiaries and insurers and assess financial sustainability.
* Communicate structured investor feedback to Syndications, with the OTD Analytical Team supporting consolidation and analysis.
* Advise underwriting and structuring on investor demand; designated authorities retain decisions. Participate occasionally in OtD or strategy meetings when relevant.
* Ensure that investor engagement activities are conducted in accordance with IFC policies, World Bank Group ethical standards, and applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
* Partner with Legal and Compliance teams on investor agreements, side letters, and co-investment arrangements.

**Selection Criteria**

* Master’s degree or MBA, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* A minimum of 12 years of relevant professional experience of increasing complexity and responsibility in institutional investor relations, capital markets, private markets, asset management, investment banking, or related areas.
* Extensive experience developing and managing senior-level relationships with institutiona

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Commercial Services
jobs.description:
**About Tide**

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

**Tide Facts**

* Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
* Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
* Over $300 million raised in funding
* 3,000 Tideans globally
* We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

**About The Team**

Tide is hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Commercial Services. You will report to the CDTO and partner with Product and Design leadership as one leadership team accountable for the outcomes of the domain.

Commercial Services is where Tide extends from helping members run their business to helping them grow it. You will shape how quickly every member becomes discoverable, how much of their buying and selling runs through Tide, and how far AI can turn that into a lasting advantage across every market we serve.

Sell gives every member a live, discoverable presence, from the Tide Business Pages we are launching for 2 million members across the UK and Europe, to Own Website, catalogue, bookings, CRM and lead capture, and embedded fulfilment through Delivery as a Service.

Buy turns that member base into a two-sided marketplace through the Tide Online Network, alongside Tide Promotions (gift cards, cashback and personalised offers), business supplies from partners, and Vendor Hub for e-procurement.

You will be the single owner accountable for engineering delivery, architecture and people across both.

**About The Role**

This role sits at the intersection of SME commerce, marketplaces and banking. Our members sit on both sides of the marketplace, our partners extend what we can offer them, and our banking platform lets us layer payments, credit, insurance and rewards into the experience at the point of need, which few commerce players can do. We need someone who can bring both streams onto one consistent engineering bar, ship quickly and build the platforms that turn Commercial Services into a material recurring revenue line for Tide.

As Director of Engineering you will

* Set the engineering strategy and technical direction across the Sell and Buy value streams, from launch through to scale.
* Lead the Heads of Engineering for Sell and Buy, build the leadership bench underneath them, and own headcount planning, hiring and organisation design.

* Set a consistent engineering practice and quality bar across architecture, delivery health measured through DORA metrics, reliability and security.
* Lead our move towards AI-assisted and agentic commerce, where a member describes what they need and Tide finds, compares and sources it.
* Apply our OnePlatform principles so we build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Director engineering leadership of a multi-team organisation of around 50 engineers across backend, frontend, data and analytics, led through at least one layer of engineering leaders.
* Domain experience in e-commerce, two-sided marketplaces, CRM or procurement platforms, including the trust and safety controls they need, with fintech or SME banking experience a plus.
* Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable product and commercial outcomes.
* Experience building partner and third-party integration platforms at scale.
* Strong product and design partnership instincts.
* Comfortable setting direction through ambiguity and launching new products into multiple markets.
* Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, architecture and technical quality.
* Experience bringing AI or agentic experiences into customer-facing commerce products would be a bonus.

**Our Tech Stack**

* Backend: Java, Spring/Spring Boot, microservices architecture
* Mobile/Web: Flutter / Angular
* Infrastructure: AWS (SNS+SQS), PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora, GCP (BigQuery, Vertex)
* Observability: Coralogix (OpenTelemetry
* Claude for agentic ways of working

**What You’ll Get In Return**

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:

* Competitive Compensation - Competitive salary and share options.
* Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
* Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
* Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
* Health Insurance – Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options.
* Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
* Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
* Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
* Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
* WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.

* Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
* Snacks & Meals – Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent).

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a
**flexible workplace**
model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. - Proven experience in collections and recovery, including delinquency buckets, roll rates and NPA management

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer, AI Engineering
jobs.description:
**Our Purpose**

We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior AI Engineer, AI Engineering
  
  
Mastercard’s Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth & innovation goals by providing unparalleled data-driven insights and advanced analytics. By leveraging proprietary data and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, more informed decisions that drive profitability and success. We turn complex data into actionable strategies that lead to better outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.
  
  
We are currently looking for a ‘Lead Engineer, Machine Learning Engineering’ for Operational Intelligence Program, within B&MI group. This role will lead ML engineering team to execute on AI/ML strategy for the program that enables business growth, enhances customer experience, and ensures delivery of secure, scalable, and high-performing software solutions. As a technology leader, this role will also focus on engineering best practices, next gen innovation and stakeholder management, while fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence within the team.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Implement multi-agent intelligence frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen) to enable reasoning, coordination, and adaptive decision-making across specialized AI agents.
* Design and operationalize multi-modal AI pipelines combining text, image, tabular, and graph data using transformer-based architectures (BERT, CLIP, LLaVA, T5, Whisper, etc.) for unified intelligence.
* Build scalable RAG and Graph-RAG systems integrating vector stores and knowledge graphs (Neo4j, AWS Neptune) to enable contextual retrieval, semantic linking, and entity-aware reasoning.
* Develop and productionize transformer-based models for NLP, vision-language understanding, and sequential prediction tasks leveraging Hugging Face, PyTorch, and TensorFlow ecosystems.
* Implement advanced Python-based backend services for inference orchestration, async job handling, and distributed data workflows supporting high-throughput AI operations.
* Establish end-to-end LLMOps and MLOps pipelines on Databricks (AWS) integrating MLflow, feature stores, model lineage, prompt evaluation, and continuous retraining frameworks.
* Apply traditional AI/ML and statistical modeling techniques (regression, clustering, forecasting, ensemble methods) alongside deep learning models for hybrid interpretability and explainability.
* Engineer state and memory management subsystems that preserve context, track embeddings, and enable agents to reason temporally across multiple modalities and interactions.
* Implement Responsible AI practices—bias detection, explainability dashboards, data ethics checks, and performance governance ensuring fairness and transparency of deployed models.
* Continuously research, benchmark, and productionize innovations in multimodal transformers, generative modeling, and agentic orchestration to drive enterprise-scale intelligence and automation.

**All About You**

* Master’s/bachelor’s degree in computer science or engineering, and a considerable work experience with a proven track-record of successfully leading and managing complex projects/products and delivering to aggressive market needs.
* Expert-level hands on experience designing, building and deploying both conventional AI/ML solutions and LLM/Agentic solutions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with quick adaptation to new technologies, methodologies, and systems.
* Strong applied knowledge and hands on experience in advanced statistical techniques, predictive modelling, machine learning algorithms, GenAI and deep learning frameworks. Experience with AI and machine learning platforms such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar.
* Strong programming skills in languages such as Python/SQL is a must. Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) and understanding of cloud computing services (AWS, Azure, GCP) related to data processing and storage is a plus.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer
jobs.description:
The Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) is responsible for establishing, implementing, operating, monitoring, and continuously enhancing OneFin’s Information Security Management System (ISMS) across all product lines and enterprise infrastructure.

This leader will own end-to-end information security strategy, cloud security governance (AWS), regulatory compliance (RBI guidelines for digital lending and IT governance), ISO/IEC 27001:2022 standards, and client-facing security assessments for institutional banking partners. Implement zero trust security architecture.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Information Security Governance & Strategy**

* Define, maintain, and enforce OneFin's Level-1 ISMS policies, standards, and guidelines in alignment with business goals.
* Report security posture, risk profiles, and incident metrics directly to the CEO, C-suite, and Board of Directors.
* Lead the annual risk assessment framework across all business units, maintaining the enterprise Risk Register and tracking remediation strategies.
* Establish annual security objectives, measurable parameters, and operational security targets.

**2. Regulatory, Compliance & Client Audit Management**

* Direct compliance for ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certifications, surveillance audits, and internal security audits.
* Ensure strict adherence to Reserve Bank of India (RBI) guidelines regarding digital lending, data localization, outsourcing, and cloud management.
* Act as the executive point of contact for financial institution (FI) client audits, managing Information Security Group (ISG) checklists, VAPT review points, and security questionnaires.
* Oversee Data Protection and Privacy compliance, protecting Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and Sensitive Personal Data or Information (SPDI).
* Oversee source code audits, and conduct internal security audits of codebase.

**3. Cloud Infrastructure & Product Security**

* Oversee security configuration across AWS environments, ensuring AES-256 encryption at rest (S3, RDS, ECR) and enforced TLS/HTTPS in transit.
* Enforce secure architecture models for single-tenant / dedicated client deployments on Financial Institution AWS infrastructure.
* Direct Web Application Firewall (WAF) policies, IP/URL whitelisting, geo-blocking, and network perimeter controls.
* Maintain DevSecOps rigor within CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions), ensuring automated peer reviews, static analysis, code coverage thresholds, and container image vulnerability management.

**4. Threat Management & Security Operations (SecOps)**

* Lead the Incident Response Team; ensure end-to-end management, SLA tracking, and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for all P1/Critical incidents.
* Oversee centralized logging, Database Activity Monitoring (DAM), and integration capabilities with Bank SIEM systems.
* Mandate periodic Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing (VAPT) across applications, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.
* Enforce robust Access Control & Identity Management (IAM), including mandatory multi-factor authentication (MFA) across email, code repositories, and cloud portals.

**5. Third-Party Risk & Business Continuity**

* Enforce Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) guidelines, ensuring mandatory MSAs and NDAs across all vendors.
* Manage annual Business Continuity Planning (BCP) and Disaster Recovery (DR) drills, validating Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO).
* Conduct annual enterprise-wide security awareness training programs and specialized DevSecOps workshops.

**Candidate Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or related engineering fields.
* **Experience:** 12+ years in Information Security and Technology Risk, with at least 4+ years in a leadership role (CISO, Head of Security, or Director of InfoSec).
* **Domain Background:** Prior experience in Fintech, B2B SaaS, Banking, or Financial Services ecosystems is strictly required.

**Technical & Professional Competencies**

**Cloud Security**- Deep expertise in AWS Security Hub, WAF, KMS, CloudTrail, IAM, RDS/S3 encryption, and containerized deployments (ECS/ECR).

**Frameworks**- Hands-on mastery of ISO/IEC 27001:2022, NIST CSF, OWASP Top 10, and SOC 2 Type II compliance.

**Regulatory Knowledge**- In depth knowledge of RBI Cybersecurity Framework, RBI Digital Lending Directions, and Indian Data Protection laws.

**Application Security**- Expertise in DevSecOps, API security, automated code scanners, tesseract/OCR pipeline security, and LLM/AI model deployment governance.

**Leadership**- Exceptional stakeholder management, board-level reporting, and experience negotiating security requirements with Tier-1 Bank CISOs.

**Certifications (Preferred)**

* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
* Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)
* Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)
* ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor / Lead Implementer

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Global Process Owner Support (GPOS) role exists to strengthen first-line-of-defence risk management and governance across Credit Origination, Credit Monitoring and Credit Allied Risk processes within Client Coverage. It supports Global Process Owners in embedding applicable policies, standards and controls into day-to-day business activities, helping the business manage operational and process risks consistently across markets. The role delivers oversight of control effectiveness, coordinated remediation of control gaps and exceptions, and clear reporting and escalation of material risks to support informed governance decisions. Working with business, country teams and second-line stakeholders, it also supports process simplification and the implementation of change with appropriate risk assessments and controls. Its primary focus is to maintain effective, consistent and efficient credit processes that support business delivery while operating within established risk tolerances.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

The role holder is an individual contributor with no formal people-management accountability. The role leads and coordinates assigned risk, control and process-improvement activities through stakeholder collaboration, supporting the Global Process Owner / delegate and GPOS Lead across Credit Origination, Credit Monitoring and Credit Allied Risk processes. The role holder is accountable for the quality and timely delivery of assigned assessments, assurance oversight, reporting and remediation coordination; designated action owners remain responsible for completing their actions.
  
**Risk assessment and control implementation**  
• Implement applicable control requirements and procedures, and support each stage of the RCSA, from process and risk identification to monitoring implemented controls, at least annually and when trigger events occur, to maintain a current view of process and residual risks.
  
**Timely risk treatment**  
• Coordinate and track agreed elevated residual-risk actions and treatment plans with designated action owners, maintain records in the Group operational risk management system, and escalate delays to support timely completion.
  
**Learning from risk events**  
• Initiate Root Cause Reviews for in-scope material risk events and, where required, aggregate smaller events with similar root causes to identify recurring weaknesses and support corrective action.
  
**Controlled change delivery**  
• Identify delivery risks and dependencies, assess impacts on critical processes and residual risk, and review and support Operational and Change Risk Assessments and process-impact assessments before go-live, including minor changes where required.

**Broad Accountabilities**  
**Strategy**  
• Targeted Improvements: Work with internal stakeholders to identify gaps and improvement opportunities in credit processes, and lead assigned change and remediation activities to make processes more effective and streamlined.
  
• Support the GPO’s credit transformation agenda by translating agreed priorities into implementation activities and delivering assigned work within agreed timelines.
  
• Automation and Streamlining: Review operational efficiency, effectiveness and quality against changing business and customer needs, and identify actions to improve process performance.
  
• Drive continuous improvement and automation, and remove or simplify unnecessary process steps to improve efficiency and consistency across systems and processes.
  
• Support CPA Team Heads, including the CPA Hub, in improving process efficiency, simplifying processes and increasing capacity.
  
**Business**  
• Assess the process and operational-risk implications of business strategies, projects and programmes, and provide remediation guidance to support informed decisions.
  
• Support global adoption of Credit COE initiatives and work with management to implement agreed process improvements and strategic credit transformation initiatives.
  
• Maintain effective relationships with Business, Finance, Risk, Technology and Operations to resolve process issues and coordinate delivery across markets.
  
• Coordinate stakeholder inputs and supporting information for regulatory and audit requests to enable timely responses.

**Processes**  
• Support the Process Owner in delivering BAU operational-risk requirements on time and in designing and maintaining the Control Assessment Standards framework for front-office processes globally.
  
• Monitor CST/KCI exception trends and agree practical improvement actions with countries to strengthen processes and controls.
  
• Guide QC teams in GBS and countries in understanding and consistently applying checks, particularly those involving qualitative or subjective assessments.
  
• Support process governance by streamlining existing processes, rolling out new processes and resolving Credit and Credit Monitoring queries with the relevant GPOS Lead.
  
• Work with CPAs, Client Management, CPOs, R&C, Business Heads and other regional and country stakeholders to share developments, lessons and best practices, and deliver agreed requirements on time.
  
• Assess change impacts through CCIA, evaluate change readiness and perform GRAM assessments. Provide subject-matter expertise to help mitigate identified process risks.
  
• Support the resolution of Group-specific process issues and related actions identified by GIA.
  
• Support the Process Owner in promptly escalating significant risks and issues to Process Universe Owners, relevant RFOs or Policy Owners. Maintain effective relationships with 2LOD across applicable risk types to support management of the Bank’s risk profile.
  
**Risk Management**  
• Identify process risks and support implementation of the Operational Risk Framework and appropriate controls. Help operations manage risk within established tolerance thresholds and minimise risks and losses in Credit Origination.

* Identify non-standard processes and agree appropriate controls with the GPOS Lead. Review proposed process and system changes for material impacts, and keep DOIs and process documentation up to date.

• Support implementation of applicable Credit, Fraud, Climate, Reputational and Sustainability Risk policies and standards within CC COE, embedding their requirements in managed processes.
  
• Prepare updates on risk initiatives for CC Governance Committee packs, and provide subject-matter expertise for Root Cause Reviews and boundary events to support oversight and corrective action.
  
• Support the design and delivery of relevant Credit Transformation initiatives and partner with TB, FM and Lending to improve the operating model and execution through existing CC credit processes.
  
• Provide ongoing learning and guidance on policies, process risks, controls and governance. Work with 2LOD and Product partners to develop and implement a roadmap for improving the control framework.
  
• Support implementation and closure of Group-level audit Management Action Plans, and delivery of actions arising from PRA Dear CEO Letters and specific reviews relating to owned processes.
  
**Governance**  
• Ensure risks are clearly identified, quantified and reported to the appropriate governance forums, with timely visibility and escalation of material issues.
  
• Assess how effectively the control framework addresses key risks and initiate treatment plans where required. Coordinate remediation of capability, process, data and documentation gaps.
  
• Provide central oversight of CST/KCI assurance checks performed by GBS, including ongoing training and guidance, to maintain standardised and consistent assessments.

The role will involve handling inbound and outbound customer calls, responding to service requests, guiding customers through digital processes and maintaining accurate records of customer interactions.

The Customer Service Executive will serve as an important point of contact between the company and its customers, ensuring that customer concerns are addressed professionally, efficiently and within defined timelines.

This is a full-time, office-based role involving regular telephone-based customer interaction and coordination with internal departments.

3. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Customer Support & Query Management

* Handle inbound and outbound customer calls relating to loan products and financial services.
* Respond to customer queries regarding loan features, eligibility, application procedures and documentation requirements.
* Provide information on loan application status, approval, disbursement and repayment schedules.
* Assist customers in understanding their loan accounts, outstanding balances, EMI obligations and payment timelines.
* Provide accurate information regarding applicable interest rates, processing fees, charges and other loan-related terms.
* Ensure that customer queries are addressed in a professional, courteous and timely manner.
* Escalate complex queries to the appropriate internal teams.

B. Loan Application & Customer Onboarding Support

* Assist prospective customers with the digital loan application process.
* Guide customers through KYC verification, documentation and other onboarding requirements.
* Help customers resolve issues related to application submission, document uploads and verification.
* Follow up on incomplete applications and pending documentation.
* Coordinate with Credit and Operations teams to track application progress.
* Keep customers informed about application status and pending requirements.
* Assist customers in navigating the company's digital platforms and applications.

C. Loan Servicing & Repayment Support

* Handle customer queries relating to loan disbursement, repayment schedules and EMI deductions.
* Assist customers with repayment-related issues, including failed transactions, incorrect deductions and payment confirmation.
* Guide customers on approved repayment channels and payment procedures.
* Coordinate with Finance and Collections teams to resolve payment reconciliation issues.
* Support customers in obtaining loan statements, repayment schedules and other account-related information.
* Track and follow up on unresolved loan servicing requests.
* Ensure that customer concerns relating to loan servicing are addressed within defined timelines.

D. Customer Complaint & Grievance Resolution

* Receive, register and track customer complaints and service requests.
* Understand the nature of customer grievances and identify the appropriate resolution mechanism.
* Coordinate with relevant departments to resolve complaints.
* Follow up on pending complaints until closure.
* Maintain accurate records of complaints, actions taken and resolution timelines.
* Escalate unresolved or sensitive customer grievances to the reporting manager.
* Ensure that customer complaints are handled in accordance with company policies and applicable regulatory requirements.

E. Customer Relationship & Communication

* Maintain professional and positive relationships with customers.
* Communicate loan-related information in simple, clear and understandable language.
* Proactively contact customers regarding pending documentation, application updates and service requests.
* Provide appropriate guidance to customers throughout their loan journey.
* Handle dissatisfied customers and difficult conversations with patience and professionalism.
* Ensure transparency in all customer communications.
* Never make unauthorised commitments regarding loan approvals, interest waivers, settlements or changes in repayment terms.

F. Coordination with Internal Teams

* Coordinate with Sales and Business Development teams for customer acquisition and onboarding-related queries.
* Work with Credit teams to obtain updates on loan applications and pending verifications.
* Coordinate with Operations for documentation, disbursement and loan servicing issues.
* Work with Collections teams on repayment-related customer queries and payment confirmation.
* Coordinate with Finance for payment reconciliation and account-related discrepancies.
* Ensure timely communication and closure of customer requests across departments.

G. Customer Service MIS & Reporting

* Maintain accurate records of customer calls, queries, complaints and service requests.
* Update customer interactions and service request status in the CRM or designated systems.
* Maintain daily customer service reports covering:
* Total inbound and outbound calls.
* Customer queries received.
* Customer requests registered.
* Complaints received and resolved.
* Pending service requests.
* Average query resolution time.
* Escalated complaints.
* Customer follow-up status.
* Share daily and weekly performance updates with the reporting manager.
* Identify recurring customer issues and highlight opportunities to improve service delivery.

4. Qualifications & Experience

**Essential Qualifications:**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* 1–3 years of experience in customer service, customer support, telecalling, contact centres or customer relationship management.
* Good verbal communication skills in Hindi and basic English.
* Comfortable handling inbound and outbound customer calls.
* Basic proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets and customer management systems.
* Ability to handle multiple customer queries and service requests simultaneously.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Prior experience in banking, NBFCs, fintech, digital lending, microfinance or other financial services organisations.
* Experience handling loan-related customer queries and servicing requests.
* Familiarity with loan application processes, KYC documentation and digital onboarding.
* Experience resolving EMI, repayment and payment-related queries.
* Experience working with CRM, LOS or LMS platforms.
* Exposure to complaint management and customer grievance resolution.

5. Key Skills & Competencies

* Excellent verbal communication and listening skills.
* Customer relationship management.
* Problem-solving and query resolution.
* Professional telephone etiquette.
* Patience and empathy in customer interactions.
* Ability to handle difficult customer conversations.
* Follow-up and service

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
**Chief Technology Officer (CTO)**

**The Role**

The CTO is a senior executive responsible for defining and governing the company’s overall technology strategy, ensuring alignment with business growth, regulatory requirements, and investor expectations. This role operates at the enterprise level, owning strategic direction, technology risk mitigation, organisational performance and delivery outcomes through accountable senior leaders.

The CTO is a core member of the executive leadership team, reporting to the CEO and working closely with the executive team, with regular engagement with the Board, regulators and investors. Success in this role is defined by long-term platform scalability, resilience and commercial value creation.

This is a strategy-first executive role with accountability for delivery and production outcomes through senior leaders, requiring technical judgement and leadership at Board and regulator level. Day-to-day coding and engineering execution sit with the engineering teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technology Strategy & Executive Leadership**

* Define and maintain a multi-year technology strategy aligned with company growth, product expansion, and geographic scale.
* Own the technology roadmap at executive level, ensuring clear prioritisation aligned to commercial outcomes.
* Act as the primary technology advisor to the CEO, Board, and investors.
* Translate complex technology topics into clear business decisions for non-technical stakeholders.
* Lead company-wide AI governance and adoption, shape AI and data strategy with business leaders and specialists, and own the supporting technology delivery.

**Architecture Governance & Technical Accountability**

* Maintain governance frameworks for platform architecture, ensuring scalability, resilience, and future readiness.
* Challenge and approve major architectural decisions and investment trade-offs, holding architecture and engineering leaders accountable for sound design and implementation.
* Ensure technology standards are defined and adhered to across all engineering and platform teams.

**Regulatory, Risk & Compliance Ownership**

* Own technology risk identification, mitigation and reporting, working with the CRO, who owns the enterprise risk register.
* Act as the primary interface with regulators (e.g., central bank authorities) on all technology-related matters.
* Ensure full compliance with regulatory technology requirements, including timelines, audits, and controls.
* Be accountable for cybersecurity posture, operational resilience and technical data custody, supporting enterprise data governance with the accountable business owners.

**Commercial & Financial Accountability**

* Own technology financial planning, including budgeting, cost optimisation, and investment prioritisation.
* Establish and maintain platform cost models (e.g., cost per transaction, cost per user) and ensure alignment with unit economics.
* Partner with the CFO to ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.
* Lead technology input into investor discussions, due diligence processes, and funding activities.

**Technology Organisation and Sourcing Leadership**

* Build on and strengthen the established technology organisation, delivering through a lean internal team and external engineering partners, with further organisational changes driven by demonstrated business needs.
* Lead engineering, architecture, delivery, technology operations, DevOps/SRE and cybersecurity through accountable senior leaders.
* Set performance expectations and accountability frameworks across senior technology leaders.
* Build a culture of ownership, governance, and execution discipline at leadership level.
* Own build-versus-buy decisions, engineering-partner performance and controlled supplier transitions.

**Governance & Operational Oversight**

* Maintain and strengthen enterprise governance frameworks covering change control, incident management, and operational risk.
* The CTO is accountable for technology delivery, production performance and transformation outcomes through senior leaders, without personally coding, managing sprints or owning team backlogs.
* Ensure organisational readiness for scale, audits, and external scrutiny.

**Investor & Board Engagement**

* Present technology strategy, risks, and investment cases directly to Board members and investors.
* Ensure the technology function is fully prepared for external due diligence.
* Provide transparency on risks, trade-offs, and investment requirements.

**Required Experience and Qualifications**

* Established CTO, or CIO with equivalent scope, with substantive executive accountability in regulated fintech or financial services, and a proven record of independently leading the full technology function, including software engineering, through growth and transformation.
* Proven experience leading regulated wallet or payments platforms, with sound judgement across transaction integrity, reconciliation, settlement and partner integrations.
* Proven experience protecting live payments while building and safely migrating to new platforms, delivering through internal teams and external partners, with measurable improvements in reliability, delivery speed and cost.
* Demonstrated track record of scaling technology platforms through significant growth phases.
* Experience operating at Board and investor level, including direct engagement on strategy and risk.
* Strong understanding of regulatory environments and technology compliance obligations.
* Experience leading the full technology function through senior leadership teams, with accountability for delivery, operations, architecture and security.

**Skills and Characteristics**

* Executive-level thinker with the ability to connect technology decisions to commercial outcomes.
* Strong governance and risk management mindset.
* Ability to operate effectively with ambiguity at enterprise scale.
* Clear and confident communicator at Board and investor level.
* High level of accountability and ownership for outcomes.
* Technically credible across platform architecture, payments and engineering, able to challenge designs, make sound decisions, and hold engineering to account, without being hands-on.

**What This Role Is**

* A C-suite CTO role with executive ownership of strategy, governance, business alignment and technology outcomes.
* An executive leadership position, driving outcomes through accountable senior leaders and intervening where material decisions, risks or performance require it.
* A role with executive accountability for technology risk, technology-related regulatory compliance and transparent Board and investor reporting.

**What This Role Is Not**

* This is not a hands-on engineering or architecture role.
* This role does not involve direct coding, sprint management, or backlog ownership.
* This is not an engineering manager or individual contributor position.

**Key Stakeholders**

* CEO
* CFO
* CPO
* COO
* CRO
* Board of Directors
* Investors
* Regulatory Authorities

* Tireless work ethic and enthusiasm to execute and get things done

The role holder is authorised to manage and operate within the scope of the roles and responsibilities outlined above. Role holders are not authorised beyond the scope of this job description unless they have a formal delegation of authority.
  
  
**About Standard Chartered**
We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.
  
  
Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

jobs.title: Head of India
jobs.description:
**The Role**
India is the biggest remittance market with over $130 billion a year flowing home to it, from everywhere: engineers in the Bay Area and Sydney, cabbies in Toronto, construction crews in Dubai, shopkeepers in Leicester, students in Berlin. From Punjabis, Gujaratis, Tamils, Malayalis and Telugus. From people wiring $3,000 a month to a Mumbai mortgage and people sending $80 to a village in Bihar. Your job is to win this market.
  
  
You are someone who gets excited by the nuances of the Indian diaspora and how to reach each group, and who wants to own the P&L, the regulatory landscape and pricing at the same time. If you find the price sensitivity of each cohort exciting, and "why do Malayali nurses cluster in specific hospital systems, and what does that mean for acquisition?" as interesting as "what's RBI's latest remittance policy and which banks make the best partners," this is it.
  
  
As the GM, you own the P&L, and set pricing. For customer growth, you decide which communities to acquire and in what order. Know the RBI's rules well enough to see the openings inside them, not just the limits. A Gujarati family in New Jersey and a Punjabi trucker in Brampton got abroad through completely different networks, and reaching them takes completely different channels.
  
  
Reports to the Head of South Asia. Builds a team of FX Advisors in India and growth managers in sending markets. The face of India inside and outside the company. Total ownership. Be your own CEO
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* The P&L. Volume, gross profit and CAC across every India corridor. Not influence, own. A miss is your miss. A beat is your win.
* Strategy and sequencing. Which sender markets, which communities, which channels, in what order. US, Canada, UK, Europe, Australia and UAE to start. Build the plan, defend it to leadership, execute it.
* Pricing. India is the most rate-sensitive, most competitive remittance market in the world, up against competitors who reprice daily. Set FX and fee strategy corridor by corridor.
* The regulatory and partner landscape. RBI rules, bank partnerships, payout rails. Know the terrain cold and own the local relationships.
* Product. Obsess over UX and the services NRIs actually need. Closer to the customer than anyone in the company, and what you hear feeds straight into product, pricing and customer support.
* The diaspora puzzle. Community partnerships, temples and gurdwaras and churches, cricket leagues, student associations, remittance-heavy employers, influencers, festivals (Diwali is a season, not a day). Get in front of each community authentically, and cheaply.
* The team. Hire, coach and retain people in India and in sending markets. Small, dense, fast.

**Who You Are**

* 10 to 15 years in high-growth environments: startups, operations, consulting, finance, fintech. Has owned a number and talks about it the way owners do.
* Diaspora-fluent. Real knowledge of and networks in the Indian diaspora, and real curiosity about it. Migration patterns, community structures, who sends money to whom and why.
* Commercially sharp. Holds pricing, unit economics and CAC math in their head, and works the data directly. Excel or Sheets required, SQL a real plus.
* A hustler with judgment. Closes a bank partnership Monday, reviews corridor margins Tuesday, shows up at a community event in Jackson Heights on Saturday. Likes all three.
* A regulatory realist. Understands (or can quickly master) RBI rules and the compliance realities of moving money into India. Treats compliance as a partner, not an obstacle.
* Multilingual, ideally. Fluent in English. Hindi, Gujarati, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu or Malayalam are genuine assets.

Location: London or Dubai. Regular travel to India and sending markets is part of the job.
  
  
**Why This Role**
India is the largest remittance market in the world, and winning it moves the whole company forward. This role owns that outcome, with the authority and the accountability that come with it. It also drives real value for the customers: Immigrants work hard for this money, and every basis point saved goes home.
  
  
**About Us**
We’re building the world’s leading cross-border fintech for emerging markets - empowering families, fuelling local economies, and changing how millions access financial services.
  
  
Since our launch in 2019, we have transformed how money moves across borders with our operations spanning 6 out of 7 continents and covering both the busiest and most underserved (remittance) corridors. We tapped into a massive shift - from banks to phones - bringing digital finance to places where traditional systems never reached. The next stage of growth will fuel a network of services and products especially designed to make money more accessible to diaspora communities including local cards, and additional savings and payments features.
  
  
We’re growing fast, backed by world-class investors, and scaling a product that blends
**real world impact with cutting edge fintech innovation**
.
  
  
**Here’s a Little More**

* Founded by Harvard grads and 3-time founders who previously built Segovia (acquired) and GiveDirectly (>$300M revenue, fastest-growing NGO in the world)
* Backed by top investors including Spark Capital, Canaan, Reid Hoffman, Breyer Capital, Unbound, Wamda, and more
* Built by global top performers from Bain, Google, McKinsey, Uber, Checkout, Bolt, and beyond - we move fast, stay humble, and care deeply about our mission
* Truly global team - 250+ people, 50+ nationalities, 50+ languages
* Guided by our values - ownership, impact, humility, and heart - in deed, not just word

Taptap Values
  
  
Impact first
  
  
Team next
  
  
Accept reality
  
  
Propose solutions
  
  
Win with grit
  
  
Be proactively candid, with yourself and others
  
  
Love the particular
  
  
Own it
  
  
Create positive energy
  
  
Maybe, even have fun
  
  
Taptap Send is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. All employment decisions are decided on the basis of qualifications, experience and business need. We strongly encourage applications who are members of underrepresented communities to apply.
  
  
If you require reasonable adjustments to be made during the recruitment process, please do not hesitate to let us know. Any information you provide us in this respect will only be used to accommodate your requirements.
  
  
*Note: we recognize imposter syndrome is real - any candidate that does not perfectly fit every characteristic of this role is still strongly encouraged to apply.*

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Manager - HAL
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
**About SC Ventures**
**SC Ventures is Standard Chartered ’s innovation, fintech investment and ventures arm. We were established to reinvent banking, as the significant technological disruptions to the industry was impacting its ability to serve clients and customers, in the ways they needed to be served. We are a unique ecosystem of innovators, banking experts, business builders and partners who are focused on rewiring the DNA in banking and bringing breakthrough ideas to scale, together. We are building ecosystems around four high conviction themes: Online Economy & Lifestyle, SMEs & World Trade, Digital Assets, and Sustainability & Inclusion. We are a global team of "Members" (excluding individual ventures), including dedicated colleagues from the Group's support functions, based in Singapore, Hong Kong, London, and the United Arab Emirates**
**About HAL**
**HAL is a B2B domestic and cross border marketplace being built for SMEs in the UAE. Incubated by SC Ventures, the ventures arm of Standard Chartered Bank, the platform will enable digital commerce and access to financial & value-added services. HAL’s vision is to act as a super glue connecting multiple partners & ecosystems by bringing together buyers, sellers, financial institutions, logistics partners under one roof. We are building this as an agentic AI native stack along with several strategic partners in the UAE who bring different capabilities into the platform.**
**SMEs are the backbone of the UAE economy and vital for economic growth and diversification. We want to help SMEs grow profitably, safely and with ease. Hal is being built for scale with the latest technologies and with a vision to truly become the one stop shop for SMEs. We are looking to launch later in the year.**
**The Senior Marketing Manager will lead HAL's marketing function, working closely with the CEO and the commercial, product and partnerships teams. This is a commercially driven role: success is measured by the qualified B2B leads you generate (sellers, buyers and SMEs looking for finance), the revenue they bring in, and HAL's growing share of the UAE SME market. You will be hands-on and highly experimental, testing new channels and ideas quickly, doubling down on what works, and doing whatever it takes to help HAL win in the market.**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**

* Develop and own HAL's go-to-market marketing plan, turning business targets for sellers, buyers and finance referrals into lead generation goals, channel priorities and budget.
* Run a structured test-and-learn approach: set clear hypotheses, launch quick experiments across channels, measure results, and scale what works.
* Build simple, reliable full-funnel reporting covering leads, cost per lead, conversion to onboarded users and revenue, and share insights and recommendations with leadership regularly.
* Plan a rolling quarterly marketing calendar aligned to HAL's launch milestones and key UAE moments (e.g. Ramadan, National Day, major trade exhibitions).
* Lead, coach and develop the marketing team, working as one team with sales, product and partnerships to hit shared growth targets.

**Business**

* Own B2B lead generation for HAL: build a predictable pipeline of qualified sellers, buyers and SMEs needing finance (e.g. trade finance, working capital, invoice discounting), and ensure smooth handover to the commercial team.
* Agree with the sales team on the ideal customer profile, lead qualification criteria, and a shared process for lead handover and follow-up.
* Drive seller and buyer acquisition for the marketplace launch, and support activation campaigns so that new users start trading on the platform.
* Partner with banks, logistics, payments and other strategic partners on co-marketing campaigns and joint lead generation.
* Manage the marketing budget with discipline, tracking cost per lead and return on spend and moving budget to the best-performing channels.

**Processes**
**Lead Generation & Performance Marketing**

* Plan, launch and optimise paid campaigns across LinkedIn, Google, Meta and regional platforms, owning cost per lead, conversion rates and return on ad spend.
* Continuously experiment with new acquisition channels, such as WhatsApp campaigns, outbound email sequences, account-based marketing for high-value accounts, partner referrals and B2B directories.
* Build landing pages, lead forms and email and WhatsApp nurture journeys that turn interest into qualified leads.
* Set up and manage the core marketing tools (e.g. CRM and marketing automation such as HubSpot) and tracking so every lead can be traced back to its source.
* Grow HAL's organic visibility through SEO and content, including in AI-assisted search.

**Events & Field Marketing**

* Plan and deliver HAL's events programme: launch events, SME workshops, roundtables, webinars and networking sessions.
* Represent HAL at relevant trade shows and industry events across the UAE, making sure every event produces qualified leads with clear follow-up.
* Build relationships with chambers of commerce, trade associations, free zones and SME programmes to reach SMEs at scale.

**Thought Leadership, Content & PR**

* Build a thought leadership programme that positions HAL and its leaders as trusted voices on SME growth, B2B trade and trade finance in the UAE.
* Manage leadership's LinkedIn presence and secure speaking slots, panels and media interviews.
* Create content that educates and converts, such as articles, guides, case studies, newsletters, short videos and webinars, in English and Arabic where needed.
* Manage PR and media relations for launches and milestones, working with agencies where needed.

**Brand & Sales Enablement**
  
  

+ Establish HAL's brand positioning, key messages and visual identity, and keep them consistent across all touchpoints.
+ Create sales materials, such as pitch decks, one-pagers and case studies, that help the commercial team convert leads.
+ Gather customer and market insights (feedback, competitor moves, win/loss reasons) to sharpen messaging and targeting.

**Risk Management**

* Continuously evaluate agency roster to ensure that right agencies are onboarded while accommodating within the budget requirements

**Governance**

* Ensure compliance with all SCB and venture governance frameworks.
* Manage the function within budgetary constraints, seeking operational efficiencies

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Key stakeholders**

* Internal: CEO, CCO, COO, Head of digital commerce, Head of Financial Services, Head of partnerships.
* External: Relevant external regulator

**Other Responsibilities**

* Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in the business and SC Ventures;
* Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures.

**Skills And Experience**

* Marketing
* Branding
* Marketing Channels
* Planning : Tactical & Strategic
* Marketing Strategy & Positioning
* Brand Management

**Qualifications**

* 8–12 years of marketing experience, including at least 3 years in B2B demand generation or growth marketing.
* Highly commercially driven, with a proven track record of generating B2B leads and pipeline and a clear link to revenue (e.g. lead volume, cost per lead, conversion, revenue impact).
* Strong startup or scale-up background, with experience building marketing from the ground up in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.
* Experimental minds

jobs.title: Growth & Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**About Verto**
At Verto, we're on a mission to democratise global finance and empower businesses in Emerging Markets to reach the world. Founded by British-Nigerian entrepreneurs Ola Oyetayo and Anthony Oduu, our roots in Africa provided a firsthand understanding of the significant challenges businesses face with cross-border payments, ranging from illiquid currencies and high fees to slow transactions. This deep-rooted insight is why Africa remains a core focus, as we're committed to bridging the gap between emerging and developed markets and fostering global economic growth.
  
  
What started as an FX solution for the Nigerian Naira has evolved into a market-leading platform, enabling thousands of businesses to seamlessly transfer billions of dollars annually.
**We believe that where you do business shouldn’t determine your success or ability to scale.**
We're creating equal access to the easy payment and liquidity solutions that are already a given in developed markets.
  
  
We're not alone in realising this crucial need; we're backed by world-class investors including Y-Combinator, Quona, and MEVP. With Verto receiving the Milken-Motsepe Prize, appearing on CNBCs list of fastest growing UK companies, the Deloitte Fast 50 and Sifted’s fastest-growing UK tech companies, we are building a seamless cross-border payment future.
  
  
Join us as we continue to grow and transform global finance.
  
  
****Role Overview****
We are seeking a strategic and results-driven
**Growth and Marketing Manager**
to spearhead customer acquisition, engagement, and retention efforts across the UAE. In this pivotal role, you will build a strong local brand presence, launch high-impact campaigns, and drive measurable B2B growth. By identifying new market opportunities and leveraging your deep digital marketing expertise, you will play a central role in advancing Verto’s mission to become the leading cross-border payments partner in the region.
  
  
****What You’ll Be Doing****

* Drive B2B customer acquisition by developing pipeline strategies that yield high-intent, ICP-aligned prospects — focusing on deal quality, conversion rates, and pipeline velocity over raw lead volume.
* Optimise customer acquisition cost (CAC), conversion rates, and overall marketing ROI through data-driven decision-making, continuous testing, and deep channel performance analysis.
* Partner closely with the Sales and Product team to design and execute highly effective Account-Based Marketing (ABM) campaigns, continuously refine our ICP, and conduct win/loss analyses.
* Collaborate with the central global marketing team to activate paid media campaigns, ensuring local marketing activities are data-driven and commercially focused.
* Establish and aggressively scale Verto's local market presence in the UAE through strategic PR, thought leadership, local industry events, and brand partnerships.
* Develop compelling, region-specific content tailored to the UAE, including customer success stories, market trend reports, white papers, and sales enablement materials.
* Identify and cultivate strategic marketing partnerships with local industry associations, fintech partners, and relevant business organizations to expand Verto's reach.
* Work alongside the Retention Lead to launch initiatives that strengthen customer engagement, loyalty, and advocacy throughout the entire customer lifecycle.
* Track, analyze, and rigorously report on campaign performance, taking direct responsibility for significantly increasing the number of active UAE customers within your first 6-12 months.

****What You Need****

* Minimum of 5 years of experience in growth marketing, with a proven track record of driving measurable customer acquisition through data-driven marketing strategies.
* Deep, practical understanding of the UAE market, encompassing both traditional and digital B2B marketing landscapes.
* Hands-on proficiency with modern marketing automation and product analytics tools such as HubSpot, PostHog, and major social media platforms.
* Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to accurately interpret performance data, identify actionable trends, and continuously refine campaign strategies.
* Excellent communication and storytelling abilities to craft compelling, high-converting messaging tailored for diverse B2B audiences.
* High agility and the organizational capacity to manage multiple high-stakes projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment while maintaining sharp attention to detail.
* A track record of collaborating directly with Sales to understand unit economics, sales cycles, and deal disqualification criteria.
* Proven ability to dissect complex B2B products and articulate clear ROI, efficiency, and risk-reduction messaging to finance decision-makers (CFOs, Treasurers, Managing Directors).
* A Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a closely related field.

****Best If You Have****

* A strong background in marketing scalable SaaS platforms, particularly in B2B environments.
* Direct experience navigating the fast-paced, high-agility environment of a rapidly expanding start-up or scale-up.
* Previous exposure to the FinTech or cross-border payments sector, understanding the nuances of financial product marketing.

****Life At Verto****
****Perks****

* Insurance paid by the company
* Health and wellness benefits (with specific added benefits depending on the location of the role)
* Yearly salary review based on inflation, personal and business performance
* Access to entire Udemy’s library
* Budget for professional development courses
* Work-From-Anywhere policy for certain durations
* Integration programme (opportunity to work from our global offices)
* Regular team social events
* Pension scheme (depending on the role location)
* Flexible work arrangements
* Exposure to work with globally distributed teams
* Location specific benefits like car lease policy, cycle to work, gym membership, etc.

****You’ll Fit Right In If You****

* Love asking “why?”
* Value solving problems over just completing tasks
* Understand sync vs. async communication practices
* Thrive in ambiguity and change
* Actively seek feedback
* Prioritise impact over activity
* Are fun to work with - we love good humour!

****Culture****

* Our Core Values: These values reflect our focus, energy, and shared expectations.

+ Champion the Mission: We are driven by curiosity and belief to solve global cross-border payment challenges.
+ Be the Best: We are open, take calculated risks, focus on results, and excel in our work.
+ Work as One: We transparently share failures and successes.
+ Go the Extra Mile: We deliver beyond expectations and achieve the impossible.
+ Customer First: We creatively solve problems and boldly design better experiences for customers.
+ Run with It: We are determined, embrace challenges, own tasks, act swiftly, and deliver results.

* Industry Competitive Compensation & Benefits: We reward employees for their value to the business with competitive compensation and benefits across all locations. This includes performance-based salary reviews, comprehensive health and wellness benefits, generous paid time off, and flexible working arrangements to support your career and life.

****Diversity and Inclusion at Verto****
Verto is an equal opportunities employer and we value diversity. Anyone seeking employment at Verto is considered based on Merit, Competence, Qualifications and their Talent. We are proud to be a truly international team and we do not discriminate in our hiring process.

jobs.title: AI Native Head Of Growth - EdTech (French fluent 🇫🇷)
jobs.description:
**This Isn’t Another Growth Job**
Most growth teams call themselves data-driven. They have a dashboard, an agency and a ChatGPT licence to write ad copy faster. That’s the 99%.
  
  
We want to be part of the 0.1%: a company where AI doesn’t just help the growth team, it runs the growth loop. Every day, on every channel.
  
  
**Then it’s your chance to define a new category : The Operating System (OS) for Human Greatness Augmented with AI.**
Science-backed. Design-led. AI-powered. Global.
  
  
We’re not looking for someone who only advises on what to test, we’re looking for someone who builds it. A hands-on Head of Growth who can ideate, write the copy, design the strategy and launch experiments directly.
  
  
**What Ai-native Growth Means At Paradox 🤖**
Our growth machine has to be able to:
  
  

* Generate hypotheses. Read the signals (ad performance, webinar attendance, sales calls, objections, churn reasons, comments, competitors’ ads) and propose what to test next, with a cost and an expected impact.
* Act across every tool. Not a chatbot in a tab: it reads and writes in our whole stack, from ad accounts to CRM, landing pages, webinars, email, social DMs and analytics.
* Hold the full context of Paradox. Our DNA, offers, voice, member stories, past campaigns and what they taught us, in one shared company brain.
* Ship its hypotheses. Produce the hook, the ad cut, the page, the email sequence or the funnel variant, and put it live.
* Measure with real KPIs. Every test is tied to a number that matters (cost per qualified lead, show-up rate, close rate, CAC, payback, LTV), not to likes or reach.
* Learn and loop on its own. Scale what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and launch the next cycle without waiting for a meeting.

This is already real. Our growth hub tracks every hypothesis and experiment, with its result. An ads library of thousands of creatives feeds our creative research. Agents cut ads from long-form content, prepare webinars, wire Instagram comment-to-DM automations and audit our tracking after every live. Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day.
  
  
**OUR MISSION**
At Paradox,
  
  
We believe self-help is broken: generic theory, a quick high, no real change.
  
  
We believe people deserve more. More than content. More than motivation.
  
  
They deserve a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.
  
  
Growth at Paradox means bringing people into something that actually changes their life, and proving it.
  
  
We do that by merging :
  
  

* Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)
* Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals)
* Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.
  
  
**Short history**
Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world.
  
  
Here’s the bet: a company that learns by itself grows in a way a company of people alone can’t. A small growth team running a self-learning machine can out-test, out-learn and out-grow teams a hundred times its size.
  
  
We hold ourselves to the standards of Apple, Spotify and MasterClass. While others hide their numbers, we let our results speak.
  
  
**YOUR MISSION 🚀**
As Head of Growth, you’ll be the architect of a growth machine that learns by itself. In a classic growth team, people do the work and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the work, you design the system, set the bar and make the calls.
  
  
You don’t just manage a team, you get your hands dirty to identify growth levers and pull them yourself.
  
  
**🎯 YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS**

* Build the agents that run growth
* ❌ The old way: a Head of Growth hires people and agencies, briefs them, and checks their work.
* 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: your team is mostly agents, and you build them yourself. You write their skills, plug them into our tools (ad accounts, CRM, webinars, email, analytics) and write the evals that tell an agent what "good" means: a hook that stops the scroll, a page that converts, a test that’s worth its cost.
* You give autonomy step by step: first an agent suggests, then it acts once you approve, then it acts alone within a budget and guardrails. You move each agent up a level only when its track record earns it.
* Example: in your first month you build the agent that reviews every ad set overnight. At first it only suggests. By month three it pauses losers and moves budget by itself within limits you set, and you only see what was decided and why.
* Build an acquisition engine that runs day and night
* ❌ The old way: a media buyer checks the dashboards each morning, changes bids by hand and waits for the weekly report.
* 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: you build and improve the agents that watch every ad set, page, webinar and email sequence around the clock. They spot what’s dropping, find the cause, fix it or launch a variant, and report what they did.
* You give autonomy step by step: an agent can pause an ad on its own long before it can raise a budget. You decide where each agent stops and a human takes over.
* Example: show-up rate drops on Tuesday’s webinar. Before anyone notices, an agent has found the cause (a reminder that never went out), fixed it and started testing a new reminder sequence.
* Build a creative machine with taste
* ❌ The old way: a creative team briefs an agency, waits two weeks and gets five ads.
* 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: you build the agents that turn every live, interview and member story into hooks, ad cuts and shorts, that study what the best advertisers in the world are running, and that write in our voice.
* Your taste becomes the eval: you write down what makes a great hook, a great cut and a great story, in rules and examples the agents check themselves against. Each time you reject something, the reason goes back into the rules.
* Example: one webinar becomes dozens of hook variants by the next morning. You keep the best few, and next week the agents’ first drafts are already closer to your bar.
* Build measurement that checks itself
* ❌ The old way: an analyst rebuilds the numbers in a spreadsheet at the end of the month, and nobody trusts them.
* 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: you build the agents that connect every touch to cash, from ad to lead, live, sale and transformed member, and that audit the tracking after every campaign.
* No number, no test: you define the KPIs that matter (CAC, show-up, close rate, LTV, payback), and agents refuse to launch a test that isn’t wired to one.
* Example: after each live, an agent cross-checks the ad platform, the CRM and our analytics, finds where they disagree and fixes the leak before the next live.
* Make the machine better every week, and keep the soul
* ❌ The old way: lessons live in people’s heads and leave with them.
* 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: every result goes back into the company brain, and agents read it before proposing anything. The machine never learns the same lesson twice.
* You measure the machine itself: tests per week, time from idea to live, the share of the work done without a human, and how many agents moved up an autonomy level this month. You push those numbers up.

The Due diligence businesses won by nimble players who can turn around files faster and in an accurate fashion. Bids are won on who has the largest capacity, quicker throughputs and scalable options.CA is seeking Senior Manager - Underwriting Operations, who can develop strategies, re-engineer process workflows, adopt cutting-edge technologies faster, build capacity and churn deliverables in a timely manner.

**Current Operation Model**

The current model of operations follows a seamless integrated model comprising of onshore and offshore team members. The offshore unit predominantly assists in performing bookmarking and data extraction activities on a loan file. The Data extraction is performed across Credit, Income and Compliance sections of the loan file. Bookmarking ensures bookmarking consistency across the labelling of each document, chronologically arranging similar documents, removal of duplicate documents, re-arranging misplaced documents and nesting bookmarks under a header bookmark. Currently both bookmarking and data extraction are performed using a third-party AI driven software. From the Offshore side, the Underwriters collect data and review on the following areas: Credit (Income Calculation) and Compliance.

**Description of the Role**

As part of the responsibility, the Senior Manager - Underwriting Operations, is required to conceive, design, develop and roll out strategies that can result in the following outcomes:

1. Process Transformation in the Offshore Underwriting Operations
2. Daily Throughput Management
3. Staffing Optimization s Productivity Enhancement

5. Client Services s Engagement

As part of performance management, the SOC will be assessed on the following KPIs. The weightage of the KPI parameters can be discussed and agreed between the SOC and the President of the organization.

1. Support in screening, interviewing and hiring new underwriters
2. To provide effective strategies for building and growing the DIS Underwriting Operations. The goal is to build a strong team of 100 offshore underwriters.
3. Oversee progress of classroom and on job training.
4. Oversee Production ramp up to meet the required level.
5. Monitor quality level and give directions to progress on quality level.

8. Manage the SLA and delivery obligations made with the client.
9. Other activities that are mutually agreed over email or as an amendment to this agreement, as the project progresses.

**Qualifications**
