At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.
  
  
Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

team within Finance. This role is located in
**Pune, India**
.
  
  
In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:
  
  

* Functional leadership: Lead Corporate Treasury Finance (CTF) and Balance Sheet Reporting & Analytics (BSRA) from India, with full accountability for the quality, timeliness, control and continuous improvement of all deliverables.
* Plan & forecast: Own the end-to-end Balance Sheet and Net Interest Income (NII) plan and forecast process (plan rounds, rest-of-year and multi-year outlooks) for supported Lines of Business, ensuring a consistent methodology and timely submission into planning systems.
* Deposit forecast governance: Lead the deposit forecast and challenger process with Treasury Finance, GLS and LOB CFOs – framing assumptions, sensitivities, beta/pricing expectations and decision asks.
* NII & balance sheet narrative: Own the NII and balance sheet story for senior management, explaining drivers of variance versus plan, forecast and prior periods (rate, volume and mix) along with forward-looking risks and opportunities.
* Subject-matter expertise: Provide leadership on Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP), liquidity metrics (LCR and liquidity stress testing), interest-bearing and non-interest-bearing balance dynamics, and assess the impact of central bank rate changes, client flows and product/currency mix on deposits and NII.
* Reporting & analytics: Oversee daily, weekly, month-end and quarterly reporting – including month-to-date NII estimates, earnings support, management memos and client-, LOB- and firm-level analytics such as deposit pricing cohorts, client movers and beta analysis.
* Stakeholder partnership: Serve as trusted advisor and senior point of contact for Corporate Treasury, CIO, Treasury Finance, LOB CFOs, GLS, Interest Rate Risk, International Treasury, Controllers and Technology; represent India in senior forums and build durable partnerships through clear service models, SLAs and governance cadences.
* Scope expansion: Identify and lead the transition of new LOBs, platforms and processes into the India hub, partnering with Finance Data Strategy, Technology and other Centers of Excellence on firm-wide initiatives.
* Transformation & AI: Drive process simplification, report rationalization and adoption of Power BI, self-serve dashboards, automation and AI agents, tracking measurable efficiency gains aligned to Finance objectives.

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:
  
  

* Education: Master’s degree in a financial discipline such as accounting, finance, economics or statistics, or local country equivalent, is required; MBA preferred. Professional qualifications such as CA, CFA, FRM or CPA are a strong advantage.
* Experience: 15+ years of progressive experience in finance, FP&A, treasury finance or balance sheet management within banking or financial services.
* Domain expertise: Strong knowledge of Asset and Liability Management (ALM), deposits, NII, FTP, liquidity (LCR/LST), interest rate risk and the bank balance sheet, with a sound understanding of financial controls and governance.
* Global operating model: Proven track record of building and scaling India-based Centers of Excellence that partner with US/EMEA senior leadership; ability to influence senior stakeholders and translate complex technical-financial topics into clear business narratives.
* Communication & tools: Excellent written, verbal and executive presentation skills; advanced MS Office; proficiency with enterprise planning, reporting and ERP tools (e.g., Planning Analytics/TM1, Cognos, HFM, Oracle) and Power BI – exposure to Python/SQL, automation and AI tools is a plus.
* People leadership: 7+ years leading multi-layered teams (VPs, AVPs, Specialists and Analysts), with demonstrated strength in organization design, workforce and succession planning, coaching and performance management, and in building an inclusive, high-performance culture.

At BNY, our culture speaks for itself, check out the latest BNY news at:
  
  
BNY Newsroom
  
  
BNY LinkedIn
  
  
**Here’s a Few Of Our Recent Awards**

* America’s Most Innovative Companies, Fortune, 2025
* World’s Most Admired Companies, Fortune 2025

**Our Benefits And Rewards**
BNY offers highly competitive compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs rooted in a strong culture of excellence and our pay-for-performance philosophy. jobs.description:
Some careers have more impact than others.
  
  
If you’re looking for further opportunities to develop your career, take the next step in fulfilling your potential right here at HSBC.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 58 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Global Head of Reconciliation Technology
**.**
**Department Background:**
CIB HBEU Technology
  
  
**Work Location**
: Pune
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The Global Head of Reconciliation Technology will lead a critical function Reconciliations and Fee Billing within Markets Operations Technology, overseeing reconciliation processes across multiple business units and geographic locations. This senior leadership role involves managing a team of 100+ professionals globally, handling over 4000 reconciliation processes, overseeing a c25 million USD budget and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements. The role holder will drive technological innovation, business strategy to optimize reconciliation operations and thereby minimizing run-the-bank costs.
  
  
This role is responsible to lead a team across five locations - UK, France, Canada, China, and India ably supported by business support teams across the bank.

* Develop and maintain risk management frameworks to identify, assess, and mitigate risks associated with reconciliation operations.
* Collaborate with compliance and risk management teams to ensure the integrity and security of reconciliation data.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including vendors, regulators, and cross-functional teams.
* Communicate effectively with senior management and other stakeholders regarding reconciliation strategies, progress, and challenges.
* Represent the bank in industry forums and conferences related to reconciliation technology.
* Implement the Technology Strategy and maintenance of reconciliation systems. This includes ensuring that systems are reliable, scalable, and compliant with the risk management framework.
* Implementing new Reconciliations and ensuring the existing reconciliations are suitably supported.
* Drive innovation and continuous improvements.
* Manage budgets and resources, ensuring that technology investments are aligned with business goals, and managing project costs

**Teamwork**

* Build and maintain the broad and diverse set of skills required to run the team.
* Provide strategic direction, leadership, support, guidance, and management for the team.

We are seeking a finance professional to lead financial operations, accounting oversight, compliance coordination, cash-flow planning, management reporting and financial controls across our growing business.

* Experience working with external accounting firms and auditors.

**Key Success Measures**

* Timely and accurate monthly financial reporting.
* Complete revenue, bank and payment gateway reconciliations.
* On-time statutory compliance.
* Improved collection and cash-flow visibility.
* Effective financial controls and reduced reconciliation discrepancies.

**We are looking for a finance leader who can build a controlled, transparent and scalable finance function.**

HighRadius, a renowned provider of cloud-based Autonomous Software for the Office of the CFO, has transformed critical financial processes for over 1000+ leading companies worldwide. Trusted by prestigious organisations like 3M, Unilever, Anheuser-Busch InBev, Sanofi, Kellogg Company, Danone, Hershey's, and many others, HighRadius optimises order-to-cash, treasury, and record-to-report processes, earning us back-to-back recognition in Gartner's Magic Quadrant and a prestigious spot in Forbes Cloud 100 List for three consecutive years.
  
With a remarkable valuation of $3.1B and an impressive annual recurring revenue exceeding $100M, we experienced a robust year-over-year growth of 24%. With a global presence spanning 6+ locations, we're in the pre-IPO stage, poised for rapid growth. We invite passionate, diverse individuals to join us on this exciting path to becoming a publicly traded company and to help shape our promising future.

This is a highly visible and complex role since the candidate will be the Senior point of contact and work with executives and users across the entire organisation. The successful candidate must be a strong leader, extremely well organised, detail-oriented, quality-minded and possess excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
● Manage a portfolio of up to 10-15 Business Transformation Enterprise projects or a couple of strategic engagements of varying complexity at any given time.
  
● Lead the implementation services & consulting for assigned clients.
  
● Implementation scoping, estimating and Contract reviews.
  
● Work with cross departments (Sales, Product Management, Customer Value, and Infrastructure) to be able to come up with solutions which help provide value to clients.
  
● Build strong relationships with Senior client stakeholders of Fortune 1000 companies.
  
● Manage project resources, including Project Managers, Solution Architects, and Consultants.
  
● Manage project issues/risks and client expectations and escalate as needed.
  
● Assist in building playbooks and benchmarks from completed projects.
  
● Understanding of Business processes and System architecture.
  
● Arranging and conducting initial Executive, CxO discussions & positioning meetings.
  
  
**Skill & Experience Needed**
● Bachelor's degree required.
  
● Professional Services Director/ Project Manager / Practice Head / Sr. Director for 3+ years.
  
● 15+ years of progressive consulting project management experience.
  
● Experience in functional or technical roles in the implementation of large ERP systems is a plus.
  
● Independent thinking with keen problem-solving skills.
  
● Ability to adapt to changing schedules and multiple work plans.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Controller
jobs.description:
**Senior Financial Controller**  
Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat | Department: Finance | Reports to: CEO / CFO

**About the Company**

Our client is one of India's fastest-growing workspace and business infrastructure companies, offering Managed Offices, Coworking Spaces, Enterprise Workspace Solutions, Build-to-Suit Offices, Design & Build Services, and Business Infrastructure Solutions.

Founded with the vision of transforming how businesses experience workspaces, the company partners with startups, SMEs, large enterprises, GCCs, and multinational corporations by providing scalable, technology-enabled workplace solutions across India.

Today, it operates across multiple cities with a rapidly expanding footprint and manages millions of square feet of commercial real estate through long-term strategic partnerships. As it scales nationally through organic growth, strategic partnerships, acquisitions, and new business ventures, the company is looking for a strong, hands-on finance leader to own the controllership backbone of the organization while partnering closely with the CFO on strategic finance initiatives.

**Business Ecosystem**

The Senior Financial Controller will drive financial control and reporting discipline across the group's ecosystem, which includes multiple business verticals and associated entities involved in workspace development, operations, technology, and business services. The role operates in a multi-entity, high-growth environment and requires strong governance, process ownership, and financial discipline across:

* Managed Office Solutions
* Coworking Spaces
* Enterprise Workspace Solutions
* Commercial Real Estate
* Design & Build
* Infrastructure Development
* Facility & Workplace Operations
* Technology-enabled Workplace Solutions
* Business Support Services

**Role Purpose**

The Senior Financial Controller will own end-to-end Finance & Accounts, Compliance, Taxation, and MIS Reporting across the organization, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and control at every stage of the financial close and reporting cycle. As a senior member of the Finance leadership team, the role will work closely with the CFO and business heads to translate financial strategy into disciplined execution, and will step in on select strategic finance, treasury, and fundraising-support responsibilities that a growing multi-entity business demands.

This is a controllership-first role with meaningful exposure to strategic finance, ideal for a finance leader who wants to build and run the core finance engine of a fast-scaling company while growing into broader CFO-level responsibilities over time.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Finance & Accounting Operations (Core Ownership)**

* Own end-to-end Finance & Accounts, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Revenue Recognition, Fixed Assets, and Payroll Accounting.
* Lead timely monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing across all entities.
* Prepare and review Consolidated Financial Statements for the group.
* Own MIS Reporting and ensure accuracy, consistency, and timeliness of management reports.
* Build and maintain scalable accounting processes and standard operating procedures across a multi-entity structure.

**Taxation & Regulatory Compliance (Core Ownership)**

* Ensure full compliance across GST, Income Tax, TDS, and Companies Act requirements.
* Oversee Secretarial Compliance and ROC filings in coordination with company secretarial support.
* Lead Statutory Audits and Internal Audits, and act as the primary point of contact for auditors.
* Strengthen Internal Financial Controls (IFC) and overall financial governance.

**Treasury & Working Capital**

* Manage day-to-day cash flow planning and working capital optimization.
* Maintain and strengthen banking relationships across the group.
* Support debt servicing, liquidity management, and treasury operations.

**FP&A and Business Finance**

* Support the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), budgeting, forecasting, and rolling forecasts.
* Track financial KPIs and business intelligence reporting for leadership review.
* Partner with business leaders to evaluate profitability, support pricing decisions, and improve operational efficiency.
* Recommend and drive cost optimization initiatives across business units.

**Strategic Finance Support (Partnering with CFO)**

* Support financial due diligence for M&A, investments, and joint ventures as needed.
* Assist in preparing financial models, investor presentations, and materials for lender / PE / VC interactions.
* Contribute financial insights to Board-level and leadership reporting.
* Support post-merger financial integration for acquired businesses.

**Risk Management & Governance**

* Strengthen internal controls and enterprise risk management practices.
* Ensure compliance with corporate policies across all entities.
* Identify and mitigate financial and compliance risks proactively.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead and mentor the accounting, taxation, and compliance teams.
* Build a high-performing, process-driven finance function capable of supporting rapid national growth.
* Act as a key escalation point for finance operations, deputizing for the CFO on controllership matters when required.

**Requirements**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) or MBA Finance is mandatory.
* Minimum 10+ years of progressive experience in Finance & Accounts, with strong hands-on controllership exposure.
* Proven experience owning the complete accounting close, MIS, and compliance function.
* Strong exposure to Accounting, Taxation, Compliance, Audit, and Financial Governance; working exposure to FP&A and Treasury preferred.
* Experience managing finance teams in a multi-location / multi-entity organization.
* Exposure to fundraising, due diligence, or investor reporting is an added advantage but not mandatory.

We aim to be where the growth is—enabling businesses to thrive, economies to prosper and people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We’re seeking an experienced professional to join our Securities Services team as **NFR Senior Manager.**

  

**In this role, you will:**

* Report to the FMI NFR Head, the Senior Manager will act as a key partner in shaping and delivering the FMI non-financial risk agenda. The role holder will recommend priorities, take ownership of agreed deliverables and lead implementation across in-scope FMI activities and NTTPs, ensuring alignment with Group mandatory procedures, the Risk Management Framework (RMF) and Third-Party Risk Policy requirements.
* This newly created position will lead the design, implementation and ongoing enhancement of the FMI NTTP risk management operating model. The Senior Manager will translate policy requirements into effective governance, controls and management information (MI), challenge existing practices and drive consistent adoption. Success will be measured through demonstrable improvements in risk management and sustainable control outcomes, rather than completion of activities alone.
* Working across Network Management and Market Intelligence (N2MI), Trading Facilities and CCP Management (TFCM), CSD Management and PS Management, the role holder will influence senior stakeholders and lead resolution of complex risk and control matters. The role will operate autonomously within an agreed mandate, escalating material exposures, unresolved disagreements and decisions requiring the FMI NFR Head’s authority. The FMI NFR Head retains overall functional accountability, while business and control owners retain responsibility for their risks, controls and remediation.
* Partner with the FMI NFR Head to establish a prioritised programme of activity that strengthens the control environment for in-scope FMI NTTPs. Lead delivery of agreed outcomes, ensuring risk management practices are consistent, evidence-based and aligned with Third-Party Risk Policy requirements, FMI-specific expectations and applicable risk appetite.
* Lead the development of clear, forward-looking risk insight and recommendations to inform governance and senior decision-making. Challenge control weaknesses, emerging exposures and the adequacy of proposed responses, holding accountable owners to agreed remediation outcomes and escalating material concerns or delivery risks.
* Drive change across FMI by leading implementation of CIB-led Third-Party Risk Management initiatives and improvements to mandatory procedures, operating instructions, reporting and tooling. Assess market infrastructure and regulatory developments, recommend proportionate responses and secure stakeholder commitment to changes that are practical, consistently embedded and sustainable.
* Partner with the FMI NFR Head to shape priorities and lead implementation and enhancement of mandatory FMI procedures and associated controls across in-scope NTTPs. Lead annual reviews and updates across N2MI and TFCM, challenge gaps and drive consistent application as business and regulatory requirements evolve.
* Lead oversight of FMI third-party controls and monitoring, critically assess results and challenge the adequacy of control design, operation and supporting evidence against Third-Party Risk Policy requirements and FMI-specific expectations. Drive resolution of weaknesses with accountable owners and maintain audit-ready documentation standards.
* Lead development and quality assurance of monthly governance packs and MI for the FMI Business Control Committee and N2MI Governance Committee. Translate complex matters into clear risk assessments, recommendations and decisions required; present and defend key messages, challenge senior stakeholders and escalate material concerns through the appropriate governance channels.
* Lead end-to-end oversight of NFR actions, issues and remediation, including Management Self-Identified Issues (MSIIs) and Audit Identified Issues (AIIs). Challenge root-cause analysis, action plans, milestones and closure evidence; hold accountable owners to agreed outcomes and escalate delays, unresolved exposures or remediation that does not deliver sustainable risk reduction.
* Lead FMI’s coordination of internal and external audits and assurance reviews. Establish coherent responses across the FMI team, challenge evidence quality and consistency, identify cross-cutting themes and drive delivery of agreed remediation with accountable owners, escalating significant matters to the FMI NFR Head.
* Lead FMI’s implementation and embedding of CIB-led Third-Party Risk Management initiatives. Assess business impacts, establish clear delivery plans and accountabilities, influence stakeholders across business, operations and Risk and Control functions, and resolve implementation challenges to secure effective adoption.
* Drive continuous improvement and simplification of FMI NFR processes, reporting and tooling. Challenge inefficient practices, prioritise changes that strengthen control effectiveness, data quality and management insight, and lead delivery from design through implementation and embedding within an agreed mandate.
* Lead analysis and preparation of responses to regulatory requests and senior management queries. Proactively assess emerging market infrastructure and regulatory developments, determine implications for FMI NTTP operational performance and the control environment, and recommend prioritised, proportionate responses to the FMI NFR Head and relevant stakeholders.
  

**To be successful you will:**

* Substantial experience in non-financial risk, operational risk, third-party risk or governance and controls within financial services or a similarly regulated environment, with a demonstrated record of leading complex risk and control initiatives.
* A self-starting, solution-oriented approach, independently setting priorities aligned with the FMI NFR agenda and driving delivery without close supervision. Takes proactive initiative and end-to-end ownership, remaining accountable for outcomes and exercising sound judgement on when to engage or escalate.
* Strong practical expertise in risk and control frameworks, including the ability to challenge risk assessments, control design and effectiveness, root-cause analysis, remediation plans and closure evidence, and maintain audit-quality documentation.
* Strong analytical capability and sound judgement to interpret complex information, identify emerging risks and cross-cutting themes, and recommend priorities based on materiality.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with senior leaders, influence and constructively challenge stakeholders, resolve competing priorities and secure delivery across business, operations and Risk and Control functions without relying on direct reporting authority.
* Strong executive communication skills, including producing concise MI, dashboards and governance papers, presenting complex matters clearly, making evidence-based recommendations and articulating the decisions and actions required from senior stakeholders.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional change from design through implementation and embedding, establish clear accountability and manage multiple priorities with disciplined delivery and attention to detail. Evidence of sustainable improvements in risk management or control effectiveness, supported by proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint and Word.
* Knowledge of FM

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Zoho Books Accountant K. Subraya Anantha Kamath & Sons Kasaragod, Kerala Position: Zoho Books Accountant Department: Accounts & Finance Location: Kasaragod, Kerala Employment Type: Full-time Reporting To: Management / Accounts Head 1. About the Company K. Subraya Anantha Kamath & Sons is an established cashew processing and trading company with a legacy dating back to 1945. The company is engaged in cashew kernel processing, domestic and international trading, procurement of raw cashew nuts and sale of cashew by-products. We are looking for a detail-oriented and responsible accountant with practical experience in Zoho Books and GST compliance to manage our accounting operations. 2. Key Responsibilities A. Zoho Books Management - Maintain complete and accurate accounting records in Zoho Books. - Record daily sales, purchases, receipts, payments and journal entries. - Maintain customer and supplier ledgers. - Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable. - Ensure timely and accurate accounting entries. - Maintain proper documentation of all financial transactions. B. GST & Statutory Compliance - Prepare and verify GST sales and purchase data. - Coordinate preparation and filing of GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B. - Reconcile GSTR-2B with purchase records. - Verify GST input tax credit eligibility. - Coordinate with external auditors and tax consultants. - Maintain TDS records and assist with statutory compliance. C. Banking & Financial Transactions - Perform bank reconciliations regularly. - Monitor customer collections and supplier payments. - Maintain cash and bank books. - Prepare payment schedules. - Track outstanding receivables and payables. D. Inventory & Stock Accounting - Maintain inventory records in Zoho. - Monitor raw cashew nut purchases and stock. - Track cashew kernel grades and quantities. - Maintain stock records of finished goods, packing materials and by-products. - Reconcile physical stock with accounting records. - Coordinate with factory and stores personnel for stock verification. E. Sales & Purchase Accounting - Verify purchase invoices, sales invoices and debit/credit notes. - Ensure correct GST rates, HSN codes and tax classifications. - Track customer outstanding balances. - Monitor supplier balances and payment due dates. - Maintain proper records of domestic and export transactions. F. MIS & Management Reporting Prepare periodic reports for management, including: - Daily sales and purchase reports. - Customer outstanding and ageing reports. - Supplier outstanding reports. - Stock and inventory reports. - Monthly Profit & Loss statement. - Cash flow and fund position. - Expense analysis. - Product-wise and business-wise profitability reports, wherever data is available. 3. Required Qualifications & Experience - B.Com / M.Com or equivalent qualification. - 2–5 years of accounting experience. - Hands-on experience in Zoho Books is essential. - Good knowledge of GST and Indian accounting practices. - Experience with inventory accounting. - Knowledge of Excel and spreadsheets. - Experience in manufacturing, processing or trading businesses will be an advantage. 4. Skills & Competencies - Strong accounting fundamentals. - High accuracy and attention to detail. - Good analytical and reconciliation skills. - Ability to independently manage daily accounting operations. - Good communication and coordination skills. - Integrity, confidentiality and accountability. - Ability to meet deadlines. 5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) The performance of the accountant will be evaluated on: 1. Accuracy and completeness of accounting entries. 2. Timely completion of bank reconciliations. 3. Timely GST preparation and compliance. 4. Accuracy of customer and supplier balances. 5. Timely submission of monthly MIS reports. 6. Accuracy of inventory and stock reconciliation. 7. Timely identification and reporting of accounting discrepancies. 6. What We Expect We expect the accountant to take ownership of the company's accounting system, ensure that all transactions are properly recorded and reconciled, and provide reliable financial information to management for decision-making. The objective is to maintain a transparent, accurate and well-organised accounting system through Zoho Books.

Pay: ₹8,500.00 - ₹42,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

**About Us**

Alpha Ladder Group is a Singapore-headquartered financial services group operating across regulated capital markets, digital asset services, wealth management, cross-border payments and asset tokenization.

Through our regulated entities and technology infrastructure, we provide institutional and corporate clients with innovative financial solutions spanning traditional finance and digital assets. Our ecosystem combines regulated financial services with advanced payment and digital asset infrastructure to support clients across global markets.

As we expand our presence in the Middle East and Africa, we are seeking an experienced regional leader to establish and scale our business across the MENA region.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a commercially driven, well-connected and entrepreneurial
**Regional Head, MENA**
to spearhead our business growth and market expansion across the Middle East and North Africa.

The ideal candidate is an established country or regional business leader from a payment institution, digital asset company or financial institution, with a strong commercial background, an extensive network of corporate and institutional clients, and established relationships with local banks.

This is a hands-on commercial leadership role with direct accountability for client acquisition, revenue generation, strategic partnerships and regional business expansion across our cross-border payments, OTC trading and wealth management businesses.

Candidates with a transaction banking background, particularly in cross-border payments, cash management, FX and treasury solutions, are highly preferred.

**Key Responsibilities**

1.
**Regional Business Development & Revenue Growth**

* Develop and execute the regional commercial strategy, with direct accountability for revenue growth, client acquisition and market expansion.
* Leverage established corporate and institutional client relationships to originate new business and accelerate revenue generation.
* Drive business development across cross-border payments, FX, OTC trading, digital assets and wealth management solutions.
* Build a strong sales pipeline, convert commercial opportunities into revenue and achieve agreed business targets.
* Identify new market opportunities, client segments and business expansion opportunities across the MENA region.

2.
**Client Origination & Strategic Partnerships**

* Leverage an established regional network to acquire and develop high-value corporate and institutional clients.
* Establish and strengthen strategic relationships with local banks, financial institutions, payment service providers and other ecosystem partners.
* Develop banking and payment partnerships to support regional business expansion and enhance payment, liquidity and settlement capabilities.
* Understand clients' cross-border payment, FX, treasury, liquidity and digital asset needs, and work with internal teams to deliver tailored financial solutions.
* Lead strategic commercial negotiations and build sustainable, long-term client and partner relationships.

3.
**Regional Business Leadership**

* Build and scale the regional business from the ground up, establishing local commercial capabilities and developing a high-performing business development team.
* Take ownership of regional business performance, revenue targets and sustainable commercial growth.
* Work closely with global Product, Operations, Compliance, Finance and Technology teams to drive business execution and deliver client solutions.
* Provide market intelligence, competitive insights and strategic recommendations to support the Group's regional expansion.
* Represent the company in the regional financial services and digital asset ecosystem, strengthening its market presence and industry relationships.

4.
**Regulatory & Business Governance**

* Serve as the designated local business leader for our VARA-regulated entity, subject to applicable regulatory requirements and approvals.
* Ensure regional business activities are conducted in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements, internal policies and governance standards.
* Partner with Compliance, Legal and Risk teams to support licensing requirements, ongoing regulatory obligations and effective business controls.

* At least 10 years of experience in payments, digital assets, banking, fintech or related financial services, with substantial experience in commercial leadership and business development.

* Existing relationships with UAE banks, regional financial institutions, family offices and institutional investors.
* Experience in OTC trading, digital asset liquidity, cross-border payments or wealth management distribution.
* Prior experience establishing or scaling a regional business in the Middle East.
* Familiarity with UAE financial services regulations and the broader MENA regulatory landscape.

**What We Offer**

* Direct exposure to senior leadership and strategic decision-making.
* The opportunity to shape the Group's MENA expansion across digital assets, payments and wealth management.
* A dynamic, entrepreneurial and internationally connected working environment.
* Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives.

jobs.title: Head of Banking & Payment Partnerships
jobs.description:
**Who we are**
We are a global wealth-tech company powering the next generation of trading. We deliver cutting-edge centralised trading solutions and robust B2B financial infrastructure. Our proprietary trading platform offers clients seamless access to stocks, ETFs, bonds, futures, options, swaps, funds, and currency pairs- all within a single, multi-currency account.
  
  
We believe in the boundless flow of capital and information. Whilst developing EXANTE, we saw technology as a means to improve global connectivity of the financial services industry. Over the years, we have earned a reputation for providing superior service and for getting the results our clients and customers want.
  
  
Most importantly, people have come to know us for our technological insights and focus on privacy. Our inspiration stems from the talent and ambition of our clients. We are offering an ecosystem of financial products and services that would provide the most tailored assistance to traders.
  
  
**Our culture**
Everything at EXANTE starts with our people. We bring together almost 800 minds across 70 locations. We place trust in our team with real autonomy - the freedom to drive change across products, processes and everything in between. That trust fuels innovation, and the demands of the markets build resilience; we adapt, push forward, and we look after each other while we do it.
  
  
That freedom is matched by real investment in growth: we back our people with ongoing learning, hands-on development and the kind of stretch opportunities that turn good careers into great ones.
  
  
**The Role Purpose**
We are looking for an experienced and commercially driven Head of Banking & Payment Partnerships to lead the development, expansion and management of EXANTE’s global banking and payment partner network.
  
  
This is a senior, hands-on role with end-to-end responsibility for establishing and maintaining strategic relationships with banks, payment service providers and e-money institutions across multiple jurisdictions.
  
  
You will play a critical role in strengthening our banking infrastructure, diversifying counterparty relationships, optimising commercial terms and ensuring reliable banking and payment services that support our international business and clients.
  
  
Working closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams, you will combine strong industry relationships, commercial negotiation skills and operational expertise to build a resilient, cost-effective and scalable banking network.
  
  
**Reporting Line**
— Chair Of Executive Committee
  
  
**Worksite**
— Remote
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Develop and expand our global banking network: Identify, evaluate and establish new relationships with banks, payment service providers and e-money institutions across key jurisdictions, including Malta, Cyprus, the UAE and Mauritius, supporting EXANTE’s international growth and operational needs.
* Own the end-to-end counterparty lifecycle: Lead the entire process from initial engagement and commercial negotiations through due diligence, onboarding, account opening and ongoing relationship management, ensuring timely and successful execution.
* Drive commercial value: Negotiate competitive banking and payment terms, including transaction fees, interest on client balances, credit facilities, account conditions and service levels, with a focus on cost optimisation and long-term value.
* Manage and strengthen strategic partnerships: Build trusted, sustainable relationships with existing banking partners through regular engagement, proactive issue resolution and ongoing management of compliance requirements, account restrictions and service performance.
* Lead banking due diligence and onboarding: Coordinate complex KYC, AML and regulatory due diligence processes, working closely with internal Compliance, Risk and other stakeholders to address counterparty requirements and facilitate successful onboarding.
* Ensure operational readiness and resilience: Partner with Finance, IT and Operations to establish effective banking and payment processes, including account structures, payment connectivity, transaction flows, reconciliations and contingency arrangements.
* Optimise counterparty diversification and performance: Monitor banking relationships, service quality, costs and counterparty concentration, identifying opportunities to mitigate risks, improve efficiency and strengthen the resilience of our banking infrastructure.
* Drive cross-functional execution and reporting: Collaborate with senior leadership and teams across the business to prioritise banking initiatives, manage multiple onboarding projects and provide clear visibility of partnership pipelines, commercial outcomes and emerging risks.

**What You Will Bring**
- Extensive relevant experience: At least 8 years of experience in banking relationship management, treasury, payment partnerships or financial institution coverage, ideally within a brokerage, fintech, payment institution, e-money business or financial services environment.
  
  

* Established banking network: Strong, active relationships with banks, financial institutions and payment providers, ideally across key international markets, including Europe, the UAE and other relevant jurisdictions.
* Proven track record of establishing banking partnerships: Demonstrable success in securing new banking relationships, opening corporate and client-money or safeguarding accounts, and establishing payment solutions for regulated financial services businesses.
* Strong commercial and negotiation skills: Experience negotiating banking fees, interest arrangements, credit facilities and service agreements, with the ability to demonstrate measurable commercial improvements and cost efficiencies.
* Deep understanding of banking due diligence: Strong knowledge of KYC, AML, regulatory requirements and financial institution onboarding processes, particularly for businesses operating across multiple jurisdictions with complex international client bases.
* Knowledge of banking and payment infrastructure: Solid understanding of banking operations, client-money arrangements, payment flows and relevant payment systems, such as SWIFT, SEPA, local payment rails and banking APIs.
* Excellent stakeholder and relationship management skills: Ability to engage confidently with senior banking executives, compliance and risk teams, internal leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, building credibility and maintaining productive long-term partnerships.
* Strong execution and project management capabilities: A proactive, structured and results-oriented approach, with the ability to manage multiple complex banking initiatives simultaneously and drive them through to completion.
* International financial services exposure: Experience supporting brokerage or financial services businesses with international client bases, particularly across European, CIS or Middle Eastern markets, would be a strong advantage.
* Communication skills: Fluency in English, with excellent communication, presentation and influencing skills

jobs.title: Director – Precious Metals Sales
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**Organization Unit Purpose**

The Precious Metals business originates, structures and delivers physical and financial precious metals solutions for the Bank’s corporate, institutional, commercial and wealth clients. The unit connects client coverage with trading, structuring, operations, legal, credit and compliance capabilities to build a scalable, well-controlled and profitable bullion franchise across the UAE and ENBDs network markets.

**Job Purpose**

The Director – Precious Metals Sales is responsible for originating and growing precious metals revenue by developing client relationships and delivering solutions across physical bullion, price-risk management, financing and investment products. The role leads opportunity identification, solution design and transaction execution while ensuring suitability, documentation, conduct, operational readiness and risk requirements are fully satisfied.

The job holder will contribute to the strategic development of the Bank’s precious metals franchise, deepen wallet share across existing relationships, acquire new-to-bank flows, and position the Bank as a trusted regional liquidity, financing and physical bullion partner.

**Job Content**

**Sales strategy and revenue delivery:**
Develop and execute a client and product sales plan to achieve annual revenue, volume, profitability and franchise objectives. Maintain a disciplined pipeline, identify white-space opportunities and convert prospects into recurring business.

**Client origination and relationship management:**
Build senior relationships with banks, refiners, bullion traders, jewellery groups, retailers, family offices, sovereign-linked entities and large corporates. Lead account planning with relationship teams and coordinate multi-product engagement.

**Physical bullion solutions:**
Originate and execute outright sales and purchases of allocated or unallocated gold and silver, minted and investment products, consignment, deferred-payment structures, import/export flows, custody and vault-related solutions, subject to approved product and risk frameworks.

**Hedging and investment solutions:**
Advise clients on precious metals price-risk management and investment requirements using approved spot, forward, swap, option and structured solutions. Translate market views into suitable, executable ideas without compromising conduct or suitability standards.

**Financing and balance-sheet solutions:**
Partner with structuring, credit and relationship teams on gold loans, bullion repo, inventory or transit financing, collateralised structures and other approved precious metals financing solutions.

**End-to-end transaction leadership:**
Coordinate pricing, credit, documentation, KYC, sanctions screening, logistics, insurance, settlement, vaulting and post-trade follow-up. Escalate execution risks early and ensure responsibilities are clearly assigned.

**Market intelligence and franchise development:**
Monitor precious metals markets, regional physical premiums, competitor activity, regulation, refining and supply-chain developments. Provide actionable intelligence to clients and management and support new product, corridor and partnership development.

**Governance, risk and controls:**
Operate within approved mandates and policies covering market, credit, legal, operational, conduct, financial-crime and reputational risk. Maintain complete records and ensure transactions meet relevant internal approvals and regulatory requirements.

**Cross-functional collaboration and leadership:**
Work closely with trading, structuring, research, operations, finance, legal, compliance, credit and coverage teams. Share product knowledge, support joint client meetings, coach junior team members and strengthen a collaborative sales culture.

Achieve financial targets

Originate profitable client flows, manage the opportunity pipeline and deliver an appropriate mix of recurring and strategic transactions.

Expand client franchise

Build account plans, conduct regular senior client engagement and create cross-sell opportunities with coverage teams.

Deliver execution excellence

Lead transactions from idea through settlement, align internal stakeholders and resolve issues promptly.

Build strategic capability

Identify market gaps, support product development and establish scalable routes to market across priority jurisdictions.

Maintain strong controls

Ensure suitability, approvals, documentation, KYC, sanctions, credit and operational controls are completed before execution.

Strengthening team and connectivity

Share market and product expertise, support junior colleagues and improve coordination across sales, trading and support functions.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, business, engineering or a related discipline.
* Postgraduate qualifications are advantageous.
* CFA, FRM or relevant treasury/commodities qualifications.

**Experiences**

Minimum 10 years of relevant banking, precious metals experience, including a strong record in client-facing sales and revenue generation. Experience with physical bullion and/or precious metals derivatives is required.

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Strong knowledge of gold and silver markets, physical supply chains, spot/forward/swap pricing, hedging, financing and settlement conventions.
* Understanding of vaulting, logistics, custody and refining ecosystems is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated ability to originate opportunities, build senior relationships, negotiate commercial terms, manage a pipeline and convert complex requirements into executable solutions.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Client centricity and trusted-adviser mindset
* Commercial judgement and revenue orientation
* Precious metals market expertise
* Strategic thinking and market development
* Negotiation and influencing
* Execution discipline and attention to detail
* Risk awareness, integrity and control ownership
* Collaboration, leadership and talent development

We’re one of the region’s most recognizable brands. We’re banking innovation leaders. We’re growing across both the UAE and our global offices. We offer a huge range of professional development opportunities to accelerate your career. It also goes without saying that we provide extremely competitive rewards, benefits and perks too, like our flexible work policy so you can work from home whenever it suits.

**Job Description**
Make your mark by leading a major modernization that replaces legacy reconciliations capabilities with a new, resilient platform at scale
  
  
As a Director of Software Engineering at JPMorgan Chase, within the Commercial and Investment Bank, at reconciliations platform you are accountable for the target-state architecture and delivery outcomes of a new reconciliations stack replacing multiple legacy capabilities. You define reference architectures, approved patterns, and measurable non-functional targets, and you drive consistent implementation across multiple engineering teams. You lead modernization execution from parallel run through cutover and decommission, with strong operational discipline in a controls-heavy domain. You set expectations for production readiness, performance engineering, and auditability to sustain reliability at extreme scale.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Owns the target-state platform architecture and ensure consistent implementation through reference architectures, approved patterns, and reusable “golden path” guidance.
* Defines measurable non-functional requirements and targets (for example throughput, latency, recovery objectives, correctness guarantees, and cost boundaries) and drive adoption across teams.
* Decides and documents key engineering trade-offs (for example consistency versus latency, streaming versus batch, storage layout, replay strategy, partitioning and compaction approach, and disaster recovery posture) for governance and reuse.
* Leads delivery outcomes across multiple workstreams, including real-time processing, batch processing, workflow and state, controls and reporting, and migration tooling.
* Drives execution discipline through dependency management, milestone planning, risk reduction, capacity planning, and escalation of cross-organization blockers.
* Owns the modernization and migration strategy, including parallel run, parity validation, acceptance criteria, phased cutovers, rollback plans, and legacy decommission sequencing.
* Establishes production readiness standards across the software delivery lifecycle, including testing strategy, continuous integration and delivery expectations, observability, incident management, and change governance aligned to a controls-heavy environment.
* Leads performance and cost engineering for Java services and large-scale data pipelines, ensuring capacity planning and optimization are proactive and measurable.
* Ensures auditability and explainability through reproducible outputs, lineage expectations, immutable retention strategy, and controlled reprocessing approaches.
* Coaches senior engineers and technical leads through design reviews, code review standards, post-incident learning, and stakeholder-facing architecture communication.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**

* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 10+ years applied experience. In addition, 5+ years of experience leading technologists to manage, anticipate and solve complex technical items within your domain of expertise
* 8+ years of technical leadership experience owning system design and delivery for complex platforms.
* Demonstrated accountability for production outcomes (reliability, incident management, and operational discipline) for large-scale distributed systems.
* Strong Amazon Web Services production experience, including Elastic MapReduce, Lambda, Elastic Container Service, and DynamoDB.
* Proven expertise designing distributed systems with idempotency, ordering, retries, consistency controls, and replay or reprocessing strategies.
* Experience delivering large-scale data processing solutions using lakehouse patterns and table formats.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**

* Hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg at scale (partitioning strategy, compaction, schema evolution, and maintenance automation).
* Advanced Apache Spark tuning experience at very large scale (skew, shuffle optimization, partition sizing, and cost-performance trade-offs).
* Experience building reconciliations or matching engines within financial services.
* Experience leading large migration programs that replace legacy platforms with parallel run and controlled cutover.

The Executive Director - Managed Services Transition Principal is a senior individual contributor accountable for defining, shaping and assuring the most complex and strategically significant Finance Managed Services transitions across Finance Managed Services. The role operates as EY’s authoritative transition specialist on major pursuits and mobilizations, providing independent judgement, deep subject-matter expertise and executive-level client counsel from RFP strategy through stable operations.
  
  
The role does not rely on formal line-management authority. Its Executive Director scope is created through enterprise-wide influence, ownership of high-value and high-risk transition outcomes, direct engagement with C-suite and Partner stakeholders, and stewardship of EY transition methods, intellectual property and digitally enabled practices. The incumbent personally intervenes at critical points, resolves ambiguity across commercial, operational, technology and people dimensions, and sets the standard for transition quality across portfolios and geographies.
  
  
**Role Scope and Impact**

* Ensure transition designs protect financial control, statutory and regulatory obligations, close and reporting timetables, cash flow, working capital and business continuity.
* Provide transition leadership for the largest, most complex and highest-risk Finance Managed Services opportunities, including deals with multi-tower, multi-country, regulated, carve-out, transformation or accelerated-mobilization characteristics.

+ Develop compelling transition strategies for complex RFPs, sole-source opportunities and strategic renewals, integrating finance organization, process, policy, controls, data, technology, service management, tax, treasury and commercial considerations.
+ Lead the transition narrative in client orals and executive workshops, using evidence-based storytelling to demonstrate value, manage concerns and establish confidence in EY’s ability to mobilize safely.

+ Challenge deal assumptions and contractual commitments where transition risk, dependency, cost or timing is not adequately understood.

* Transition solution design & execution assurance

+ Assure the design and operation of financial controls, segregation of duties, data reconciliation, opening balances, knowledge transfer, service acceptance and retained-organisation readiness.
+ Architect end-to-end transition approaches for highly interdependent finance process towers, retained organisations, delivery locations and geographies, defining critical paths, entry and exit criteria, governance, control points, dependencies and operational acceptance requirements.
+ Provide independent assurance across mobilization, identifying systemic risks early and directing corrective action through accountable delivery owners without assuming permanent line-management responsibility.

+ Confirm that transitions achieve safe landing into steady-state operations, with clear ownership, measurable readiness and no unmanaged residual risk.

+ Provide expert coaching and technical direction to deal and transition practitioners through communities of practice, design reviews and targeted interventions, without direct supervisory accountability.
+ Build external market credibility through client forums, thought leadership, alliance activity and selected industry engagement.

+ Evaluate complex commercial and delivery trade-offs, including speed versus control, standardization versus client specificity, investment versus risk, and short-term mobilization needs versus long-term service sustainability.

Required Experience

**- Experience leading large treasury, finance, or operations programs across multiple stakeholders.**

**- Strong understanding of payments, settlements, bank connectivity, controls, reporting, treasury workflows, and operational risk.**

**- Experience with requirements gathering, process design, testing, implementation, and change management.**

**Must-Have Technical / Tools Criteria**

- Strong proficiency building dashboards, operational KPI views, variance analysis, issue trackers, reconciliations, and executive reporting materials.

**- Ability to define dashboard requirements, data models, business rules, workflow metrics, and reporting packs that support treasury oversight and exception-based processing.**

- Experience working with large data sets, control evidence, exception reports, process flows, testing evidence, and controls documentation.

**- Must have experience supporting or driving automation for SWIFT payment format testing, including payment message validation, formatting rule checks, bank-specific requirements, and regression testing across bank connectivity and treasury payment workflows.**

- Must have experience coordinating or executing automated testing across the treasury ecosystem, including payments, settlements, reporting, controls, interfaces, and related system integrations.

- Strong familiarity with SIT, UAT, regression testing, parallel runs, defect triage, test evidence management, and implementation readiness.

**- Ability to partner effectively with Technology teams, data teams, and operations stakeholders without being a pure technology role.**

**Preferred Qualifications**

**- Experience in asset management, private equity, banking, capital markets, fintech, treasury operations, or global capability centers.**

**- Exposure to Treasury Management Systems, payment platforms, banking portals, ERP tools, reporting platforms, or workflow tools.**

**- Familiarity with SWIFT messaging, ISO 20022, bank connectivity, settlement processes, and treasury controls.**

**- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.**

**- CTP, PMP, CPA, CFA, or process improvement certification preferred.**

jobs.title: Director, Payment Acceptance
jobs.description:
**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
  
  
**Job Title**
Director, Payment Acceptance
  
  
**Job Location: Pune**
**5 Days Work from Office**
**Shift Timing : 6:30PM to 3:30AM**
**What does a great Director of Business Analysis I do?**
The
**Director, Payment Acceptance**
provides strategic and operational leadership for Payment Acceptance operations functions within Merchant Solutions. This leader is accountable for delivering consistent, controlled, and efficient operations across least cost routing, interchange reconciliation, network reporting and fee oversight, merchant data integrity and PCI compliance support, and Payment Acceptance inquiries while ensuring the organization meets client commitments, network requirements, financial controls, service levels, quality standards, and productivity expectations.
  
  
The Director leads through other leaders and is responsible for translating business strategy into operational execution across a complex Payment Acceptance environment. The role provides oversight across credit deibt and dispute operation routing and configuration, interchange and settlement reconciliation, network fees and reporting, merchant compliance requirements, inquiry management and escalation, production workflow, reporting and analytics, and continuous improvement.
  
  
This leader is expected to think beyond daily operations. They anticipate operational, financial, network, and compliance risk; identify opportunities to simplify and modernize processes; develop scalable operating models; and establish the controls, metrics, talent, and governance necessary to support Payment Acceptance.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Provide strategic leadership for Payment Acceptance operations, establishing priorities, operating standards, performance expectations, and long-term direction across supported functions.
* Lead through managers, supervisors, and professional staff, creating clear accountability for operational execution, service delivery, quality, productivity, associate development, and results.
* Oversee Least Cost Routing support, ensuring debit network routing requirements, eligibility indicators, configuration values, and related data are accurate and support appropriate transaction routing.
* Provide leadership for interchange reconciliation activities across payment, interchange, settlement, and billing processes, ensuring variances, exceptions, and out-of-balance conditions are identified and resolved in a timely manner.
* Oversee network reporting and fee governance activities, ensuring reporting accuracy, data integrity, merchant compliance support, fee validation, and timely resolution of discrepancies.
* Provide leadership for Payment Acceptance inquiry support, ensuring Account Management and lines of business receive timely research, clear answers, appropriate issue tracking, and escalation to Technology when technical investigation or system changes are required.
* Provide oversight of payment and debit network requirements that affect routing, interchange, reporting, fees, merchant compliance, and Payment Acceptance operations.
* Lead production workflow and capacity management, ensuring inventory, staffing, skills, and resources are aligned to volumes, service-level requirements, and business priorities.
* Maintain strong financial and operational controls across interchange reconciliation, network fees, routing, reporting, exceptions, adjustments, and other activities affecting merchant or corporate financial positions.
* Establish and monitor performance metrics across productivity, quality, SLA attainment, inventory, aging, financial accuracy, data quality, operational risk, and client experience. Use data to identify trends, root causes, and opportunities requiring leadership intervention.
* Establish consistent processes for issue intake, research, ownership, escalation, aging, resolution, and communication across Payment Acceptance support functions.
* Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement by simplifying processes, eliminating manual activity, improving controls, expanding automation, and partnering with Technology on system and reporting enhancements.
* Lead Payment Acceptance technology and modernization initiatives, representing Operations in the design and enhancement of routing, reconciliation, inquiry, reporting, workflow, automation, and control capabilities.
* Drive a scalable operating model that provides resiliency, knowledge transfer, cross-training, and appropriate site redundancy while maintaining consistent operational standards across locations.
* Manage operational risk by proactively identifying process breaks, control gaps, financial exposure, network or compliance concerns, data-quality issues, and emerging trends and ensuring appropriate remediation and escalation.
* Support audit and control activities, maintaining strong documentation, process adherence, evidence management, and sustainable controls.
* Partner across the organization with Product, Technology, Finance, Risk, Compliance, Network Relations, Account Management, and other business partners to resolve complex issues and deliver strategic objectives.
* Provide leadership for client, merchant, and business escalations, ensuring complex Payment Acceptance issues are researched thoroughly, root causes are understood, and sustainable corrective actions are implemented.
* Develop organizational talent and succession, strengthening leadership capability and Payment Acceptance subject-matter expertise while building clear development paths for associates, analysts, supervisors, and managers.
* Create an accountability-driven culture where leaders and associates demonstrate ownership, sound judgment, follow-through, continuous learning, and commitment to client and business outcomes.
* Communicate operational performance and risk to senior leadership, translating complex operational data and issues into clear business impacts, recommendations, decisions, and action plans.

**What You Need To Have**

* Demonstrated experience in business analysis, Payment Acceptance, payment operations, network reporting, fee oversight, merchant compliance, or a related field, ideally within financial services.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret large data sets, identify trends, validate data integrity, and resolve discrepancies.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex network requirements into clear business requirements and operational direction.
* Proven ability to lead multiple projects and priorities simultaneously with strong organization, accountability, and attention to detail.
* Strong knowledge of payment networks, merchant compliance requirements, network fees, reporting processes, and industry regulations.
* Proficiency with CRM systems, reporting tools, and Microsoft Office applications.
* Experience working with reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI, and Excel macros.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate complex issues, assess business impact and risk, and coordinate solutions with payment networks and internal teams.
* Ability to work effectively across payment networks, lines of business, and cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
* High attention to detail, adaptability, and commitment to data quality, compliance, accuracy, and strong operational controls.

**What Would Be Great To Have**

* Experience leading Paymen

* Lead the Technology Internal Control Testing Programme, including methodology, planning, scope, approval, execution, quality assurance and reporting.
* Develop a risk-based testing plan using RCSA results, process mapping, risk appetite measures, incidents, control failures, audit findings, regulatory priorities and material technology changes.
* Prioritize controls associated with Critical and High inherent risks, while including Moderate-rated controls where justified by risk concentration, limited assurance coverage, control failures or emerging risk.
* Maintain a technology testing inventory covering control ownership, risk linkage, testing frequency, previous results, existing assurance coverage and open issues.
* Lead control walkthroughs and assessments of control design and operating effectiveness.
* Define testing methods, evidence requirements, sampling approaches and quality standards.
* Ensure conclusions are supported by complete, reliable and traceable evidence.
* Coordinate with IT Risk Assurance lead on SOX, Compliance, Head Office and other assurance programmes to minimize unnecessary duplication.
* Continuously improve testing methodology, guidance, templates and supporting tools.

**Issues and Remediation:**

* Ensure control deficiencies, self-identified issues, risk acceptances and treatment plans are consistently identified, recorded and escalated.
* Challenge control ownership, testing conclusions, remediation plans and proposed issue closure.
* Ensure remediation actions have clear owners and target dates.
* Monitor remediation through to closure and arrange validation or retesting where required.
* Identify recurring or systemic control weaknesses requiring coordinated remediation.
* Escalate material control failures, overdue actions and risk appetite breaches through the appropriate governance channels.

**Audit and Regulatory Readiness:**

* Coordinate Technology responses to internal audit, external audit, SOX and regulatory assurance activity.
* Maintain a coordinated view of assurance activity, findings, evidence requests, management responses and remediation commitments.
* Improve the quality and timeliness of evidence, walkthroughs and management responses.
* Maintain a reusable regional evidence base to support assurance activity.
* Ensure recurring audit and regulatory themes inform the control framework, testing plan and remediation priorities.
* Support senior-management and regulatory briefings on material technology control matters.

**Reporting and Governance:**

* Own management information covering technology control testing delivery, control effectiveness, issues, remediation, risk acceptances and recurring themes.
* Provide concise, accurate and decision-oriented reporting to Technology leadership and relevant governance forums.
* Act as the central escalation and prioritisation point for Technology control-testing matters.
* Represent the Chief Technology Controls Team at relevant committees and working groups.
* Ensure material control weaknesses and risks are escalated promptly and transparently.

**Data, Tools and Continuous Assurance:**

* Own the Technology Controls testing toolset, workflows, dashboards and analytics capability.
* Ensure testing plans, evidence, samples, conclusions, issues and remediation records are accurately maintained in approved repositories.
* Establish standards for evidence quality, naming, ownership, version control, retention, permissions and audit traceability.
* Lead evidence coordination and quality review with process and control owners.
* Develop automated monitoring and continuous control-testing capabilities where supported by reliable data and repeatable testing logic.
* Define appropriate governance for automated testing, including data quality, access, change control, exception handling and periodic validation.
* Explore the responsible use of AI to support evidence review, control mapping, testing preparation, exception identification, thematic analysis and reporting.
* Ensure that automation and AI retain appropriate governance, validation and human oversight.

**Leadership and People Management:**

The role leads a team of high-performing individuals, sets quality thresholds and tolerances, owns the risk-based QA/QC methodology and drives AI-led transformation of how quality is measured and assured. The successful candidate will be a trusted partner to Operations, Risk, Compliance, Technology and Audit leadership, able to influence without direct authority and to make strong, commercially aware decisions in a highly regulated environment.

**Primary Responsibilities**

jobs.title: Sr Director, Finance
jobs.description:
**About Data Axle**

Data Axle Inc. has been an industry leader in data, marketing solutions, sales, and research for over 50 years in the USA. Data Axle now has an established strategic global centre of excellence in Pune. This centre delivers mission-critical data services to its global customers, powered by its proprietary cloud-based technology platform and by leveraging proprietary business and consumer databases.  
  
**Role Summary:**

We are looking for an experienced and strategic Senior Director - Finance to lead the finance function, oversee financial operations, and drive financial governance across the organization.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in managing financial reporting, accounting, controllership, taxation, audit, and regulatory compliance, with strong expertise in both Indian Accounting Standards (IGAAP / Ind AS) and US Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (US GAAP).

This role will serve as a strategic finance partner to senior leadership and global stakeholders, ensuring financial accuracy, operational efficiency, compliance, and alignment with global finance policies and business objectives.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Financial Reporting & Controllership**

* Lead end-to-end financial reporting, accounting, and controllership functions.
* Ensure accurate and timely preparation of financial statements under both IGAAP / Ind AS and US GAAP.
* Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing processes.
* Manage financial consolidation, reconciliations, intercompany accounting, and reporting.
* Ensure consistency between local statutory reporting and US GAAP reporting requirements.
* Establish robust internal financial controls, accounting policies, and governance frameworks.

* **US GAAP & IGAAP Compliance**

* Provide technical accounting guidance on complex accounting matters under US GAAP and IGAAP / Ind AS.
* Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, statutory requirements, and regulatory guidelines.
* Manage accounting differences between Indian and US reporting frameworks, including revenue recognition, leases, fixed assets, provisions, and foreign currency transactions.
* Coordinate with global finance teams to ensure alignment of accounting practices and reporting standards.
* Drive implementation of changes in accounting standards and assess their business impact.

* **Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)**

* Lead budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, and performance management.
* Provide financial insights and recommendations to support strategic business decisions.
* Monitor revenue, operating expenses, profitability, cash flow, and financial performance.
* Develop financial models, business forecasts, and scenario analyses.
* Partner with business leaders to identify cost optimization and profitability improvement opportunities.

* **Audit, Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Lead statutory, internal, and external audit processes.
* Manage coordination with external auditors, tax consultants, and regulatory authorities.
* Oversee direct and indirect taxation, including corporate tax, GST, transfer pricing, and other applicable compliance requirements.
* Ensure adherence to Indian statutory and regulatory requirements.
* Support US audit and tax reporting requirements in coordination with global finance teams.

* **Treasury & Cash Flow Management**

* Oversee treasury operations, working capital, liquidity, and cash flow management.
* Develop strategies for efficient cash utilization and financial risk management.
* Monitor foreign exchange exposure and implement appropriate risk mitigation measures.
* Manage banking relationships and financing arrangements.

* **Global Finance Stakeholder Management**

* Act as a key finance business partner to US-based leadership and global finance teams.
* Drive standardization of financial processes, reporting frameworks, and controls across geographies.
* Present financial performance, risks, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership.
* Ensure effective coordination between India finance operations and US corporate finance.

* **Leadership & Team Management**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing finance and accounting team.
* Build a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
* Drive automation, process optimization, and digital transformation across finance operations.
* Establish KPIs and performance metrics for the finance function.

Requirements:

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) with 15+ years of post-qualification experience (PQE) in Finance and Accounting, including significant experience in senior finance leadership roles.
* Strong hands-on expertise in both **IGAAP / Ind AS and US GAAP**.
* Proven experience managing financial reporting and controllership for multinational organizations or US-headquartered companies.
* Strong understanding of US GAAP technical accounting, financial consolidation, and statutory reporting.
* Experience managing global finance stakeholders and cross-border financial operations.
* Strong exposure to financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, taxation, treasury, and audit management.
* Experience leading large finance teams and managing complex financial operations.

jobs.description:
**Description**
===============

  

**Trintec** h is an award-winning AI-driven Fintech SaaS organisation transforming the way finance teams operate.

  

We are looking to hire a **Director of Software Engineering** for our growing operation in Bangalore.

  

This is a fantastic opportunity to build and scale a team of stellar engineers. The leader we are looking for will have natural confidence and charisma, a strong ability to influence up to executive level, with a true passion and curiosity for building next gen tech.

  

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

  

Essential functions include, but are not limited to the following:

  

* ***Strategic and Product Engineering Leadership***
  + Translate product portfolio priorities and business objectives into clear engineering goals, investment themes, capacity plans, and measurable outcomes.
  + Partner with Product Management and Architecture to shape executable roadmaps that balance customer value, platform modernization, quality, security, and maintainability.
  + Anticipate future product, scale, compliance, and operational needs, and influence engineering plans accordingly.
  Drive cross-functional alignment for major product portfolio initiatives, dependencies, risks, and delivery trade-offs.

  

* ***Portfolio Delivery and Governance***
  + Provide portfolio-level oversight across engineering teams supporting the product portfolio to ensure commitments are realistic, risks are visible, and delivery outcomes are predictable.
  + Establish governance mechanisms for planning, execution reviews, release readiness, quality health, dependency management, and stakeholder communication.
  + Use engineering and product metrics to improve delivery predictability, quality, productivity, and operational performance.
  Support budget planning, capacity forecasting, hiring prioritization, and investment trade-off decisions across the product portfolio.

  

* ***Engineering Excellence and Operational Maturity***

  + Promote consistent engineering standards across teams while enabling Engineering Managers and technical leads to own team-level execution.
  Champion the responsible adoption of automation and AI-assisted engineering practices that improve productivity, quality, and customer value.

  

* ***Product Portfolio Modernization and Technical Direction***
  + Partner with Architecture and senior engineers to evolve the product portfolio's technical roadmap, reduce technical debt, and improve long-term maintainability.

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline; master’s degree preferred.

* Strong understanding of enterprise SaaS engineering, including scalability, performance, security, reliability, CI/CD, observability, and production operations.
* Experience partnering with Product, Architecture, Cloud Operations, Security, Support, and Customer Success teams in a global product organization.

* Experience in financial close, reconciliation, accounting software, banking, payments, ERP integrations, or finance transformation is preferred.
Experience working with distributed engineering teams and offshore/global delivery models is preferred.  

  
  
  
  
  

*At our core, Trintechers stand committed to fostering a culture rooted in our core values – Humble, Empowered, Reliable, and Open. Together, these values guide our actions, define our identity, and inspire us to continuously strive for excellence in everything we do.*

*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or disability.*
