**In this role, you will:**

* This role supports Securities Services (SSv) in executing consistent, high-quality Non-Financial Risk (NFR) governance and client risk capability, with specific emphasis on post-sales servicing risks across the client lifecycle. The Associate Director will help manage inbound and outbound client risks, produce senior-ready MI and insights, and support the ISAE reporting programme (e.g., ISAE 3402 / relevant assurance reporting).

**Description**

At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd  
  
Treasury is the Vice Presidency, reporting to the Managing Director and World Bank Group Chief Financial Officer, performing treasury functions for the IBRD and IDA and, to varying degrees, for other members of the World Bank Group and other public sector investors. Its activities are organized and grouped into the following departments: Capital Markets & Investment Management, Client Asset Management and Advisory, and Treasury Operations.  
  
Treasury (TRE) has been a large and significant player in the international financial markets for over seventy years and has achieved a global reputation as a prudent and innovative borrower, investor and risk manager. Treasury is responsible for: (i) managing approximately $195 billion in assets for the World Bank and other official sector investors; (ii) leading IBRD’s and IDA’s triple-A rated financing programs in international and domestic bond and derivative markets; (iii) conducting asset and liability management for IBRD’s and IDA’s balance sheets; (iv) overseeing the development and outreach related to the financing and hedging products the Bank provides for its developing-country clients; and (v) collaborating with the World Bank member countries to help build their capacity. Staff in Treasury regularly interact and collaborate with other departments across the Bank and Finance Partners’ teams.  
  
The Treasury Operations Department (TREOP) provides a full range of operational support for Treasury’s asset management, capital markets and banking businesses. The Department is presently organized in 7 operational units: Asset and Liability Operations (TREAL), Quantitative Solutions and Analytics (TREQA), and Cash and Banking Operations (TREBK), Treasury Quantitative Modelling (TREQM), Treasury ALM & Collateral (TREAC), Treasury Market Data and Valuation (TREMV) and a Financial Technology coordination unit (TREFT).  
  
Treasury Asset and Liability Operations (TREAL) is the unit responsible for delivering on a range of operations functions supporting the funding, investment, and asset and liability management portfolios for internal World Bank Group (IBRD, IDA, MIGA, and Trust Funds) entities. In addition, the team supports investment portfolios for a growing roster of more than 60 client entities in domestic and international markets. The team provides integrated and end-to-end support for all trade execution and portfolio servicing activities including trade review, settlement and documentation, options monitoring, debt service and cash and collateral management across the full range of products including bonds, swaps, repos, deposits, and exchange-traded derivatives.  
  
In performing these functions, the team works closely with internal partners and market counterparts as well as external service providers such as technology vendors, custodians, and paying agents. In addition to managing the day-to-day operations, TREAL staff lead the research, coordination, and implementation of new products and markets across Treasury. The team has a heavy focus on, and takes a leadership role in, evaluating and deploying the latest products and technologies (core trading platforms and new initiatives and technologies like CBDC, blockchain, AI, robotics, etc.) to create efficiencies, reduce risk, and advance thought leadership amongst WB’s peers and clients. TREAL staff participate in capacity-building programs for clients in these areas of expertise. TREAL staff recently co-led projects where the World Bank issued innovative digital bonds using blockchain technology and CBDC. In recognition of their efforts to advance capital markets and asset management, the TREAL team received several industry awards including for “Innovation in Reserves Management” (2021) and “Asset Servicing Initiative of the year” (2023). The team has twice been shortlisted for “Operations Team of the Year” award (2023 and 2024).  
  
Treasury ALM & Collateral Operations (TREAC) delivers operations support for asset and liability management, client risk management and collateral activities across IBRD, IDA and IFC. It is the operational engine of Treasury Client Solutions (TCS) and the central collateral management provider for WBG entities and RAMP clients. Team covers the full transaction lifecycle for funding and client hedging transactions, from trade setup and confirmation through settlement, rate fixings, payment events, exception handling, reconciliations and reporting. On the collateral side, it manages margining for OTC derivatives, MBS and futures, including daily margin calls, dispute resolution, CSA agreement administration, and monitoring of valuation.  
  
The team also supports long-term local currency investment transactions through IFC in countries where market solutions are not sufficiently available under the IDA–IFC Private Sector Window. The team works closely with front office, risk, finance, legal and technology teams, and with external counterparties, custodians, brokers and clearing organizations. Operating from Washington, D.C., Chennai and Sofia give the unit time-zone coverage and continuity. Beyond daily operations, TREAC leads systems implementation, convergence and digital transformation, with a strong focus on operational risk, controls and governance. The team operates on a common WBG operating model that aligns with IBRD, IDA and IFC practices, reduces duplication and manual handoffs, and delivers scalable, traceable, automation-ready processes.  
  
**Duties and Accountabilities:**  
The TRE Operations Chennai (TRECH) is an integral part of TREOP and is responsible for a variety of duties providing vital support across its operational divisions. It works closely with the Headquarters in Washington D.C and another shared services center in Sofia, Bulgaria. Under the guidance and supervision of a Team Lead and/or Functional Lead, the incumbent will have responsibilities for specific individual tasks/projects as well as for working as an integral part of the team in executing the Treasury Operation’s work program, while maintaining close relationships with the other Treasury departments.  
  
The incumbent’s primary responsibilities will include, but are not limited to, some combination of the following activities:  
  

* Work closely with the team to understand various facets of post-execution activities for fixed income, derivatives, and cash products to identify, analyze and prioritize process reengineering, automation and streamlining opportunities focusing on enhancing efficiency and accuracy.
* Support data collection, analysis, visualization, and report writing, including by innovatively using data, stories, and analytics to build powerful narratives.
* Support automation initiatives and projects relating to various sub-operational areas including maintenance of databases, dashboards, and reports using

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Technology Build & Operations
jobs.description:
Portage Point is a Chicago-headquartered advisory, interim management and investment banking firm focused on serving the middle-market. Backed by New Mountain Capital, the firm has grown at over 30% annually since its founding in 2016 and today operates from ten offices across the United States and an office in Gurugram.

The firm delivers integrated financial and operational solutions across Transaction Advisory Services, Transaction Execution Services, Office of the CFO, Valuations, Performance Improvement, Turnaround & Restructuring and Investment Banking. Engagement teams are lean and execution-oriented, working directly with senior stakeholders to navigate complex transaction, transitions and transformations.

Triple P India (TPI) is a strategic extension of the firm's platform, established to build a high-quality team that operates as an integrated part of U.S.-based teams. Professionals in TPI are involved in live engagements from the outset, contributing to analysis, execution and client deliverables in coordination with colleagues across the firm. The platform is designed to provide meaningful responsibility, direct exposure to senior leadership and long-term growth in a high-performance environment.

The Technology function serves as the strategic and operational core of the firm's AI platform – building the enterprise-grade infrastructure, AI product platform and data foundation that power Portage Point's AI-enabled advisory model. The team architects and operates the multi-tenant Portage Point Platform, the Enterprise Data Vault and a portfolio of 15 AI products spanning all practice lines. Working directly with US leadership and practice line leaders, the team translates the firm's ambition – a digital AI version of every advisory capability – into a governed, scalable and commercially deployable technology platform.

The Director, Enterprise Technology Build & Operations will report directly into the CTO, and holds unified accountability for Portage Point corporate technology environment and security posture. As firm scales, there is a need for robust IT operations, security and infrastructure planning and management. This Director ensures the firm's IT foundation is reliable, secure and audit-ready, integrating network and endpoint operations, Microsoft 365 governance, ITSM delivery, Zero Trust security architecture, SOC 2 Type II compliance and AI-specific security controls under a single point of ownership. The role approves IT operations and service management designs, security architecture decisions, vendor engagements and infrastructure implementation decisions within CTO-approved standards.

### **Responsibilities**

* Design and operate enterprise network infrastructure (for e.g. Cisco Meraki, SD-WAN, dual-ISP failover, next-gen firewall) and Microsoft 365 environment (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, Microsoft Purview) — covering tenant governance, licensing optimisation, DLP, retention and compliance features; manage the endpoint platform (Intune / Autopilot) including device enrolment, configuration, patch management and Conditional Access compliance enforcement
* Partner with the Head of Innovation and Product Manager on the platform roadmap, product intake from practice lines and release readiness
* Own the ITSM framework (ServiceNow or Jira Service Management) across incident, change, problem, service request and asset management; operate the IT service desk with P1–P4 SLA tiers, CSAT measurement and self-service knowledge base; personally own IT onboarding (Day 1 device, accounts and access) and offboarding (account revocation and access audit) within defined SLAs
* Design and enforce end-to-end security architecture with Zero Trust Network Access, micro-segmentation, Azure AD / Entra ID PIM, Conditional Access, application-layer security (OWASP Top 10 controls for all AI products), encryption, key management (Azure Key Vault) and AI-specific controls covering prompt injection defenses, model access controls and audit trails for all LLM interactions
* Own the SOC 2 Type II program – map platform and corporate IT controls to AICPA Trust Services Criteria, manage gap remediation, coordinate the external audit and produce the SOC 2 report for client and PE sponsor review; maintain TPI's information security policy suite; ensure compliance (personal data mapping, legal basis documentation, breach notification); manage the third-party and vendor risk assessment program
* Design and operate the vulnerability management program (Tenable.io or Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management) with automated scanning and enforced remediation SLAs; deploy and operate SIEM (Microsoft Sentinel) for identity, data exfiltration and AI-specific threat detection; own the Incident Response Plan and personally lead all P1 and P2 security incidents
* Lead and develop the combined IT and security team of engineers and analysts; own IT procurement (TCO analysis, with CTO) and the full vendor portfolio; design and test IT BCP and DR procedures; produce monthly ITSM performance review and quarterly security dashboard for the CTO and COO
* Support talent acquisition and firm development efforts
* Lead technical trainings on architecture, data engineering and AI infrastructure
* Contribute to a high-performing and inclusive engineering culture

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree from a top undergraduate program required
* 11 plus years in IT leadership with demonstrated ownership of both corporate IT operations (infrastructure, service management) and cybersecurity (architecture, compliance)
* Experience as the senior IT and security lead in a professional services, advisory or GCC environment; Big Four or comparable advisory GCC experience a strong differentiator
* Located in or willing to relocate to Gurugram, India
* ITIL 4 Managing Professional (or above) and CISSP, CISM or equivalent cybersecurity certification required; must have designed and operated a live ITSM framework and personally owned a SOC 2 Type II program
* Production experience with the Microsoft security stack at scale (500+ users): Entra ID, Conditional Access, PIM, Intune, Microsoft Sentinel, Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft Purview; enterprise network infrastructure (Cisco Meraki, SD-WAN, NGFW); ZTNA implementation experiences a differentiator
* ServiceNow or Jira Service Management administration — must have built incident, change and asset management workflows from scratch; hands-on PAM (HashiCorp Vault or CyberArk) and secrets management program ownership; vulnerability scanning and CI / CD security integration (SAST / DAST) experience
* Prior exposure to private equity, M&A, or restructuring transaction environments preferred; ability to collaborate across US and India time zones and willingness to flex working hours for cross-border stakeholder engagement
* Superior written and verbal communication skills, including executive-ready presentation and reporting skills
* Proven ability to thrive in lean, fast-moving teams
* High attention to detail, responsiveness and ownership mindset
* Track record of success in high-pressure, client-facing environments

The AI & Technology function serves as the strategic and operational core of the firm AI platform, building the enterprise-grade infrastructure, AI product platform and data foundation that power Portage Point's AI-enabled service delivery model. The Head of Platform role is the technical backbone of this function, directly owning the design, build and operation of the multi-tenant Portage Point Platform and the Enterprise Data Vault that underpins all AI products. The platform hosts a growing portfolio of AI solutions across practice lines and is architected from day one to support future client access optionality as the firm's AI offering matures.

The Head of Platform reports to the CTO and is the principal hands-on solution architect of the AI Platform. The Head of Platform designs the platform architecture, produces Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and provides the technical depth that enables the firm's AI-enabled service model. The role builds and operates a multi-tenant, cloud-native platform that hosts, scales and governs firm's AI product portfolio and simultaneously architects the Enterprise Data Vault, the firm's proprietary data moat built from anonymized, indexed engagement data across mandates. Build and operationalise the platform and data vault as per roadmap timelines.

The Head of Platform operates within architectural guardrails set by the CTO, with autonomy over reversible engineering decisions and a defined escalation path for irreversible architectural choices. * Work with Head of IT / Infra / Security to embed security-by-design and jointly own SOC 2 Type II technical controls at the application and data layer

* Contribute to a high-performing and inclusive engineering culture

**Job Summary**
---------------

Treasury works closely with senior management, the businesses, Country CEOs / CFOs, and Finance to manage and promote the bank’s liquidity, capital, and balance sheet position. Treasury is laser-focussed on its vision to be “Open, progressive and trusted, working commercially with our partners” to create sustainable value by balancing the supply and demand of liquidity and capital.

Within Treasury (which comprises Capital, Liquidity & Markets), the Treasury Liquidity function is responsible for driving the strategic liquidity agenda and Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Booking (‘IRRBB’).

The Associate Director – IRRBB, India hub will support the Head of IRRBB, India Hub in advancing IRRBB Analytics for overseeing and executing comprehensive internal analyses. The role holder will help in migrating and centralising global IRRBB processes from Group and Clusters, performing detailed stress tests and scenario analyses, leveraging IRRBB data to provide insightful risk assessments and mitigation strategies. This position requires a deep understanding of IRRBB, strong analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with senior stakeholders across the organization.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Strategy**  
• Keep up to date with the Group’s business strategy (incl. SC Ventures) and ensure the IRRBB frameworks are aligned to that.
  
• Partner with Global Head of IRRBB in developing and recommending risk mitigation strategies based on the findings from stress tests and scenario analyses. Ensure that these strategies are effectively communicated and implemented across relevant business units.

**Business**  
• Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates, with a focus on the Group’s participation in the Digital Assets and platforms space.
  
• Provide insights on current and forward looking IRRBB exposures, impact assessments on interest income and actions available for balance sheet optimisation.
  
• Lead the engagement with businesses on balance sheet optimisation strategies including but not limited to asset & liability mix to manage IRRBB while optimising returns.

**Processes**  
• **Analytics:** Support the newly developed IRRBB analytics capabilities on a regular basis, including operating the RCO IRRBB calculation engine to run bespoke scenarios and extracting and analysing the results, covering key metric including, but not limited to, Weekly NIIS Flash, Hedging Strategy Assessments, Corporate Plan NII impact simulations and PV01 analysis. This will also involve working with CPM and Finance closely to prepare MI slides for relevant committees like GALCO, ALCO and IRRBB Steering Forums.

* **Strategy:** Support IRRBB strategy by engaging Treasury Markets on NII sensitivities, hedging performance and P&L forecasting. Support investor relations for quarterly results, including GALCO/ALCO hedging updates, and contribute to annual disclosures through slide preparation, briefing notes, Q&A drafting and investor query responses.

* **Framework & Governance:** Support IRRBB governance through preparation of monthly GALCO/ALCO packs with commentary, review of risk metrics and monitoring of group, solo and local limits. Lead regulatory submissions and challenge returns, oversee MAT and risk appetite reviews, maintain IRRBB policies, support disclosures and audits, escalate emerging topics and drive regulatory engagement and interpretation.

* **Modelling & Methodology** : Apply and maintain IRRBB models per regulatory requirements, including PTR and CASA assumptions. Review and update IRRBB and structural hedging policies, maintain standards, and perform annual forecasts of NII, EBE, and P2A. Conduct policy effectiveness, self-assessment, gap and impact analyses, harmonize models with group, and run simulations and scenario analyses to support regulatory and corporate planning.

* **Structural Hedging:** Support the structural hedging in planning, executing, and monitoring hedges, including P&L sign-off and capacity management. Support group IRBB hedging programs, assess available instruments, forecast and quantify hedge requirements, run analytics and simulations, and provide MI for GALCO discussions to drive informed hedging decisions.

* **Stress Testing:** Support IRRBB stress testing including ICAAP and Pillar 2 assessments, NMD parameter stress, country/cluster ICAP, and reverse stress testing. Conduct basis risk evaluations, Pillar 2 charge reviews, and prepare Pillar 3 disclosures. Support IRBB-related GIA and audit reviews, ensuring all stress testing aligns with ORF requirements and regulatory expectations.

* **IRRBB Technology Journey:** Support delivery of new system rollouts, enhancements and data fixes by providing requirements, validating functionality, and ensuring data accuracy. Collaborate with stakeholders to implement changes efficiently, maintain alignment with IRRBB policy and reporting standards, and drive continuous improvement of systems and processes.

• Collaborate within Treasury and with key partners in Finance, CPM, Technology, and Change in India and the clusters.
  
• Lead by example in reinforcing the appropriate culture and values of the function.
  
• Contribute to ongoing training and development of team members.

**Risk Management**  
• Oversee enterprise-wide interest rate risk in the banking book ensuring alignment with risk appetite and regulatory requirements. Monitor, measure and manage exposures, set limits, and perform scenario analysis and stress testing. Maintain robust frameworks, policies and governance, validate models, provide insights for strategic planning and support senior management, GALCO/ALCO and regulators on risk mitigation, reporting and capital optimisation.

**Governance**

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Visa is transforming the future of banking and payments through Pismo, Visa's cloud-native core banking and issuer processing platform. Built to help financial institutions modernize legacy infrastructure, launch innovative products faster, and scale securely in real time, Pismo is enabling the next generation of digital banking experiences across the globe.

As an Implementation Director, you will lead the successful delivery of some of Visa and Pismo's most strategic client transformation programs. Working with leading banks, fintechs, and financial institutions, you will be responsible for orchestrating large-scale platform implementations that redefine how clients issue cards, process transactions, manage accounts, and deliver modern payment experiences to their customers.

This is a highly visible leadership role that sits at the intersection of technology, payments, and transformation. You will act as the executive sponsor for complex implementation programs, partnering with senior client stakeholders and cross-functional Visa and Pismo teams to drive delivery excellence, mitigate risk, and accelerate value realization.

The successful candidate will combine strategic thinking, executive stakeholder management, and deep program leadership capabilities to guide clients through critical modernization journeys, helping them move from legacy platforms to cloud-native infrastructure that supports future growth and innovation.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

  

* Lead end-to-end implementation and transformation programs for strategic Pismo clients, from contract signature and mobilization through go-live and post-launch stabilization.
* Serve as the primary executive point of contact for client leadership teams, building trusted relationships with C-suite, business, operations, technology, and transformation stakeholders.

* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Client Success, Information Security, Risk, and Commercial teams to ensure successful delivery against client commitments.
* Establish executive steering committees and governance forums, providing clear visibility into program progress, milestones, risks, decisions, and business outcomes.
* Navigate complex organizational environments to align stakeholders, resolve delivery challenges, and maintain momentum across large-scale transformation programs.
* Champion implementation excellence while ensuring clients achieve measurable business outcomes, operational improvements, and accelerated time-to-value.
* Support clients through change management, platform adoption, and operational readiness as they transition onto Pismo's cloud-native infrastructure.
* Capture lessons learned and implementation best practices to continuously strengthen Visa and Pismo's delivery frameworks.

**Qualifications**

**Basic Qualifications:**

* 10 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 8 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters/ MBA/JD/MD) or at least 3 years of work experience with a PhD

  

* Over 15 years of experience in technology-driven financial services, with a strong focus on leading large-scale implementation and transformation projects for global fintech's and banks.
* Detailed technical knowledge of payments ecosystem in GCC countries, more specifically implementation and certification of Jaywan and AEP Switch in UAE
* Technical knowledge of payments and banking platforms operating in the cloud in a microservice architecture, with REST/JSON API’s and data streaming.
* Educational background in solutions architecture and software engineering. Cloud certifications are a plus.
* Having completed a core banking, payments transformation implementation from contract signature to production live.
* Expertise in building and scaling high-performing teams, with a hands-on leadership style that emphasizes mentorship, empowerment, and a culture of accountability.
* Proven ability to deliver complex, multi-market projects on time and within scope, leveraging advanced project management methodologies (Agile, Lean, and hybrid models) and a pragmatic, results-oriented approach.
* Recognized for forging strong, trust-based relationships with C-level executives, clients, and cross-functional partners, ensuring alignment and transparency throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Adept at translating business strategy into actionable plans, optimizing processes, and driving continuous improvement through data-driven decision-making and KPI management.
* Russian speaker is highly desirable

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

**About The Opportunity**

* Fintoo is a SEBI-registered Investment Adviser and fee-based financial planning firm offering holistic financial planning, investment advisory, global investing, and tax advisory services. The company’s philosophy prioritizes planning before execution and places client interests first, combining professional advice with technology to help individuals make informed financial decisions.
* The company is expanding its advisory footprint and seeks a leader to build and scale its Wealth Advisory business in Bengaluru, translating its strong foundation (₹5,000+ Cr Assets Under Tracking, ₹1,000+ Cr Assets Under Advisory, 2,300+ Paid Customers) into a scalable, sustainable, and profitable business.

Role & Responsibilities
  
  

* Own the Bengaluru business plan, revenue targets, growth strategy, and profitability.
* Develop and execute a go-to-market strategy targeting affluent professionals, HNI clients, and other relevant segments through referrals, professional networks, chartered accountants, corporate relationships, and strategic alliances.
* Personally lead key client conversations, business negotiations, and high-value conversions; manage the full customer journey from prospecting to long-term advisory.
* Identify growth opportunities, improve conversion ratios, and strengthen revenue productivity; present forecasts and quarterly plans to senior management.
* Champion a planning-led, fiduciary, and client-first advisory approach; understand clients’ goals, income, liabilities, risk profiles, liquidity needs, and investment horizons to support comprehensive financial planning.
* Ensure recommendations are appropriate to clients’ circumstances, supported by suitable documentation and disclosures; drive holistic financial planning over transactional, product-led selling.
* Lead periodic portfolio reviews, goal tracking, and proactive client engagement in collaboration with research, investment, product, and technology teams.
* Grow AUA sustainably through appropriate client acquisition, retention, and deeper advisory engagement; convert paid financial planning customers into ongoing advisory relationships.
* Improve renewals, referrals, customer lifetime value, and relationship longevity through consistent service and demonstrable advisory value.
* Establish client segmentation, engagement frequency, review, and escalation frameworks; personally manage key relationships and strategic prospects.
* Lead an initial team of six professionals across advisory, relationship management, and business development; set clear KRAs, revenue goals, productivity benchmarks, and accountability mechanisms.
* Recruit, coach, and develop professionals with financial planning capabilities, client orientation, and commercial acumen; build a high-performance culture based on ownership, collaboration, integrity, and continuous learning.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, pipeline reviews, and capability-building initiatives; identify and develop future leaders; scale the team in line with approved budgets and performance.
* Translate annual objectives into actionable quarterly and monthly plans; track revenue, conversion ratios, paid customer acquisition, AUA growth, client retention, and individual productivity.
* Identify performance gaps early and implement corrective actions; balance growth investment, acquisition costs, team capacity, and profitability; build dashboards and repeatable processes for scale.
* Partner with product and technology teams to improve advisory workflows, customer experience, and advisor productivity; use digital tools, analytics, automation, and AI-enabled solutions to make financial advice scalable and accessible.
* Collaborate with marketing on targeted campaigns, financial education, and lead generation; work with operations, finance, and compliance teams for efficient execution and robust governance.
* Share market and customer insights to inform advisory products and business strategy.
* Uphold Fintoo’s fiduciary, fee-based, and client-first advisory philosophy; ensure compliance with SEBI requirements, internal policies, and ethical standards; maintain high standards of client suitability, documentation, disclosures, and transparency.

**Skills & Qualifications**
Must-Have
  
  

* 8–12 years of relevant experience in BFSI / Wealth Management, including at least 4 years in business development and team leadership.
* Proven track record of building a business, acquiring clients, and achieving revenue targets.
* Strong understanding of comprehensive financial planning, investment advisory, asset allocation, and relationship management.
* Experience working with affluent professionals and HNI clients, with the ability to build credibility and long-term relationships.
* Commercial judgment, analytical ability, and ownership of business performance.
* Demonstrated ability to hire, coach, motivate, and scale teams in a growth-oriented environment.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Both NISM Series X-A and Series X-B certifications are mandatory.

**Preferred**

* Experience in building and scaling advisory businesses in competitive markets.
* Deep understanding of digital tools and technology-enabled advisory workflows.
* Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with product, marketing, and operations teams.

Benefits & Culture Highlights
  
  

* Opportunity to build a trusted, high-performing, and profitable advisory business in Bengaluru.
* Focus on establishing a strong local presence, creating a consistent acquisition engine, growing AUA and long-term advisory relationships.
* Culture that values ownership, ethical advice, and measurable outcomes.
* Support to develop a capable team and build operating systems that support the next stage of expansion.

**About the Company**

Qualitia is a world-leading technology product company and a pioneer in scriptless, AI-native test automation. For over 15 years, we have helped some of the world's most demanding organizations ship software faster and with confidence. This includes top global banks, leading insurance companies, and stock exchanges. jobs.description:
**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. **Job Title**

**5 Days Work From Office**

**What does an Inside Sales Representative do?**
The Inside Sales Representative manages sales opportunities from qualification through account activation while delivering an exceptional experience to franchise, enterprise and mid-market merchants. As part of Fiserv's Franchise & Business Development organization, you will act as a trusted advisor to merchants, referral partners and internal stakeholders by connecting client needs with Fiserv payment solutions, Clover point-of-sale technology and value-added services.
  
  
This role combines consultative selling, relationship management, merchant onboarding, account support and cross-functional coordination to drive activation, solution adoption, merchant satisfaction and portfolio growth.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Sales Opportunity Management**

* Manage sales opportunities from qualification through activation.

* Prepare pricing proposals, statement analyses and solution recommendations.
* Promote Fiserv products and value-added services aligned with merchant business needs.

**Merchant Onboarding and Activation**

* Guide merchants through onboarding and account activation.
* Generate merchant agreements and collect required documentation.
* Coordinate approvals, account setup and implementation activities with internal teams.
* Monitor account progress, resolve onboarding challenges proactively and ensure documentation accuracy.

**Relationship and Partner Management**

* Build and maintain relationships with merchants, franchise organizations and referral partners.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for partner inquiries and account-status updates.
* Support partner initiatives, strategic programs and portfolio-growth activities.
* Deliver responsive service to internal and external stakeholders.

**Client Account Support**

* Assist merchants with account maintenance, solution enhancements, equipment requests and operational inquiries.
* Resolve billing, onboarding and service-related issues in partnership with internal support teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve the client experience, solution adoption, satisfaction and retention.

**Pipeline and Business Management**

* Maintain accurate opportunity and account records in Salesforce and related business systems.
* Track pipeline activity, activations, revenue performance and key business metrics.
* Provide reporting and visibility to management and stakeholders, ensuring timely follow-up on assigned opportunities.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Credit & Risk, Legal, Boarding Operations, Implementations, Marketplace, Franchise Priority and Account Management teams.
* Escalate and resolve issues requiring specialized support.
* Support contract reviews, approvals and operational initiatives as needed.

**What You Will Need To Have**

* Two or more years of experience in merchant services, payments, financial services, technology solutions, account management, sales support, training or a related field.
* Experience managing customer relationships, onboarding activities or sales opportunities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong relationship-building, consultative communication and needs-assessment skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, organization, time-management, problem-solving and issue-resolution skills.
* Proficiency with Salesforce, Microsoft Office and related business applications.

**What Would Be Great To Have**

* Knowledge of payment processing, merchant acquiring, point-of-sale systems and Clover solutions.
* Experience supporting franchise, enterprise or multi-location merchant accounts.
* Familiarity with merchant onboarding, account activation and customer-support processes.
* Experience working with referral partners, franchise organizations or strategic partner programs.

**"Merchant Operations Pune"**
**Thank You For Considering Employment With Fiserv. Please**

* Apply using your legal name
* Complete the step-by-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).

**Our Commitment To Diversity And Inclusion**
Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.
  
  
**Note To Agencies**
Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.
  
  
**Warning About Fake Job Posts**
Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Director (ID # 912)
jobs.description:
**About the Company**

Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India’s full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India’s leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC.

**About the Role**

The role owns the commercial relationship and ensures each account is getting real value from Sarvam’s products, expanding into new use cases, and renewing with conviction. You are the single point of commercial accountability for your book of business. You will work at the intersection of the client, the delivery team (FDSEs, CSEs, CSMs), and Sarvam’s product and GTM leadership. What you learn in the field shapes how the company prioritises product improvements, structures pricing, and designs its post-sales playbooks. If you are someone who combines commercial sharpness with genuine curiosity about how AI products create value for enterprise clients, this role is for you.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the full commercial relationship across a portfolio of Sarvam’s enterprise accounts: renewals, expansion, cross-sell, and net revenue retention
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with key stakeholders across your accounts, from operational teams running Sarvam products daily to CXO-level sponsors
* Drive account expansion by identifying new use cases, business units, and product lines where Sarvam can deliver incremental value
* Lead renewal negotiations end-to-end, including pricing, scope, and contract structuring, in close coordination with GTM leadership
* Run structured account reviews (QBRs, health checks, success plans) that demonstrate measurable business impact and align both sides on next steps
* Use product usage data, delivery metrics, and client feedback to proactively identify health signals, adoption gaps, and churn risk
* Work closely with FDSEs, CSEs, and CSMs to ensure delivery quality remains high and client expectations are met throughout the engagement lifecycle
* Translate client feedback, feature requests, and competitive intelligence back to product teams with enough context and specificity to be actionable
* Contribute to building Sarvam’s post-sales playbook: account segmentation frameworks, expansion motions, health scoring models, and renewal processes

**Qualifications**

* 8-20 years of experience in enterprise sales ales, account management, customer success, or post-sales roles within B2B SaaS, enterprise technology, or AI/ML products
* Proven track record of owning and exceeding revenue targets, specifically renewal rates and net revenue retention (NRR) metrics

**Required Skills**

* Commercial instinct: you segment your book by expansion potential, keep active expansion conversations going, and build business cases that land with economic buyers
* Ability to hold a technical conversation with an engineering or product team on the client side. You do not need to write code, but you need to understand how APIs, integrations, and AI workflows connect
* Strong communication skills: you can move fluidly between an operational lead, a technical counterpart, and a procurement team within the same account
* Comfort using product data and analytics to drive account decisions rather than relying on gut feel alone
* Experience working in a fast-moving environment where you build process as you go, not inherit it from a mature org

**Preferred Skills**

* Prior experience managing accounts in conversational AI, voice technology, language technology, or document intelligence
* Familiarity with the Indian enterprise buying landscape: procurement cycles, compliance requirements, multi-stakeholder decision-making, and government contracting norms
* Experience working alongside Forward Deployed Engineering, professional services, or delivery teams in a post-sales capacity
* Background in consulting, solutions engineering, or customer success before moving into account management
* Hands-on experience with CRM and customer health tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, Gainsight, or equivalent)

**Pay range and compensation package**

Note: We are looking for people who can own the outcomes described here, not people who match every line of this specification. If this problem excites you and you believe you can do this work, we want to hear from you.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

Sarvam is a fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population-scale impact. Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar. High ownership and high impact, from day one. Everything we do is AI-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we think about problems. You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns, works, and communicates. If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be.

Business Development Director / Senior Manager
  
  
SAP S/4HANA Transformation Services - Middle East
  
  
ROLE MANDATE Build the Middle East SAP transformation business through new-client acquisition, strategic account expansion, and trusted executive relationships.
  
  
Location Middle East, with flexibility across GCC markets
  
  
Travel Frequent regional travel and onsite customer presence as business needs require
  
  
Experience level 12+ years overall, including significant SAP business development, consulting, sales, or client engagement experience
  
  
Role orientation Customer-facing growth leader with an entrepreneurial and aspirational mindset
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
We are seeking a highly motivated and entrepreneurial Business Development Leader to accelerate growth across the Middle East. The role requires a customer-facing professional with proven exposure to large SAP S/4HANA transformation programs and the ambition to build a scalable regional business. The successful candidate will identify and shape opportunities, influence C-level stakeholders, expand strategic accounts, and position the organization as a trusted transformation partner.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Business Growth and Sales Leadership
  
  
Develop and execute the regional growth plan; identify, qualify, and pursue new SAP transformation opportunities; build a healthy pipeline across SAP S/4HANA, RISE with SAP, Cloud ERP, AMS, and adjacent digital services; and drive new-logo acquisition and account growth.
  
  
Customer and Executive Engagement
  
  
Build trusted relationships with CIOs, CFOs, CTOs, business leaders, and other decision-makers. Lead executive conversations, discovery sessions, value workshops, proposal presentations, and strategic account discussions.
  
  
SAP Transformation Advisory
  
  
Understand customers' business priorities and translate them into transformation opportunities. Use experience from large S/4HANA programs to support transformation roadmaps, business cases, solution positioning, and value propositions.
  
  
Opportunity Pursuit and Deal Closure
  
  
Lead opportunity qualification, RFP responses, proposals, and pursuit governance. Collaborate with solution architects, consulting, delivery, commercial, finance, and legal teams to develop compelling and commercially sound proposals.
  
  
Account Expansion and Market Development
  
  
Drive account mining, cross-selling, and upselling. Track market and industry trends, represent the organization at relevant events, and build productive relationships with SAP, hyperscalers, and alliance partners.
  
  
Onsite Presence and Regional Coverage
  
  
Maintain a strong onsite customer presence across the Middle East. Travel regularly for customer meetings, executive workshops, industry events, proposal discussions, steering sessions, and critical pursuits. Be comfortable working from customer locations for extended periods when required.
  
  
**Required Experience And Qualifications**
Must Have
  
  
12+ years of experience in SAP consulting, sales, business development, or client engagement; at least 5 years supporting or selling large SAP transformation programs; strong exposure to S/4HANA greenfield, brownfield, selective transformation, or RISE with SAP engagements; proven executive stakeholder management; experience in the Middle East or GCC market; and strong commercial and negotiation capability.
  
  
**Preferred**
Experience in industries such as Oil and Gas, Utilities, Manufacturing, Retail, Government, or Public Sector; understanding of SAP BTP, Cloud, Analytics, Data Migration, and enterprise integration; and experience working with SAP and strategic technology partners.
  
  
Core Competencies
  
  
Commercial Leadership
  
  
Strategic selling, opportunity qualification, negotiation, deal shaping, account planning, and revenue ownership.
  
  
Client Leadership
  
  
Executive presence, consultative engagement, relationship building, cross-cultural communication, and trusted-advisor capability.
  
  
Transformation Acumen
  
  
Understanding of SAP-enabled business transformation, S/4HANA deployment approaches, program risks, value articulation, and large-deal solutioning.
  
  
Growth Mindset
  
  
Entrepreneurial drive, resilience, market-building ambition, collaboration, adaptability, and willingness to take ownership.
  
  
Success Measures
  
  
Business Outcomes
  
  
Revenue achievement, qualified pipeline growth, conversion, new-logo acquisition, account expansion, customer retention, partner-led opportunity creation, and contribution to the regional growth strategy.

Essential requirement: The candidate must be keen to travel frequently across the Middle East and be available to work onsite at customer locations as and when required. The individual should be adaptable to diverse cultural and business environments and able to support time-sensitive pursuits and executive engagements in person.

A commercially driven and well-networked SAP transformation professional who combines knowledge of large S/4HANA programs with a passion for customer engagement and business expansion. jobs.title: Client Analytics Business Partner
jobs.description:
**Marcus Evans**
is a global leader in business intelligence and growth partner for leading businesses worldwide, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities. Since 1983, we have brought decision-makers together through high-level summits, conferences, online platforms and performance programmes, working across all sectors and regions.

Our overriding approach is one of collaboration, and our belief that "We'll be our most successful when we work together." We recognise excellence and actively develop top performers into future leaders. Our culture promotes teamwork, continuous learning and global career growth.

**About Client Analytics**

Client Analytics is a new team in Hyderabad. It partners with the Managing Directors who lead our sales offices around the world, and helps them manage every client account to a consistent standard: before an event, on site and long after it. The team works on the data and discipline behind how we keep and grow clients, so our sales leaders can spend their time in front of them.

**Job Summary**

We're hiring Client Analytics Business Partner to work alongside the Managing Directors who run our sales offices in North America, APAC and Europe. You'll own the account management rhythm for those offices. That covers the rebook plan before every event, the results after it, the clients we're trying to win back, and the health of every active account. You'll turn client data into a clear view of where each account stands and what should happen next.

This is a partnering role, not a sales role and not an administrative one. You won't sell to clients. You will be the person an MD relies on to know whether the right work has been done on every account, to prompt it when it hasn't, and to report it clearly to our senior leadership.

This is an hybrid role in our Hyderabad office. Working hours overlap with the business day of the offices you support in North America and Europe.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan & Report: Build the pre-event rebook review four weeks out, covering what we plan to offer each client and how well we know them. Check that pricing has reached the sales team in time. Run a strategy update with the MD in the final one to two weeks. Four weeks after the event, report the outcome for every client.
* Win back lost clients: Own the lost opportunity list for your offices. Categorise each account, keep it current and review it with the MD every four weeks. Run the win-back programme, including the controlled use of complimentary video meetings. Track the results of reassigned accounts.
* Know the active portfolio: Keep a live view of each client showing what we know, what we plan to offer and when we next engage them. Use CRM data, AI tools and third-party sources to build the picture, and spot where the account can grow.
* Hold the standard: Monitor adherence to the account management workflow and alert the MD when a step is missed. Track KPIs and scoring, keep the dashboard current, and flag where retraining is needed. Work with Learning & Quality to train sales teams.
* Report to leadership: Present evidence-based reviews and clear recommendations to senior leadership, including the Chairman and CEO.
* Work across the business: Partner with Operations, Finance, Marketing and Technology. Direct the Account Management Coordinators who support your offices. Suggest improvements to our reports and tools, including where AI can save time.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in business, commerce, economics, statistics or a related field
* Minimum 5 years in sales operations, revenue operations, commercial analytics, account management analytics or a similar role supporting sales leaders
* Experience working directly with senior stakeholders in the US, UK or Europe, and the confidence to challenge them constructively
* Advanced Excel, plus hands-on experience with a CRM such as HubSpot or Salesforce
* Able to turn data into a short, clear recommendation that a busy senior leader can act on
* Excellent written and spoken English (C1 or above)
* Highly organised and comfortable managing several stakeholders, deadlines and reporting cycles at once
* Discretion with commercially sensitive information
* Willing to work hours that overlap with North American and European offices

**Preferred**

* MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification
* Experience in B2B services, events, media, consulting or financial services
* Experience with dashboard tools such as Power BI or Tableau
* Experience using AI tools for research and analysis
* Familiarity with sales intelligence platforms such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo or Apollo
* Experience supporting account management, client retention or key account programmes

**Compensation**

**Compensation & Benefits**

Competitive base salary and performance base bonus opportunity, discussed in the hiring manager conversation

**Benefits**

* Work directly with Managing Directors and senior leadership, including the Chairman and CEO's office
* Join a new team at the start, and help shape how it works
* Fast-track, transparent promotional structure, with a path to Senior Business Partner and team leadership
* Opportunity to attend Marcus Evans events
* International travel opportunities
* A friendly, dynamic and vibrant work environment

**Marcus Evans**
is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity, and all employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need.

jobs.title: Associate Vice President Premier Relationship Manager
jobs.description:
Some careers open more doors than others.
  
  
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
To build and grow HSBC Premier Banking relationships with high-net-worth individual (HNI) customers, acting as a single point of contact and providing comprehensive banking support and financial advisory aligned to customer needs. The role focuses on delivering against business targets while meeting Global Premier Service Standards and ensuring strong conduct and regulatory outcomes.
  
  
**Responsibility**

* Grow profit and portfolio value across Premier client relationships through new and existing business
* Deliver agreed financial targets through effective relationship management and consistent service delivery
* Conduct regular client reviews to understand needs and recommend suitable products and services
* Identify wealth review opportunities and provide tailored wealth solutions aligned to customer goals
* Build long-term client relationships that improve retention satisfaction and wallet share
* Maintain accurate client information using client relationship management tools and disciplined record keeping
* Manage a prospect pipeline and apply structured plans to deepen and expand relationships
* Embed HSBC policies and controls including KYC AML and sanctions alongside sales quality requirements

**Pro-tip : Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.**
**Eligibility & Educational Qualifications**

* Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline with 4-7 years of relevant experience
* Substantial experience as a Relationship Manager within the Retail or Premier Banking segment
* Proven outcomes in wealth products with a record of meeting portfolio and revenue goals
* Strong wealth management technical knowledge to provide suitable recommendations and advice
* Experience building trusted relationships with high-net-worth individual (HNI) clients as a consistent point of contact
* Capability using client relationship management systems to maintain accurate timely client data
* Experience partnering with Compliance Credit and Risk and Internal Control teams to deliver balanced risk outcomes
* Required local regulatory licences and accreditations for wealth management or equivalent demonstrable experience
* AMFI IRDA NISM XXI A (PMS Certification) and NISM XIII (SIF Certification) or equivalent certification or equivalent demonstrable experience where required by the market.

**Additional Information**
Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.
  
  
As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
  
  
Issued by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, India

Experience : 7+ Years

Work Location : Chennai , Hyderabad

  

Description;

We are looking for an experienced **Lead / QA Manager who have strong domain experience in Cards and Payment in BFS domain with Automation testing using Playwright OR Java Selenium / Manual Testing** to design, develop, and maintain robust automation solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with API automation, SQL, cross-browser testing, and modern test automation frameworks.

The candidate will work closely with development, product, and QA teams in an Agile environment, contribute to quality engineering strategies, and provide technical leadership to ensure the delivery of high-quality software.

  

Responsibilities will include:

* 7-15 years of hands-on software QA experience and must have minimum 2 years of experience in Cards and Payment in BFS domain>
* Strong knowledge of card processing, payments, and customer servicing systems, including TS2, card lifecycle management, account servicing, card issuance and replacements, authorization, settlement, transaction research, fraud blocks, disputes and back-office operations.
* Experience testing fraud, transaction defence, dispute, and chargeback solutions, including rule validation, fraud case management, representments, and network compliance validation.
* **Must have strong hands-on experience in Playwright OR Java and Selenium.**
* Strong proficiency in backend data validation and integration testing, including SQL verification, Postman API testing, and data synchronization across customer service, payment, fraud, and downstream systems.
* Experience with data migration, conversion, and cloud migration testing, including source-to-target validation and reconciliation of customer/account/card/transaction data; familiarity with AWS environments.
* Good understanding of ISO 8583 message formats and payment interchange protocols (MTIs, bitmaps, data elements).
* Packet and protocol testing experience using SoapSonar / WSDL Weaver or similar tools.
* Strong hands-on REST/SOAP API testing using Postman, SoapUI, Thunder Client, or similar tools.
* Hands-on experience in web UI testing and test automation (see skill table below).
* Strong experience in defect triage, defect lifecycle management, and retesting; experience with Jira or similar tools.
* Good understanding of Agile, SDLC, and STLC; strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently on complex scenarios while supporting offshore team coordination.

jobs.title: Professor Computer Science & Engineering (CSE)
jobs.description:
**PROFESSOR COMPUTER SCIENCE & ENGINEERING (CSE)**

**Specialization:** Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Design and Analysis of Algorithms & Graph Theory

**Department:** Computer Science & Engineering (CSE)  
 **Location:** Hyderabad  
 **Reporting To:** Head of the Department / Principal  
 **Position:** Professor

**1. JOB PURPOSE**

To provide academic leadership and deliver quality teaching and research in Computer Science & Engineering, with specialization in Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Design and Analysis of Algorithms, and Graph Theory.

The Professor will be responsible for teaching undergraduate and postgraduate students, guiding research scholars, mentoring faculty members, promoting research and innovation, and contributing to the academic and research development of the department.

**2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. Teaching & Academic Responsibilities**

* Teach Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Design and Analysis of Algorithms, and Graph Theory to undergraduate and postgraduate engineering students.
* Prepare course plans, lecture materials, assignments, tutorials and assessment methodologies.
* Teach machine learning concepts, supervised and unsupervised learning, neural networks, model evaluation and predictive modelling.
* Explain data collection, preprocessing, statistical analysis, data visualization and analytical techniques.
* Teach algorithm design techniques, computational complexity, optimization and problem-solving methods.
* Explain graph structures, graph algorithms, network analysis and graph-based applications.
* Conduct laboratory sessions, programming assignments, technical demonstrations and project-based learning activities wherever applicable.
* Evaluate student performance and provide academic guidance and mentoring.
* Implement Outcome-Based Education (OBE), including Course Outcomes (COs), assessment and attainment analysis.
* Contribute to curriculum improvement and the development of effective teaching and learning practices.

**B. Research & Development**

* Conduct research in Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Algorithm Design, Graph Theory and related emerging technologies.
* Publish quality research papers in reputed peer-reviewed journals and international conferences.
* Apply for funded research projects, grants and consultancy opportunities from government agencies and industry.
* Guide Ph.D. research scholars, postgraduate dissertations and undergraduate research projects, subject to university recognition and eligibility.
* Encourage interdisciplinary research, innovation, patents and industry collaboration.
* Establish research collaborations with reputed academic institutions and research organizations.
* Contribute to the development of research laboratories and departmental research activities.

**C. Academic Leadership & Departmental Responsibilities**

* Mentor junior faculty members and support their teaching, research and professional development.
* Contribute to curriculum development, academic planning and continuous improvement.
* Participate in Board of Studies, academic committees and institutional development activities.
* Coordinate workshops, seminars, conferences, technical events and Faculty Development Programmes (FDPs).
* Support NBA, NAAC, AICTE and other accreditation and quality assurance activities.
* Contribute to departmental academic administration, research planning and institutional development.
* Promote industry-academia collaboration and student skill development initiatives.

**3. REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS**

**A. Machine Learning**

* Supervised and Unsupervised Learning
* Regression, Classification and Clustering
* Feature Engineering and Feature Selection
* Neural Networks and Deep Learning Fundamentals
* Model Training, Validation, Testing and Evaluation
* Ensemble Learning Techniques
* Predictive Modelling and Performance Optimization
* Python and Machine Learning Libraries such as Scikit-learn, TensorFlow or PyTorch

**B. Data Analytics**

* Data Collection, Cleaning and Preprocessing
* Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
* Statistical Analysis and Hypothesis Testing
* Data Visualization and Interpretation
* Python / R Programming
* SQL and Database Management
* Data Analytics Libraries such as Pandas, NumPy and Matplotlib
* Business Intelligence Tools such as Power BI, Tableau or equivalent
* Predictive Analytics and Data-Driven Decision-Making

**C. Design and Analysis of Algorithms**

* Data Structures and Algorithm Design
* Time and Space Complexity Analysis
* Asymptotic Notations
* Sorting and Searching Algorithms
* Divide and Conquer Techniques
* Greedy Algorithms
* Dynamic Programming
* Backtracking and Branch and Bound
* Graph Algorithms
* NP-Completeness and Computational Complexity
* Algorithm Optimization and Performance Analysis

**D. Graph Theory**

* Graph Structures and Representations
* Directed and Undirected Graphs
* Graph Traversal Algorithms (BFS and DFS)
* Connectivity, Trees and Spanning Trees
* Shortest Path Algorithms
* Minimum Spanning Tree Algorithms
* Graph Coloring and Matching
* Network Flow and Graph Optimization
* Graph-Based Modelling and Network Analysis
* Applications of Graph Theory in Computer Science

**4. REQUIRED EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS**

**Undergraduate Qualification**

* B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering, Information Technology or an equivalent relevant discipline.

**Postgraduate Qualification**

* M.E. / M.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science or an equivalent relevant discipline.

**Doctoral Qualification**

* Ph.D. in Computer Science & Engineering, Computer Science or a relevant allied discipline.

**Preferred Teaching and Research Specializations**

* Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence
* Data Analytics and Data Science
* Design and Analysis of Algorithms
* Graph Theory and Graph Algorithms
* Computational Complexity and Optimization
* Applied Machine Learning and Predictive Analytics

*Educational qualifications and eligibility shall be subject to applicable AICTE, UGC, Osmania University and institutional recruitment norms.*

**5. EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS**

* Teaching, research and professional experience as prescribed under applicable AICTE/UGC and university norms for appointment to the position of Professor.
* Proven teaching experience in undergraduate and postgraduate Computer Science & Engineering programmes.
* Demonstrated ability to independently handle Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Design and Analysis of Algorithms, and Graph Theory.
* Experience in guiding postgraduate dissertations and Ph.D. research scholars, as permitted under university regulations.
* Strong research publication record in reputed peer-reviewed journals and conferences.
* Experience in academic leadership, curriculum development and faculty mentoring.
* Experience in funded research projects, consultancy, industry collaboration and institutional development will be preferred.

**6. REQUIRED SKILLS & COMPETENCIES**

* Strong knowledge of core Computer Science & Engineering subjects.
* Expertise in Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Algorithm Design and Graph Theory.
* Strong programming and analytical skills using Python, R, SQL and relevant development tools.
* Ability to develop and demonstrate machine learning models and data analytics applications.
* Strong understanding of algorithm design, complexity analysis and graph-based problem-solving.
* Excellent teaching, communication, mentoring and academic leadership skills.
* Strong research, analytical and technical problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to guide research scholars and contribute to funded research and consultancy activities.
* Ability to independently handle all four identified subjects.
* Ability to mentor faculty members and contribute to departmental academic and research development.

**7. SELECTION PREFERENCE**

Ghaf Benefits, launched by Lunate is a leading workplace benefits platform dedicated to helping employers deliver meaningful financial wellbeing and benefits solutions to their workforce. * Prepare client proposals, presentations, and responses to RFPs and tenders.
