* Strong understanding of the UAE financial services landscape and corporate ecosystem.
* Demonstrated business development and sales support experience.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline.

jobs.title: Director Relationship Manager (FI)
jobs.description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
  
  
If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
  
  
**Skills And Competencies**

* Minimum 10 years’ enterprise sales or direct client coverage and relationship management of a broad spectrum of institutional clients: regional banks, central banks, sovereign wealth funds, insurance, asset managers
* Familiarity with Middle East, GCC and global markets, reflecting cross-border client engagement and product delivery
* Arabic language skills (spoken and written) are an advantage, supporting engagement with regional clients and senior stakeholders
* Strong knowledge of credit, risk, capital markets or regulatory workflows—and the ability to translate GCC regulatory requirements (such as those of the local Central Banks or Capital Monetary Authorities) into Moody’s solutions
* Working knowledge of Moody’s capabilities across KYC and customer onboarding, supplier and third-party risk, commercial and corporate lending, private credit and AI-enabled solutions, with the ability to position them to risk, compliance, credit and technology stakeholders
* Exceptional C-level relationship-building, consultative selling and contract negotiation skills, complemented by independent thought leadership and advisory sales expertise. Demonstrates the ability to generate impactful ideas for clients, influencing outcomes at the highest level
* Demonstrates a strong track record in building and leading high-performing sales teams, with a focus on cross-functional collaboration. Applies strategic planning, pipeline management and disciplined execution to consistently meet or exceed revenue targets
* Excellent communication—listening, presenting and writing—and the confidence to influence senior external and internal stakeholders
* High initiative, resilience and the ability to work independently while fostering teamwork in a matrix environment

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, applied finance, economics or a related field (post graduate finance or risk qualification advantageous)

**Responsibilities**

* Own and expand relationships with the GCC’s Tier 1 banks and a broad spectrum of institutional clients—including central banks, banks, sovereign wealth funds, insurance, asset managers —engaging board and C-suite stakeholders and setting multi-year account strategies aligned to client priorities
* Retain and grow revenue by cross-selling and up-selling the full Moody’s Analytics suite, leveraging advisory sales and innovative solutions across KYC and onboarding, supplier and third-party risk, lending and credit origination, private credit, AI-enabled solutions, credit, ESG, AML, regulatory reporting, data and analytics
* Partner with global product heads to position Moody’s insights in the context of local and regional regulatory and industry trends, including private credit, lending modernisation, AI adoption, automation, KYC and supplier risk management, climate risk and digitised credit workflows
* Travel (~30 %) across the GCC and wider Middle East and, when required, to regional hubs to strengthen senior relationships and align global strategy
* Build, lead and empower high-performing sales teams, fostering talent development and cross-functional collaboration with Product, Specialists, Finance and Legal to drive complex sales cycles, identify new use cases, negotiate commercial terms and close enterprise agreements
* Deliver accurate forecasting and client feedback to senior leadership, surfacing cross-business leads and supporting business growth objectives
* Participate in management and risk committees to support governance, conduct and best execution standards

**About The Team**
You will sit within the Moody’s Analytics Middle East Sales team, a high energy group of enterprise sellers, with this role based in Dubai and focused on the GCC. The team partners with the region’s biggest banks and FIs to deliver Moody’s data, analytics and workflow solutions. Collaboration is core: Relationship Managers lead opportunities while working hand in hand with Product Specialists, Solutions Consultants, Finance and Legal colleagues to solve complex client challenges, accelerate revenue growth and share best practices across the wider regional and global sales organisation.
  
  
Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.

jobs.title: Client Business Executive - CSS UAE Oman Bahrain KW Jordan
jobs.description:
**About The Opportunity**
The Client Business Executive is accountable for the end-to-end CSS business within the assigned customer unit or cluster. The role owns the business agenda across pre-sales, solution positioning, sales execution, delivery alignment, customer satisfaction, and profitable growth.
  
  
As the primary CSS business leader toward the Cluster Heads, the Client Business Executive translates customer and business priorities into clear growth strategies, investment decisions, execution plans, and measurable outcomes. The role requires strong commercial judgment, customer intimacy, cross-functional leadership, and the ability to make timely decisions across a complex, geographically diverse organization.
  
  
The Client Business Executive works closely with KAMs, Customer Unit leadership, Solution Areas, delivery organizations, commercial functions, partners, and senior customer stakeholders to grow the CSS business across the complete customer lifecycle.
  
  
**Business and Financial Accountability**

* Own the CSS business plan and performance objectives for the assigned customer unit cluster.
* Drive profitable growth through new business, renewals, upselling, cross-selling, transformation programs, and improved customer retention.
* Monitor business performance, pipeline health, forecast accuracy, delivery economics, customer satisfaction, risks, and profitability.
* Ensure disciplined governance of commercial commitments, resources, investments, costs, and business risks.
* Convert customer relationships and market insight into concrete sales results and sustainable business outcomes.

**Leadership Responsibilities**

* Lead and influence cross-functional teams without relying solely on formal authority.
* Create a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer focus, innovation, and results orientation across the CSS organization and its interfaces.
* Align diverse teams around common customer outcomes, clear priorities, and measurable execution plans.
* Coach and develop leaders and key contributors across sales, pre-sales, delivery, service management, and supporting functions.
* Promote knowledge sharing, best-practice reuse, talent development, and strong succession planning.
* Represent the CSS organization with credibility and executive presence in internal and external forums.

**Key Interfaces**

* Cluster Heads and Customer Unit leadership
* Key Account Managers and Account Teams
* Senior customer executives and buying centers
* CSS sales, pre-sales, solution architecture, and delivery organizations
* Service management, fulfillment, assurance, and operations teams
* Solution Areas and Business Areas
* Commercial management, finance, legal, and procurement
* Strategic partners and third-party suppliers
* Market Area and global Ericsson stakeholders

**What You Will Do**

* Own the end-to-end CSS business within the assigned customer unit or cluster, with accountability for revenue growth, profitability, customer satisfaction, delivery performance, and overall business results.
* Act as the primary CSS business interface toward Cluster Heads, Customer Unit leadership, KAMs, and relevant Solution Area leaders.
* Develop and execute a CSS growth strategy covering customer priorities, market opportunities, portfolio development, pipeline creation, account planning, and long-term business transformation.
* Lead the CSS business agenda across the full lifecycle, from early customer engagement and opportunity shaping through pre-sales, contracting, delivery, adoption, value realization, renewal, upsell, and cross-sell.
* Take ownership of key business decisions across pre-sales and delivery, balancing customer value, commercial opportunities, delivery feasibility, risk, quality, resource requirements, and profitability.
* Drive executive-level customer engagement with CIOs, CTOs, operations leaders, procurement stakeholders, and other senior decision-makers to understand business priorities and position relevant CSS solutions and services.
* Identify customer business needs and translate them into practical, scalable, and de-risked solution approaches that deliver measurable business outcomes.
* Build and manage a healthy CSS funnel through proactive, data-driven opportunity identification, early engagement, consultative selling, and disciplined pipeline governance.
* Lead the development of customer engagement plans, growth plans, account strategies, and opportunity execution plans in collaboration with KAMs and cross-functional teams.
* Ensure high-quality proposals, solution positioning, commercial models, costing, pricing, governance, and executive communications throughout the sales cycle.
* Establish strong alignment between sales, pre-sales, solution architecture, delivery, service management, commercial management, finance, partners, and customer stakeholders.
* Maintain accountability for delivery readiness and customer value realization, ensuring that commitments made during the sales process are understood, managed, and delivered effectively.
* Act as a senior escalation point for significant customer, commercial, delivery, quality, and relationship issues within the CSS scope.
* Drive continuous improvement through automation, digitalization, standardized ways of working, performance transparency, knowledge reuse, and operational efficiency.
* Collaborate with partners and internal organizations to strengthen the end-to-end CSS offering and expand the value delivered to customers.

**What You Will Bring**

* Significant experience in telecommunications, IT, managed services, customer support, service operations, or related technology businesses.
* Proven experience managing complex customer engagements across sales, pre-sales, delivery, and the customer lifecycle.
* Strong understanding of CSS offerings, service management, operational transformation, automation, digitalization, and customer experience.
* Demonstrated ability to lead business growth, manage senior customer relationships, and deliver commercial results in a complex matrix organization.
* Experience managing or influencing large, geographically distributed, and cross-functional teams.
* Strong financial and commercial acumen, including understanding of revenue, margin, cost, forecasting, pricing, investment, and risk management.
* Ability to engage credibly with C-level and senior customer stakeholders.
* Strong consultative selling, negotiation, presentation, influencing, and relationship-building skills.
* Proven ability to make sound, timely decisions across competing business, customer, delivery, and commercial priorities.
* Strong executive presence, resilience, adaptability, and results orientation.
* A collaborative leadership style and the ability to create alignment across organizational boundaries.
* University degree or equivalent experience in telecommunications, business, engineering, information technology, or a related discipline.
* Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

**Success in the Role**
Success will be measured by the Client Business Executive’s ability to:
  
  

* Deliver sustainable and profitable CSS growth.
* Strengthen executive-level customer relationships and customer confidence.
* Improve alignment between pre-sales, sales, delivery, and service operations.
* Increase pipeline quality, conversion, retention, upsell, and cross-sell performance.
* Improve delivery predictability, customer satisfaction, and value realization.
* Build a high-performing, accountable, and collaborative CSS leadership culture.
* Establish CSS as a strategic business partner to the customer—not only as a delivery or support function.

**What This Role Is Not**
This role is not limited to account relationship management, opportunity coordination, or operational delivery oversight. It is an end-to-end business leadership role with accountability for shaping, growing, governing, and delivering the CSS business across

jobs.title: Global Acct Manager - Etisalat Group
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**Global Account Manager – Etisalat Group**
**Location:**
Based in Dubai
  
  
**Account coverage:**
Entire Etisalat Group globally, with particular emphasis on the Middle East, Africa and Europe.
  
  
**Role Overview**
Fortinet is seeking a senior Global Account Manager to lead the strategic relationship with Etisalat Group worldwide, developing its potential as both a major enterprise customer and a strategic service-provider partner.
  
  
The role brings together two complementary growth strategies: sell-to, expanding Fortinet’s contribution to the Group’s own cybersecurity and infrastructure priorities; and sell-with, building joint propositions and go-to-market programmes that bring Fortinet-powered services to its customers.
  
  
The successful candidate will own the overarching global account strategy, build executive sponsorship and lead coordinated execution across Fortinet teams, Group functions, business units and operating companies. The role requires the ability to translate a complex multinational relationship into a focused business plan, strategic commercial agreements and measurable growth.
  
  
The Global Account Manager provides strategic leadership across local quota-carrying account owners, aligning priorities and enabling execution without replacing their direct sales accountability. Local account owners retain responsibility for their assigned quotas, opportunities and forecasts; the Global Account Manager leads the consolidated Group strategy, executive engagement and cross-market growth agenda.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Account Leadership**
Develop and lead an integrated, multi-year global account strategy spanning the Group’s internal technology requirements and customer-facing services businesses.
  
  
Build trusted executive relationships across Group leadership, operating companies and technology, security, commercial, product and procurement functions.
  
  
Establish joint priorities, executive sponsorship and governance to advance strategic initiatives and remove barriers to execution.
  
  
Translate Group-level priorities into coordinated local account plans, with particular emphasis on the Middle East, Africa and Europe.
  
  
**Sell-To: Strategic Customer Development**
Position Fortinet against the Group’s cybersecurity, network modernization, cloud, data-centre and operational resilience priorities.
  
  
Identify strategic opportunities through a deep understanding of investment plans, architectures, decision-making processes and business objectives.
  
  
Lead Group-level engagement and support local account owners in complex sales pursuits, commercial negotiations and executive alignment.
  
  
Drive adoption and expansion across business units and operating companies through compelling business cases, shared reference architectures and demonstrated customer outcomes.
  
  
**Sell-With: Joint Solutions and Go-to-Market**
Co-develop a global growth strategy for Fortinet-powered offerings across the Group’s enterprise, SMB and managed-services businesses.
  
  
Work with product, commercial and technical teams to turn capabilities into market-ready propositions with defined customer segments, value propositions, commercial models and launch plans.
  
  
Develop joint sales plays, account targeting and demand-generation programmes with Group stakeholders, operating companies and Fortinet field teams.
  
  
Drive partner-sourced and co-sell opportunities from proposition development through pipeline creation and commercial execution, alongside the relevant local account owners.
  
  
Scale successful offerings across markets and operating companies, adapting to local demand, regulation and delivery capabilities.
  
  
**Commercial Frameworks and Executive Governance**
Lead the development and advancement of strategic framework, managed-services and other relevant agreements with Fortinet Legal, Finance and commercial stakeholders.
  
  
Establish joint business plans with clear objectives, accountable owners, milestones and success measures.
  
  
Lead executive business reviews and steering committees, translating strategic alignment into decisions, actions and business outcomes.
  
  
Maintain clear engagement and opportunity-ownership arrangements across global-account, local sales, alliance and channel teams.
  
  
**Cross-Functional Execution and Enablement**
Mobilize Fortinet Sales, Systems Engineering, Product and Marketing around agreed account priorities.
  
  
Coordinate across regions to provide a consistent global-account approach while enabling effective local execution.
  
  
Develop targeted enablement programmes that equip the Group’s sales, presales, product and delivery teams to position, sell and support joint offerings.
  
  
Share customer insights and successful practices across markets, bringing strategic requirements into Fortinet’s solution development and planning.
  
  
Maintain a consolidated global view of account performance, strategic opportunities and pipeline across sell-to and sell-with activities.
  
  
Align local account plans and forecasts with the overarching Group strategy, while preserving local quota and opportunity accountability.
  
  
Drive disciplined opportunity qualification and CRM reporting with local account owners; identify execution gaps and coordinate corrective actions.
  
  
**Required Qualifications And Experience**
10+ years of experience in strategic or global account management, enterprise technology sales, service-provider business development or strategic alliances.
  
  
Demonstrated success managing large, complex relationships with telecommunications groups, service providers or multinational technology organizations.
  
  
A proven track record in both direct enterprise sales and partner-led growth, including joint solution development and co-sell execution.
  
  
Experience coordinating multinational account strategies across diverse markets, ideally including the Middle East, Africa and Europe.
  
  
Strong understanding of cybersecurity and networking, with the ability to connect technical capabilities to commercial value and customer priorities.
  
  
Experience leading complex negotiations, strategic agreements and multi-stakeholder sales engagements.
  
  
Executive presence and credibility with C-suite stakeholders, combined with the discipline to drive detailed execution.
  
  
**Preferred Experience**
Experience working with Etisalat / e& Group, its operating companies or comparable multinational telecommunications groups.
  
  
Familiarity with managed security services, service-provider productization and recurring-revenue business models.
  
  
Experience developing propositions spanning secure connectivity, SD-WAN, SASE, cloud and data-centre security, and security operations.
  
  
Experience within Fortinet’s ecosystem or a comparable cybersecurity vendor environment.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**
Fortinet is established as a strategic partner to the Group for both its internal transformation and customer-facing services.
  
  
A unified global account plan produces measurable growth across sell-to and sell-with activities, with effective execution by local account owners.
  
  
Executive relationships translate into funded initiatives, effective commercial frameworks and sustained execution.
  
  
Joint propositions progress from development into launched services, qualified pipeline and revenue across relevant markets.
  
  
Group-level and local teams operate with clear accountability, consistent opportunity attribution and a coordinated approach to the account.

jobs.description:

As a professional team of global scale, we work with best clients for great and exciting projects, in an environment where we learn amazing things every day. Each code, each voice, each contribution, each challenge, each success is celebrated here.

We welcome candidates who share our values, have the skills and are
**passionate to enjoy our journey to build the digital future of finance, together.**

About the job:

**About the Job:**

We are looking for a Regional Sales Manager to manage our sales process with our customers. The position would be based in Dubai and would oversee sales for all our customers in the UAE and Qatar region.

**What you will be doing:**

* Responsible for selling VeriPark’s software solutions and professional services
* Making and planning meetings with partners and Microsoft
* Generating leads from various physical and digital channels and connections.
* Responsible for constantly attaining targeted revenue and profitability goals for the assigned territory
* Lead client presentations during the sales meetings
* Coordinate with internal teams for proposal preparation and RFP response preparation and ensuring the SLAs are met
* Follow up on contracts to closure
* Manage existing accounts by ensuring AMC renewal follow-up, guiding preparation of proposals and closing sales for additional requests and new projects
* Regularly visiting existing customers and relationship building.
* Actively participating in the marketing activities and would be responsible to attend all events and tradeshows in the territory, setting up of VeriPark booth and staffing them and delivering presentations during the sponsored events

**What we are looking for:**

* 10+ years of business experience in technology, enterprise, online/mobile services or IT application solutions sales.

jobs.title: Growth (French speaking)
jobs.description:
**About Column**
For companies building financial technology and transforming the financial services space, the biggest bottleneck to their growth and innovation is often the underlying banks and infrastructure stack they rely on. We have spent our careers founding and scaling companies like Plaid, Square, Meta, Blend, and Affirm, and have seen this problem firsthand — builders and developers needing to partner with traditional banks, and creating API and abstraction layers over the patchwork that is the bank, its core, and many other vendors. All of this results in a complex (and often expensive) banking supply chain involving a user, fintech, BaaS middleware provider, bank, core and the Federal Reserve.
  
  
At Column, we set out to simplify and fix this. We are a bank and a software company built from the ground up, offering builders and developers technology-forward banking solutions that cut out the hundreds of vendors, middleware providers, and abstraction layers. This means a safer, more transparent, and less costly banking supply chain. Come build with us!
  
  
**The opportunity**
Column's Growth team is focused on managing our highly strategic customer relationships. As a member of the Growth team, you’ll be responsible for building and overseeing all aspects of our customer management while acting as a trusted partner, advisor and advocate for a wide variety of customers. You will also be in charge of designing and implementing the strategy, processes, and content needed to help us scale this key function.
  
  
This role has a unique international focus, helping build one of Column's most strategic expansion initiatives from the ground up. At least have of your work will be dedicated to building and managing partnerships with banks across Africa. The rest of your time will go to working with Column's core fintech partners.
  
  
Column's Growth team is not your typical Customer Success or Account Management team in that Column is a critical, often existential, partner for our customers, our customer relationships are deeply collaborative and complex, and each customer contributes meaningfully to our revenue. We're therefore looking for team members who are analytical, demonstrate great critical thinking, and have experience managing very strategic relationships.
  
  
This role is highly cross-functional and collaborative, partnering closely with Column’s Executive, Solutions Engineering, Sales, Compliance, and Correspondent Banking teams to ensure customers are onboarded smoothly, that we can anticipate and address both issues and opportunities for growth, and that these relationships are healthy and mutually beneficial. You’ll also represent the voice of the customer to help inform Column's strategy, including the product roadmap, go-to-market motions and more.
  
  
Success in this role also means having a desire to become an expert on the Financial Technology space and on how companies partner with Column (our customers include many key industry players such as Brex and Carta).
  
  
**This role reports to the Head of Growth and is an in-person role based out of Dubai, UAE. We will help secure any required visas.**
**What You’ll Do**

* Help establish our customer-facing strategy, processes, playbooks, systems and best practices. Identify patterns and build repeatability at every step
* Manage all aspects of a customer’s relationship with Column, from onboarding and implementation to ongoing management and expansion of the account
* Onboard and manage our emerging markets bank partners: Serve as the day-to-day lead for banks across Africa. Guide them through onboarding and own the ongoing relationship once they’re live.
* Build and nurture relationships across various functions within a customer's organization, identifying and creating advocates wherever you go, and helping find new use cases for partnering with Column
* Proactively identify challenges and opportunities for growth, and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to find solutions in order to move the relationship forward
* Share key findings and recommendations on market feedback and trends to inform Column’s growth strategy and product roadmap
* Perform day-to-day activities consistent with safe and sound business practices and regulatory requirements
* This role includes periodic travel to Africa to meet with our bank partners in person.

**What You’ll Need To Be Successful**

* 5+ years of relevant work experience -- strong preference for a mix of Consulting, Private Equity, Investment Banking, VC or an equivalent role plus operating experience in an early stage company and/or selling a new line of business
* Professional fluency in French and English required
* A desire to become very knowledgeable on the financial technology and payments space. Prior experience in financial services can be helpful but certainly not required
* A growth and critical thinking mindset: You’re comfortable navigating ambiguous environments and are energized by the prospect of helping build processes with little guidance
* Excellent project management: You’re organized, can manage all aspects of partnering with customers, and effectively work with other internal teams
* Ability to turn naysayers into champions: You’re a persuasive communicator and understand the importance of being helpful, responsive, and solutions-oriented
* Curiosity: You know what questions to ask to uncover and understand customer needs and proactively learn more about the industry, competitive landscape, and product offerings to better support your customers
* Insatiable hunger for improvement: you’re a naturally curious person, enjoy digging into the data, and regularly solicit feedback

**What You’ll Get From Us**

* 🏥 Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans, including options that are 100% covered by Column for you and 100% covered for your dependents!
* 🌴 Competitive time-off policy - take the time off that you want and need to relax and recharge
* 🧳 Sabbatical Program - Reach your 5-year anniversary to take up to 8 weeks of fully paid leave to rest, recharge, and pursue personal interest - with full salary and benefits
* 👶 100% paid parental leave, including 16 weeks for birth mothers, 12 weeks for primary caregivers, and 8 weeks for secondary caregivers
* 🎉 Regular team building events, including annual offsite

**We look forward to hearing from you**
Column is committed to working with the best and brightest people from the broadest talent pool possible. We value bringing together a team with different perspectives, educational backgrounds, and life experiences, and believe a diversity of ideas is what allows us to develop the best solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.
  
  
If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application and recruiting process, please reach out to accommodations@column.com.
  
  
We participate in the E-Verify program in certain locations as required by law. Learn more about the E-Verify program here.

The role will be responsible for driving Visa Government Solutions growth across the UAE market, building trusted relationships with government stakeholders and partners, and translating public sector priorities into scalable commercial opportunities.

* Expand and deepen the Visa Government Solutions public sector strategy and commercial pipeline across UAE, developing and maintaining a prioritized portfolio of clients, use cases and solution opportunities.

jobs.title: Account Management Specialist
jobs.description:
**Department:**
Merchant Business
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full Time
  
  
**Location:**
UAE
  
  
**Description**
**About Tabby:**
Tabby creates financial freedom in the way people shop, earn and save by reshaping their relationship with money. Over 20 million users choose Tabby to stay in control of their spending and make the most out of their money.
  
  
The company’s flagship offering allows shoppers to split their payments online and in-store with no interest or fees. Over 40,000 global brands and small businesses, including Amazon, Noon, IKEA, and SHEIN use Tabby to accelerate growth and gain loyal customers by offering easy and flexible payments online and in stores.
  
  
Tabby generates over $14 billion in annual transaction volume for its partner brands and is the highest-rated, most-reviewed, largest, and fastest-growing FinTech in the GCC region.
  
  
Tabby launched in 2019 and has since raised +$1 billion in equity and debt funding from global and regional investors, and now has an implied valuation of $4.5 billion.
  
  
**About the Role:**
The Account Management Specialist manages a portfolio of strategic and enterprise merchants, driving long-term growth, retention, and product adoption across accounts. Acting as a trusted advisor, the specialist is responsible for developing account strategies, identifying revenue opportunities, and delivering data-driven recommendations that maximize merchant performance and business outcomes.
  
  
This role requires strong commercial acumen, analytical capabilities, and stakeholder management skills. The Account Management Specialist is expected to operate independently, lead strategic merchant conversations, influence decision-making, and drive the adoption of Tabby's full product suite. The role also plays a key part in cross-functional initiatives, process improvements, and strategic projects that support broader business objectives.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Strategic Account Management:**

* Own and manage a portfolio of strategic and enterprise merchants, driving retention, growth, and long-term partnership success.
* Build relationships with key decision-makers and act as a trusted advisor to merchants.
* Develop and execute account growth plans aligned with merchant objectives and Tabby's commercial strategy.

**Revenue Growth & Product Expansion:**

* Drive revenue growth through upselling, cross-selling, and expansion of Tabby's products and services.
* Identify opportunities to increase product penetration across the portfolio, including new and existing solutions.
* Lead commercial discussions and proactively position relevant products based on merchant needs and performance insights.
* Own pipeline generation within the portfolio and track expansion opportunities through to execution.

**Data Analytics & Portfolio Optimization:**

* Analyze merchant performance, transaction trends, conversion metrics, and product adoption to identify growth opportunities and risks.
* Translate complex datasets into actionable recommendations that improve merchant performance and revenue contribution.
* Conduct portfolio reviews, business reviews, and strategic performance discussions with merchants.
* Build dashboards, reports, and presentations to support data-driven decision-making.

**Strategic Projects & Business Initiatives:**

* Lead and contribute to strategic initiatives, product launches, operational improvements, and merchant experience enhancements.
* Identify process improvement opportunities and support automation and scalability initiatives across the business.
* Partner with leadership and cross-functional teams on high-impact commercial and operational projects.

**Merchant Success & Problem Resolution:**

* Proactively identify merchant challenges and business risks before they impact performance.
* Take ownership of complex merchant escalations and coordinate stakeholders to drive timely resolution.
* Ensure merchants receive strategic recommendations and solutions that support continued growth.

**Cross-Functional Leadership:**

* Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, Operations, Risk, Finance, and Tech teams to deliver merchant solutions and achieve business objectives.
* Act as the primary point of coordination for strategic merchant initiatives requiring cross-functional involvement.
* Influence internal stakeholders and drive alignment to achieve successful merchant outcomes.

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
* 3-5+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Partnerships, Business Development, or a similar client-facing role.
* Proven experience independently managing enterprise or strategic accounts.
* Strong commercial mindset with demonstrated success in driving revenue growth, upselling, and cross-selling.
* Advanced analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate insights into business recommendations.
* Experience conducting portfolio reviews, business reviews, and presenting performance insights to senior stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder management, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to manage multiple strategic initiatives and priorities simultaneously.
* Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Operations, Finance, and Technical teams.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and experience with Tableau, Power BI, or similar analytics tools.
* Experience within fintech, payments, BNPL, e-commerce, or technology industries is preferred.

Job Benefits
  
  

* We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well at times that suit you and your team.
* A working environment that gives you autonomy and responsibility from day one.
* You should be comfortable with the idea that the quality of your work will influence the shape of your career.
* Participation in the company’s employee stock options program.
* Health Insurance.
* Flexi Perks: a monetary benefit to spend on what matters most to you — health, well-being, education, or professional development.

jobs.title: Account Director, Private Sector (MEA & Turkey)
jobs.description:
Build a Safer World.
  
  
TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.
  
  
TRM helps financial institutions detect and stop illicit finance, and this role brings that mission to private sector clients including banks, payment providers, crypto natives and fintechs across MEAT. You will own the Private Sector business in a territory where TRM is building coverage, setting account strategy and strategic deals with compliance and risk leaders. What makes this seat unusual is a large greenfield territory plus the freedom to shape your own go-to-market with local partners and AI-assisted research.
  
  
**The Impact You Will Have**

* Open new private sector accounts across the MEAT region. Working with internal and external stakeholders to build effective networks to deliver commercial execution of TRM’s services to leading private sector organisations across the region.
* Win a mixture of high velocity and larger more strategic engagements, by turning AML and fraud pain points into a clear business case, with AI-drafted account plans and proposals that you sharpen with your own market judgment.
* Own and define the model to build a 3x qualified pipeline each quarter through targeted campaigns, using AI-assisted segmentation and local-language messaging, and measure what converts.
* Decide how TRM enters each market, choosing between direct selling, resellers, and regional partners, and back each choice with AI-assisted analysis of account data.
* Grow strategic existing customers engagements through renewals, upsells, and new use cases.
* Bring customer and regulatory insight back to Product and Marketing so the next release matches how banks in your region actually work.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 5+ years selling SaaS or data products into banks, payment firms, crypto or fintechs in MEAT, or 4+ years with deep AML and financial crime expertise, plus experience using AI tools to research and prioritize accounts.
* A record of closing a mixture of quick deal cycle and strategic longer term, higher value engagements and meeting quota, with AI-supported forecasting and pipeline reviews.
* Working knowledge of regional AML and sanctions frameworks and how compliance, risk, and procurement teams buy.
* Hands-on use of AI for prospecting, account planning, and call preparation, with clear examples of time or revenue gained.
* Experience building pipeline in a new territory, forming human lead networks and AI-assisted tools to test and measure what works.
* Credible, clear communication with senior compliance and risk executives, in person and virtually, including AI-assisted preparation for each meeting.
* Fluent English, other relevant languages including Arabic, Turkish, French a bonus
* Based in Dubai and willingness to travel regularly across the region.

**About The Team**

* TRM’s EMEA Sales team gives each Account Director full ownership of a territory and the room to choose how to win it.
* The team collaborates closely and supports one another through shared pipeline insight, deal reviews, and open sharing of what works.
* The work is hard in a useful way: regulated buyers, several countries, long procurement cycles, and a product category that is still new to many banks.
* You will work with RevOps, Marketing, Legal, Product, and Solutions Architecture, who move quickly to back your deals.

**Learn About TRM Speed In This Position**

* Within your first 30 days, you rank every target bank and fintech in your territory and start outreach to the top tier, so pipeline grows before onboarding ends.
* When a compliance leader asks for a demo late on a Friday, you and TRM’s Solutions team deliver it that day, turning a warm inquiry into a scheduled evaluation by Monday.
* Within 90 days, you build qualified pipeline worth at least 3x your quota, backed by an account plan for every Tier 1 target.

**Team Operating Rhythms**

* Distributed, not distant: the team works across Gulf time, and occasional US calls on complex deals.
* Slack is the center of day-to-day communication. @mention colleagues for timely responses.
* Weekly 1:1 with your manager, a weekly team call, a weekly pipeline call, a weekly forecast call, and regular pod calls.
* Company-wide all-hands and founder Q&A sessions keep everyone connected to the mission.

**Required Online And Collaboration Hours**

* Schedule: Core hours overlapping Gulf Time, with flexibility for occasional US calls.

**Application Instructions**
If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.
  
  
Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.
  
  
If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.
  
  
**Interviewing with TRM**
Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.
  
  

* Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.
* Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.
* First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.
* Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.
* References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.
* Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.
* Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.
  
  
**AI Fluency at TRM**
AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.
  
  
We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.
  
  
At TRM, AI Fluency Means You Are Among The Top 10 Percent Of Operators In Your Function In How You Apply AI To
  
  

* Accelerate repeatable workflows
* Structure and solve problems
* Improve output quality
* Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.
  
  
**Life at TRM**
We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.
  
  
TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.
  
  
Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.
  
  
**At TRM, You Should Expect**

* Priorities and targets to change quickly
* Operating with a high degree of ambiguity
* A high level of personal ownership and accountability
* Close collaboration across teams and functions
* Frequent, high-touch communication
* Creati

jobs.description:

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Manager, Business Development - Digital Giant Segment
  
  
**Overview**
1- Overview
  
  
Market Development is looking for a Manager, Business Development, Digital Giant Segment to build, develop and manage the Digital Giant segment key strategic clients across the EEMEA markets. The primary objective of the role is developing the strategy and growing revenue in the segment across the region by identifying and pursuing opportunities with new or existing customers/markets, growing market share and deepening Mastercard’s regional footprint; embedding multiple products, platforms, and capability bundles that drive innovation and stickiness. Developing and setting sales & commercial strategies aligned with geographies and segments including pipeline management and go to market at the segment level.
  
  
The ideal candidate is passionate about leveraging payments technology to digitally transform new and emerging sectors, digital innovation, highly motivated, intellectually curious, analytical, and possesses an entrepreneurial and commercially astute mindset.
  
  
This role will be based in UAE
  
  
2- Role
  
  

* In this high-profile, customer facing position, you will partner with the digital giants across EEMEA deepening our relationship with them across the key marketplace segment partners . Your focus will be on deal commercializing, doubling down on acceptance, VAS, portfolio optimization including revenue diversification with a strong bottom line focus.
* You will be the ‘owner’ of Mastercard’s relationship with your assigned accounts and accountable to build mutually aligned strategies and plans with your partners and execute on them by effectively leveraging the Mastercard organization
* You will be responsible for driving Mastercard revenue growth and be comfortable developing business cases including ROI analyses as well as leading responses to RFPs.
* You will dive into financial and payment related data to be grounded in facts to provide customer specific recommendations that drive value for partners and Mastercard.
* You will be the expert on your assigned partners and learn about Mastercard’s capabilities and be ready to provide insight into a digital giants business, thinking strategically and broadly.
* You will establish day to day and senior business relationships and work with partners to create roadmaps and through QBRs and daily interactions ensure alignment on strategy and execution on agreed projects.
* You will lead negotiations with partners and with internal stakeholders and develop terms sheets and contracts.
* Build, in cooperation and input by the region, roadmap & pipeline for ecosystem to accelerate growth and commercialization
* Entrepreneurial approach; ability to quickly understand business requirements and to translate them into potential business development opportunities
* Interpersonal and negotiation skills - extensive experience in communicating in international environment at senior management level.
* Account management experience - ability to understand customer’s need marketplace dynamics, industry trends and the competitive landscape.

3-This Jobholder
  
  

* Must be capable of operating with high levels of empowerment and accountability
* Capable of operating at both a strategic and operational level
* Strong relationship management skills and ability to build effective partnerships with the relevant business stack holders from banks, government, and third-party processors
* Negotiate, execute, and manage multiple multi-market & large digital giant customers
* Develop strategies, financial modeling and business cases for identified opportunities, as well as coordinate contract development
* Leadership in developing strategy, solutioning design, obtain investment funds, sales planning, delivery, and ongoing management (customer delivery, business risk management, optimization)
* Represent Mastercard in strategic partnership programs & events.

4- All About You
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in business or equivalent work experience
* Strong written and verbal communication skills. Expertise on deal commercialization and P & L management.
* Expert relevant work experience with a core knowledge of payments, data processing concepts and financial industry/banking operations practices
* Deep knowledge and understanding of payment solutions, with significant experience in sales and business development
* Thorough understanding of the marketplace Landscape across the region
* Action-oriented and results driven and with a disciplined approach to deliver sales targets, financial analysis, and strategic development
* A passion and comfort in meeting new people and building & nurturing meaningful relationships at all levels including with senior-level and C-Suite executives.
* Strong Business Development & Relationship management expertise.
* Possess a blend of analytical capability, strategic thinking, and emotional intelligence and able to dive deep on all areas of the business to deliver creative solutions to unstructured problems.

* Strong relationship management skills - experience of managing multiple stakeholders in a multicultural environment. Strong negotiating and influencing skills, with the ability to execute through others who are cross functional teams
* Committed to quality with a strong focus on customer needs
* A team player who easily builds relationships
* Strong people management and coaching skills

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Employ, engage and retain high quality people, with succession planning for critical roles.
* Responsibility to review team structure/capacity plans.

**Risk Management**

* Ensure full awareness of all policies relating to operational risk, sales processes, anti-misselling, etc and comply with the same.
* Read, understand and comply with all provisions of the Group Code of Conduct.

**Our Ideal Candidate**

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

This role is responsible for managing people and employee experience matters within the aligned business area, translating agreed people priorities into practical interventions and ensuring their consistent and effective implementation, while working closely with HRBPs who connect broader business priorities and challenges to the people agenda.

**Your role**

jobs.description:
Summary of This Role
  
  
Responsible for overseeing Application systems, architecture, design, data workflow, logical processes, and system interfaces. Assure synergy between software and hardware architecture to maximize that relationship. Determine and develop architectural approaches and solutions, conduct business reviews, document current systems, and develop recommendations on how to proceed with the applications. Responsible for ensuring optimal application and system performance.
  
  
What Part Will You Play?
  
  

* Collaborates with clients, senior management, and other functional areas to plan, design, and implement information systems and updates within established guidelines and objectives, with issues and factors largely undefined. Studies client needs, analyzes existing system, identifies gaps/risks, proposes an architecture model, and recommends short/long term actions based on best practices. Implements a hardware and software infrastructure that renders reliable, scalable, and operable products and platforms.
* As the Subject Matter Expert (SME), researches and evaluates new technological advances in the external technology marketplace to assess current practices for compliance with information systems requirements. Anticipates and develops solutions to address current and future information system needs. Creates process improvements and controls. Serves as the SME in the Request for Proposal (RFP) and vendor selection process for the purchase of software systems. Assesses impacts on the budget and technical requirements associated with implementing new system technologies or upgrading existing system technologies.
* Provides strategic guidance to senior/lead developers, management and other functional areas to ensure new development is consistent with existing applications, assess information system needs and requirements, and recommend possible alternatives to meet information system needs. Facilitates capacity planning. Remains apprised of project status and communicates issues and resolutions on potential problems.
* Oversees and provides expert advice in the evaluation of software programming and modification ensuring adherence to required procedures, methodologies and/or application standards, including Payment Card Industry (PCI) and security related compliance. Monitors the maintenance of information systems to maintain optimum system capacity levels. Coordinates and monitors the troubleshooting of information systems. Establishes a communication plan to alert users of problems and resolutions.
* Solicits feedback from internal customers and IT teams to understand how well information systems are serving customers and recommends improvements.

* Bachelor's Degree
* Relevant Experience or Degree in: Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Business or related field

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's Degree
* Computer Science or Information Systems

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**About the Role:**
As Business Analyst you are the bridge between business stakeholders and Avaloq delivery squads: you elicit and challenge requirements, shape them into Avaloq-executable functional designs, and stay accountable for them through build, SIT, UAT and go-live.
  
  
This is a hands-on delivery role on large, multi-workstream Avaloq programmes. You will own the requirement thread end to end — from a business pain point in the front office to a signed-off UAT result in production.
  
  
**Job Requirements**
**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, Finance, Engineering or a related discipline.
* 5–10 years of Business Analysis experience, of which at least 3 years in banking or financial services.
* Avaloq: Hands-on delivery experience on the Avaloq Banking Suite — a firm requirement for this role. You must be able to discuss Avaloq business objects, parameters and functional design decisions unaided.
* Demonstrated delivery on at least one large-scale core banking transformation programme, end to end.
* Greenfield: Proven exposure to a greenfield implementation, with end-to-end command of your workstream from initial design through to go-live.
* Cross-workstream: Track record of coordinating across parallel workstreams — engaging other workstream owners to surface cross-impacts, agree interface and data dependencies, and keep design decisions aligned programme-wide.
* Proven authorship of BRDs, FSDs, user stories, process maps and traceability matrices.
* Experience in both Agile and Waterfall delivery environments.
* Excellent written and verbal English, with the ability to write specifications that a developer can build from without further explanation.

**TOOLS & TECHNICAL SKILLS**
Avaloq Banking Suite (functional)
  
  

* Requirements management
* BPMN / Visio process modelling
* JIRA & Azure DevOps
* Confluence
* SQL (preferred)
* Advanced Excel (pivots, lookups, reconciliation)
* Functional testing, SIT & UAT management
* Business process re-engineering

**Job Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities:**
2. Process Analysis & Avaloq Solution Design3. Stakeholder Engagement & Governance4. Agile Delivery & Backlog Management5. Delivery Assurance, Data Validation & Go-Live
  
  

* Requirements Engineering & Documentation
* Elicit requirements through workshops, stakeholder interviews and process observation across front, middle and back office.
* Translate business needs into Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Specification Documents (FSDs), user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Author Avaloq-specific functional designs covering impacted business objects, parameters, interfaces, reports and batch processing.

**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
  
  
**Job Title**
Enterprise Implementations Advisor

**Enterprise Implementations Advisor**

Implementations – Sr. Professional I

9

Individual Contributor
  
  
**About Your Role**
Provide implementation expertise and strategic guidance for complex enterprise client implementations to support successful onboarding, conversion, expansion, and deployment of payment processing products and services. Partner with Enterprise Implementation teams, clients, Sales, Product, Operations, Technology, Credit, Compliance, Product Support, and other stakeholders to develop implementation strategies, address complex requirements, identify and mitigate delivery risks, and resolve implementation challenges. Serve as a subject matter expert and trusted advisor who helps teams navigate highly complex implementations, improve delivery practices, and ensure enterprise clients are positioned for successful production launch and transition to ongoing support.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Serve as a subject matter expert and strategic advisor for complex, high-impact, or escalated enterprise implementations involving multiple products, platforms, locations, workstreams, integrations, and stakeholders.
* Advise implementation teams and client stakeholders on implementation strategy, sequencing, dependencies, delivery approach, readiness requirements, and potential risks throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Partner with implementation leadership and project teams to assess complex client requirements and develop implementation approaches that align client objectives with product, technology, operational, and organizational capabilities.
* Engage during critical stages of enterprise implementations to provide guidance, remove barriers, facilitate decisions, and help resolve complex delivery challenges.
* Provide expertise on implementation methodology, governance, project controls, risk management, escalation practices, readiness standards, and implementation best practices.
* Evaluate implementation risks, issues, dependencies, and delivery constraints and recommend mitigation strategies or corrective actions when project milestones, client expectations, or production readiness may be affected.
* Facilitate complex problem-solving sessions, implementation strategy discussions, readiness reviews, risk reviews, and cross-functional working sessions involving senior client and internal stakeholders.
* Partner with Sales and pre-sales stakeholders when needed to assess implementation complexity, identify delivery considerations, clarify implementation requirements, and support effective transition from sales into implementation.
* Collaborate with Product, Technology, Operations, Credit, Compliance, Product Support, and other teams to address complex requirements, clarify ownership, resolve cross-functional dependencies, and improve implementation outcomes.
* Review implementation plans, solution approaches, requirements, project controls, readiness criteria, and other key implementation deliverables for complex or high-risk engagements and provide recommendations to project teams and leadership.
* Support implementation teams in managing significant client escalations by helping identify root causes, developing recovery strategies, coordinating appropriate resources, and establishing clear paths to resolution.
* Identify recurring implementation challenges, delivery risks, process gaps, and opportunities for improvement and partner with leadership and cross-functional teams to develop scalable solutions.
* Develop, document, and promote implementation best practices, standards, tools, playbooks, templates, and repeatable approaches that improve consistency and effectiveness across Enterprise Implementations.
* Coach and mentor implementation professionals by sharing subject matter expertise, implementation practices, lessons learned, and approaches for managing complex client and project situations.
* Provide implementation insights and recommendations to leadership based on project trends, client feedback, recurring delivery challenges, emerging risks, and opportunities to improve the enterprise implementation experience.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives designed to increase implementation quality, predictability, scalability, client satisfaction, and speed to production.
* Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.

**Experience You'll Need To Have**

* 7+ years of experience leading or supporting complex enterprise implementations, payment processing implementations, technology deployments, client onboarding, conversions, or related implementation and delivery work.
* 5+ years of experience managing or advising complex projects involving multiple products, platforms, integrations, workstreams, dependencies, timelines, and internal and external stakeholders.
* Experience working directly with large enterprise clients throughout an implementation lifecycle, including requirements, planning, solutioning, testing, readiness, launch, and transition to ongoing support.
* Experience identifying and resolving complex implementation risks, issues, dependencies, escalations, and delivery challenges involving multiple cross-functional teams.
* Experience advising project teams or stakeholders on implementation strategy, project governance, risk management, readiness, and delivery best practices.
* Experience facilitating complex discussions and communicating implementation strategy, risks, recommendations, trade-offs, and decisions to client stakeholders, internal partners, and senior leadership.
* Experience applying project management and implementation methodologies to complex client engagements, including scope, schedule, risk, issue, dependency, change, and stakeholder management.
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or an equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.

**Experience That Would Be Great To Have**

* Experience supporting large enterprise merchant, payment processing, merchant acquiring, fintech, or integrated payment implementations.
* Experience implementing solutions involving multiple payment products, platforms, processing environments, integrations, locations, or business units.
* Experience with Clarity, Salesforce, or similar project management, client relationship management, reporting, and support platforms.
* Knowledge of payment processing, merchant acquiring, merchant boarding, authorization, settlement, funding, interchange, chargebacks, reporting, compliance, certification, or related payment operations.
* Experience supporting complex conversions, portfolio migrations, platform transitions, product launches, or multi-workstream enterprise programs.
* Experience establishing implementation standards, developing playbooks or methodologies, performing project assessments, or leading implementation process-improvement initiatives.
* Experience mentoring implementation professionals, providing subject matter expertise, or serving as an escalation resource for complex client engagements.
* Project management or related professional certification such as PMP, PgMP, PMI-ACP, or Certified ScrumMaster (CSM).

**How You'll Work**

* This role is on-site Monday through Friday. Fiserv

jobs.title: SAP BTP Integration Suite
jobs.description:
We are hiring for MNC company

  

**Role & responsibilities**

  

1) Integration Engineering (Cloud, Hybrid, On Prem)

* Design, develop, and run end-to-end integration scenarios using cloud integration capabilities, enabling reliable connectivity across SAP and non SAP systems.
* Build, structure, and manage large integration flows with clear modularity, reusability, and maintainability for enterprise scale.

2) Integration Flow Development (iFlows) & Message Transformation

* Create and maintain integration flows using routing, splitting, gathering, and other transformation patterns.
* Implement message mappings and data transformations for common enterprise formats (e.g., JSON, XML, CSV), ensuring semantic correctness and downstream compatibility.
* Apply canonical modeling and contract-first practices to reduce brittle point-to-point dependencies.

3) Scripting, Persistence & Advanced Flow Control

* Use scripting (e.g., Groovy) to implement complex transformation logic, enrichment, validation, and conditional execution paths.
* Implement message persistence patterns (e.g., data stores) to support idempotency, retries, correlation, and resilience.

4) API & Connector Enablement

* Design and expose secure APIs through API management capabilities (policies, authentication/authorization, throttling, versioning).
* Integrate with third party applications using connector-based approaches and standardized integration patterns.
* Enable event-driven integration approaches using messaging/event capabilities for near real-time propagation and decoupled architectures.

5) AI Native Integration Intelligence (Agentic Integration Layer)

* Build integration agents that can generate initial iFlows from system/endpoint selections and naming conventions, then validate them against enterprise standards.
* Implement retrieval-grounded assistance that pulls from interface catalogs, mapping specs, standards, runbooks, and known incident patterns to produce verifiable recommendations (no free-form guessing).
* Apply intelligent recommendations for mapping and configuration, accelerating build and reducing rework.
* Develop AI-driven anomaly detection and prediction for integration/API behavior (error spikes, latency patterns), with human-in-the-loop controls for remediation actions.
* Optimize and analyze scripts used in integration flows for performance and maintainability through AI-assisted code analysis techniques.

6) Testing, Quality Engineering & Evaluation Loops

* Build automated testing strategies for integrations: schema/contract validation, payload regression suites, replay testing, and API testing tool-driven verification.
* Implement AI evaluation harnesses (offline golden test sets + online monitoring) for generated mappings, generated flows, and operational recommendations.
* Establish release gates for both integration changes and AI prompt/tool updates to prevent silent degradation.

7) Monitoring, Troubleshooting & Observability

* Set up monitoring dashboards and alerts for flows, APIs, and event-driven pipelines establish traceability with correlation IDs and end-to-end tracking.
* Diagnose and resolve integration issues using structured logs, message traces, and failure-mode analysis.
* Create AI-native operational experiences such as conversational root-cause analysis, runbook-guided remediation, and impact analysisbounded by role-based access and approval workflows.

8) Integration Strategy & Maturity Enablement

* Apply integration advisory practices to design hybrid integration platforms and define integration best practices across teams.
* Use integration assessment approaches to improve integration maturity, standardize patterns, and automate repeatable architectural governance where feasible.

Primary Skills (AI Native Must Have)

* Strong hands-on expertise with SAP BTP Integration Suite concepts and building blocks (cloud integration/iFlows, transformation patterns, monitoring).
* Proven ability to implement message mappings, routing patterns, and transformation logic across enterprise data formats.
* Practical scripting capability (e.g., Groovy) for advanced integration flow customization and performance tuning.
* Solid API design and management fundamentals (security, throttling, lifecycle/versioning, observability).
* AI-native delivery capability: tool-augmented workflows, retrieval-grounded outputs, measurable evaluation loops, and safe action boundaries.

Secondary / Strongly Beneficial Skills

* Event-driven integration design and enterprise messaging patterns.
* Connector-based integrations with third-party SaaS ecosystems.
* Migration and modernization experience from legacy integration platforms to cloud integration.
* Integration governance and advisory methodologies for enterprise-wide standardization.

What This Role Does Not Center On

* Training or fine-tuning foundation models from scratch.
* AI-assisted only integration work this role builds and owns AI behavior in the integration layer (grounding, evaluation, guardrails, observability).

Value Delivered

* Faster integration delivery via intelligent flow generation, mapping recommendations, and script optimization.
* Higher reliability and lower run cost via anomaly detection, predictive operations, and grounded troubleshooting.
* Scalable integration landscapes through standardized patterns, governance, and maturity enablement.

Additional Information

* A 15 years full time education is required

jobs.description:
**Overview**

**About Omnicom Global Solutions**

Omnicom Global Solutions (OGS) is Omnicom's integrated solutions engine, bringing together a global talent community and connected capabilities to build adaptive, future-ready solutions.

As an integral part of Omnicom, the world's leading marketing and sales company, OGS helps agencies and clients navigate what's next through expertise spanning Media, Data & Analytics, Technology, Creative, Strategy & Insights, MarTech, Commerce, Healthcare, and Business Support Solutions.

With over 8,000 professionals across India, the Philippines, and Colombia, and a growing global footprint, OGS combines deep domain expertise with scaled delivery to drive innovation, accelerate growth, and create meaningful business impact.

At OGS, the future is tested, built, and scaled every day for some of the world's most ambitious agencies, brands, and clients.

**Let’s build what’s next.**

**Responsibilities**

**Role Overview:** The Senior / Lead Data Engineer owns substantial components of the Databricks platform, including full pipelines from ingestion through Gold-layer modeling. This role is expected to take on tasks with unresolved ambiguity, resolve open questions efficiently, and deliver without close supervision. The Senior Data Engineer identifies data and design issues before they affect downstream work and supports less experienced Data Engineers on the pod in developing the same judgment.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Design and build Databricks pipelines (Spark/PySpark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog) across Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers for financial and operational data sets.
* Own a defined workstream (e.g., a source system or a domain such as project financials) from intake through delivery, including testing and documentation.
* Participate actively in sprint planning and daily standups, surfacing risks and clarifying requirements rather than waiting for direction.
* Review code and output from Data Engineers on the pod and provide direct, constructive feedback.
* Implement and validate row-level and column-level security controls on owned data sets.
* Support the design, build and validation of Boomi-based and API-driven integrations  (e.g., JDE-Concur, JDE-UKG) including application-to-application data flows across enterprise systems.
* Understand and manage integration requirements such as source-to-target mapping, data transformation, validation, error handling, retries and reconciliation.
* Evaluate integration approaches and contribute to technical design decisions across Boomi, REST APIs and Databricks-based integration patterns.
* Partner with the Lead Engineer to break down larger backlog items into task-ready work.
* Identify and raise technical debt, data quality issues, or design gaps proactively, rather than deferring to QA.

**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience designing, building, and supporting at least one production integration that uses an API to create or update records in business applications other than Databricks. Ability to clearly articulate what you personally built, how the receiving application used the data, and how you verified the result.
* 5+ years of data engineering experience, including at least 2–3 years of hands-on Databricks experience (Spark/PySpark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog).
* Experience building pipelines from financial or ERP source systems — JD Edwards (JDE) directly preferred, with EcoSys or Microsoft Dynamics also relevant — including general ledger, cost, or project financial data.
* Strong SQL and Python skills, with the ability to own a pipeline end-to-end.
* Strong understanding of integration design, including data mapping, transformation, error handling, retries and reconciliation.
* Experience working in agile sprints with daily standups and sprint-based delivery.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate or Professional.
* Experience in a construction, EPC, energy, or other asset-heavy industry, particularly with cost-to-complete or earned value data.
* Experience implementing RLS/CLS security models in Unity Catalog.
* Familiarity with Databricks Genie (AI/BI) or Power BI reporting on governed Gold-layer data.
* Prior experience in a hybrid onshore/offshore delivery model.
* Hands-on experience with Boomi or a comparable iPaaS platform (pipeline build, deployment, monitoring).
* Familiarity with REST/webhook API integration patterns and file-based integration (EDI, flat file, CSV).

**Candidate Profile:**

* Defaults to asking questions when requirements are unclear rather than proceeding on assumptions.
* Prioritizes efficient resolution of ambiguity over continuing without clarity.
* Takes end-to-end ownership of assigned work and maintains a high quality bar without close supervision.
* Communicates clearly and directly with the Lead Engineer and, when required, the onshore team.
