jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model — it's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real-time, event-driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on.

  

Solace is the leading real-time data platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide — including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, Heineken, PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more — have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees.

  

So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology—and your hard work!

  

**About the role**

You will be the technical lead on Solace opportunities across Indian government bodies, public sector undertakings and the country's largest enterprises, working with Account Executives, system integrators and channel partners.

  

**What You’ll Do**

Be a trusted advisor, not just a demonstrator

* Partner with Account Executives to qualify opportunities, shape account strategies and drive deals to closure.
* Educate customers on event-driven architecture (EDA) and agentic AI, and challenge them to think bigger about their real-time data and AI strategy.
* Guide customers on integration patterns and modernization strategies, including the convergence of EDA and multi-agent AI systems.

  

Build champions and relationships

* Build deep relationships with technical and business stakeholders, from enterprise architects and CTOs to CIOs, department heads and programme officers, and turn users into advocates.
* Run on-site visits, regular check-ins and discovery sessions to stay aligned with evolving needs.
* Translate the Solace platform, from Event Broker to Agent Mesh, into outcomes customers care about.

  

Own technical validation and proof of value

* Lead demonstrations, Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Proofs of Value (PoVs) that map to customer objectives, including tender-mandated PoCs and bid-stage technical presentations.
* Own the evaluation process, guiding prospects through workshops, hands-on trials and technical validation.

  

Government and public sector engagement

Serve as the technical lead for Solace opportunities across central and state government departments, public sector undertakings (PSUs), regulators, defense and strategic establishments, smart-city programmes and government-owned platforms, typically alongside system integrators and channel partners.

* Translate programme requirements into validated event-driven and agentic AI solutions for use cases such as citizen and agency services, transport and aviation operations, logistics and sustainment, command-and-control style situational awareness, and real-time data exchange between departments.
* Position Solace Event Brokers, Event Mesh and Agent Mesh for on-premises, private-cloud and air-gapped deployments, including constrained or intermittently connected sites, and for hybrid deployments across state data centers and Indian cloud regions.
* Speak credibly to Indian security, data and compliance expectations, including MeitY cloud empanelment and GI Cloud (MeghRaj) hosting, the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, CERT-In directions, and sector rules such as RBI and SEBI requirements where public sector banks and market infrastructure are involved.
* Support government acquisition motions: respond to RFPs, RFIs and Expressions of Interest, write technical bid volumes and compliance matrices, handle pre-bid queries and corrigenda, and work within tender portals, GeM, GFR procurement norms and L1 and QCBS evaluation models.
* Understand Make in India public procurement preferences and local-content requirements, and help partners position Solace within them.
* Enable system integrators, OEM partners and channel partners (for example, national and global SIs with large public sector practices) so they can qualify, architect and deliver Solace-based solutions to government customers.
* Align Solace with national modernization priorities such as Digital India, data-centric and interoperable platforms, open standards, and responsible AI adoption.

  

Large enterprise engagement

Lead technical engagements with India's largest enterprises, where scale, resilience and regulatory pressure make real-time event infrastructure a board-level topic.

* **Banking, financial services and insurance (BFSI):** real-time payments and transaction flows, market data distribution, core banking modernization, fraud and risk signals, and AI agents for operations and customer service, within RBI, SEBI and IRDAI expectations on resilience, outsourcing and data localization.
* **Telecom and digital platforms:** real-time provisioning, recharge and balance events, customer 360 and channel modernization at very high volumes.
* **Aviation and transport:** airport and airline operations, flight and baggage events, and partner data exchange across heavily siloed ecosystems.
* **Manufacturing and energy:** plant-to-cloud event meshes, IoT and MQTT connectivity, supply chain visibility and Industry 4.0 programmes.
* **Logistics and retail:** shipment and fleet tracking, order orchestration and omnichannel inventory events.
* Help enterprises evolve beyond batch and request/response integration, and move from legacy middleware (IBM MQ, TIBCO, ESBs) towards a distributed, event-driven enterprise that can support real-time AI.
* Work with global system integrators and consulting partners that run large Indian enterprise transformation programmes.

  

Evangelise event-driven architecture

* Show deep command of core EDA concepts and patterns: publish/subscribe, event sourcing, CQRS, event streaming, and choreography versus orchestration, applied to real Indian enterprise and government architectures.
* Articulate the business value of EDA to executive and technical audiences: faster time-to-insight, operational resilience, accelerated digital transformation, and the ability to scale AI applications on a live data fabric.
* Position Solace Event Brokers against Apache Kafka, IBM MQ, RabbitMQ, TIBCO and cloud-native brokers, and against locally hosted open-source deployments that customers often start with. Be ready to explain where multi-protocol support, hybrid and multi-cloud event mesh, enterprise-grade QoS and dynamic topic routing create clear differentiation, and to defend total cost of ownership in L1-driven evaluations.
* Guide customers through an EDA maturity model, from point-to-point integration and basic messaging to a distributed, event-driven enterprise ready for real-time AI and autonomous systems.

  

Solace Agent Mesh subject matter expert

* Position Solace Agent Mesh Enterprise as the production-grade foundation for agentic AI, bridging event-driven infrastructure with LLM orchestration and multi-agent workflows.
* Show how Agent Mesh extends an existing Solace Event Mesh investment into agentic AI and shortens time-to-production for AI initiatives.
* Explain horizontal scalability, fault-tolerant asynchronous messaging and governance to technical teams and executives, including how agents can run with models and data kept inside the customer's own or sovereign environment.
* Develop use cases where real-time event triggers drive autonomous agent actions: banking operations and service, airport and airline disruption handling, supply chain and plant operations, citizen service workflows, and public infrastructure monitoring.
* Serve as the field voice for Agent Mesh adoption in India, feeding real use cases and objections back to Product and GTM teams.

jobs.title: Director of Technical Implementation, EMEA
jobs.description:
**Job Title:**
Director of Technical Implementation, EMEA
  
  
**Work Location:**
Dubai
  
  
**Job Summary:**
The Director of Technical Implementation, EMEA is responsible for leading and transforming the regional technical delivery organization into a scalable, high-performing, and standardized function. This role centralizes technical leadership across all countries (including UKI, ME, South Africa, Italy, France and DACH), establishing a unified operating model that ensures consistent implementation quality, strong governance, and measurable delivery outcomes across InterSystems EHR and HealthShare solutions.
  
  
The position drives operational efficiency through structured resource management, cross-regional collaboration, and the adoption of shared tools, reusable assets, and standardized processes. It enables the transition from country-based execution to a coordinated EMEA-wide delivery model, improving flexibility, utilization, and responsiveness to project demands.
  
  
In addition, the role plays a critical part in aligning technical delivery with quality objectives, ensuring each country can meet its project targets while benefiting from regional synergies. It is also accountable for embedding AI-driven methodologies, including the evolution of ARIES, into day-to-day delivery practices to enhance predictability, quality, and decision-making.
  
  
Overall, this position is key to improving customer outcomes, strengthening partner ecosystems, and building a future-ready technical implementation capability across EMEA.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead and unify all Technical Implementation teams across EMEA under a single functional structure, ensuring consistent standards and execution.
* Define and enforce technical implementation best practices, governance, and quality frameworks across all projects.
* Maintain strong alignment with country leadership, ensuring technical delivery supports each country in achieving its annual project targets while applying regional synergies and continuous improvements.
* Drive cross-country collaboration and resource optimization, enabling flexible deployment of technical expertise across the region.
* Own regional technical capacity planning, forecasting, and utilization, leveraging data and AI-driven insights.
* Oversee partner strategy and execution, including onboarding, performance management, and management alignment.
* Embed and scale the AI-powered ARIES methodology across all technical delivery activities.
* Establish and monitor KPIs related to delivery quality, efficiency, resource utilization, and partner performance.
* Support country Professional Services Directors in achieving project success, while maintaining strong technical oversight.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives, including reusable assets, automation, and standardization of deliverables.
* Act as a senior stakeholder in customer engagements, supporting critical projects and ensuring delivery excellence.

**Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of experience in technical delivery, implementation, or professional services leadership.
* Proven track record managing large-scale, complex, multi-country implementation programs.
* Strong background in healthcare IT or enterprise software implementation environments.
* Deep understanding of technical architectures, integration, and data platforms.
* Experience with resource management, forecasting, and operational optimization at scale.
* Demonstrated ability to lead organizational transformation and drive standardization.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills in a matrix environment.
* Experience working with partners and external delivery ecosystems.
* Strategic mindset with the ability to translate vision into execution.
* Ability to travel internationally 60% of the time.

**Education and Training:**

* Relevant University technical Degree
* Proficiency in English

**Key Success Factors:**

* Improved delivery predictability and quality across EMEA
* Increased resource utilization and cross-regional efficiency
* Strong partner performance and optimization
* Effective adoption of AI-driven implementation practices
* Scalable and standardized technical delivery model across EMEA markets

**About InterSystems**
InterSystems, a creative data technology provider, delivers a unified foundation for next-generation applications for healthcare, finance, manufacturing, and supply chain customers in more than 80 countries. Our data platforms solve interoperability, speed, and scalability problems for large organizations around the globe to unlock the power of data and allow people to perceive data in imaginative ways. Established in 1978, InterSystems is committed to excellence through its 24×7 support for customers and partners around the world. Privately held and headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, InterSystems has 38 offices in 28 countries worldwide. For more information, please visit
**InterSystems.com**
.
  
  
**AI Disclaimer**
InterSystems may use AI tools for its internal operations including administrative tasks during recruitment (e.g., organizing candidate information). InterSystems’ approach to AI is guided by the InterSystems Responsible AI Guidelines. AI is not used to make or influence hiring decisions. All decisions are made by InterSystems employees.
  
  
Candidates may use AI for CV or interview preparation, provided materials are truthful and reflect their own experience. AI tools and third-party transcription services must not be used during interviews or assessments.
  
  
Please note that the use of wearable technology, including any AI-related tools or other technology-connected devices (such as META or Google smart glasses and/or wearables, and/or any similar devices), is
*strictly prohibited*
during the interview and screening process with InterSystems. Any applicant who requires a wearable device or any type of technology support during the interview process as a reasonable accommodation under the ADA or applicable state or country laws and regulations must contact the InterSystems Human Resources Department
*prior*
to attending or participating in any interview or screening process.

**Head of Project Delivery**
to join a leading international organisation and provide senior leadership across the construction and delivery of large-scale energy projects.

The role will work closely with SPV CEOs, Project Directors, JV partners, EPC contractors, lenders and other key stakeholders.

• Build new partnerships and distribution arrangements

• Be the single senior point of contact for partners on underwriting, pricing and service issues, and resolve escalations quickly.

**Owning the cross-functional drive**

• Own end-to-end delivery of what the segment needs from other functions, not only the underwriting decision.

• Technology: set and drive the segment's requirements for quote-and-bind tools, broker portals, underwriting rules engines, automation and MI; prioritise and follow through on delivery.

• Build and own a multi-year growth and profitability plan for Individual and SME Health, Liva's key strategic segment.

• Define where to grow: target customer segments, industries, scheme sizes and channels.

• Own underwriting guidelines, risk appetite and authority limits for the segment, in line with reinsurance treaties.

• Approve cases and renewals above the Health UW Manager's authority.

• Ensure full compliance with regulatory requirements, internal policies and audit standards.

Team leadership

• Lead, coach and develop the Health UW Manager (Individual & SME) and, through them, the underwriting team.

• Build technical depth, a commercial mindset and succession within the team.

**Qualifications**

• More than 10 years of health insurance experience in the UAE market, with a strong track record in Individual and SME health

• An established network among UAE brokers and distribution partners, with relationships that can be activated from day one

• Proven experience leading teams across underwriting and operations (and ideally other functions such as sales support or customer service)

• Experience working closely with actuarial, medical, reinsurance and technology teams to deliver business outcomes

• Sound knowledge of UAE health insurance regulations, including DHA and DOH requirements

**Key Competencies & Skills**

• Strategic and commercial judgment: builds a segment plan and balances growth with profitability

• Strong technical underwriting and data-driven decision making

• Relationship building and influence across functions and with external partners

• Clear communication and negotiation skills

• People leadership and coaching

• Process improvement mindset and comfort with digital underwriting tools

CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14.68 billion and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi.com.
  
  
Position: Director – Product Engineering Capability
  
  
Experience: 20+years
  
  
Category:
  
  
Shift Timing: General Shift
  
  
Location: Chennai
  
  
Position ID: J1126-0178
  
  
Employment Type: Full Time
  
  
Job Description:
  
  
CGI Advantage is a large enterprise product portfolio supporting complex government operations across Financials, HRM/Payroll, Procurement, Framework, Analytics and related capabilities.
  
  
As we evolve our Product Engineering organization toward stronger end-to-end Build & Run accountability, we are looking for a Director – Product Engineering Capability to build and sustain the functional, domain and specialist capabilities required across the Advantage portfolio.
  
  
The Director will be accountable for ensuring that Advantage has the right capability, in the right roles, at the right level of maturity, when the business needs it. The role will establish common capability standards, strengthen domain and functional depth, build leadership and specialist pipelines, reduce critical-person dependencies and enable scarce expertise to be leveraged effectively across products.
  
  
This is not a traditional learning or training role. It is a senior Product Engineering leadership position working closely with Product Engineering Directors, Product Leaders and functional leaders to ensure that the organization has the capability required to deliver product outcomes today while building the skills required for the future.
  
  
Your future duties and responsibilities
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Capability Strategy & Workforce Readiness
  
  

* Define the capability strategy and operating model across critical Product Engineering roles including functional/product roles, business analysis, domain SMEs, solution architecture and specialist engineering disciplines.
* Translate product strategy, roadmap, modernization, SaaS, cloud and AI priorities into future capability requirements.
* Develop product- and portfolio-level capability maps identifying critical skills, capacity risks, succession gaps and future capability needs.
* Ensure persistent/core capabilities and shared specialist capabilities are appropriately identified and developed.

Role & Competency Model
  
  

* Establish clear role charters, competency expectations and proficiency models for critical roles.
* Create consistent expectations across Product Lines while allowing appropriate domain specialization.
* Define career and progression pathways that build deep functional, domain and technical expertise.

Talent Depth & Succession
  
  

* Build strong pipelines for critical roles and reduce dependence on individual experts.
* Drive succession and readiness planning for business-critical positions.
* Enable mobility of talent and specialist expertise across Product Lines.
* Partner with Engineering Directors and leadership on build/buy/borrow decisions for emerging capability requirements.

Capability Excellence & Communities
  
  

* Establish and strengthen communities of practice and capability forums across Advantage.
* Drive common methods, standards, reusable patterns, templates, accelerators and knowledge assets.
* Promote adoption of leading engineering, solutioning, analysis and product practices across teams.
* Ensure lessons and capabilities developed in one Product Line can be effectively leveraged across the broader portfolio.

Transformation & Future Skills
  
  

* Lead capability transformation required for the evolving Build & Run model.
* Accelerate skills in AI-assisted engineering, cloud/SaaS, automation, modern architecture, product engineering and data-driven delivery.
* Identify opportunities where capability improvements can materially improve quality, productivity, predictability and engineering effectiveness.

jobs.title: Principal Consultant - Financial Crime, Risk, Regulation and Finance Function
jobs.description:
*Joining Capco means joining an organisation that is committed to an inclusive working environment where you’re encouraged to #BeYourselfAtWork. We celebrate individuality and recognize that diversity and inclusion, in all forms, is critical to success. It’s important to us that we recruit and develop as diverse a range of talent as we can and we believe that everyone brings something different to the table – so we’d love to know what makes you different. Such differences may mean we need to make changes to our process to allow you the best possible platform to succeed, and we are happy to cater to any reasonable adjustments you may require. You will find the section to let us know of these at the bottom of your application form or you can mention it directly to your recruiter at any stage and they will be happy to help.*
**About Capco**
Capco is a global technology and business consultancy, focused on the financial services sector. We are passionate about helping our clients succeed in an ever-changing industry.
  
  
**We Are**

* Experts in capital markets, banking and payments, insurance and wealth and asset management
* Deep knowledge in financial services offering, including e.g. Finance, Risk and Compliance, Financial Crime, Resilience etc.
* Committed to growing our business and hiring the best talent to help us get there
* Focus on maintaining our nimble, agile and entrepreneurial culture

**Role Description**
We are looking to recruit Financial Crime, Sanctions and Fraud transformation candidates across different senior levels into our growing Financial Crime, Risk, Regulation and Finance capability.
  
  
**Requirements**
Successful candidates will be involved in advising on financial crime risk management and delivering transformation across AML/KYC, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions and Fraud. The role will entail working across all types of financial institutions in the market to help them navigate and deliver against key regulatory requirements and business objectives. This would range across:
  
  

* Supporting our clients to achieve compliance with regulatory obligations, including dealing with remediation and response to regulatory reviews.
* Transforming and automating financial crime, sanctions and fraud operating models and processes through the implementation of new technologies (e.g. AI) that can bring a holistic and faster approach to identifying and managing financial crime, sanctions and fraud risk, whilst delivering cost optimisation for our clients.
* Analysing our clients’ capabilities and finding opportunities to save costs and improve risk management through innovation within existing anti-financial crime and anti-fraud functions
* Assessing, benchmarking, and re-designing financial crime and fraud target operating models and controls, identifying weaknesses and proposing improvements.
* Supporting clients in dealing with operational backlogs (e.g. KYC files and alerts).
* Sourcing and implementing technology solutions for KYC, TM, Sanctions and Fraud.

**Skills & Expertise**

* A good understanding of the wider picture of financial crime, sanctions and fraud including regulatory requirements, risk assessment, KYC and how all components interrelate and support each other across the three lines of defence.
* Experience of delivering automation and transformation using AI
* Financial crime tooling and processes (across risk assessment, screening, transaction monitoring, KYC/CDD),
* Fraud (detection, prevention, response)
* Sanctions regimes, including tooling and processes

This will be coupled with strong change management experience (preferably Agile certifications) and prior success, either as a management consultant or within a change role in a financial services institution.
  
  

* This role allows you to deliver as part of a long-term strategic partnership with our clients, whilst developing within a forward thinking and entrepreneurial business.
* An understanding of the key market, global and regulatory drivers shaping the financial crime and the wider industry and an ability to articulate these by way of opportunities for consulting firms to support the industry.
* Proven expertise delivering change and lead transformation programmes
* Self-starter and strong team player.
* Strong interpersonal & written communication skills.
* Strong problem-solving skills and an analytical mind-set.
* Demonstrable expertise in building and leveraging relationships.
* To be able to face off to key stakeholders with strong credibility.
* The ability to present to a wide range of stakeholder from AVP to senior MDs.

**Other Expectations**

* To balance client delivery with supporting development of new client opportunities or market propositions and proactive sales efforts within Financial Crime team.

**For senior level candidates**

* Mentor and coach other members of the team.
* Solution development, showing a clear ability as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) to enhance existing propositions, and develop new ones.
* People management, building a team of consultants with the right mix of grades, skills and experience to support client opportunities and projected growth.
* Develop, drive and convert a pipeline of opportunities and lead on RFP responses.
* Fulfil a key role in account and proposition development within Market Domains and Key Client Accounts, assisting senior management to increase revenue.
* Formulate propositions and solutions that meet client requirements in addition to managing and directing pursuit activity.
* Strong bid management abilities, with a proven ability to mentor and train Consultants.
* Drive thought leadership and client campaigns
* Build and maintain strong client relationships within the sector, leveraging proven industry content and delivery capability.

**WHY JOIN CAPCO?**
You will work on engaging projects with some of the largest banks in the world, on projects that will transform the financial services industry.
  
  
**We Offer**

* A work culture focused on innovation and building lasting value for our clients and employees
* Ongoing learning opportunities to help you acquire new skills or deepen existing expertise
* A flat, non-hierarchical structure that will enable you to work with senior partners and directly with clients
* A diverse, inclusive, meritocratic culture

jobs.title: Vice President, Deal Advisory & Research COE
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

* Lead the ESG & Sustainable Finance Research Centre of Excellence in Bangalore, setting its strategic direction, operating model and research agenda, and building a scalable team that supports senior decision-making, client engagement and business development across the Bank.
* Own delivery governance, stakeholder alignment, quality assurance and capability development for ESG and sustainable-finance research, ensuring outputs are commercially relevant, evidence-based, consistent and suitable for senior internal and external audiences.
* Act as a senior adviser to Coverage, Sustainable Finance, product and regional teams, translating complex sustainability, transition, regulatory and market developments into sector perspectives, financing implications and actionable client opportunities.
* Combine deep ESG and sustainable-finance expertise with strong corporate finance, valuation and analytical judgement to connect material sustainability factors with business strategy, financial performance, capital allocation, risk and financing requirements.
* Lead collaboration across markets and time zones, prioritising the COE portfolio, allocating resources and ensuring effective delivery against agreed service standards and strategic priorities.
* Drive innovation in research methodologies, ESG data, knowledge management and responsible use of AI-enabled tools while maintaining appropriate controls for confidentiality, accuracy, attribution, bias and human review.
* Build a high-performing and inclusive team, with clear accountability, coaching, succession planning and structured development pathways for Band 6 managers and research professionals.
* The role is expected to operate flexibly across India, Singapore, UK, UAE and other relevant markets to support global stakeholders and priority deliverables.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Set the COE strategy, annual plan, thematic research agenda and measures of success in alignment with CIB, Coverage and Sustainable Finance priorities.
* Lead a multidisciplinary team delivering ESG and sustainable-finance market intelligence, sector research, transition-pathway analysis, company perspectives and client-ready insights.
* Own senior stakeholder engagement and demand governance, converting business priorities into a transparent delivery portfolio and resolving competing requirements across markets and products.
* Provide senior review and challenge of sustainable, transition and sustainability-linked finance frameworks, including use-of-proceeds, KPI selection, targets, credibility considerations and market comparability.
* Ensure ESG analysis is integrated with corporate finance, valuation, credit and capital-structure considerations to support differentiated client dialogue and commercially relevant recommendations.
* Oversee executive briefings, sector outlooks, thematic papers, client materials and thought leadership, with accountability for quality, balance, traceability and timely delivery.
* Establish and maintain robust standards for research methodology, source validation, ESG data use, citations, peer review, sign-off, confidentiality and records management.
* Identify and manage greenwashing, reputational, conduct, data, methodology and operational risks, escalating material concerns and ensuring assumptions and limitations are transparent.
* Build partnerships with internal experts and approved external data and research providers to strengthen sector knowledge, market coverage and analytical depth.
* Drive technology enablement, automation, reusable content and responsible AI adoption to improve productivity, consistency and scalability of the COE.

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.

This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

* Internal stakeholders

* Excel / Financial Modelling
* Stakeholder management
* Project Management
* Market intelligence and sector research
* Business analytics and insight generation
* Advanced Microsoft Office suite skills; Proficient with Bloomberg, S&P / Capital IQ, LSEG, Mergermarket and/or other platforms/databases;
* Superior analytical aptitude and creative problem-solving abilities.

* Demonstrated experience establishing or leading a research, advisory or analytics capability and managing senior professionals across complex, multi-market portfolios.
* Deep knowledge of sustainable-finance instruments and frameworks, transition planning, sector pathways, ESG data and evolving policy, regulatory and disclosure regimes.
* Excellent PowerPoint and Excel skills with a proven ability to create client-ready outputs
* Experience with various MDS tools such as Bloomberg, Capital IQ, Market, Wood Mackenzie, etc
* Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and manage teams in high-pressure environments.
* Deep expertise in corporate finance, valuation, and financial modelling.
* Excellent stakeholder management, strong communication and presentation skills with proven experience in delivering C-level presentations.
* Financial Modelling and Accounting

jobs.title: Sr Client Consulting Manager (Cards Benefits/vendor management/ Operations Lead)
jobs.description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Overview**
**Job Description**
Visa Consulting & Analytics (VCA) is Visa's consulting division, serving Visa's clients (including card issuers, acquirers and merchants) and solving their strategic problems focused on improving performance. Drawing on our expertise in strategy consulting, payments, data analytics, marketing, operational and macroeconomics, VCA drives high impact and tangible financial results.
  
  
Cards benefits team within VCA manages the deployment of cards benefits programs for Visa’s clients in AP. This is to support Visa’s clients with differentiated card propositions and stay relevant to and drive preference amongst consumers.
  
  
As a Senior Manager, Operations – Card Benefits, you will define and drive the regional operations strategy for Visa’s card benefits program. You’ll lead transformation initiatives that establish scalable operating frameworks, enhance delivery performance, and strengthen cross-market collaboration. This role is ideal for a strategic operator and people leader who thrives in ambiguity, brings structure to complexity, and inspires a team to achieve sustainable, high-impact outcomes.
  
  
This role involves a significant component of cross-functional work and will require the Senior Manager to work closely with the VCA market teams, Product, Sourcing and partners to streamline operations across AP.
  
  
**What a Senior Manager Does At Visa**
In this role, you are expected to:
  
  

* Shape and Scale Operations: Lead the transformation of Visa’s card benefits operations across Asia Pacific, designing scalable frameworks, automation opportunities, and governance models to support long-term growth.
* Own Client Onboarding and Delivery: Oversee onboarding for new clients, managing vendor relationships, contracts, and financial processes—including POs, renewals, and top-ups—to ensure seamless implementation.
* Operational Intelligence and Insight: Define and implement analytics and reporting frameworks that provide visibility into performance, benefits utilisation, and commercial optimisation opportunities.
* Drive Financial Discipline: Oversee billing, revenue, and expense recognition, ensuring accurate and efficient financial management across multiple markets.
* Vendor and Partner Leadership: Build and manage strategic vendor partnerships, driving consistency, efficiency, and value across service delivery.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with key internal stakeholders—such as finance, sourcing and legal—to optimise processes and enhance operational outcomes.
* Build Capabilities and Lead Talent: Recruit, lead, and develop a high-performing operations team, championing a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Strategic Advisor: Act as a trusted advisor to regional leadership and market leads on operational strategy, cost optimization, and delivery excellence. Ensure at all times timely and relevant communication.
* Lead Through Ambiguity: Navigate complex, evolving business contexts with agility and composure, bringing clarity, alignment, and focus to teams and stakeholders.
* Champion Innovation: Lead or support special projects that modernise processes, expand services, and enhance client and cardholder experiences across Asia Pacific.
* Client Relationship Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for market teams and issuing/acquiring/merchant/fintech bank clients across assigned markets, building trusted, long-term partnerships and ensuring high levels of satisfaction and retention
* Stakeholder Coordination: Collaborate closely with internal teams - including product, operations, sourcing, and legal to ensure seamless onboarding, implementation, and ongoing delivery of benefits services
* Kssue Resolution: Proactively address and resolve client concerns, operational challenges, or service escalations to maintain strong relationships and protect the company’s reputation.

**Projects You Will Be a Part Of**
You’ll spearhead the delivery of Visa’s premium card benefits helping issuers enhance customer value, deepen engagement, and differentiate in competitive markets.
  
  

* Work with the Consulting and Product team to operationalize card benefits program that can help us transform the way issuer and Visa drive PV and engagement amongst Visa cardholders
* Development and maintenance of relationships with merchants and third-party suppliers
* Negotiation of terms and agreements to secure relevant benefits for Visa’s clients at compelling terms to ensure card benefits provision drives payment volume as well as Value Added Service revenue.
* Collaborate with stakeholders within VCA, Regional Products & Solutions, and in-market counterparts to align benefits with business goals and strategies
* Monitor and evaluate the performance of secured benefits, report on these findings and make recommend changes to strategy as may be necessary to clients
* Manage the budget, financial planning and forecasting for benefits.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**
What you will need:
  
  

* Minimum 8+ years of experience in financial services or consulting or loyalty programs across operations and execution
* Minimum 6+ years of strong experience utilizing analytical and project management skills
* Ability to build and maintain professional relationships, with proven negotiation and communication skills, used to secure deals and offers, ideally from merchants and third parties
* Strong team player internally and with clients, working independently to coordinate cross functional activities, obtaining critical support from multiple stakeholders
* Proven ability to define operational strategy and build scalable processes for long-term success
* Deep experience managing vendors, contracts, and commercial negotiations, including rate setting and performance review
* Strong financial acumen to manage budgets, forecasts, and multi-market billing accuracy
* Demonstrated success as a people leader, fostering high-performing, collaborative, and empowered teams.

**What Will Also Help**

* Master’s Degree in business, engineering or a related field
* Experience in consulting, managed services, or large-scale operations within payments or financial services
* Familiarity with card products, loyalty programs, or premium benefit ecosystems
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office and analytical tools
* Proven experience leading automation, transformation, or process redesign initiatives

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.title: Lead Architect/Senior Associate Director
jobs.description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
  
  
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Solution Architecture
  
  
Ready to set the architecture direction for HSBC’s CTO Platforms domain?
  
  
Why HSBC
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
Join CTO Platforms to shape the architectural direction for a value stream or domain within a large regulated bank. This role sets target and transition architectures and keeps delivery aligned to reference architectures, standards and guardrails. You’ll represent architecture in governance and Design Authority forums, presenting options and trade-offs and helping decisions land clearly. The role also focuses on cross-programme dependencies and early risk identification so delivery stays coherent across teams. You’ll influence strategic initiatives including Compass and the AI/GenAI agenda by promoting shared platforms and governed capabilities. Success looks like simpler, reusable and well-controlled technology outcomes that engineering teams can deliver with clarity and pace.
  
  
What you'll be doing
  
  

* Set architectural direction for an assigned value stream or domain aligned to target architecture, reference architectures, standards and guardrails
* Produce and maintain target and transition architectures with clear sequencing, dependencies, decision points and interim guardrails
* Represent architecture in governance and Design Authority forums, presenting options, trade-offs, recommendations and exception impacts
* Identify and manage cross-programme architectural dependencies, risks and constraints and escalate early to support timely decisions
* Embed alignment to Group architecture strategy and standards including Build vs Buy, reuse, simplification and control-by-design
* Shape architectural direction for strategic R&C initiatives including Compass and the AI/GenAI agenda to converge on shared platforms and governed capabilities
* Translate architectural direction into solution designs with engineering teams using patterns, non-functional requirements and guardrails to maintain delivery alignment
* Strengthen solution architecture capability across engineering through coaching, quality reviews and communities of practice

What we're looking for
  
  

* Bring extensive experience as a solution, domain or enterprise architect in a large complex and regulated organisation
* Demonstrate defining target-state architectures and translating them into transition states, roadmaps and decision frameworks
* Show strong experience reviewing solution designs and articulating options, trade-offs and recommendations based on evidence and standards
* Apply broad understanding of modern application, integration, data and cloud architectures including APIs, event-driven patterns, microservices, CI/CD and operational non-functional requirements
* Embed security, resilience, privacy, records management and auditability requirements into designs and delivery workflows
* Apply Build vs Buy, reuse, simplification and technology rationalisation including assessing Low-Code/No-Code and third-party options
* Use working knowledge of AI and GenAI architecture including responsible adoption, platform integration, data and knowledge foundations, governance, monitoring and evidence
* Operate effectively in senior governance forums and across geographically distributed teams with clear stakeholder management and influencing
* Communicate complex technology choices clearly through concise architecture artefacts for business and technology audiences

Building coherent platforms at scale
  
  
If you want to shape how platforms evolve across a complex environment this role offers the scope to make a visible difference. You’ll help teams converge on shared architectures that are easier to deliver, operate and govern. You’ll bring clarity to decisions that cut across programmes and turn architectural intent into practical delivery guardrails. If this aligns with the work you want to do next we’d welcome your application.
  
  
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
  
  
www.hsbc.com/careers
  
  
HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”

We achieve this through our leading cloud-based spend management platform that empowers hundreds of the world's most admired brands to effectively manage all categories of spend and all suppliers to increase profitability, improve ESG (environmental, social, and corporate governance) performance, lower risk, and improve productivity. They bridge the gap between technology and finance, helping prospective and existing customers quantify and track the hard business impact of digital procurement transformations.

jobs.title: Manager, Tax Process Strategy & Solutions
jobs.description:
The Tax Process Strategy & Solutions Manager supports process leads and the Tax Practice to understand how one or more product(s) fit into the overall “vision” for one or more business area(s). The ideal candidate will be a self-directed problem solver with an ownership mindset and will have: (a) extensive experience independently preparing and reviewing complex Form 1040 and 1041 tax returns, as well as having handled and advised on diverse issues and complexities (federal, state and foreign) arising from ownership of complex flowthrough (partnership, S-Corporation) operating businesses, real estate entities, fund of funds, hedge funds and private equity; and (b) played a key hand in technology, tax research, process improvement or workpaper standardization initiatives: whether at the practice, region or market level, or within the context of one or more large or complex engagements.

* Bachelor's degree (preference given to accounting, business or technology major)
* Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Chartered Accountant (CA), Enrolled Agent (EA) or JD, or actively pursuing

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**

* Minimum of 10 years’ experience having done tax compliance and advisory for high net-worth individuals within mid to large size public account firms (required).

* Advanced SQL: Expert-level capability in complex joins, common table expressions, window functions, stored procedures, query optimization, large-volume analysis, reconciliation, data profiling, and investigation queries.
* Cloud: Mandatory delivery experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS, or GCP, covering solution design, deployment, data services, security, monitoring, integration, scalability, and operational support.

**Mandatory Financial Crime domain knowledge (2 or more mandatory)**

**About Us:**

Opensity Solutions is the largest tech‑enabled managed services organization serving leading law firms, financial institutions and professional services firms. At Opensity, we provide integrated operational platforms, automation and advisory services that enable clients to modernize operating models, reduce cost and accelerate growth. Our capabilities include IT and technology solutions, document processing and administrative support, marketing and communications, billing and AP/AR services, records and information governance, workflow automation, consulting and hospitality and facilities services.

**Our Mission:**

Our mission is to provide modernized technology platforms, elevated technology support, and valuable insights, empowering our clients to excel in what they do best.

Opensity Solutions delivers technology projects for professional services and enterprise clients. Our Project Managers own those projects — scope, commitments, budget, and the client relationship — and they are at their best when they are spending their time there, rather than rebuilding a resource schedule or chasing a missing time entry. The PMO Delivery Operations Coordinator takes that resource coordination load off them.

You will own the resource assignment and scheduling process across the projects you support: building and maintaining schedules against planned effort, processing modifications and confirming their downstream impact, monitoring availability and over-allocation across both project and support demand, and improving how scheduling works over time.

And you will assist Project Managers with project plans, WBS structures, task records, RIDAC logs, change order documentation, recurring reporting, and meeting materials, working at their direction and with their approval.

We are looking for someone with 1–3 years in project coordination, project support, PMO analyst, scheduling, or project administration on technology projects, with hands-on exposure to a PPM platform — ServiceNow strongly preferred.

Experience with resource scheduling or assignment is the closest match to the core of this role, and experience reviewing timekeeping or billing data for accuracy is a significant advantage. Success here takes exceptional attention to detail, the willingness to hold peers to a standard, and sound judgment about which calls are yours and which belong to the Project Manager.

jobs.description:
**Financial Advisory Service Offerings**
----------------------------------------

Teneo guides companies and their stakeholders through periods of uncertainty and stress to assess options, address financing and/or balance sheet stresses, create liquidity headroom, reduce costs, improve profitability, more efficiently run their businesses and turnaround and/or exit underperforming businesses, whilst communicating appropriately with stakeholders. Our expert team also brings market-leading experience in developing and delivering contingency plans and insolvencies across multiple jurisdictions, providing credible fallback plans to protect value or helping to shape and affect a restructuring.

We advise clients on strategies and actions to create, protect and realize value across the full spectrum of stressed or distressed transactions and industries, while helping leaders solve complex business challenges and achieve their goals. No two situations are the same, and our advice and approach is tailored to each set of circumstances and client priorities.

**The Role**
------------

As part of ambitious growth plans for our already successful Middle East Financial Advisory business, we are looking for Managers, Associate Directors, Directors and Managing Directors to join our Financial Advisory team in the UAE. Our Managers, Associate Directors, Directors and Managing Directors have the opportunity to lead on a diverse range of engagements across different sectors and geographies, with responsibility for leading projects or key workstreams, managing junior staff and supporting senior leadership in client-facing delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Client service

* Lead and/or manage key parts of engagements, providing support to senior team members or often directly to the Senior Managing Directors.
* Support client management teams in preparing and challenging business plans, short and/or longer term cash flow forecasts and restructuring plans.
* Providing cash management services to clients to identify working capital and other cash flow improvements.
* Reviewing and stress-testing integrated business plans, budgeting and forecasting models using a fact-based, data driven approach, including KPI definition, data visualization, reporting automation and touchless forecasting.
* Reviewing detailed, integrated 3 statement forecasts (profit & loss, cashflow and balance sheet), and discounted cashflow (DCF).
* Preparing report outputs that may range from business plan documentation and board reports when working for a company, through to preparation of independent business reviews when working for creditors.
* Developing, analysing and presenting restructuring, refinancing and/or insolvency options using input from other teams, e.g. insolvency or tax analysis, sector and financial modelling.
* Liaising with the Company’s legal advisors to understand key aspects of legal documentation and also drive any documentation processes (term sheets, waivers, loan documentation etc.).
* Preparation of engagement letter(s) and ensuring adherence to all compliance requirements to support financial and risk management.
* Apply an understanding of engagement economics.

Knowledge acquisition

* Build client relationship skills, sector knowledge and continue to develop leadership skills.
* Continue to build technical expertise, broader business advisory and people management skills.
* Understand the market, topical issues and our Financial Advisory propositions.

People and leadership

* Support practice and talent development.
* Provide on-job coaching and development to staff.
* Develop junior staff outside of jobs through appraising and mentoring.
* Support wider Financial Advisory training initiatives.
* Manage diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognised for their contribution.

Business development

* Own elements of business development including actively supporting business development activities, building and expending your own contact network and supporting Middle East Financial Advisory marketing and sales activities.
* Participate in existing business development programmes and key client accounts.
* Identify opportunities to expand jobs as well as opportunities to provide wider Teneo services to existing clients.
* Take responsibility for leading marketing initiatives aimed at specific channels to market, or events.

Examples of the types of projects you would be expected to work on include:

* Company diagnostic, turnaround planning, and implementation
* Debt restructuring
* Short-term cash flow forecasting and cash management office set-up
* Preparation and validation of business plans
* Independent business reviews and options analysis
* Working capital management
* Operational cost reduction
* Interim management and active PMO leadership

**Key Skills & Experience**
---------------------------

Basic Qualifications

* A minimum of 5 years Financial Advisory experience gained either as an advisor within a professional services company, consultancy or investment bank.
* Very strong analytical skills, including: business analytics, business planning, short term cash flows, financing options.
* Understanding of financial statements and related data to assess historical financial performance and future outlook for client companies and prospects.
* Good understanding of the Financial Advisory marketplace, its trends, and key players (principals and advisers).
* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* Strong project management skills, with ability to lead mid-large teams and develop people.
* Understanding of debt markets, banking, loan agreements and other relevant financial and legal documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

* An Accounting degree and/or Qualified Accountant.
* Arabic language skills are strongly preferred, but not mandatory.
* Experience in the UAE or KSA market is strongly preferred.

**About Teneo**
---------------

Teneo is a leading global financial advisory powerhouse that provides innovative, market leading solutions from recognized experts across offices in the UK, US, The Caribbean and Bermuda, Europe, Middle East, Australia, and Asia Pacific, supported by Teneo’s wider global offering of c.2,000 professionals. We offer our clients unique, integrated solutions to complex issues.

Teneo’s full range of advisory services includes strategic communications, investor relations, financial advisory and restructuring, management consulting, physical and cyber risk, organisational design, board and executive search, geopolitics and government affairs. The breadth of our offering and our ability to provide bespoke and seamless advisory services, on either a standalone or integrated basis, makes us truly unique. Teneo's Middle East Financial Advisory senior leadership team has worked on the majority of the largest and most complex situations completed in the Middle East over the past 2 decades.

jobs.title: Head of New Verticals Business Planning and Performance
jobs.description:
**Our Global Structure**

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

**The Team**

Deliveroo is on a mission to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders.

Our Grocery & Retail team manages Deliveroo's Grocery and non-food Retail businesses. We work closely with our partners and cross-functional teams to drive growth, strengthen the customer proposition and improve business performance.

As the scale and complexity of Grocery & Retail continues to grow, the Strategy & Performance function plays a central role in setting market strategy, leading business planning, embedding strong performance management and ensuring we continue to improve the customer experience.

**The Role**

The Head of Strategy & Performance, New Verticals - Middle East is responsible for setting the strategic direction of Deliveroo's Grocery and non-food Retail business and ensuring we translate that strategy into measurable growth and performance.

This is a high-impact leadership role with significant exposure to senior local and global stakeholders, sitting at the centre of some of the most important decisions shaping the future of Grocery & Retail in the Middle East. You will work closely with the Director of Grocery & Retail and wider leadership team across strategy, business planning, performance, customer value proposition and high-priority cross-functional initiatives.

You will lead two core functions: Strategy & Performance and Category Management, setting their direction, building strong teams and bringing together data, customer insight and commercial context to determine where we should focus, what needs to change and how we deliver against our ambitions. Through Category Management, you will shape the customer proposition across key levers including conversion, selection, catalogue quality, pricing, promotions and merchandising, ensuring priorities translate into tangible improvements across the customer journey.

The role combines big-picture strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You will need to be equally comfortable defining long-term priorities, diagnosing why the business is performing the way it is, influencing senior stakeholders and getting into the details to unblock complex initiatives.

You will directly manage the Strategy & Performance Manager and Senior Category Manager, with the wider Category Management team also sitting within your organisation.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* **Own Grocery & Retail strategy and planning:** Set the strategic direction for Grocery and non-food Retail, lead annual and quarterly planning, identify and size the biggest growth opportunities, and partner closely with Finance to translate strategic priorities into financial plans, business cases and clear targets.
* **Drive business performance:** Own the overall performance framework for Grocery & Retail, ensuring leadership understands what is driving performance and where action is required. Set the direction for WBRs, MBRs and performance diagnostics, and build a strong culture of accountability and follow-through.
* **Shape the customer proposition and Category Management agenda:** Own the overarching CVP strategy and set the direction for Category Management across key levers including selection, availability, pricing, promotions, merchandising, catalogue quality and conversion. Ensure priorities are grounded in customer behaviour, commercial performance and competitor insights.
* **Lead high-impact strategic initiatives:** Take ownership of complex, cross-functional opportunities and problems that do not naturally sit within one team, from initial diagnosis and strategic direction through to alignment, delivery and handover into BAU.
* **Lead and develop high-performing teams:** Lead the Strategy & Performance and Category Management functions, directly managing the Strategy & Performance Manager and Senior Category Manager. Set clear priorities, coach and develop the team, and build the capabilities, tools and operating models needed for both functions to scale effectively.
* **Influence senior stakeholders and shape decisions:** Act as a strategic partner to the Director of Grocery & Retail and wider leadership team, representing Grocery & Retail in key local and central discussions and shaping decisions on the business's most important strategic priorities.

**Qualifications:**

* 6+ years of experience in Strategy & Operations, strategy, consulting, investment banking, commercial, growth or business operations, ideally in a high-growth technology, marketplace or startup environment; experience in on-demand delivery, Grocery, Retail or digital category management is a strong advantage.
* Strong commercial and analytical judgement, with the ability to understand business performance, diagnose root causes and make clear recommendations grounded in data and commercial context.
* Strong ability to structure ambiguity, taking broad or loosely defined business problems, framing the problem clearly, identifying the right questions and translating them into a practical strategy and execution plan.
* Strong influencer and relationship builder, able to bring senior and cross-functional stakeholders on the journey, communicate in a way that resonates with different audiences and drive alignment without relying on formal authority.
* Proven end-to-end execution capability, including mobilising the right teams and resources, securing investment or headcount where needed, removing blockers and driving complex initiatives through to measurable outcomes.
* Proven people leadership experience, with the ability to set clear direction, develop high-performing teams, coach managers and build the capabilities and ways of working needed for teams to scale effectively.
* Strong data literacy and comfort using analytical and AI tools to accelerate analysis, problem-solving and decision-making; experience with tools such as Looker, Cursor, Claude or similar is an advantage.

**Benefits and Diversity**

* Annual Holiday Leave
* Annual flight allowance
* Free Deliveroo Plus - Free delivery and access to special offers
* Enhanced Maternity & Paternity benefits
* End of year parties & regular social events
* An extremely fun team to work alongside!

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business, and we prioritize their welfare. We offer many great benefits in areas including health insurance, family, financial coverage, community, convenience, growth opportunities, time away, and relocation.

We believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgment when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion, or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing start-ups around.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**  
  
At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.
